### [1] [STATERA: Hidden Mass Estimation via Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Kinematics using Frozen Temporal Tubelets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00003)
*Animesh Varma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 STATERA，通过适配冻结权重的预训练视频骨干（V-JEPA）与轻量时序 tubelet 混合器，从短单目视频预测不透明非对称刚体的质心位置，并构建 HiddenMass Benchmark 验证其在仿真与真实场景中的表现，发现相位感知监督能促使模型向真实隐藏偏移移动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 帧级外观预训练的视觉模型难以从运动中推断隐藏的物理属性；对于自遮挡条件下的不透明非对称刚体，表面线索与点跟踪不可靠，需要利用时序运动信息估计质心（隐藏物理参数）。

Method: 提出 STATERA：以大部分冻结的 V-JEPA 视频骨干提取时序表征，结合轻量时序 tubelet 混合器，预测逐帧质心热力图与轨迹；同时构建 HiddenMass Benchmark（50K MuJoCo 轨迹 + 63 段真实世界测试序列，含物理标定的质心真值）。

Result: 仿真中 STATERA-50K-Sigma 将归一化质心误差从 DINOv2 的 41.7% 降至 25.2%；零样本仿真到真实迁移中，相位感知目标可诱导双峰预测，相位无关目标会坍缩到统计安全质心；相位感知的 STATERA-50K-Crescent 是唯一持续向真实隐藏偏移移动的方法，物理捕获率从 2.6% 提升至 41.0%，但因单目向量过冲伪影导致绝对欧氏误差略高于静态几何质心。

Conclusion: 冻结的时序表征能够更好地将惯性动力学与视觉几何解耦，从而服务于隐藏参数估计，为从视频中恢复隐藏物理属性提供了新思路。

Abstract: Vision models pretrained for frame-level appearance often struggle to infer hidden physical properties from motion. We study center-of-mass (CoM) localization for opaque, asymmetric rigid bodies from short monocular videos, where surface cues and point tracking are unreliable under self-occlusion. We propose STATERA, which adapts a pretrained video backbone (V-JEPA) with mostly frozen weights and a lightweight temporal tubelet mixer to predict per-frame CoM heatmaps and trajectories. To support this task, we introduce the HiddenMass Benchmark, comprising 50K MuJoCo trajectories and a 63-sequence real-world test set with physically calibrated CoM ground truth. In simulation, STATERA-50K-Sigma improves normalized CoM error from 41.7% (DINOv2) to 25.2%. In zero-shot sim-to-real transfer, we observe a fundamental trade-off in supervision: phase-aware targets can induce bimodal predictions, while phase-agnostic targets can collapse toward statistically safe centroids. Nevertheless, our phase-aware STATERA-50K-Crescent is the only evaluated method that demonstrates consistent movement toward the true hidden offset. While this leads to a monocular vector overshoot artifact that marginally increases absolute Euclidean error compared to a static geometric centroid, it improves physics capture from 2.6% to 41.0%. These results suggest that frozen temporal representations can better separate inertial dynamics from visual geometry for hidden-parameter estimation.

</details>


### [2] [Emergent Object Binding Has a Finite Spatial Horizon](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00006)
*Mayank Singal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 预训练视觉Transformer的冻结patch嵌入中蕴含着"是否同一对象"（IsSameObject）信号，但单一准确率掩盖了其结构：对象绑定是局部的，随patch间距呈指数衰减并趋于非零下限，这一局部空间相干性可解释大对象绑定减弱、同类对象区分难、部分与整体归组等行为，且与遮挡无关（控制对象尺寸后）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前工作表明IsSameObject信号可从冻结patch嵌入高精度解码，暗示对象绑定由自监督预训练自发涌现。但作者认为单一聚合准确率这一标量掩盖了信号内部的空间结构，不足以刻画绑定行为，因此需要对绑定的局部性、衰减尺度及其引起的各类行为进行系统刻画。

Method: 作者将"绑定"重新解读为有限范围的局部空间相干性：测量同一对象两patch被解码为"已绑定"的概率随二者距离的变化，发现其单调下降并趋于非零地板，可用带有限长度尺度的指数模型拟合。该衰减在ADE20K与COCO数据集、DINO与CLIP骨干、三类探针（probe）族上均成立，并通过逐一控制混淆变量来刻画大对象效应、同类与异类对象区分、部分-整体归组、遮挡等行为；最后在DINOv2与DINOv3上初步观察衰减尺度（horizon）与地板（floor）在不同深度层的分布差异。

Result: 绑定概率随距离指数衰减并趋于非零地板，其有限长度尺度跨对象尺寸、数据集、探针与骨干保持不变，表明这是表征本身而非解码器的属性。该局部相干性解释了聚合分数无法解释的行为：大对象绑定更弱、同类不同实例的区分度低于异类对象、对象部分与其整体被归组；控制对象尺寸后，遮挡对绑定无影响。初步观察显示horizon与floor在DINOv2和DINOv3中分别在不同深度层被组织，作者因探针层数少且两模型存在混淆而持谨慎态度。

Conclusion: 对象绑定应理解为有限范围的局部空间相干性，而非全局二值属性；其指数衰减与地板是表征的固有特性，能够统一解释一系列先前看似矛盾或无法解释的行为。DINOv2与DINOv3的深度分布差异仅为初步观察，尚需更多层探针与消除模型混淆来验证。

Abstract: Pretrained Vision Transformers encode whether two image patches belong to the same object. This IsSameObject signal is decodable from frozen patch embeddings at high accuracy, which suggests that object binding emerges from self-supervised pretraining alone. We show that this single accuracy number hides the structure of the signal. Binding is local: the probability that two patches of the same object are decoded as bound falls off monotonically with the distance between them and levels off at a nonzero floor, a falloff well described by an exponential with a finite length scale. This decay holds across object sizes, across three families of probe, on both ADE20K and COCO, and across DINO and CLIP backbones, which indicates that it is a property of the representation rather than of the decoder. Reading binding as local spatial coherence with a finite range accounts for a set of behaviors that the aggregate score leaves unexplained: binding weakens on large objects, separates distinct objects of the same class less reliably than objects of different classes, and groups object parts with their wholes. It is, by contrast, unaffected by occlusion once object size is controlled. We map each behavior with confounds controlled. As a preliminary observation, the horizon and its floor are organized at different depths in DINOv2 and DINOv3, which we report as suggestive given the small number of layers probed and the confound between the two models.

</details>


### [3] [Spatial Lifting for Dense Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00017)
*Mingzhi Xu,Tao Zhou,Yong Li,Yizhe Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Spatial Lifting（SL）——一种面向密集预测任务的新方法：将 2D 图像等标准输入"抬升"到更高维空间，再用为高维设计的网络（如 3D U-Net）处理，从而在降低推理成本、大幅减少参数量的同时保持良好性能，并天然产生结构化输出以支持密集监督和测试时的自一致性质量/不确定性估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有密集预测方法通常受限于标准维度（如 2D）的网络设计，面临参数量大、推理成本高、缺乏内在结构化输出等问题。作者希望寻求一种更简洁通用的建模策略，在提升效率与精度的同时，还能为密集预测任务提供可靠的质量与不确定性估计。

Method: 提出 Spatial Lifting（SL）方法：将标准输入（如 2D 图像）抬升（lifting）到更高维空间（如 3D），随后使用针对该高维设计的网络（如 3D U-Net）进行密集预测。抬升维度上自然形成的结构化输出被用于训练阶段的密集监督；在测试阶段，利用单次前向传播即可基于自一致性（self-consistency）进行质量和不确定性估计。

Result: 实验表明，SL 在基准密集预测任务上取得与常规方法相当甚至更好的性能，同时显著降低推理成本，并大幅减少模型参数量。抬升维度产生的结构化输出还成功支持了密集监督训练与单次前向的自一致性质量/不确定性估计。

Conclusion: Spatial Lifting 提供了一种简单且通用的建模策略，为构建更高效、更准确、更可靠的视觉密集预测深度网络开辟了有前景的方向。

Abstract: We present Spatial Lifting (SL), a novel methodology for dense prediction tasks. SL operates by lifting standard inputs, such as 2D images, into a higher-dimensional space and subsequently processing them using networks designed for that higher dimension, such as a 3D U-Net. Counterintuitively, this dimensionality lifting allows us to achieve good performance on benchmark tasks compared to conventional approaches, while reducing inference costs and \textbf{drastically lowering the number of model parameters}. The SL framework produces intrinsically structured outputs along the lifted dimension. This emergent structure facilitates dense supervision during training and enables single-forward-pass self-consistency-based quality and uncertainty estimation at test time. Spatial Lifting introduces a simple and general modeling strategy that offers a promising path toward more efficient, accurate, and reliable deep networks for dense prediction tasks in vision.

</details>


### [4] [Encoded but Disconnected: Decomposing Vision-Language Model Failures under a Patching Null](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00024)
*Genpei Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在三种视觉语言模型架构上，中间层的可解释性信号普遍存在但与最终预测因果脱节：中间层虽在多数错误中编码了正确答案，却无法通过残差流修补触发预测翻转；错误可操作性地分为三类失败模式并可通过干预得到类别特异性响应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究视觉语言模型中间层激活是否编码了正确信息，以及这些中间层信号是否对最终预测具有因果影响力，从而检验"中间层可解释性"这一主流假设的真实性。

Method: 在 LLaVA-1.5-7B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B 和 InternVL3-8B 三种架构上，以 POPE 基准为共同测试集，采用残差流修补（residual-stream patching）在层级别与头级别（per-head）检验中间层信号的因果作用；并将错误操作性地划分为 Perception Failure、Encoded-but-Disconnected、Prior-Override 三类失败模式，进一步验证其可学习性与先验方向对干预响应的预测能力。

Result: 中间层在 68–91% 的错误中编码了标准答案，但残差流修补在三种架构的层级上均产生 0% 的非平凡翻转；头级别上三种架构中两种也是 0（Qwen：0/12600 次修补前向）。唯一例外 InternVL3 的第 20 层第 2 头是一个非词表、自注意力头，其效果仅局限于该特定头（p < 1e-4）。三类失败模式在三种架构上均可学习（准确率超过 60%），且架构的先验方向能预测两类干预中哪一类会引发类别特异性响应。

Conclusion: 中间层编码的"正确答案"信号虽普遍存在，但与最终预测因果脱节，构成对中间层可解释性的普遍负面发现；错误可操作地分为三类机械上真实存在的失败模式，相关缓解效果仅在神谕标签下成立，不构成可部署方法。

Abstract: Across three vision-language model architectures (LLaVA-1.5-7B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, InternVL3-8B), we report a universal negative finding for mid-layer interpretability. On POPE -- the benchmark common to all three -- the mid layers encode the ground-truth answer in 68-91% of errors, yet this signal is not causally active for the final prediction: residual-stream patching yields 0% non-trivial flip at the layer level on all three architectures, and on two of three at the per-head level (Qwen: 0/12,600 patched forwards). The lone exception, InternVL3 layer-20 head-2, is a non-vocab, self-attending head whose effect is localized to that specific head (p < 1e-4). Despite the null, the errors separate operationally into three failure modes -- Perception Failure, Encoded-but-Disconnected, Prior-Override -- learnable above 60% on all three architectures, and the architecture's prior direction predicts which of two interventions elicits a category-specific response. We report these mitigation effects under oracle labels as evidence the categories are mechanistically real, not as a deployable method.

</details>


### [5] [Domain generalization and synthetic data in object detection: the enabler, the probe, and the gap](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00030)
*Elfi I. S. Hofmeijer,Ella P. Fokkinga,Friso G. Heslinga,Klamer Schutte,Jörgen M. Karlholm*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文综述了目标检测领域的域泛化（DG）研究，重点从三个互补视角探讨合成数据的作用：作为提升鲁棒性的使能器、作为识别失败模式的探针，以及合成到真实域差距的挑战，并指出未来需要表征感知的方法来同时应对定位与分类问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目标检测模型在分布偏移（如天气、运行环境、目标外观变化）下性能严重退化，而专门针对目标检测的域泛化研究十分稀缺。同时，目标检测还面临定位和多尺度表征等额外挑战，亟需系统梳理该领域并探索合成数据在提升泛化能力方面的潜力与局限。

Method: 本文采用以目标检测为中心的综述方法，从三个互补视角系统考察合成数据在域泛化中的作用：(1) 合成数据作为使能器，通过多样化与对齐策略提升对分布偏移的鲁棒性；(2) 合成数据作为探针，支持受控实验以识别和理解模型的失败模式；(3) 讨论合成到真实（synthetic-to-real）域差距这一极具挑战性的域偏移形式。

Result: 通过综述发现，现有目标检测域泛化方法存在明显局限：当前方法未能充分应对定位与分类在域偏移下的耦合挑战以及多尺度表征问题，缺乏统一的表征感知范式。合成数据虽能通过大规模多样化生成和受控实验发挥作用，但合成到真实域差距仍是关键瓶颈。

Conclusion: 本文认为未来研究需要开发表征感知（representation-aware）的方法，即在域偏移下显式地同时处理定位和分类问题，以弥补现有目标检测域泛化方法的不足，并进一步缩小合成到真实域的差距。

Abstract: Object detection models often experience performance degradation when deployed under distribution shifts, caused by for example changes in weather type, operational environment, or object appearance. Domain Generalization (DG) aims to develop models that remain robust under such shifts and generalize well to unseen domains. DG research specifically focused on object detection models is scarce, although these models face additional challenges around localization and multi-scale representations. Synthetic data is a promising tool to support in DG, by enabling large-scale generation of diverse new samples. In this paper, we present an object detection-centric review of DG and examine the role of synthetic data from three complementary perspectives. First, synthetic data acts as an enabler of DG through diversification and alignment strategies that aim to improve robustness to distribution shifts. Second, it serves as a probe that enables controlled experimentation to identify and understand failure modes. Third, we discuss the synthetic-to-real gap, a particularly challenging form of domain shift that arises when models trained on synthetic imagery are deployed on real-world data. Through reviewing these perspectives, we identify limitations of current DG approaches for object detection and argue that future research requires representation-aware methods that explicitly address both localization and classification under domain shift.

</details>


### [6] [Seeing the City or Recognizing the Place? What Street-View Imagery Adds Beyond Existing Urban Data in VLM Urban Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00031)
*Kaizhen Tan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究系统比较了街景图像预测与现有城市数据（公共记录、邻近观测等）在七种城市属性上的表现，发现街景图像的价值高度依赖属性的视觉可读性与本地数据覆盖度，并以楼层的距离/高度相关误差和OpenFACADES数据溯源问题为例加以说明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 街景图像被越来越多地用于推断城市属性，但仅凭预测精度无法揭示图像相对于同一地点已有数据究竟贡献了多少增量信息。作者希望定量评估图像的边际价值，并检验现有数据集（如OpenFACADES）可能存在的标签溯源（循环引用）问题。

Method: 以相同的城市单元为对象，分别用图像、任务上下文、邻近观测和公共记录进行预测评估，覆盖七个属性、五个公共数据资源和三个视觉语言模型（VLM）；通过图像替换实验与冲突记录测试来检验模型对不同信息源的依赖程度；并对楼层预测的误差随距离、高度变化趋势及OpenFACADES标注（由OpenStreetMap楼层值生成）的误差模式进行对照分析。

Result: 在道路损坏、路缘坡道和房价上，现有城市数据的表现持平或优于纯图像模型；在人口上，邻近官方统计已接近最佳图像结果。图像在建筑类型、建筑功能和低层建筑层数上更具信息量。对于楼层数，图像优势随与最近已标注建筑的距离每翻倍增加5.7个百分点，但高楼因屋顶常超出画面而优势下降。模型常被冲突记录误导。OpenFACADES的楼层标注因由OpenStreetMap生成，其误差随高度变化的模式与纯图像重跑结果相反。

Conclusion: 街景图像的价值取决于属性的视觉可读性和本地数据覆盖度；将图像预测与现有城市数据进行对比，可以指导图像采集策略，并厘清衍生城市地图的数据溯源（provenance）。

Abstract: Street-view imagery is increasingly used to infer urban attributes, but predictive accuracy alone does not reveal how much a photograph contributes beyond data already available for the same place. We compare image-based predictions with existing urban data across seven attributes from five public resources and three VLMs. The same urban units are evaluated using images, task context, nearby observations, and public records, while image replacements and conflicting records test source reliance. Existing urban data matched or exceeded image-only models for road damage, curb ramps, and house price, while neighbouring official statistics nearly matched the best image result for population. Images were more informative for building type, building function, and low-rise floor count. For floor count, image advantage increased by 5.7 percentage points per doubling of distance to the nearest labelled building and declined for tall buildings whose rooflines often fell outside the frame. Models frequently followed conflicting records. OpenFACADES floor annotations were generated with OpenStreetMap floor values and showed the opposite height-dependent error pattern from image-only reruns. Street-view image value therefore depends on visual legibility and local data coverage. Comparing images with existing urban data can guide image collection and clarify the provenance of derived urban maps.

</details>


### [7] [DSSR-3D: Decoupled Reasoning for View-Dependent Referring in 3D Gaussians](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00040)
*Thanh-Khoi Nguyen,Thien-Phuc Tran,Minh-Triet Tran*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 DSSR-3D，一个针对连续 3D 高斯场、无需训练的视角相关指代分割推理框架，将任务形式化为"位姿不变语义定位"与"位姿条件空间推理"两个接口，并配套提出 ViewRef-GS 基准，在多个测试上稳定超越现有 3DGS 指代方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于 3D Gaussian Splatting 的开放式/指代分割方法将语言特征嵌入到全局视角不变空间中，因此无法解析依赖相机姿态的观察者中心空间关系（如"在……的左边"）。作者旨在解决这一视角相关空间指代问题，且不依赖重新训练或离散几何代理。

Method: 提出 DSSR-3D 推理框架，将视角相关指代分割形式化为两个接口：位姿不变语义定位与位姿条件空间推理，凡满足约束的任意函数对均可构成有效实例，无需重训练底层语义场、不依赖边界框等离散几何代理。具体实例化采用温度锐化 softmax 定位机制和基于投影的方向打分函数，通过轻量、免训练的步骤融合；两接口可零样本迁移到结构不同的语义场。

Result: 实验表明，在 ViewRef-GS（专门隔离 3D 高斯场上视角相关分割的基准）以及增强版 Ref-LERF 联合评测中，DSSR-3D 相比现有 3DGS 指代方法取得一致提升，且在基础语义场之外无需任何额外训练。

Conclusion: DSSR-3D 通过解耦"语义定位"与"视角条件空间推理"，以免训练方式解决了 3D 高斯场上的视角相关指代分割问题，验证了接口化形式化的有效性与跨语义场的零样本迁移能力，并提供了更严格的评测基准。

Abstract: Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting have enabled open-vocabulary and referring segmentation by distilling semantic knowledge from 2D foundation models into 3D representations. However, existing referring fields embed language features in a globally view-invariant space, making them fundamentally unable to resolve observer-centric spatial relations (e.g., "to the left of") that depend on camera pose.   <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型法官（model judges）如今在大规模监督多模态系统，负责过滤训练数据、选择输出、提供塑造多模态推理模型的奖励。信任一个法官的前提是验证它确实使用了图像证据，而这种"检查"本身也值得被审视。因此作者追问：检验视觉接地的反事实探针，是否真的测到了它所声称的东西？

Method: 将该探针形式化为 Verdict Grounding Score（VGS）：编辑图像使真值翻转、固定推理轨迹不变，观察裁决是否随之改变。作者分析该分数如何被"决策相关解读的可感知性"所封顶，证明编辑未使属性更易读时误差是单向的（只会让法官看起来更不接地）。进一步证明，在给定假设下，被封顶所缺失的量可由同一审计协议已收集的三个量（未编辑图像上的检测探针等）识别，从而使误报率可直接测量而非仅是担忧。在九个法官上开展审计，施加保守拒绝阈值来认证误报。

Conclusion: 反事实视觉接地方案在实践中会因编辑的可感知性受限而产生单向误差，导致审计者误弃可用法官（误报）。该缺失量可被识别并直接测量，实际审计验证了理论排序并认证了误报。可靠的做法是永远将图像侧反事实分数与未编辑图像上的检测探针联合报告，后者上界前者、认证误报且零额外成本。

The probe edits the image so the ground truth flips, holds the reasoning trace fixed, and asks whether the verdict follows. A verdict responds only to an edit that reaches the judge's decision-relevant reading, so the score is capped by how perceptible the edit is, and unless editing makes the attribute easier to read, the error is one-sided: the score can only make a judge look less grounded than it is. Applying a conservative rejection threshold certifies several cells as false alarms outright, the clearest being a judge that detects the injected error essentially every time while still scoring as if it had not used the image at all. The rule that follows is that an image-side counterfactual score should never be reported alone: a detection probe on the unedited image upper-bounds it, certifies its false alarms, and costs nothing extra to run.

</details>

Abstract: Visual-token compression for vision--language models is posed almost entirely as a selection problem: decide which tokens to keep and discard the rest. </details>

Abstract: Crowdsourced imagery provides timely, fine-grained, street-level observations for disaster mapping, complementing conventional remote sensing imagery (RSI) during emergency response. However, such imagery is often unstructured, spatially ambiguous, and lacks reliable geographic metadata, making manual geolocalization and interpretation labor-intensive and difficult to scale. This work proposes a multi-task Geospatial Reasoning Disaster mapping framework, namely GRDisaster, to examine the potential of vision-language models (VLMs) in understanding, geolocalizing, and reasoning over crowdsourced disaster imagery. GRDisaster is built on a newly curated benchmark dataset derived from PhotoMappers, comprising 26,340 images organized into human-validated volunteered geographic information (VGI), street-view imagery (SVI), RSI cross-view triplets covering multiple disaster events from 2018 to 2024. The framework combines deterministic and probabilistic cross-view geolocalization with multi-view fusion to associate VGI images with georeferenced SVI and RSI. Its Ego-referenced Predictive Alignment module uses the current ego feature to guide cooperative trajectory-field prediction and refines the sampling offsets along an ego-referenced trajectory direction. Its Trajectory-conditioned Reliability-aware Fusion module treats the trajectory discrepancy between the ego and cooperative streams and the directional refinement magnitude as alignment cues, using them to condition the relation between aligned features and adaptively reweight the two streams before convolutional fusion. TL;DR: Memorizon 提出一种用检索式有限记忆库替代长程稠密注意力的流式世界模型训练方法，使模型能在低成本下对多次访问同一地点保持渲染一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式世界模型在重复访问同一地点时应保持一致渲染，直接监督这种重访需要捕捉两次访问的长跨度训练样本（常达数分钟）。但传统稠密注意力在完整时间跨度上的代价是二次方，使长跨度监督成本过高。作者的洞见是：长跨度只在监督阶段需要，注意力阶段并不需要包含每一帧中间帧——两次访问可以共享一次前向传播。

Method: Memorizon 将监督与注意力解耦：训练样本可覆盖任意长度跨度，但仅对最后 k 个块打分。每个被打分的块不依赖其之前全部历史做 token 化，而是通过相机共视性（co-visibility）检索各自的 top-K 隐向量，这些请求的并集构成一个共享记忆库。记忆库大小受 kK 上界约束，因此无论跨度多长序列长度都保持有界；在最短跨度时该方案退化为普通训练。增加记忆库只使单步成本上升一次，之后更长跨度几乎不再增加成本（从 100 秒到 400 秒仅增加 12% 步时间）。

Result: 与滑动窗口基线相比，检索机制在所有划分（split）上都提升了重访一致性；跨度长到足以覆盖每次返回的首次访问时，一致性再提升 24% 至 30%，但代价是图像质量有所下降；超过该跨度后继续加长不再带来收益。若从另一条轨迹（episode）填充记忆库，重访相关性下降 83%，证明模型确实利用了所检索到的内容。

Conclusion: Memorizon 证明长跨度监督可以与有界长度的注意力解耦，通过共视性检索的有界记忆库在低成本下显著提升流式世界模型的重访一致性，且所需的跨度存在一个最优阈值，超过后收益不再增加。

Abstract: Streaming world models should render a place consistently across repeated visits. Directly supervising such revisits requires training samples that capture both visits, often spanning minutes. Yet dense attention over the full span incurs quadratic costs, making long-span supervision expensive. Memorizon breaks this coupling: long spans are needed for supervision, but not for attention, since the two visits can share a forward pass without including every intervening frame. A training sample covers a span of any length but is scored only on its last $k$ chunks. Instead of tokenizing the history before them, each scored chunk retrieves its own top-$K$ latents by camera co-visibility, and the union of these requests forms a shared bank. The bank is bounded by $kK$, so the sequence stays bounded however long the span; at the shortest span the recipe is exactly conventional training. Adding the bank raises the cost of a step once; beyond that, a longer span costs little, and going from 100 to 400 s adds 12% to the step time. Against a sliding-window baseline, retrieval raises revisit consistency on every split, and a span long enough to reach the first visit of each return adds a further 24% to 30%, at some cost in image quality; beyond that span, more length no longer helps. Abstract: Aesthetic image cropping aims to identify the optimal crop of an image in terms of aesthetics and composition. While supervision based on annotated data is fundamental, the field has been hindered by a long-standing problem: existing datasets suffer from (1) human subjectivity and (2) rigid discreteness confined to fixed sampling grids. These flawed annotations not only limit the accuracy and generalization of trained models but also severely distort fair evaluation. To overcome this, we propose to model human cropping preference as a multi-peaked, continuous, and sharp field over the crop space. Based on this, we train CPIC, a VLM-based cropping model optimized via GRPO with the CPF reward, which overcomes template collapse, achieving state-of-the-art performance and exceptional out-of-domain generalization. By leveraging the CPF to correct grid-bound artifacts across mainstream benchmarks, CPICD establishes a rigorous and reliable foundation for future cropping research.   <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表示对齐虽能加速扩散训练，但其收益无法可靠迁移到像素空间的干净图像预测。作者发现辅助特征对齐会增强语义特征访问、同时削弱干净图像预测所需的图像变异访问，导致辅助目标与去噪任务错配。因此需总结出新原则：辅助监督应直接改进预测目标本身，而非另设表示目标。

Result: 在 ImageNet 256×256 上，JAx 在 JiT-B/16、L/16、H/16 上一致提升 FID 并加速收敛；梯度诊断显示小批量梯度方差降低；消融实验表明收益不能仅由时间重加权解释。

Conclusion: 预测空间监督为像素级生成模型提供了一种简单且有原则的表示对齐替代方案，能直接改进预测目标、降低训练目标方差并加速收敛，无需外置编码器或架构/采样改动。

Abstract: Representation alignment has become an effective way to accelerate diffusion training, but its benefits do not transfer reliably to pixel-space clean-image prediction. In JiT, we find that auxiliary feature alignment can improve access to semantic features while reducing access to image variation needed for clean-image prediction, creating a mismatch between the auxiliary objective and the denoising task. This suggests a different principle: auxiliary supervision should improve the prediction target itself rather than impose a separate representation target. We introduce JAx (Just Align x), a prediction-supervision method that aligns clean-image predictions across noise levels. Under this coupling, the oracle prediction from the cleaner state has the same conditional mean as the optimal JiT target, while its conditional target covariance is no greater. Thus, oracle prediction alignment preserves the population JiT objective up to a constant while providing a lower-variance training target. Gradient diagnostics further show reduced minibatch gradient variance, while ablations demonstrate that the gains cannot be explained by time reweighting alone. These results show that prediction-space supervision provides a simple and principled alternative to representation alignment for pixel-space generative models.

</details>

Abstract: Speculative decoding has achieved substantial lossless speedups for LLMs, but remains less effective for large vision-language models (LVLMs), where lightweight drafters struggle to use rich multimodal information. HAWK uses representation similarity to select informative target layers and learns how to combine their hidden states. For visual information, it directly provides the drafter with compressed visual hidden states from the target model instead of raw visual tokens, making the visual information easier for a shallow drafter to use. HAWK also trains the drafter to capture how target predictions change after its own proposals, improving its agreement with the target during multi-step drafting. </details>

*Vu Dinh Xuan,Duc-Hai Nguyen,Minh-Dung Dao,Vu Quynh Giao,Quang Hong Nguyen,Binh-Son Hua,Barry O'Sullivan,David Murphy,Hoang D. Nguyen*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准只对视觉比较结果打标量质量分或整体偏好分，导致裁判可能因错误视觉理由选中偏好图而仍获奖励。缺乏将判断依据与具体视觉标准对齐的评估方式，无法衡量 VLM 裁判的判据正确性。

Abstract: Qualitative comparison figures are central evidence in computer vision papers, and vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used to judge them. Abstract: Federated learning (FL) has recently attracted increasing attention in remote sensing (RS) since it enables collaborative model training across decentralized RS image archives without requiring direct access to local data. Abstract: Recaptioned image-text corpora are now standard for text-to-image (T2I) training, with vision--language model (VLM) captioners replacing sparse alt-text by dense descriptions.   <summary>Details</summary>

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频基准声称测量某项能力，但现有模型可能利用答案选项、题干文字或部分视觉证据等捷径获取高分，导致评测失真。作者旨在系统审计这些捷径漏洞，构建一个真正难被"钻空子"、可复现的视频评测基准。

Result: 在35个基准上，完全看不到帧的攻击者接近全视频精度；在51个带时序探针的基准上，打乱帧后仍保留中位数96%的全视频精度；63个基准中至少一半题目为近似重复题。在Video-Index上，Claude Opus 5比所有开源模型高出37个百分点以上，加入Agent工具再提升约20个百分点，但所有系统在效率与准确性上仍有改进空间。

Abstract: Science teachers frequently search for documentary excerpts not by describing what appears on screen, but by querying the abstract concepts they intend to teach. CDDA treats concepts as intermediate semantic anchors: it first structures the textual embedding space with textbook and teacher-handbook example-concept pairs, then transfers this concept-aware geometry to documentary visuals under a frozen visual encoder, and finally jointly adapts both encoders with sparse visual concept supervision. From a geometric perspective, this staged alignment reduces text-concept and vision-concept angular gaps, thereby encouraging concept-level adaptation while preserving the pretrained model's concrete image description alignment. On a curated middle-school physics retrieval benchmark, CDDA achieves stronger pedagogically oriented concept retrieval than several competitive multimodal baselines, including Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B, while maintaining concrete image-text matching after adaptation.

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Existing synthetic image evaluators typically provide only a scalar quality score and do not identify the image regions that support it. We introduce VIEScore2, a unified evaluator for image generation and editing tasks with optional conditioning images. VIEScore2 represents an image as an N x N grid and jointly predicts quality scores and defect locations in a single model pass. Its text-native grid representation provides a common interface for heterogeneous spatial supervision and enables directly verifiable post-training objectives. We train on 38K examples spanning score-only, localization-only, and joint supervision across generation and editing tasks. Starting from supervised fine-tuning, we further apply GRPO to improve defect localization using rewards that combine cell-level Dice overlap, score accuracy, and output-format validity. A parameter-free parser converts the structured predictions into readable explanations. On the primary suite, VIEScore2 achieves an overall-score SRCC of 0.601, compared with 0.491 for Gemini-3-Flash, the strongest zero-shot general-purpose VLM baseline under matched inputs. For defect localization, VIEScore2 outperforms both general-purpose VLMs and specialized spatial evaluators on three of six benchmarks in per-image grid IoU and ranks among the top three on five, including datasets beyond its training sources.

Abstract: Video-to-speech synthesis aims to generate natural-sounding speech from silent talking-face videos while ensuring phonetic accuracy. A fundamental challenge in this task is the inherent one-to-many mapping problem, where visual dynamics often lack sufficient information to uniquely determine the corresponding utterance. To address this, we propose Watch Your Speech (WYS), a video-to-speech synthesis framework that incorporates textual conditioning as an explicit linguistic cue to mitigate visual ambiguity. Our framework features an attention-based embedding fusion module that synergistically integrates textual context with video sequences, coupled with a conditional flow matching objective for high-fidelity speech generation. Extensive experiments on the LRS2 and LRS3 datasets demonstrate that WYS achieves superior performance, establishing new state-of-the-art results in audio-visual synchronization (LSE-C/D) while maintaining highly competitive textual accuracy (WER).   <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前馈 3D 模型（如 VGGT）虽统一了相机估计与稠密重建，但其二次全局注意力使长图像序列推理成本高昂；而现有稀疏方法可能偏向高注意力但值冗余的区域，导致效率与质量难以兼顾。

Abstract: Feed-forward 3D vision models such as VGGT have achieved remarkable progress, unifying camera estimation and dense scene reconstruction in a single pass. However, their quadratic global attention makes long image sequences expensive, while existing sparse methods may favor highly attended yet value-redundant regions. To address these limitations, we introduce VASC, a training-free sparse attention method combining value-aware block selection and execution-aware cross-layer memory. Our value-aware block selection integrates pooled query--key relevance with neighboring value contrast, reducing redundancy while preserving query-relevant and distinctive content. Cross-layer memory tracks unserved demand across layers and updates this state according to actual execution, enabling previously underserved blocks to compete under a fixed computation budget. Experiments on 7Scenes and NeuralRGB-D with VGGT and $π^3$ demonstrate improved pose estimation and reconstruction quality compared with FasterVGGT, together with up to $2.29\times$ faster inference than dense VGGT. </details>

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FutureWorlds 是一个世界模型学习框架，通过多样束搜索构建候选未来、用候选专属有界记忆维护历史，并提出 MemSPO 将视频轨迹奖励转化为组相对优势来优化模型。在 RT-1、BridgeV2、RoboCasa 上 32 帧预测的 LPIPS 分别下降 14.78%、20.84%、9.12%，仅 200 步 MemSPO 更新即可提升生成质量并支持超出训练时长的持续预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人世界模型虽能预测动作条件下的未来场景，但如何将多个候选预测转化为有用的学习信号仍然困难：候选过于相似会削弱质量比较的信息量，而轨迹分叉又需要持续维护各自的独立历史，导致无法公平比较与有效学习。

Result: 在 RT-1、BridgeV2、RoboCasa 三个数据集上，相较各数据集最强基线，FutureWorlds 将 32 帧预测的 LPIPS 分别降低 14.78%、20.84%、9.12%。在固定评估配置下，仅 200 次 MemSPO 更新即可进一步提升生成质量，并支持超出训练时长的持续预测。记忆消融、解码敏感性分析与光流评估表明，这些提升不止于视觉质量，还带来更准确的运动预测和更一致的对象状态。

Conclusion: FutureWorlds 通过统一候选构造、历史维护与相对质量学习，有效解决了世界模型从替代预测中学习的难题，显著提升长期视频预测的视觉质量、运动准确性与状态一致性，并展现出超出训练范围的持续预测能力。

Abstract: Robotic world models predict action-conditioned future scenes, providing a foundation for understanding action outcomes. However, turning alternative predictions into useful learning signals remains challenging: similar candidates limit informative quality comparisons, while diverging trajectories require persistent maintenance of their individual histories. We introduce FutureWorlds, a framework that unifies candidate construction, history maintenance, and learning from relative quality. Built on a multimodal discrete autoregressive model, FutureWorlds uses diverse beam search during reinforcement learning to construct candidate futures that balance confidence and diversity. Candidate-specific bounded memory preserves scene states and ensures that generation and policy scoring use matching histories. We further propose MemSPO (Memory-Conditioned Search-Guided Policy Optimization), which converts video trajectory rewards into group-relative advantages to optimize the world model. On RT-1, BridgeV2, and RoboCasa, FutureWorlds reduces LPIPS for 32-frame predictions by 14.78%, 20.84%, and 9.12%, respectively, relative to the strongest baseline on each dataset. Under fixed evaluation configurations, only 200 MemSPO updates further improve generation quality and support continued prediction beyond the training horizon. Memory ablations, decoding sensitivity analysis, and optical-flow evaluation show that these gains extend beyond visual quality to more accurate motion prediction and more consistent object states. </details>

*Arash Rocky,Q. M. Jonathan Wu*

TL;DR: 本文提出两个模块（GPT 与 ASH）改进记忆注意力视频实例分割方法，实现任意长度视频的全自动、免训练开放词汇标注，基于 SAM3 的流水线在 MOTS20 上取得零样本 SOTA，且显存峰值低于 25 GB。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于记忆注意力的视频实例分割方法虽具备强大的零样本跟踪能力，但存在两大瓶颈：一是内存需求大，只能处理短视频片段；二是单提示（single-prompt）推理设计使多类别开放词汇跟踪的计算代价过高。作者旨在构建一个面向任意视频的全自动跟踪标注方案，克服长度限制与多类别推理效率问题。

Method: 提出两项贡献：(1) 广义存在令牌（Generalized Presence Token, GPT），通过虚拟提示批处理重构 SAM3 的推理流程，使其能同时处理 N 个文本提示，将图像编码成本从 O(N) 降至 O(1)，且无需修改任何已学习的组件；(2) 标注与分割处理器（Annotation and Segmentation Handler, ASH），利用重叠时间分块（overlapping temporal chunks）与基于 IoU 的块间身份匹配，将任意记忆注意力 VIS 跟踪器扩展到任意长度序列，无需数据集特定训练。二者实例化于 SAM3，构成 SAM3-ASH 流水线。

Result: SAM3-ASH 在完全零样本条件下于 MOTS20 上取得最先进的 HOTA 指标，并在其余七个基准上与经过训练的专用模型保持竞争力，同时峰值 GPU 显存消耗低于 25 GB。

Conclusion: 该工作确立了可扩展、免训练的自动化视频标注实用基线，验证了 GPT 与 ASH 在解决内存限制、序列长度及多类别推理效率方面的有效性，为全自动视频标注提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Memory-attention-based Video Instance Segmentation (VIS) methods have demonstrated strong zero-shot tracking capability, yet their substantial memory requirements confine them to short video clips and their single-prompt inference design makes multi-category open-vocabulary tracking computationally prohibitive. This work introduces two contributions toward fully automated tracking annotation of arbitrary video. The Generalized Presence Token (GPT) reformulates SAM3's inference pipeline to process N text prompts simultaneously via virtual prompt batching, reducing image encoding cost from O(N) to O(1) with no modifications to any learned component. The Annotation and Segmentation Handler (ASH) extends any memory-attention VIS tracker to sequences of arbitrary length through overlapping temporal chunks with IoU-based inter-chunk identity matching, requiring no dataset-specific training. Instantiated on SAM3, the resulting pipeline -- SAM3-ASH -- achieves state-of-the-art HOTA on MOTS20 under fully zero-shot conditions and remains competitive with trained specialists across seven additional benchmarks, while peak GPU memory consumption stays below 25 GB, establishing a practical baseline for scalable, training-free automated video annotation.

</details>


### [63] [Bootstrapping Video Interaction Generation with Synthetic State Transitions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01039)
*Jiho Jang,Jinyoung Kim,Nojun Kwak,Kyungjune Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种生成可控物理交互视频的框架，通过结构化分类与图像编辑生成起止状态锚点，并利用状态引导采样（SGS）合成连贯视频，辅以自动化评估系统验证质量，微调后显著提升模型生成合理交互的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型虽能合成高保真视频，但难以表现合理的物理交互及由此产生的状态转移，这成为机器人与VR/AR应用的关键瓶颈。

Method: 构建可扩展的合成交互数据集流水线：利用结构化分类法和先进图像编辑模型生成明确的起始与结束状态图像作为视觉锚点；提出状态引导采样（State-Guided Sampling, SGS）这一新颖采样技术，以缓解朴素条件生成中常见的伪影，从而基于锚点生成无缝视频；同时开发并验证了一套与人类判断相一致的自动化评估系统以保障数据质量。

Result: 实验表明，在生成的数据集上微调基础模型，能显著增强其生成合理物理交互的能力；所提出的自动化评估系统与人类判断高度一致。

Conclusion: 通过结构化数据合成、状态引导采样和可靠的自动评估，本框架有效解决了视频生成模型中物理交互合理性的瓶颈，为机器人与VR/AR应用提供了可扩展的解决方案。

Abstract: While recent video generative models can synthesize high-fidelity videos, they struggle to portray plausible physical interactions and the resulting state transitions, a critical bottleneck for applications in robotics and VR/AR. To address this, we introduce a framework to generate a scalable synthetic dataset of controllable interactions. Our pipeline leverages a structured taxonomy and state-of-the-art image editing models to create explicit `start' and `end' state images, which serve as visual anchors for the interaction. To generate a seamless video utilizing these anchors, we propose State-Guided Sampling (SGS), a novel sampling technique that mitigates artifacts common in naive conditional generation. Furthermore, we develop and validate a new automated evaluation system that aligns with human judgments to ensure data quality. Experiments show that fine-tuning a base model on our dataset significantly enhances its ability to generate plausible interactions.

</details>

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 DynSC-Eval 评估框架，用于在长时视频生成中动态追踪主体并衡量其主体一致性；并利用其构造奖励，通过 DiffusionNFT 后训练显著降低多种模型的不一致指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着视频生成时长延长，主体一致性应针对动态主体集合进行评估，而非静态评估；现有指标无法捕捉长时生成中的主体不一致事件，导致模型间差异被掩盖。

Method: 提出 DynSC-Eval 框架，动态追踪主体在其可见生命周期内的变化，使用六个互补的对象级指标衡量局部连续性与全局身份保持，并显式检测不一致事件；设计合成实验主动注入不一致事件以验证敏感性；进一步将 DynSC-Eval 构造为奖励，在自动驾驶测试环境中应用 DiffusionNFT 后训练，并通过课程学习扩展到 10s 和 30s 生成。

Result: 合成实验证明 DynSC-Eval 对不一致事件敏感，并暴露现有指标的局限性；在 5s、15s、60s 生成上揭示被传统指标掩盖的主体一致性差异；后训练使 5s 生成的六个不一致指标在 Wan-2.1-1.3B 上平均下降 13.82%，SANA-2B 下降 5.66%，I2V 模型 ReSim 亦有改善；扩展到 10s/30s 时一致性优化仍有效且基本保持其他能力。

Conclusion: 动态主体集合视角与事件驱动评估更能反映长时视频的主体一致性；DynSC-Eval 不仅能客观评测，还可作为奖励信号指导模型优化，在保持生成能力的同时有效提升主体一致性。

Abstract: We argue that as video generation extends to longer durations, subject consistency should be evaluated over \textit{dynamic subject sets}. We therefore introduce \textbf{DynSC-Eval}, an evaluation framework that dynamically tracks eligible subjects throughout their visible lifespans and measures local continuity and global identity preservation using six complementary object-level metrics, with explicit detection of inconsistency events. To validate its effectiveness, we design synthetic experiments that actively inject inconsistency events, demonstrating both the sensitivity of DynSC-Eval and the limitations of existing metrics. Evaluations of diverse models on 5s, 15s, and 60s video generation further reveal substantial subject consistency differences that are obscured by conventional metrics. Beyond evaluation, we construct rewards from DynSC-Eval and apply DiffusionNFT post-training in an autonomous-driving testbed. On 5s generation, our approach reduces the six inconsistency metrics by an average of 13.82\% for Wan-2.1-1.3B and 5.66\% for SANA-2B, with improvements also observed on the I2V model ReSim. Qualitative comparisons further demonstrate the effectiveness of our method. We then extend generation to 10s and 30s through curriculum learning and show that consistency optimization remains effective while largely preserving other capabilities.

</details>


### [65] [HierGF: Hierarchical Gaussian Fields via Geometry-perception Message Passing for Sparse-view 3D Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01056)
*Bi'an Du,Zhimin Zhang,Daizong Liu,Baoquan Chen,Wei Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对稀疏视角3D重建中视图少、覆盖不足导致的多视图一致性与结构缺失问题，本文提出Hierarchical Gaussian Fields(HierGF)，通过分层几何感知将有限观测转化为可靠的伪监督，并结合可学习置信度网络与几何一致稠密化模块，提升稀疏视图下的重建质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏视图3D重建在AR/VR内容创作、文化遗产数字化和机器人应用中十分常见，但稀疏视图仅含有限的3D信息，带来两大挑战：视图过少难以建立多视图一致性，以及覆盖不足导致欠采样区域信息缺失、结构出现孔洞。现有方法主要依赖有限的重投影误差和正则项，容易过拟合单一视图且跨视图外观不一致；在几何欠采样区域则依赖启发式密度控制，缺乏可靠引导，常导致模糊和结构空洞。因此需要一种能从有限观测中生成可靠自监督的稀疏视图重建方法。

Method: 提出Hierarchical Gaussian Fields(HierGF)，从分层几何感知视角处理稀疏视图重建：1) 通过一个两阶段的几何感知骨干网络，将粗糙3D几何信息与额外2D生成先验转化为结构化的伪监督，从而在极少输入视图下增强多视图一致性；2) 引入可学习置信度网络，引导梯度流向跨视图一致的内容；3) 设计几何一致稠密化模块，改善多视图对齐与欠采样区域的重建。

Result: HierGF将有限的稀疏视图观测转化为可靠的自身生成的伪监督，超越了固定先验与启发式密度控制；在极少数输入视图下增强了多视图一致性，并改善了多视图对齐和欠采样区域的结构重建，减少了模糊与结构孔洞问题。

Conclusion: HierGF通过分层几何感知将稀疏视图的有限观测转化为可靠自监督，显著提升了稀疏视图3D重建的多视图一致性与欠采样区域的结构完整性，为稀疏视图重建提供了一种超越固定先验和启发式密度控制的有效方案。

Abstract: Sparse view 3D reconstruction is an important and common scenario in multimedia applications, such as augmented reality/virtual reality (AR/VR) content creation, cultural heritage digitization, and certain robotic applications, where only a limited number of randomly captured views may be available. However, sparse views contain only limited 3D information, posing two major challenges:1) too few images are available for matching, making it difficult to build multi-view consistency; 2) insufficient view coverage leads to a lack of information in under-sampled regions, resulting in missing parts of object structure. Existing methods mostly still rely on limited reprojection errors and regularization terms, which are prone to overfitting to a single view and inconsistent appearances across views. In geometrically under-sampled regions, they often rely on heuristic density control, lacking reliable guidance and often resulting in blurring and structural holes.To address these issues, this paper proposes Hierarchical Gaussian Fields (HierGF), which revisits sparse-view reconstruction from a hierarchical geometry-perception perspective and converts limited observations into reliable self-generated supervision beyond fixed priors and heuristic density control. In particular, we transform coarse 3D geometric information and additional 2D generative priors into structured pseudo-supervision through a two-stage geometry-perception backbone network, thereby enhancing multi-view consistency with very few input views. In addition, we introduce a learnable confidence network to guide gradients toward cross-view consistent content, and a geometrically consistent densification module to improve the reconstruction of multi-view alignment and under-sampled regions.

</details>


### [66] [Overcoming Kernel Redundancy for Scaling Logic Gate Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01069)

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 可微逻辑门网络仅用逻辑门运算，是高效替代方案，但其规模扩展行为未被深入研究。本文针对宽度扩展进行系统分析，发现朴素扩展会引入逻辑核冗余导致性能饱和，为此提出动态逻辑核框架，通过输入依赖的核路由促进专业化分工，并以门级布尔运算实现推理，有效提升了核利用率、多样性与参数效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度神经网络的中心设计原则之一是扩展模型容量并通常带来性能提升，但可微逻辑门网络虽高效，其规模扩展行为却鲜有探讨。作者希望回答：逻辑门网络能否同样通过扩展（尤其是宽度）获得性能收益；并解决朴素宽度扩展中出现的核冗余与性能饱和问题。

Method: 作者聚焦宽度这一主要扩展维度，系统分析逻辑门网络的宽度扩展行为。观察到朴素扩展会在逻辑核之间引入冗余，削弱新增核的实际效用。为此提出动态逻辑核框架，通过促进核组之间的专业化分工来重组核利用率，利用输入依赖的核路由更好地利用新增宽度，同时保证路由与计算在推理阶段完全由门级布尔运算实现。进一步发现核冗余在第一门级最为显著，因而提出早期动态逻辑核策略，将自适应主要集中在第一层。

Result: 实验表明，所提方法提升了核利用率并增强了核多样性，在获得更高精度的同时改善了参数效率。

Conclusion: 逻辑门网络同样可以通过恰当设计从宽度扩展中获益；动态逻辑核框架通过专业化分工与输入依赖路由有效缓解了核冗余问题，实现了更优的精度与参数效率权衡。

Abstract: Differentiable logic gate networks, which operate using only logic gates, have recently attracted attention as an efficient alternative to conventional neural networks. However, despite their efficiency, the scaling behavior of logic gate networks remains underexplored. By contrast, scaling model capacity is a central design principle in deep neural networks and typically leads to improved performance. This discrepancy raises a key question: Can similar scaling benefits also be achieved in logic gate networks? In this work, we focus on width as a primary scaling axis and conduct a systematic analysis of its behavior in logic gate networks. We observe that naive width scaling often introduces redundancy among logic kernels, limiting the effective use of additional kernels and leading to performance saturation. To address this limitation, we propose a dynamic logic kernel framework that reorganizes kernel utilization by promoting specialization across kernel groups. This enables the network to better utilize increased width via input-dependent kernel routing, while ensuring that both routing and computation are implemented entirely with gate-level Boolean operations at inference time. We further find that kernel redundancy is most pronounced at the first gate level, motivating an early-stage dynamic logic kernel strategy that concentrates adaptation at this level. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach improves kernel utilization and increases kernel diversity, leading to higher accuracy with improved parameter efficiency.

</details>


### [67] [Ego2Act: Evaluating Goal-Directed Manipulation in Egocentric Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01092)
*Patrick Amadeus Irawan,Iskandar Muda Rizky Parlambang,Rava Maulana,Qinrong Cui,Erland Hilman Fuadi,Zayd M. K. Zuhri,Nanda Ryaas Absar,Ahmed Elshabrawy,Wilfried Ariel Mulyawan,Shoubin Yu,Yue Zhang,Mohit Bansal,Alham Fikri Aji*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Ego2Act 基准与配套评测管线 Ego2ActJudge，用于评估视频生成模型在目标导向、多步骤、以自我为中心（第一人称）物理操作任务中的模拟与规划能力。结果显示现有模型常跳过或部分执行步骤，导致目标未完成，且在精细物理动态与持久世界建模上持续失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频生成模型正被探索用作具身规划与学习的世界模拟器，但现有基准主要关注单一短动作或逐步指令，缺乏对多步骤物理推理的评估，尤其是在需要通过规划并执行多个真实世界操作来完成高层目标的以自我为中心视频生成上。因此需要一个能验证模型能否生成拟真、目标导向、多步骤操作视频的严格测试基准。

Method: 构建 Ego2Act 基准：包含 2,640 段视频，覆盖 110 个日常真实任务，并在物体杂乱程度与多步骤复杂度上变化；给定初始场景图像和高层目标，评估模型生成手的操作视频完成任务的能力。同时引入 Ego2ActJudge，一种免参考（reference-free）评估管线，用于自动评估任务完成度与物理合理性。

Result: 实验发现：模型生成的模拟视频经常跳过或仅部分执行步骤，后续步骤因缺少依赖状态而无法进行，最终目标未达成；模型在复杂物体操作与持久世界建模等细粒度物理动态上持续失败。Ego2ActJudge 在任务完成度和物理合理性评估上与人类共识的对齐程度优于相关基线。

Conclusion: Ego2Act 为推进视频模型迈向物理合理、目标导向的模拟提供了严格的测试平台。作者希望借此推动视频生成模型在物理一致性、多步骤规划与真实操作执行方面的能力提升。

Abstract: Video generation models are increasingly being explored as world simulators for embodied planning and learning. To do so effectively, these models must not only generate visually appealing frames, but also predict how environments dynamically evolve when executing goal-directed actions. While evaluating these capabilities is crucial, existing benchmarks focus mainly on single short actions or step-by-step instructions. This leaves multi-step physical reasoning underexplored, especially in egocentric video generation that requires planning to simulate proper execution to accomplish high-level goals by carrying out multiple real-world manipulations. We introduce Ego2Act, a goal-directed benchmark featuring 2,640 videos from 110 real-world tasks across day-to-day settings, varying object clutter and multi-step complexity. Given an initial scene image and a high-level goal, Ego2Act evaluates whether video generation models can produce realistic egocentric videos of a hand manipulating objects to carry out the task. To support scalable evaluation, we also introduce Ego2ActJudge, a reference-free evaluation pipeline that achieves better task completion and physics plausibility evaluation alignment with human consensus compared to relevant baselines. Our findings reveal that models' generated simulations often skip or partially execute steps, leaving later steps missing dependent states, which leads to unfulfilled goal. Furthermore, models consistently fail at fine-grained physical dynamics, particularly during complex object manipulation and persistent world modeling. We hope Ego2Act provides a rigorous testbed for advancing video models toward physically plausible, goal-directed simulation.

</details>


### [68] [MVDG: Efficient Multi-view 3D Disambiguation on Unconstrained Real-World Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01098)
*Hanyuan Xiao,Gonglin Chen,Haolin Xiong,Wenbin Teng,Haiwei Chen,Yajie Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MVDG 提出一种基于 3D 基础模型 VGGT 的可扩展多视图消歧框架，用于解决 3D 重建中的"分身"（doppelganger）误匹配问题，在保持二元分类精度的同时提升 SfM 精度与推理速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉相似但实际不同的 3D 表面（doppelgangers）产生的假匹配是大规模真实场景 3D 重建与视觉定位的根本障碍。现有方法依赖成对分类器，限制了多视图上下文推理能力，且对下游 SfM 引入 O(n²) 推理复杂度。

Method: 提出 MVDG——基于 3D 基础模型 VGGT 的多视图消歧框架，可对任意数量的多视图图像进行联合推理。通过引入 3D 感知的多视图特征，以单次编码-解码视图的方式降低对成对比较的依赖。针对直接多视图微调 VGGT 在噪声监督下不稳定的问题，受 Doppelgangers 标签歧义启发，从 AerialMegaDepth 构建伪成对训练集，并在采样子集上微调以获得稳定优化与对未见场景的强泛化。此外，处理伪成对数据集以实现高效验证，并推导出常规 SfM 指标与该伪成对测试分类精度之间的预测关系。

Result: 实验表明，MVDG 在取得与基线相当的成对分类精度的同时，在 SfM 精度和推理速度上均优于基线方法。

Conclusion: MVDG 通过 3D 基础模型上的多视图联合推理，有效缓解了 doppelganger 误匹配问题，兼顾了精度与可扩展性，为大规模 3D 重建与定位提供了高效方案。

Abstract: Illusory matches between distinct yet visually similar 3D surfaces--doppelgangers--remain a fundamental obstacle for large-scale, in-the-wild 3D reconstruction and visual localization. Prior work mitigates this issue with pairwise classifiers, but this design limits multi-view contextual reasoning and incurs O(n^2) inference complexity for downstream structure-from-motion (SfM). We present MVDG, a scalable multi-view disambiguation framework built on the 3D foundation model VGGT, which jointly reasons over an arbitrary number of multiview images. By incorporating 3D-aware multi-view features, our method reduces dependence on pairwise comparisons by encoding and decoding views in a single pass. We further observe that direct multi-view fine-tuning of VGGT can be unstable under noisy supervision; motivated by label ambiguity in Doppelgangers, we construct a pseudo-pairwise training set from AerialMegaDepth and show that fine-tuning on sampled subsets yields stable optimization and strong generalization to held-out scenes. Finally, because full SfM evaluation (even with faster pipelines such as GLOMAP) remains expensive, we process a pseudo-pairwise dataset for efficient validation; we derive a predictive relationship between regular SfM metrics and the classification accuracy on this pseudo-pairwise test. Experiments show that our method achieves comparable pairwise accuracy while improving both SfM accuracy and inference speed over baselines.

</details>


### [69] [Affine-Aligned Atlas for Canonical Gaussian Construction in Video Representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01114)
*Masaya Takabe,Hiroshi Watanabe,Sujun Hong,Tomohiro Ikai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种仿射图集（affine-atlas）规范高斯表示，通过在更大的仿射对齐图集空间中构建规范高斯，并用逐帧仿射变换吸收全局运动，从而缩小规范表示与目标帧之间的差距，提升大相机运动视频的重建质量，且仅需极少的额外参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于高斯的视频表示通常将视频分解为规范高斯与时间形变。但当视频包含相机运动等大范围全局运动时，规范表示可能与各帧内容发生错位，从而加重时间形变模型的负担，降低重建质量。

Method: 提出仿射图集规范高斯表示：在更大的仿射对齐图集空间中构建规范高斯，利用逐帧仿射变换先吸收全局运动再进行规范高斯构建。由于该方法仅修改规范构建阶段，可无缝集成到现有基于规范高斯的各类方法中。

Result: 实验表明，该方法能够提升重建质量，尤其在包含大幅相机运动的序列上效果显著，且额外参数开销可忽略不计。

Conclusion: 通过将全局运动在规范构建前用仿射变换吸收，有效缓解了规范表示与目标帧的错位问题，是一种低成本、易集成的高斯视频表示改进方案。

Abstract: Gaussian splatting has recently emerged as an efficient representation for images and videos due to its explicit structure and fast rendering capability. Existing Gaussian-based video representations often decompose a video into canonical Gaussians and temporal deformation. However, when a video contains large global motion such as camera movement, the canonical representation may become misaligned with individual frames, increasing the burden on the temporal deformation model. In this paper, we propose an affine-atlas canonical Gaussian representation, which constructs canonical Gaussians in a larger affine-aligned atlas space. Frame-wise affine transforms absorb global motion before canonical Gaussian construction, reducing the gap between the canonical representation and target frames. Since the proposed method only modifies the canonical construction stage, it can be integrated into existing canonical-Gaussian-based methods with negligible additional parameter cost. Experiments show that our method improves reconstruction quality especially for sequences with large camera motion.

</details>


### [70] [Open Vocabulary Word Recognition From Transcribed Bangla Texts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01134)
*Faias Satter,Sk. Md. Masudul Ahsan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于深度学习的孟加拉语手写体单词识别方法，通过SSD+MobileNetV2、Faster R-CNN+InceptionResNetV2及其集成模型并结合改进的NMS，在9841张自建手写单词图像数据集上取得最佳F1-score 92.61%，词级正确识别率达96.12%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的OCR系统在孟加拉语（Bangla）上缺乏可靠的等价解决方案，尤其是手写文本识别更加困难。单词识别是OCR流程中继文本分割之后最关键的阶段，若该阶段失败，即使其他阶段表现良好，整体OCR性能也会很差。因此需要研究基于深度学习的手写孟加拉语单词图像识别方法，以提升识别效果。

Result: 在测试集上，三种模型中集成模型表现最佳，F1-score达到92.61%；在词级别上，集成模型正确识别了96.12%的单词（达到一定程度）。

Abstract: An optical character recognition (OCR) can scan a paper and extract text using technology, making people's jobs easier. While various OCR systems are available in the software industry, finding a reliable equivalent solution for Bangla takes much work. When it comes to handwritten texts, the situation is much more unusual. Recognizing words from word images is the most critical stage in any OCR process. It is the second stage after segmenting words from text pictures. If this stage fails, the overall performance of the OCR will be poor, regardless of how well the other phases perform. This study aims to recognize words using deep learning in a handwritten Bangla word image. Three object detection models, SSD with MobileNetV2, Faster R-CNN with InceptionResNetV2, and an ensemble model of these two, have been used to train and test handwritten word images. A modified Non-Maximum Suppression has been introduced to enhance the effectiveness of the models' results. A customized dataset of 9841 handwritten Bangla word images has been compiled, featuring diverse handwriting styles from various individuals. All three models' performances have been checked against the test dataset, and the ensemble model has been the most impressive, with an F1-score of 92.61%. The system can be further improved by introducing a post-processing phase to correct errors generated by the system.

Abstract: Intracranial aneurysm rupture is associated with substantial morbidity and mortality, yet aneurysm detection remains challenging, particularly for small lesions and on routine non-angiographic imaging examinations. To support the development and evaluation of artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms for intracranial aneurysm detection and localization, the Radiological Society of North America (RSNA), in collaboration with the American Society of Neuroradiology (ASNR), the Society of Neurointerventional Surgery (SNIS), and the European Society of Neuroradiology (ESNR), curated the RSNA Intracranial Aneurysm (RSNA-ICA) Dataset. Developed for the 2025 RSNA Intracranial Aneurysm Detection Challenge, RSNA-ICA is a large, publicly available, expert-annotated dataset comprising 7202 CTA, MRA, and MRI series from 4278 adult patients collected across 21 institutions in 12 countries spanning five continents. The dataset includes 2566 CTA, 2166 MRA, and 2470 MRI series from patients with and without intracranial saccular aneurysms, providing substantial geographic and imaging diversity. Expert annotations indicate both aneurysm presence and location, and 178 series additionally include three-dimensional segmentations of challenge-defined vascular locations. RSNA-ICA was used to develop and evaluate algorithms in the 2025 RSNA Intracranial Aneurysm Detection Challenge. Of the 7202 image series, 5041 are publicly available through MIRA (https://mira.rsna.org/dataset/7), while the remainder were used for challenge public and private test sets. The dataset is freely available to the research community for noncommercial use and provides a comprehensive resource for advancing AI-based aneurysm detection across both angiographic and routine neuroimaging examinations.

### [72] [OptimusMesh: Compact Autoregressive Mesh Generation from Point Clouds via Sparse Latent Pivots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01148)
*Mazhar Iqbal,Naoya Chiba,Xuanmeng Sha,Tomohiro Mashita,Yuki Uranishi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OptimusMesh 提出一种通过稀疏潜在枢轴（16 个 pivot）条件化，直接从点云自回归生成紧凑三角形网格的框架，相比现有方法将条件序列缩短 16.1 倍，并以少 25.7%–94.1% 的面数保持有竞争力的几何保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从点云直接生成紧凑且几何保真的 3D 网格仍是根本性难题：点云无序且稀疏，网格结构不规则且拓扑多变。现有基于隐式表示再接表面提取的方法常生成过密或过度平滑的网格，且需要昂贵的后处理与简化，因此需要一种直接、紧凑的网格生成方案。

Method: 提出 OptimusMesh 框架：将 2048 个定向输入点压缩为仅 16 个稀疏潜在枢轴（pivot），使几何条件集缩小 128 倍。这些枢轴作为紧凑结构表征，在自回归两阶段框架中共享：第一阶段生成网格顶点，第二阶段在生成顶点和相同枢轴的条件下预测三角面。

Result: 相比近期使用 257 个解码器条件 token 的点云条件自回归方法，OptimusMesh 仅用 16 个条件 token，条件序列缩短 16.1 倍。实验表明其输出最紧凑，面数比对比的近期自回归方法少 25.7%–94.1%，同时保持有竞争力的几何保真度和分布质量。

Conclusion: 通过将点云压缩为稀疏潜在枢轴作为共享条件，OptimusMesh 显著降低了条件序列长度，实现了从点云直接生成紧凑三角网格的目标，在面数大幅减少的同时保持几何保真，证明了稀疏枢轴条件化的有效性。

Abstract: Generating compact and geometrically faithful 3D meshes directly from point clouds remains a fundamental challenge. Point clouds are unordered and sparse, whereas meshes exhibit irregular structure and varying topology. As a result, many existing approaches rely on implicit representations followed by surface extraction or reconstruction. Although effective, these pipelines can produce dense or over-smoothed meshes, often requiring computationally expensive post-processing and simplification. We present OptimusMesh, a framework for direct compact triangle mesh generation from point clouds using sparse latent pivot conditioning. Our key idea is to compress $2{,}048$ oriented input points into only $16$ sparse latent pivots, reducing the geometric conditioning set by $128\times$. These pivots provide a compact structural representation shared across a two-stage autoregressive framework that first generates mesh vertices and then predicts triangular faces conditioned on the generated vertices and the same pivots. Compared with the evaluated recent point-cloud-conditioned autoregressive methods, which use $257$ decoder-conditioning tokens, OptimusMesh uses only $16$, yielding a $16.1\times$ shorter conditioning sequence. Experiments show that OptimusMesh produces the most compact outputs among the compared recent autoregressive methods, using $25.7\%$--$94.1\%$ fewer faces while maintaining competitive geometric fidelity and distributional quality.

</details>


### [73] [PhysicsLENS: Diagnosing Physical Property Blindness in Video Generation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01162)
*Isaiah Milkey,Som Sagar,Aditya Taparia,Xinyuan Liu,Jiqing Wen,Ransalu Senanayake*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 PhysicsLENS，一个面向机器人场景、用于评估视频世界模型"物理属性合理性"的数据集与基准。它通过成对的场景（保持相同条件帧与任务、仅改变底层物理描述）来检验生成视频是否真正遵循所声明的物理属性，并在四个视频生成模型上实验发现：外观合理的视频常忽略所声明的物理属性（47 例中有 34 例），且显式说明物理属性对合理性仅有轻微、不显著的降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可靠的视频世界模型能为机器人学习、规划与评估提供可扩展的预测环境，但当前生成的机器人视频可能违反物理原理、以物理上不可信的行为完成任务，从而限制其用于机器人学习与规划的可靠性。现有视频生成基准只评估视觉保真度，而忽略了视觉上天然不可见的物理属性（如重量、粘度、摩擦力），导致评估的是"物理的逼真外观"而非"底层物理的正确性"。

Method: 作者构建了 PhysicsLENS 数据集与基准：从公开机器人视频来源筛选场景，并标注七个物理域（碰撞、重力、动量、摩擦、形变、流体、因果）。核心设计是采用"配对场景"—同一条件帧与同一任务下，仅在场景描述中改变底层物理属性。随后在四个视频生成模型上进行评估，收集超过 400 条人工标注标签，以判断生成视频在视觉合理性与物理属性遵循度上的表现。

Result: 在四个视频生成模型上、超过 400 条人工标注的实验结果显示：外观上看似合理的视频往往忽略了所声明的物理属性（47 个案例中有 34 个），而显式声明物理属性只会略微降低视觉合理性，且这种降低在统计上不显著。

Conclusion: 现有视频生成模型更擅长生成视觉上逼真的画面，却难以真正遵循底层物理属性，说明仅靠视觉保真度无法保证视频世界模型在机器人场景中的物理可靠性。PhysicsLENS 通过配对场景设计与人工标注，为评估生成视频的物理属性合理性提供了新基准，并揭示出当前模型在物理遵循性上的明显不足。

Abstract: Reliable video world models could provide scalable predictive environments for robot learning, planning, and evaluation. However, generated robot videos can violate physical principles and complete tasks through physically implausible behavior, limiting their reliability for robot learning and planning. Current video-generation benchmarks exclude physics that are inherently hidden by visuals (e.g., weight, viscosity, friction). Due to this, video models are evaluated on the fidelity of physics, not the underlying accuracy of physics. We introduce PhysicsLENS, a dataset and benchmark for evaluating plausibility of physical properties grounded in robotics. PhysicsLENS uses matched scenario pairs that hold the same conditioning frame and task, while varying underlying physics in the scene description. Scenarios are curated from public robot video sources and annotated across seven physical domains: collision, gravity, momentum, friction, deformation, fluid, and causality. We evaluate across four video generation models, producing over 400 human-annotated labels. Results show that plausible-looking videos often ignore the stated property (34 of 47), and that stating the property lowers plausibility only slightly and not significantly.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电影 CMR 是评估心脏形态与心室功能的金标准，其解读需结合视觉判断与心室容积、射血分数、心肌质量、室壁厚度、局部室壁运动等定量测量。现有医学视觉语言模型无法在缺乏分析工具的情况下从多维电影图像中可靠地得出定量测量，因此需要一种能调用工具并整合输出的方法。

Method: 提出 CineMR，一个工具增强型视觉语言模型，调用心脏图像分析工具（分割、相位选择、容积测定、形态测量、局部室壁运动分析）并将输出整合到交错推理中。训练流程为：先用工具交互轨迹进行监督微调（SFT），再用带条件工具使用奖励的 Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）进行强化学习。同时构建了覆盖定量指标提取、多分类诊断与鉴别诊断的多队列视觉问答基准。

Conclusion: 可靠的工 具使用对电影 CMR 的定量推理至关重要，CineMR 证明了这一点，并展现出作为辅助心脏影像评估方法的前景。代码、基准资源和模型权重已公开。

Abstract: Cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR), including cine imaging, is a reference standard for the noninvasive assessment of cardiac morphology and ventricular function. Cine CMR interpretation integrates qualitative visual assessment with quantitative measurements of ventricular volumes, ejection fraction, myocardial mass, wall thickness, and regional wall motion. Current medical vision-language models (VLMs) cannot reliably derive quantitative measurements from multidimensional cine images without analysis tools. We present CineMR, a tool-augmented VLM that invokes cardiac image-analysis tools and integrates their outputs into interleaved reasoning for quantitative CMR assessment. We also construct a multi-cohort visual question answering benchmark covering quantitative metric extraction, multiclass diagnosis, and differential diagnosis, together with tools for segmentation, phase selection, volumetry, morphometry, and regional wall motion analysis. CineMR is trained with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on tool-interaction traces followed by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with conditional tool-use rewards. On the multi-cohort cine CMR benchmark, CineMR achieves 35.9% pass@1 and 58.9% pass@4, compared with 1.5% pass@1 for the Qwen3-VL-8B backbone and 0.0% and 7.0% pass@1 for LLaVA-Med v1.5 and MedGemma-4B, respectively. Correct tool invocation reaches 99.8% after GRPO, up from 78.9% after SFT. Live tool outputs improve ventricular measurement accuracy by 20.4--23.7% over direct model predictions, and removing all tools reduces pass@1 from 35.9% to 27.9%. These results highlight the importance of reliable tool use for quantitative cine CMR reasoning and support CineMR as a promising approach for assistive cardiac image assessment. Code, benchmark resources, and model weights are available at https://github.com/AI-MIND-Lab/CineMR.

</details>


### [75] [Skeleton-and-Strategy Prompting: Training-Free Negation Understanding for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01180)
*Yuliang Cai,Mohammad Rostami,Jesse Thomason*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Skeleton-and-Strategy Prompting (SSP)，一种免训练的上下文学习方法，通过抽取问题骨架、检索同类骨架问题并合成回答策略，显著提升视觉语言模型对否定句的理解能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型在大多数视觉问答任务上表现优异，但在涉及否定从句的问题上持续出错，缺乏对否定语义的理解能力，亟需一种无需参数更新即可提升否定理解的通用方法。

Method: SSP 为免训练的上下文学习方法：首先将否定问题的底层结构抽象为"骨架"；从轻量级问题池中检索少量同骨架问题；随后提示 VLM 分析这些问题的共同否定模式并合成一句式的回答策略；最终将骨架与策略前置到测试样本，引导模型正确作答。

Result: 在多个否定类视觉问答基准上，SSP 取得了否定聚焦 VQA 任务的最优（state-of-the-art）性能，同时保持较低的计算开销。

Conclusion: SSP 证明通过骨架抽象与策略合成的免训练提示方法，可有效弥补视觉语言模型在否定理解上的短板，在不增加参数更新的前提下实现高性价比的性能提升。

Abstract: Despite the strong performance of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on a wide range of visual question answering (VQA) tasks, these models consistently struggle to understand negation and produce incorrect answers when questions involve negated clauses. To address this limitation, we propose Skeleton-and-Strategy Prompting (\textbf{SSP}), a training-free, in-context learning method that improves VLM negation understanding capabilities without any parameter updates. Given a negation question, our method first abstracts the underlying question structure into a skeleton, retrieves a small set of same-skeleton questions from a lightweight question pool, then prompts the VLM to analyze their shared negation pattern and synthesize a single-sentence answering strategy. The skeleton and strategy are prepended to the test sample to guide the model correctly tackle the negation problems. Experiments on multiple negation VQA benchmarks show that SSP achieves state-of-the-art performance on negation-focused VQA tasks while remaining computationally efficient.

</details>

Motivation: 现有OCR系统众多，但针对孟加拉语（尤其手写文本）的可靠方案极为稀缺；单词分割是任何OCR的首要基础步骤，若此阶段失败，后续阶段再出色也无法保证整体性能。

Method: 构建包含各类现实障碍（如不同颜色纸张与墨水、智能手机拍摄造成的阴影干扰）的自定义数据集，采用自适应的单词分割流程，利用自适应阈值化（adaptive thresholding）与膨胀滤波（dilation filter）等技术从文本图像中提取单词边界框。

Abstract: An optical character recognition(OCR) system can scan paper and extract text, making people's jobs easier. While numerous OCR systems are accessible in the software sector, finding a dependable equivalent solution for Bangla is tough. When it comes to handwritten texts, the case is even more rare. The first fundamental step to any OCR is to segment words from text images. If this stage fails, the total OCR's performance will be poor no matter how promising the later stages perform. This research aims to segment words in a handwritten Bangla text image. This research can be implemented on any smartphone-captured image, irrespective of the color and type of paper and ink. Furthermore, as smartphone-captured images can create shadow interferences, the custom dataset built for this research is created in such a way that every possible obstacle that can be faced is included. For 7374 words, a total of 7278 bounding boxes are generated, which have recall of 90.60 %, precision of 91.80 %, and F1-score of 91.20 %. The system can be further improved with nested operations on bounding boxes containing several words or by adjusting the adaptive thresholding and dilation filter sizes to a more precise level.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式视觉-语言模型需在有限算力预算下持续处理不断增长的视频流，面临实时感知与长期记忆之间的持久冲突。历史信息召回虽能缓解遗忘，但并非总是有益：无关历史可能引入干扰性上下文，损害原生实时感知。因此，有效的流式记忆不仅要解决"记住什么"，还要解决"何时以及如何访问"历史的问题。

Method: 提出 FlashBack，一个免训练的选择性多级记忆框架。其核心流程为：在召回历史前，利用冻结流式 VLM 的语义理解能力判断当前查询是否需要历史证据；该判断决定推理是走 Native（原生）轨迹，还是触发一个隔离的 Recall（召回）轨迹。Recall 轨迹通过一种查询局部的 Side-KV 通路，将近端上下文与检索到的长期记忆相结合，从而在不修改持久 Native 状态的前提下保持局部时间连续性。该方法在 StreamingVLM 和 Mage-VL-4B 上实例化。

Result: 在 OVO-Bench 和 StreamingBench 上评估，FlashBack 在多个长时程和记忆依赖任务上取得提升，同时基本保持实时感知能力；在无需额外训练的情况下，性能可与强训练型流式方法相竞争。

Conclusion: FlashBack 证明通过选择性地决定何时及如何访问历史记忆，免训练框架即可在流式 VLM 中有效平衡实时感知与长期记忆，达到接近训练型方法的性能，并将在后续公布代码。

Abstract: Streaming vision-language models must process continuously growing video streams under a bounded compute budget, creating a persistent tension between real-time perception and long-term memory. Retrieving historical information provides a natural remedy, yet historical recall is not uniformly beneficial: unnecessary history may introduce irrelevant context into current reasoning and interfere with native real-time perception. Effective streaming memory should therefore address not only what to remember, but also when and how to access it. To this end, we introduce FlashBack, a training-free framework for selective, multi-level memory in streaming vision-language models. Before retrieving history, FlashBack draws on the semantic understanding of the frozen streaming VLM to infer whether a query calls for historical evidence. This assessment determines whether inference remains on the Native trajectory or invokes an isolated Recall trajectory. The Recall trajectory combines recent context with retrieved long-term memory through a query-local Side-KV pathway, preserving local temporal continuity without modifying the persistent Native state. We instantiate FlashBack on StreamingVLM and Mage-VL-4B and evaluate it on OVO-Bench and StreamingBench. The results show improvements on several long-horizon and memory-dependent tasks while largely preserving real-time perception, with performance competitive with strong training-based streaming methods despite requiring no additional training. Our code will be announced later.

</details>


### [78] [iSEE: Object Permanence Through Self-Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01201)
*Pramish Paudel,Ajad Chhatkuli,Luc Van Gool,Danda Pani Paudel*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 iSEE，一种完全无监督的框架，用于解决视频中物体被遮挡时的"客体永久性"问题，使槽（slot）在物体隐藏期间仍能保持其身份与位置的连续性，并通过"重现"作为唯一学习信号来训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于槽注意力（slot attention）的自监督物体中心方法虽然能无标签地发现并跟踪物体，但物体一旦被遮挡，槽就会丢失，无法实现客体永久性。而实现永久性需要满足三点：检测遮挡发生、物体重现时重新识别身份、以及在隐藏期间保持位置连续，且只能以重现作为学习线索，这是一个困难问题。

Method: 提出 iSEE 框架，包含三个组件：(i) 物体证据建模——将槽的注意力与其自身过去比较，判断物体何时被遮挡；(ii) 外观-位置分离——用两条槽流分别承载外观（用于重现时的重识别）与位置（持续变化）；(iii) 从重现中学习永久性——一个 "walker" 跟随隐藏物体的位置，仅以物体重现位置作为监督进行训练。此外，位置流可作为世界模型的动作用于下游规划。

Result: 在 LA-CATER static 数据集上，iSEE 在 86% 的遮挡后能将重现物体归还到其原来的槽中（SlotContrast 仅为 32%），并且在物体隐藏期间的定位精度达到 4.1 mAP，接近有标签训练的 SoTA 方法 RAM。

Conclusion: iSEE 证明在没有标签的情况下，通过分离外观与位置并对隐藏位置进行连续性建模，可以仅依靠重现信号实现客体永久性，其表现接近有监督的 SoTA，并支持下游规划任务。

Abstract: Object permanence, keeping track of an object's identity and position while it is occluded, is central to video representations that track, predict and plan. Trackers that achieve it learn from boxes, track identities and visibility labels. On the other hand, self-supervised object-centric methods discover objects without labels: through slot attention, it represents a video as slots that bind to objects and follow them across frames. However, these slots are lost under occlusion, making the desired permanence impossible. Reasoning permanence is a hard problem because it requires to detect when an object becomes occluded, re-identify when object reappears, and keep the object's hidden position continuous, using reapperance as the only learning cue. To address this, we propose iSEE, a novel framework that offers all three aforementioned requirements, without any labels whatsoever. We built iSEE using the following three proposed components: (i) Object evidence modelling: a slot's attention, compared with its own past, reveals when its object is hidden. (ii) Appearance-position separation: two slot streams let the appearance be held for re-identification while the position keeps changing. (iii) Permanence from reappearance: a walker follows the hidden object's position, trained only on where the object reappears. On LA-CATER static, iSEE returns a reappearing object to its own slot after 86% of occlusions, against 32% for SlotContrast, and localises it while hidden within 4.1 mAP of the label-trained SoTA RAM. The two streams also allow downstream planning, with the position stream as the action of a world model. Project page: https://insait-institute.github.io/iSEE/

</details>


### [79] [Semantic RGB--Depth Based Surgical Skill Assessment in Microscopic Stereo Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01205)
*Jecia Z. Y. Mao,Sue M. Cho,Francis X. Creighton,Deepa Galaiya,Russell H. Taylor,Manish Sahu*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于视频的手术技能评估主要依赖 RGB 图像，忽略器械-解剖交互的 3D 空间关系；而立体手术显微镜虽提供深度信息，但在高倍成像条件下传统立体匹配会产生稀疏且不可靠的深度估计，限制了其在自动化技能评估中的应用。因此需要一种能融合并利用深度信息的框架。

Method: 提出语义 RGB-Depth 框架：(1) 回归式深度融合方法将稀疏度量立体深度与密集单目深度估计结合，生成密集几何场景表示；(2) 将该表示与按器械和周围解剖结构语义分解的 RGB 流整合；(3) 采用分层注意力架构联合编码各流，以捕捉不同训练水平术者在器械使用与器械-解剖交互上的判别性模式。评估采用 6 名术者（主治医师与住院医师）的 33 例离体经口显微喉手术，留一术者交叉验证。

Result: 在 33 例离体经口显微喉手术（6 名术者，留一术者交叉验证）上，所提语义 RGB-Depth 模型技能分级 F1 达 0.938，语义 RGB 为 0.696，语义深度为 0.929。学习到的空间、时间与语义注意力模式支持对模型所强调的场景区域、视频片段和语义流进行定性分析。

Conclusion: 几何（深度）信息能够提升显微立体视频的自动化手术技能评估性能，语义化融合 RGB 与深度的分层注意力框架取得了最佳分类效果，并具备可解释性。

Abstract: Objective assessment of microsurgical technical skill is essential for competency-based training and quality assurance, yet existing video-based approaches predominantly rely on RGB images and therefore overlook the 3D spatial relationships that characterize instrument-anatomy interactions. Although stereo operating microscopes provide complementary depth information, conventional stereo matching algorithms can produce sparse and unreliable depth estimates under high-magnification imaging conditions, limiting their use for automated skill assessment. This work presents a semantic RGB-Depth framework for surgical skill assessment from microscopic stereo videos. A regression-based depth fusion method combines sparse metric stereo depth with dense monocular depth estimates to generate a dense geometric representation of the surgical scene. This representation is integrated with semantically decomposed RGB streams corresponding to individual surgical instruments and surrounding anatomy. A hierarchical attention architecture jointly encodes these streams to capture discriminative patterns of instrument use and instrument-anatomy interaction across surgeons at different training levels. The framework was evaluated on 33 ex vivo transoral microlaryngeal procedures performed by six surgeons, comprising attending surgeons and surgical residents, using leave-one-surgeon-out cross-validation. The proposed semantic RGB-Depth model achieved an F1 score of 0.938 for skill-level classification, compared with 0.696 for semantic RGB and 0.929 for semantic depth. These results suggest that geometric information can improve automated surgical skill assessment from microscopic stereo videos. The learned spatial, temporal, and semantic attention patterns also support qualitative examination of the scene regions, video segments, and semantic streams emphasized by the model.

</details>


### [80] [Resolving Mixed Single-Photon LiDAR Returns for Foreground-View and Hidden Scene Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01206)
*Ziting Wen,Runrong Deng,Zili Zhang,Haitao Zheng,Yuecong Xu,Xiaoqiang Ren,Guodong Shi,Kemi Ding*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种状态感知框架，从被部分透明遮挡物干扰的单光子激光雷达直方图中，同时重建前景遮挡层与隐藏场景的深度和点云，并通过真实配对数据集验证了其优于基线的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人检测中常见的半透明屏与保护罩会产生前景材质与后方场景的混合激光雷达回波。传统峰值式激光雷达会丢弃微弱隐藏回波，而单光子激光雷达虽保留衰减和重叠回波，但现有瞬态重建方法通常用单一场景表示拟合波形，在遮挡情况下弱回波或近邻前后景回波会形成宽峰或微弱肩部，导致瞬态拟合准确但几何错误。因此需要一种能区分并重建前景与隐藏场景的方法。

Method: 提出状态感知（state-aware）框架，针对每根射线估计局部回波证据，将其归类为"无可靠表面证据""单回波证据"或"双回波证据"三种状态；由推断的回波状态为双头神经场（two-head neural field）路由监督信号，其中所有射线约束波形重建，而可靠锚点提供几何定位。此外，构建了一个真实配对单光子激光雷达遮挡数据集，在相同位姿下同时采集遮挡与干净场景。

Result: 在真实数据集上的实验表明，相比基线方法，该方法在隐藏场景深度与点云精度上均有提升，证明单光子分层重建是透过部分透明遮挡物实现三维感知的可行路径。

Conclusion: 通过状态感知的双头神经场框架与配对遮挡数据集，解决了部分透明遮挡下单光子激光雷达的前景与隐藏场景联合重建问题，并在真实数据上取得优于基线的几何精度，展示了单光子分层重建技术的实用价值。

Abstract: Partially transmissive screens and protective covers are common in robotic inspection, but they create mixed LiDAR returns from both the foreground material and the scene behind it. Conventional peak-based LiDAR usually discards weak hidden returns, while single-photon LiDAR records time-resolved histograms that preserve attenuated and overlapping echoes. However, existing transient reconstruction methods typically fit a single scene representation to the measured waveform. Under occlusion, weak or nearby foreground--hidden echoes can form a broad peak or subtle shoulder. Because such waveforms can also be explained by a displaced single surface or a thick density distribution, accurate transient fitting does not necessarily imply correct geometry. We propose a state-aware framework for foreground-view and hidden scene reconstruction from occluded single-photon histograms. For each ray, we estimate local echo evidence, identifying no reliable surface evidence, single-return evidence, or two returns. The inferred echo state routes supervision for a two-head neural field: all rays constrain waveform reconstruction, while reliable anchors provide geometry localization. We also introduce a real paired single-photon LiDAR occlusion dataset with occluded and clean captures at fixed poses. Experiments on a real dataset show improved hidden scene depth and point-cloud accuracy over baselines. Our results demonstrate single-photon layered reconstruction as a practical route for 3D perception through partially transmissive occluders.

</details>


### [81] [EgoFound3R: End-to-End Egocentric Hand Reconstruction in World Space with Point-Wise Interaction Attributes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01210)
*Hongming Fu,Jingcheng Shi,Wenjia Wang,Binhua Zuo,Bo Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EgoFound3R 是一个统一的端到端模型，可在与场景共享的米制尺度下估计世界空间中的手部几何，并预测逐点交互属性（可见性、接触、距离），一次前向即可完成重建，吞吐量提升约 6 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以自我为中心（第一人称）视频是具身模型监督的主要来源，其价值在于恢复世界坐标下的手部运动，但相机运动和手部遮挡使此困难。现有重建流程通常将手与场景估计分离、将交互属性交给独立任务模型，并在每段视频上调用多个模型，导致没有先前的重建模型能估计这些属性，且吞吐量成为大规模标注的实际瓶颈。

Method: 提出统一端到端模型 EgoFound3R，包含三项设计：(i) 结构化手部提示（structured hand prompts），将预训练的几何先验迁移到世界空间手部重建；(ii) 显式手部表示（explicit hand representation），解码手部几何与交互属性；(iii) 共享参数的多速率设计（shared-parameter multi-rate design），降低推理成本。这三项设计使模型在单次前向中预测手部几何与逐点属性。

Result: 在 OakInk-v2、TACO 和 HOI4D 上，EgoFound3R 将平均每关节位置误差（MPJPE）分别降低 43.2%、22.4% 和 11.6%，并在同一次前向中预测逐点接触与距离，同时实现约 6 倍更高的吞吐量。

Conclusion: EgoFound3R 通过统一建模与高效设计，在对手部几何重建精度显著提升的同时，将交互属性预测集成到单次推理中，大幅提高了大规模视频标注的吞吐量，解决了现有流水线分离、多次调用与属性缺失的问题。

Abstract: Egocentric video has become a primary source of supervision for embodied models, and its value rests on recovering hand motion in world coordinates, which camera motion and hand occlusion make difficult. Existing reconstruction pipelines typically separate hand and scene estimation, leave interaction attributes to separate task-specific models, and invoke several models per video, so no prior reconstruction model estimates these attributes and throughput becomes a practical constraint on large-scale annotation. We therefore introduce EgoFound3R, a unified end-to-end model that estimates world-space hand geometry in a metric scale shared with the scene, and predicts point-wise interaction attributes, including visibility, contact, and distance. The model integrates three designs: (i) structured hand prompts that transfer pretrained geometric priors to world-space hand reconstruction; (ii) an explicit hand representation that decodes hand geometry and interaction attributes; and (iii) a shared-parameter multi-rate design that lowers inference cost. Together, these designs predict hand geometry and point-wise attributes in one pass. On OakInk-v2, TACO, and HOI4D, EgoFound3R reduces the mean per-joint position error (MPJPE) by 43.2%, 22.4%, and 11.6% over previous methods and predicts point-wise contact and distance alongside the geometry in the same pass, while attaining approximately 6x higher throughput.

</details>


### [82] [AutoGUIWorld: Image Generators as Visual World Models for GUI Agent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01215)
*Cheng Yang,Yifan Wu,Yutao Huang,Zhaohua Zhang,Beiduo Chen,Muxi Chen,Chenchen Zhao,Hexuan Deng,Haolin Yang,Geyuan Zhu,Sa Zhu,Jianhuan Zhuo,Qiuyong Xiao,Jianhao Ruan,Yiran Peng,Jiayi Zhang,Tian Ye,Xinlei Yu,Tianwen Jiang,Jihong Zhang,Yuyu Luo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AutoGUIWorld 是一个 GUI 交互轨迹生成框架，无需部署或运行真实软件环境，即可借助图像生成器的视觉先验与规划器的任务知识合成轨迹，并据此微调 GUI 智能体以提升真实任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练 GUI 智能体需要高质量的交互轨迹，但可用轨迹的多样性受限于底层环境中的应用、界面状态和工作流覆盖范围；扩展覆盖需部署越来越多样的复杂软件，而专用应用带来高额的安装、配置和运行成本。因此需要一种不依赖真实环境部署的轨迹生成方法。
