Abstract: GUI agents require high-quality interaction trajectories to learn how software environments respond to actions, maintain state, and support multi-step workflows. However, the diversity of available trajectories is constrained by the applications, interface states, and workflows accessible in the underlying environments. Expanding this coverage requires deploying increasingly diverse and complex software, with specialized applications imposing additional installation, configuration, and runtime costs. We introduce AutoGUIWorld, a data generation framework that combines the visual priors of image generators with the task knowledge of a planner to synthesize GUI interaction trajectories without deploying or running the corresponding software environments. AutoGUIWorld samples initial GUI scenes from structured specifications of operating-system context, visual appearance, and interface state, and generates tasks conditioned on those scenes. A planner then specifies atomic actions and their intended visual consequences, while an image generator iteratively edits the current screenshot to produce subsequent observations. Action grounding and transition-level quality filtering yield 79,266 spatially annotated step-level training samples across Ubuntu, Windows, macOS, and Chrome. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on AutoGUIWorld trajectories improves the mean task score on OSWorld from 33.0% to 40.8% and the task success rate on ScienceBoard from 14.0% to 32.2%. These results show that generated trajectories improve GUI-agent performance on real desktop and scientific tasks.

</details>


### [83] [A Compact Explicit 4D Representation for Dynamic Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01229)
*Di Yang,Zhihao Li,Yanhai Xiong,Yufei Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Sparc4D 是一种前馈自编码器，将已知相机参数的单目视频压缩为稀疏 4D 场景状态，在 MultiCamVideo 数据集上以约 0.95M 个 32 位等价值实现 21.70 dB 的重建质量，优于 MoVieS，并能零微调迁移到 DyCheck 与 Neu3D。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 紧凑的动态场景表示需同时保留随时间变化的表面几何与用于新视角渲染的外观信息。现有方法在状态规模与重建质量之间难以兼顾，因此需要一种既能高效压缩时间变化特征、又能保留精细纹理的稀疏 4D 表示。

Method: Sparc4D 采用前馈自编码器架构：静态特征在整段视频片段内共享，空间锚定的时间槽（temporal slots）压缩时间变化特征；稀疏解码器生成 2D 高斯面元（surfels），并通过几何重投影利用存储的源像素保留精细纹理。状态包含一个完整源帧、每隔四帧采样的动态区域像素、可学习特征与稀疏占用信息。

Result: 在 32 帧 MultiCamVideo 片段上，随机窗口平均约 0.95M 个 32 位等价值，first-32 协议约 0.92M。first-32 下重建达 21.70 dB，优于 MoVieS 的 20.40 dB；随机放置窗口上两者 PSNR 相当。禁用存储纹理后，时间槽将时变特征状态压缩 4.0 倍（中位数），平均状态从 1.04M 降至 0.42M，而目标视角重建质量基本不变。未经真实数据微调即可迁移到 DyCheck 和 Neu3D，存储纹理提升 LPIPS 但略微降低 PSNR。

Conclusion: Sparc4D 证明通过"共享静态特征 + 空间锚定时间槽 + 稀疏 2D 高斯解码 + 源像素重投影"的组合，可在极小状态规模下实现高质量动态场景新视角合成，并具备良好的跨数据集泛化能力。

Abstract: A compact dynamic-scene representation must retain both the surfaces seen over time and the appearance needed to render them from new viewpoints. We present Sparc4D, a feed-forward autoencoder that encodes a monocular video with known cameras into a sparse 4D scene state. Static features are shared across the clip, while spatially anchored temporal slots compress time-varying features. A sparse decoder produces 2D Gaussian surfels, while stored source pixels preserve fine texture through geometric re-projection. The state includes one full source frame and dynamic-region pixels sampled every fourth frame, alongside learned features and sparse occupancy. For a 32-frame MultiCamVideo clip, it averages 0.95M 32-bit-equivalent values on random windows and 0.92M on the first-32 protocol. On first-32, Sparc4D reaches 21.70\,dB, compared with 20.40\,dB for MoVieS. On randomly placed windows, their PSNR scores are comparable. With stored texture disabled, temporal slots compress the time-varying feature state by a median $4.0\times$ and reduce the mean state from 1.04M to 0.42M values, with essentially unchanged target-view reconstruction quality. Without fine-tuning on real data, Sparc4D transfers to DyCheck and Neu3D, where stored texture improves LPIPS while slightly reducing PSNR.

</details>


### [84] [Flow Matching Reinforcement for 3D Mesh Generation via Dynamic Homing Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01233)
*Zhen Zhou,Zhiwei Ning,Puhua Jiang,Sheng Zhang,Yifei Tang,Jie Yang,Xintong Han,Wei Liu,Chunchao Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出动态归航优化(DHO)这种正向过程强化学习方法,通过将负样本轨迹优化重新表述为"正样本吸引引导的动态归航",并构建 Flow3D-Pro 图像到3D几何生成框架,在3D生成上超越现有DPO/GRPO/NFT类目标及网格生成方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流匹配是3D生成的核心,但现有强化学习方法(DPO、GRPO、NFT风格目标)多从2D视觉生成直接移植。这些方法在应用于负样本轨迹时,仅将预测速度推向远离相应方向,而未明确指定朝向优选样本的目标速度场。受预训练模型能力、rollout多样性及奖励分布复杂度限制,直接套用这些RL方法在3D生成中几何质量提升有限。

Method: 提出正向过程RL方法DHO,将负样本轨迹优化重构为"正样本吸引引导的动态归航":(1)最小代价吸引匹配(MAM)为每个负样本分配一个不同的正样本目标;(2)时间感知动态校正(TDC)利用剩余时间感知的校正速度,将其轨迹重定向到目标。基于异步在线DHO进一步构建Flow3D-Pro图像到3D几何生成框架。

Result: 实验表明,DHO在3D生成中优于代表性的DPO、GRPO和NFT风格目标;Flow3D-Pro相比现有网格生成方法能生成更高质量的3D几何。

Conclusion: 通过将负轨迹优化转化为具有明确正样本目标的正向归航过程,DHO克服了2D移植RL方法在3D几何生成中缺乏目标速度场的缺陷,显著提升3D几何质量,验证了该思路在图像到3D生成任务中的有效性。

Abstract: Flow matching is central to 3D generation, yet in practice its reinforcement learning (RL) methods are largely adapted from 2D visual generation. Representative DPO-, GRPO-, and NFT-style objectives, when applied to negative trajectories, mainly steer predicted velocities away from the corresponding directions without explicitly specifying a target velocity field toward preferred samples. In 3D generation, constrained by pretrained model capabilities, rollout diversity, and reward-distribution complexity, directly applying these RL methods yields limited gains in geometric quality. We introduce a forward-process RL method \textbf{Dynamic Homing Optimization (DHO)}, which reformulates negative-trajectory optimization as positive-sample attraction-guided dynamic homing. Specifically, Minimum-Cost Attractive Matching (MAM) assigns each negative sample a distinct positive target, and Time-Aware Dynamic Correction (TDC) then redirects its trajectory toward the target using a remaining-time-aware corrective velocity. Building on asynchronous online DHO, we develop \textbf{Flow3D-Pro}, an image-to-3D geometry generation framework. Experiments show that DHO outperforms representative DPO-, GRPO-, and NFT-style objectives in 3D generation, while Flow3D-Pro produces higher-quality 3D geometry than existing mesh generation methods.

</details>


### [85] [When the Judge Acts: Auditing VLM-Guided Image Selection on Culturally Situated Prompts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01243)
*Huichan Seo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文审计了视觉语言模型（VLM）作为图像评判者时的决策质量，发现4B参数模型存在严重的位置偏置（首选第一张图）且仅略优于随机，而8B模型表现更好；结果还表明"跨顺序一致性"这类过滤策略只在针对特定模型的失败模式时才有效，更换评判者后必须重新审计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM越来越多地被用作评判者来选择最佳生成图像，其选择直接影响用户所见，但现有验证方式仅以与人类评分的分数一致性为标准，而非关注评判者实际返回的图像质量。作者希望将VLM评判者作为真正的"决策者"进行审计，检验其选择是否可靠、是否受候选顺序影响，以及一致性过滤策略是否有效。

Method: 在300个具有文化情境的提示上，将VLM评判者返回的图像与（评判者不可见的人类评分）及同一候选池中的随机选择进行比较；每次决策在候选顺序重排后重复执行，以检测位置偏置和决策稳定性。进一步检验"跨顺序一致性"作为过滤器的效果，并与CLIP相似度基线、一个较弱的第二评判者进行对照；还测试了聚合多个顺序后的刻板印象评分变化。

Result: 4B参数评判者几乎不优于随机，且弱于CLIP基线；在49%的调用中挑选第一张显示的图像（随机概率为28%），顺序重排使其在60%的提示上改变选择。对该模型而言，跨顺序一致的决策远优于随机，但与较弱第二评判者的一致性反而保留错误决策。8B评判者几乎没有位置偏置且优于CLIP，但同样的跨顺序过滤器却主要丢弃了其正确决策。4B模型在单个顺序下略显升高的刻板印象评分，在跨顺序聚合或换用更大模型后不再可检测。

Conclusion: 仅当一致性过滤器针对评判者的具体失败模式时才有帮助，因此每当评判者更换时，过滤器都必须重新审计；同时应以返回图像的质量而非单纯的分数一致性来验证VLM评判者。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly act as judges that pick the best of several generated images, so their choices decide what users see. Such judges are usually validated by score agreement with human ratings, not by the images they return. We audit VLM judges as decision-makers: on 300 culturally situated prompts, we compare the returned image with human ratings the judge never sees and with random choice from the same candidates, and repeat every decision with the candidates reordered. A 4B-parameter judge barely beats random and falls short of a CLIP similarity baseline. It picks the first image shown in 49% of calls (chance: 28%), and reordering changes its choice on 60% of prompts. For this judge, agreement across orders is informative: decisions that survive reordering are much better than random, whereas agreement with a weaker second judge keeps the wrong ones. An 8B judge shows almost no position bias and outperforms CLIP, yet for it the same filter mostly discards good decisions. Agreement helps only when it targets the judge's failure mode, so filters must be re-audited whenever the judge changes. The 4B judge's slight rise in stereotype ratings is no longer detectable after aggregating across orders or with the larger judge.

</details>


### [86] [PickMoment: Continuous-Time Single-Image-to-Video via Learning Deblurring and Blur-to-Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01279)
*Junseong Shin,Hyeonsu Jo,Daehyun Kim,Tae Hyun Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PickMoment 将运动去模糊重新表述为连续时间问题，用一个确定性模型直接学习曝光区间任意子区间上的区间均值模糊，统一了单图去模糊、模糊转视频与任意时刻取帧三种任务，并在多项基准上达到领先水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 运动模糊本质上是清晰连续信号在有限曝光时长上的时间积分，但现有学习方法绕开了这一物理模型：单图去模糊仅恢复曝光中心一帧，模糊转视频预测固定的帧序列。作者希望直接贴合模糊的积分模型，支持对曝光区间内任意子区间/任意时刻的查询，并以单一模型统一多个相关任务。

Method: 提出连续时间重表述 PickMoment，借鉴 MeanFlow 的平均速度公式，用一个确定性模型学习任意子区间上的“区间均值模糊”（interval-mean blur）。训练采用源自模糊积分的三重监督：1) 基于可用子帧的经验重建损失；2) 强制重叠子区间自一致的加和性损失（additivity loss）；3) 锚定在零区间极限处的清晰帧损失（sharp-frame loss）。单个网络通过不同查询即可完成各任务，无需逐任务单独训练。

Result: 在 GoPro 和 HIDE 上，PickMoment 在基于生成式的去模糊方法中取得最先进性能；在 RealBlur 上与基于复原的方法具有竞争力；在 GoPro-7 模糊转视频上取得最高的逐帧保真度。上述结果均在单次前向传播中完成，无需迭代采样。

Conclusion: 通过以物理积分为导向的连续时间建模与三重监督，PickMoment 用单一确定性模型统一了单图去模糊、模糊转视频和连续时刻取帧，兼顾了生成式方法的性能与单步前向的高效推理。

Abstract: Motion blur arises from the temporal integration of a continuous sharp signal over a finite exposure window, yet existing learning-based methods sidestep this physical model and predict only the sharp signal itself: most single-image deblurring methods recover a single frame at the exposure center, while blur-to-video methods predict a fixed set of frames. We introduce PickMoment, a continuous-time reformulation that directly learns the interval-mean blur over arbitrary sub-intervals of the exposure with a single deterministic model. Drawing an analogy to MeanFlow's average-velocity formulation, we train the model with three supervisions derived from the blur integral: an empirical reconstruction loss from available subframes, an additivity loss that enforces self-consistency across overlapping sub-intervals, and a sharp-frame loss anchored at the zero-interval limit. A single trained model unifies single-image deblurring, blur-to-video generation, and continuous-time pick-a-moment recovery as different queries to the same network, with no separate training for each task. Our PickMoment achieves state-of-the-art performance among generative-based deblurring methods on GoPro and HIDE while competitive against restoration-based methods on RealBlur, and the highest per-frame fidelity on GoPro-7 blur-to-video, all in a single forward pass without iterative sampling.

</details>


### [87] [ShelfChange3D: Object-Level 3D Change Detection for Retail Shelf Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01283)
*Lingyi Zhou,Yunke Wang,Mengyu Zheng,Wenbo Wang,Zijian Wang,Chang Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文将货架监控定义为物体级3D变化检测任务，提出ShelfChange3D数据集与ChangeBox端到端框架，用于从成对RGB-D观测中检测商品变化并输出3D包围盒，并引入基于深度与重力先验的几何精修阶段提升定位精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可靠的货架监控对零售自动化至关重要，但现有缺货检测方法主要在图像空间运行，缺乏可供下游机器人系统使用的度量级3D定位能力，因此需要将货架监控建模为物体级3D变化检测任务。

Method: 作者将任务定义为：给定不同时间捕获的两组RGB-D观测，识别变化商品并以3D包围盒定位每处变化。为此构建了ShelfChange3D数据集（含145K合成与5K真实世界成对RGB-D观测及物体级3D变化标注），并提出ChangeBox端到端框架，联合推理成对观测并预测物体级3D变化盒；同时引入基于几何的精修阶段，利用深度与重力先验估计相对位姿并优化预测盒。

Result: 实验表明，ChangeBox优于现有变化检测基线，几何精修阶段带来进一步增益，且合成数据到真实世界观测的迁移有效。

Conclusion: 通过在3D变化检测框架中结合物体级标注、成对推理与几何精修，可实现更准确的货架商品变化检测与度量级3D定位，适用于下游机器人系统。

Abstract: Reliable shelf monitoring is an important capability for retail automation, yet existing out-of-stock detection methods mainly operate in image space and lack metric 3D localization for downstream robotic systems. We formulate shelf monitoring as object-level 3D change detection: given two RGB-D observations captured at different times, the goal is to identify changed products and localize each change with a 3D bounding box. To support this task, we introduce ShelfChange3D, comprising 145K synthetic and 5K real-world paired RGB-D observations with object-level 3D change annotations. We further propose ChangeBox, an end-to-end framework that jointly reasons over paired observations and predicts object-level 3D change boxes. To improve localization accuracy, we introduce a geometry-based refinement stage that exploits depth and gravity prior to estimate relative pose and refine predicted boxes. Experiments show that ChangeBox outperforms existing change detection baselines, with further gains from refinement and effective transfer from synthetic to real-world observations.

</details>


### [88] [Dyna3: VLM-Guided Training-Free 4D Reconstruction via Depth Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01286)
*Xinhao Xiang,Weiyang Li,Zhijie Zheng,Abhijeet Rastogi,Jiawei Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Dyna3是一个免训练框架，将深度基础模型Depth Anything 3（DA3）扩展到4D动态场景重建，利用跨视图特征匹配区分动静物体，并结合VLM与SAM 3做实例级分割，实现更快速、更低内存的4D重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DA3等深度基础模型在静态3D场景中表现优异，但现实环境多为动态；现有免训练4D方法（如Easi3R、VGGT4D）依赖面向对应关系训练的骨干网络，其注意力编码了跨帧匹配信息，而纯深度模型DA3缺乏该能力。作者需要一种无需微调即可让DA3支持动态4D重建的方法。

Method: 提出Dyna3免训练框架：①利用DA3的跨视图特征，结合跨帧最佳匹配特征搜索，发现静态表面能全局一致匹配、动态物体无法匹配，从而隐式编码运动判别信号；②采用视觉语言模型自动生成场景相关的语义提示，驱动SAM 3实现精确实例级分割，区分"哪些物体在动"与"哪些物体存在"；③将场景解耦为跨帧对齐的静态背景与逐帧动态点云进行重建。

Result: 在四个数据集上，Dyna3在动态物体分割上超过最先进的VGGT4D达+5.5个百分点J-Mean；姿态估计速度最高快13倍，4D重建快3倍，内存占用降低4到8倍，从而支持更密集的时间采样。

Conclusion: Dyna3成功将纯深度模型DA3培训free地扩展至动态4D重建，无需对应关系训练即可通过特征匹配与语义分割区分动静区域，在精度、速度与内存效率上均优于现有免训练4D方法，有望支持以往方法无法实现的密集时间采样。

Abstract: Recent depth foundation models like Depth Anything 3 (DA3) achieve remarkable multi-view depth estimation but assume static 3D scenes, limiting their applicability to real-world dynamic environments. Existing training-free 4D methods like Easi3R and VGGT4D rely on correspondence-trained backbones whose attention encodes cross-frame matching, a property absent in depth-only models like DA3. We present Dyna3, a training-free framework that extends DA3 for 4D dynamic scene reconstruction without any fine-tuning. Our key insight is that DA3's cross-view features, though trained only for depth consistency, implicitly encode motion-discriminative signals when combined with best-match feature search across frames. Its static surfaces find consistent matches globally, while dynamic objects cannot. We further adopt vision-language models (VLM) to automatically generate scene-specific semantic prompts for SAM 3, enabling precise instance-level segmentation that distinguishes which objects move from what objects exist. For reconstruction, we decouple the scene into a cross-frame aligned static background and per-frame dynamic point clouds. Experiments on four datasets demonstrate that Dyna3 surpasses correspondence-trained methods with +5.5pp J-Mean over state-of-the-art VGGT4D on dynamic object segmentation, while achieving up to 13x faster pose estimation and 3x faster 4D reconstruction with 4 to 8x lower memory. Dyna3 could therefore enable much denser temporal sampling that prior methods cannot support.

</details>


### [89] [ODDR: One-Step Deshadow Diffusion via Reward Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01291)
*Junseong Shin,Kijun Kim,Minseong Kim,Dongjin Kim,Tae Hyun Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 ODDR 框架，通过合成数据训练的一步扩散去影模型 ODD 结合首个无需人工标注的奖励模型 ShadowReward 进行奖励引导微调，实现高效、高保真的去影，无需真实成对数据即可逼近有监督方法性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度去影方法依赖成本高昂且场景多样性有限的真实成对数据集，导致泛化能力受限。作者希望摆脱对真实成对监督的依赖，同时解决合成数据与真实数据之间的域差异问题。

Method: 提出 ODDR 框架：先训练 ODD（基于合成阴影数据的一步去影扩散基线模型）实现高效单步去影重建；再训练 ShadowReward 奖励模型，该模型完全无需人工标注，通过对带有受控退化（如纹理失真、边界伪影）的合成图像进行排序来模仿人类感知判断；最后用 ShadowReward 对 ODD 进行奖励引导微调，缩小合成到真实的域差距。

Result: ODD 无需真实成对监督即可取得强性能；ODDR 进一步改善结果，缩小与在真实成对数据上训练的全监督方法的差距，同时作为单步模型保持更高的计算效率。

Conclusion: ODDR 通过无真实配对监督的合成训练与无人工标注的奖励引导相结合，在高效单步推理下实现了高保真去影，有效弥合了合成到真实的域差距，为去影任务提供了更经济且可泛化的解决方案。

Abstract: Recent advances in deep learning for shadow removal have significantly enhanced image quality and realism. However, most approaches rely on real-world paired datasets, which are costly to collect and often limited in scene diversity, leading to limited generalization. To address these limitations, we propose One-step Deshadow Diffusion via Reward guidance (ODDR), a new framework that achieves efficient and high-fidelity shadow removal without relying on real-world paired supervision. Our method begins with One-step Deshadow Diffusion (ODD), a baseline model trained on synthetic shadow data for efficient one-step shadow-free reconstruction. We further adapt ODD into ODDR using ShadowReward. In contrast to traditional, annotation-heavy approaches, ShadowReward is the first reward model for shadow removal trained entirely without human annotation. It learns to mimic human perceptual judgments by ranking synthetically generated images with controlled degradations, such as texture distortion and boundary artifacts. This reward-guided fine-tuning enables ODDR to close the synthetic-to-real domain gap. Extensive experiments show that ODD achieves strong performance without relying on real-world paired supervision, and ODDR further improves the results, narrowing the gap to fully supervised methods trained on real-world paired data while maintaining higher computational efficiency as a single-step model.

</details>


### [90] [STAGE: Subspace-Targeted Affine Generative Erasure for Text-to-3D Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01302)
*Karol Dziekan,Przemysław Spurek,Dawid Malarz*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: STAGE 是一个无需训练、闭合形式的框架，用于在原生文生3D生成器中按阶段（结构/外观）抹除概念，通过将编辑约束在擦除-锚点嵌入差的低维子空间内，并用最小二乘仿射校正取代正交约束，在 TRELLIS 上以 66.7 的综合得分超越最强基线（53.2）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有闭合形式概念抹除方法专为 2D 图像扩散设计，假设单一生成路径，一次编辑需同时覆盖几何与纹理；而原生 3D 生成器直接合成结构化 3D 表示，违背该假设。作者发现形状/物体概念须在结构阶段抹除、材质概念须在外观阶段抹除，故需要阶段感知的编辑方案。

Method: 将原生文生3D抹除形式化为阶段感知编辑问题，提出 STAGE 框架：把每次编辑限制在擦除嵌入与锚点嵌入之差的低维子空间内；并将先前的保范（正交）约束松弛为最小二乘仿射校正，使目标激活映射到安全锚点，同时惩罚保留提示（retained prompts）的位移；校正可作用于结构阶段、外观阶段或两者。

Result: 在标准开源原生 3D 生成器 TRELLIS 上，跨越 15 个形状、材质和物体概念，STAGE 在平衡“遗忘目标概念”与“保留其余一切”的综合得分（聚合 CLIP 语义与物理指标）上达到 66.7，超过最强适配基线（53.2）。

Conclusion: 概念抹除在原生产文生3D中必须按阶段进行：形状与物体概念针对结构阶段、材质概念针对外观阶段。STAGE 通过低维子空间约束与最小二乘仿射校正实现训练免费、闭合形式的阶段感知抹除，并显著优于已有基线，证明阶段感知设计对原生 3D 生成器概念抹除的必要性。

Abstract: Concept erasure suppresses a target concept while preserving behavior on unrelated inputs. Existing closed-form methods were designed for 2D image diffusion and assume a single generative pathway, so one edit must cover geometry and texture at once. Native 3D generators, which synthesize structured 3D representations directly rather than by lifting 2D samples, violate this assumption. We show that shape and object concepts must be erased in the structural stage of the pipeline and material concepts in the appearance stage. We therefore formulate erasure in native text-to-3D as a stage-aware editing problem and introduce STAGE, a training-free, closed-form framework. STAGE confines each edit to the low-dimensional subspace spanned by the differences between erase and anchor embeddings, and relaxes the norm-preserving (orthogonal) constraint of prior editors into a least-squares affine correction that maps target activations onto safe anchors subject to a penalty on the displacement of retained prompts. The correction applies to the structural stage, the appearance stage, or both. We find that the stage an edit must reach is determined by concept type. On TRELLIS, the standard open native 3D generator, across 15 shape, material, and object concepts, STAGE reaches 66.7 on a composite score that balances forgetting the target concept against preserving everything else, aggregating CLIP-based semantic and physical metrics, versus 53.2 for the strongest adapted baseline.
  Code: https://github.com/gmum/STAGE/
  Project Page https://gmum.github.io/STAGE/

</details>


### [91] [ARROW: Arbitrary Reconstruction and Tracking of 4D Observations in the Wild](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01314)
*Ilya Fradlin,Christian Schmidt,Jens Piekenbrinck,Karim Knaebel,Gonzalo Martin Garcia,Bastian Leibe*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ARROW 是一个前馈模型，通过一种顺序不变（order-invariant）的查询机制，统一处理任意图像集合中的 3D 重建与 3D 点追踪任务，并在多个基准上达到新 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态场景可由运动相机、多路视频流或不同时刻拍摄的图像捕捉，这些观测揭示了场景几何与运动的互补信息；但将其整合需要跨视角、跨时间及克服可见性变化建立对应关系。现有方法往往针对单一输入形式（如固定视频或成对图像）设计，难以在任意图像集合上统一建模，因此需要一种能统一 3D 重建与 3D 点追踪的通用框架。

Method: 提出前馈模型 ARROW，核心是一种新颖的顺序不变查询方法（order-invariant querying），使查询能够与任意输入中的观测建立关联，从而不受输入图像数量与排列顺序限制。在训练阶段，通过让模型接触更多样化的输入集合来提升任务性能，并使其泛化到多视角追踪等更广泛的任务。

Result: ARROW 在 WorldTrack 和 TAPVid-3D 上建立了 3D 追踪的新 SOTA；在仅 RGB 的自适应 MVTracker 基准上超越专用多视角追踪器；同时在各类 3D 重建任务中保持竞争力。代码与权重已公开。

Conclusion: 通过顺序不变的查询机制和多样化的训练策略，ARROW 成功统一了任意图像集合上的 3D 重建与 3D 点追踪，展现出更强的泛化能力与更高的跨任务性能，为动态场景理解提供了通用且高效的解决方案。

Abstract: Dynamic scenes may be captured by a moving camera, multiple video streams, or images taken at different times. These observations reveal complementary aspects of scene geometry and motion, yet bringing them together requires establishing correspondence across viewpoints, capture times, and visibility changes. We introduce ARROW, a feed-forward model that unifies 3D reconstruction and 3D point tracking from arbitrary image sets. At its core is a novel order-invariant querying approach, which allows the association of queries with observations across arbitrary inputs. We show that exposing the model to more diverse sets of inputs during training results in improved task performance. Moreover, the resulting model is capable of generalization to a wider range of tasks including multi-view tracking. Trained with this strategy, ARROW establishes a new state of the art in 3D tracking on WorldTrack and TAPVid-3D and outperforms dedicated multi-view trackers on an adapted RGB-only MVTracker benchmark, while remaining competitive across 3D reconstruction tasks. Code and weights are publicly available.

</details>


### [92] [CLASP: Continual Low-rank Adapters for Spatially Placed Concepts from One Hypernetwork](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01331)
*Wojciech Gromski,Patryk Krukowski,Jan Miksa,Maciej Zieba,Przemysław Spurek*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于单一固定大小超网络的免排练方法，用于文生图扩散模型的持续个性化，在避免灾难性遗忘的同时保持参数占用不随概念数量增长，并整合空间控制能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有持续个性化方法要么遭受灾难性遗忘，要么需存储额外的概念特定参数与空间组件，导致参数量随概念流增长，无法扩展到长序列个性化任务。

Method: 使用单个固定大小的超网络对冻结的扩散模型进行持续个性化；超网络动态生成个性化所需的、概念特定的适配参数，并在不引入额外每个概念组件的前提下整合空间控制，使用户能指定个性化概念出现的位置。

Result: 实验表明该方法能强健地保留已学概念、实现可靠的空间定位，在匹配或优于现有方法的同时能有效扩展到长流式个性化任务。

Conclusion: 该免排练、固定参数占用的超网络框架实现了可扩展的持续个性化，兼具概念保留与空间可控性，适合处理长序列个性化任务。

Abstract: Continual personalization of text-to-image diffusion models requires sequentially acquiring new concepts while retaining previously learned ones. However, existing methods either suffer from catastrophic forgetting or rely on storing additional concept-specific parameters and spatial components, causing their parameter footprint to grow with the concept stream. This limits their ability to scale to long sequences of personalization tasks. We propose a rehearsal-free approach that uses a single fixed-size hypernetwork to continually personalize a frozen diffusion model. Instead of expanding the model as new concepts are acquired, the hypernetwork dynamically produces the concept-specific adaptations required for personalization while preserving previously learned concepts. Our framework further integrates spatial control into the personalization process, allowing users to specify where a personalized concept should appear without introducing additional per-concept components. This formulation enables continual personalization with a parameter footprint that remains independent of the number of learned concepts, aside from compact concept representations. Experiments demonstrate strong retention of previously learned concepts and reliable spatial grounding, matching or improving upon existing methods while scaling effectively to long streams of personalization tasks.

</details>


### [93] [MMVistaReason: Toward Open-Data and Post-Training Recipes for Multimodal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01352)
*Juekai Lin,Honglin Lin,Yuqian Yuan,Xiaolong Wu,Jie Cao,Liang Liang,Yunqi Cao,Yun Zhu,Wenqiao Zhang,Lijun Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MMVistaReason (MVR) 提出了一套开放数据的多模态推理后训练方案，通过更广的能力覆盖、高效的 SFT/RL 数据构建以及"先专精后整合"的训练策略，使 4B 模型在 15 个多模态基准上达到 72.8 平均分，超越 9B/8B 基线，且所需样本减少约 70%；扩展至 9B 后平均分达 74.4。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放的多模态推理模型虽受益于大规模推理监督，但可靠的后训练仍面临四大挑战：数据质量参差不齐、监督构建效率低下、难度分布失衡以及跨领域干扰。

Method: 提出三部分配方：(1) 更广的能力覆盖——将数据分为互补的 Analytical 与 Real-World 推理组，分别侧重结构化推理与视觉感知/空间定位；(2) 高效的 SFT 与 RL 数据构建——通过分阶段清洗与标注标准化异构开放数据，结合难度感知的级联教师蒸馏与基于答案似然的轨迹筛选构建 MVR-SFT-528K，再应用规模特定的前沿过滤得到 MVR-RL-63K；(3) 先专精后整合训练——训练互补的 RL 专家，并通过多教师在线策略蒸馏(MOPD)整合其能力。

Result: 分析揭示监督难度、轨迹质量与模型容量之间存在容量依赖的交互：较小学生模型更多受益于筛选后的监督，而较大模型对轨迹变化和混合域干扰更鲁棒。混合域 RL 引入基准级负迁移，而 MOPD 提供一致的能力整合，且偏好的 KL 方向随模型规模变化。在 15 个多模态基准上，MVR-4B 平均分 72.8，超越 Qwen3.5-9B(Instruct)和 MMFineReason-8B，且样本用量比 MMFineReason 少约 70%；扩展到 9B 后平均分提升至 74.4，超越 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B(Instruct)。

Conclusion: MMVistaReason 证明，系统的开放数据构建与容量感知的后训练为可靠的多模态推理提供了一条实用且可扩展的路径。

Abstract: Open multimodal reasoning models have benefited from large-scale reasoning supervision, yet reliable post-training remains challenging due to uneven data quality, inefficient supervision construction, imbalanced difficulty, and cross-domain interference. We introduce MMVistaReason (MVR), an open-data post-training recipe with three components: (1) broader capability coverage across complementary Analytical and Real-World reasoning groups, emphasizing structured reasoning versus visual perception and spatial grounding; (2) efficient SFT and RL data construction, standardizing heterogeneous open data through staged cleaning and annotation, combining difficulty-aware cascaded teacher distillation with answer-likelihood-based trajectory selection to construct MVR-SFT-528K, and applying scale-specific frontier filtering for MVR-RL-63K; and (3) specialize-then-integrate training, which trains complementary RL experts and consolidates their capabilities through multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). Our analyses reveal a capacity-dependent interaction between supervision difficulty, trajectory quality, and model capacity: smaller students benefit more from selected supervision, while larger students are robust to trajectory variation and mixed-domain interference. Mixed-domain RL introduces benchmark-level negative transfer, whereas MOPD provides consistent capability integration, with the preferred KL direction varying across model scales. Across 15 multimodal benchmarks, MVR-4B achieves an average score of 72.8, outperforming Qwen3.5-9B (Instruct) and MMFineReason-8B while using about 70% fewer samples than MMFineReason. Scaling to 9B improves the average to 74.4, surpassing Qwen3.5-35B-A3B (Instruct). Overall, MMVistaReason demonstrates that systematic open-data construction and capacity-aware post-training provide a practical and scalable path toward reliable multimodal reasoning.

</details>


### [94] [Supervising Sound Localization by In-the-wild Egomotion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01388)
*Anna Min,Ziyang Chen,Hang Zhao,Andrew Owens*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种利用相机自身运动（egomotion）作为弱监督信号来学习双耳声源定位的方法，并提出了一个包含真实世界音视频与自运动的数据集用于评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双耳声源定位通常依赖传统双耳线索（如耳间时间差、耳间声级差），但缺乏大规模的真实标注数据。作者希望借助视频中相机运动引起的声源方向变化，获取一种廉价而丰富的弱监督信号，从而在真实世界数据上训练出有效的声源定位模型。

Method: 随着视频推进，相机相对于声源的方向会随相机运动而改变。作者先利用多视图几何等传统方法估计相机的视觉运动，然后训练一个音频模型，使其预测的声源方向与视觉估计的相机运动保持一致，从而构成弱监督；同时将该弱监督与传统双耳线索相结合进行联合训练。

Result: 作者构建了一个包含真实世界音视频与相机自运动的数据集用于评测。实验表明，模型能够成功地从真实世界数据中学习，并在声源定位任务上取得良好表现。

Conclusion: 利用自运动作为弱监督信号是一种有效且实用的双耳声源定位学习方法，能够在缺乏人工标注的真实场景数据上训练出性能良好的定位模型。

Abstract: We present a method for learning binaural sound localization using egomotion as a supervisory signal. Over the course of a video, the cameras direction to a sound source will change as the camera moves. We train an audio model to predict sound directions that are consistent with visual estimates of camera motion, which we obtain using traditional methods from multi-view geometry. This provides a weak but plentiful form of supervision that we combine with traditional binaural cues. To evaluate this method, we propose a dataset of real-world audio-visual videos with egomotion. We show that our model can successfully learn from real-world data and that it performs well on sound localization tasks

</details>


### [95] [Smoother Flow Matching via Contrastive Trajectory Repulsion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01408)
*Ziqi Jiang,Zhenqi He,Long Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 CoFlow，将对比学习引入流匹配（FM），在训练时显式排斥轨迹以降低速度场的局部 Lipschitz 常数，从而缓解轨迹交叉问题，在少步推理中显著降低 FID，且不增加训练开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 轨迹交叉是流匹配的关键瓶颈。以往工作多从理论优化角度看待交叉（导致速度平均），通过事后蒸馏或端点耦合间接处理，未显式调控中间轨迹。作者提出新的网络学习视角：交叉点会使目标速度场产生大的局部 Lipschitz 常数，带来两个缺陷：(1) 高 Lipschitz 常数对应速度场中的高频信号，因神经网络的谱偏置（spectral bias）难以拟合；(2) 剧烈速度变化在少步推理中导致严重的数值积分误差。

Method: 提出 CoFlow 框架，将对比学习范式引入流匹配，在训练时显式排斥轨迹以降低速度场局部 Lipschitz 常数。具体从随机微分方程（SDE）角度建模，注入排斥性漂移项（repulsive drift term），引导正样本的前向过程远离负样本轨迹；并进一步从该 SDE 导出等价的随机插值（stochastic interpolant）形式，提供简单可控的设计空间来调节负样本的影响。

Result: 在 ImageNet 256x256 上的大量实验表明，与标准 FM 相比，CoFlow 在少步推理（如 20 步）中显著降低 FID，且不增加训练开销。

Conclusion: CoFlow 通过显式排斥轨迹、降低速度场局部 Lipschitz 常数，有效缓解流匹配中的轨迹交叉与少步推理误差，在保持训练开销不变的前提下提升生成质量，并开源代码。

Abstract: Trajectory crossing remains a critical bottleneck in Flow Matching (FM), and previous works typically view these crossings from a theoretical optimization perspective causing velocity averaging. They attempt to address it indirectly by post-hoc distillation or endpoint coupling, without explicitly regulating the intermediate trajectories. In this paper, we introduce a new network learning perspective: crossing points inherently induce large local Lipschitz constants in the target velocity field, leading to two drawbacks. First, high Lipschitz constants correspond to high-frequency signals in the velocity field that neural networks struggle to fit due to spectral bias. Second, they also imply drastic velocity variations, leading to severe numerical integration errors in few-step inference. To alleviate this, we propose CoFlow, a framework that introduces the contrastive learning paradigm into FM to explicitly repel trajectories during training, thereby lowering the local Lipschitz constants of the velocity field. Specifically, we formulate CoFlow from a Stochastic Differential Equation (SDE) perspective by injecting a repulsive drift term. This drift actively guides the forward process of positive samples away from negative trajectories, effectively reducing the local Lipschitz constant. Furthermore, we derive an equivalent stochastic interpolant formulation from this SDE, providing a simple and tractable design space to control the influence of negative samples. Extensive experiments on ImageNet 256x256 demonstrate that CoFlow significantly reduces FID compared to standard FM in few-step inference (e.g., 20 steps), with no added training overhead. The code can be accessed at: https://github.com/HKUST-LongGroup/CoFlow

</details>


### [96] [Localisation-Aware Uncertainty for Pretrained Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01409)
*Charmaine Barker,Daniel Bethell,Simos Gerasimou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 GRACE，一种轻量级事后（post-hoc）证据元模型，在冻结目标检测器的前提下，通过学习何时将目标定位视为不确定，来估计每个预测边界框的不确定性，无需重训练、修改架构或重复推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目标检测器在分布/协变量偏移及对抗攻击下需要可靠的不确定性估计，但现有方法常需重训练检测器、修改架构或重复多次推理，成本高昂或不可行。因此需要一种无需改动检测器、开销低的事后不确定性估计方法。

Method: 提出轻量级事后证据元模型 GRACE：自动识别与定位相关的特征，并通过显著性引导的修改构建难度逐步递增的课程；检测级目标结合定位误差、修改级别与预测不稳定性，训练证据元模型为每个预测框估计不确定性。整个过程保持基础检测器冻结，不改变其定位输出。

Result: 在多种对抗攻击及其强度下，GRACE 相较于最强对比方法，TP-FP AUROC 在某些情况下相对提升 22%，同时保持分布内检测性能不下降。

Conclusion: GRACE 提供了一种无需修改检测器、开销低且有效的事后不确定性估计方案，在对抗攻击下显著提升不确定性估计质量，并保留原有检测定位输出。

Abstract: Reliable uncertainty estimation is essential for deploying object detectors when distribution/covariate shift and adversarial attacks may occur. Existing approaches often require detector retraining, architectural modification, or repeated inference, which may be infeasible or incur significant overheads. We introduce a lightweight post-hoc evidential meta-model that learns when object localisations should be considered uncertain while keeping the base detector frozen. Our approach automatically identifies localisation-relevant features and uses saliency-guided modification to construct an increasingly challenging curriculum. Detection-level targets combine localisation error, modification level, and prediction instability to guide an evidential meta-model to estimate uncertainty for each predicted bounding box. Our approach requires no changes to the detector and preserves its original localisation outputs. Across adversarial attacks and evaluated strengths, GRACE improves TP-FP AUROC by 22% relative to the strongest comparator in some cases while maintaining in-distribution detection performance.

</details>

### [97] [On-Device Named-Entity Recognition: A Deployability Study of Accuracy, Cost, Reliability, and Confidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00007)
*Vinay Kumar Chaganti*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文在设备端 NER 场景下联合评估了三类模型（经典序列标注器、双向编码器专家、本地生成式 LLM）的准确率、延迟与输出有效性，发现"金标准来源"会翻转范式排名；编码器在可部署性上占优，生成式模型通过扩大规模而非增加预算来修复无效输出。文中还刻画了 GLiNER 的逐 span 置信度：排序能力尚可但过度自信，可用温度缩放校准，并考察了阈值化与本地级联路由的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NER 日益需要在设备端运行（无 API、低延迟、数据本地保存）。从业者真正关心的不是排行榜，而是：哪个模型可部署、如何在无人工标注下评估、以及其置信度能否被信任。作者希望联合回答这三个问题，并补齐文献中缺失的延迟与输出有效性两个维度。

Method: 将 9 个系统跨 3 种范式、13M 至 8B 参数（经典 spaCy；双向编码器专家 GLiNER 166M–460M；本地生成式 LLM Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B/4B-Instruct、DeepSeek-R1-1.5B/8B）置于 3 个性质不同的数据集上，报告准确率、延迟与输出有效性。由于 RSS-News 语料无金标准，先构建跨家族 LLM 评委组生成的"银标准"，再对照基准金标准测量其忠实度，并对整个语料做全量人工复验（严格 F1 0.95，且因人标是银标种子，实为准确率上界）。此外刻画 GLiNER 逐 span 置信度的 AUROC、ECE，采用温度缩放校准、阈值化，并设计全本地小到大级联与成本匹配的随机路由对比。

Result: 金标准来源会翻转范式排名：从 LLM 撰写的银标准切换到人工金标准，每个编码器模型准确率上升、每个生成式模型下降。仅看准确率，4B 指令型 LLM 具有竞争力（在干净新闻数据上领先），但编码器的优势在于可部署性：体积仅为 1/9 到 1/24，时延毫秒到秒级，零畸形输出；而最小的生成式模型在长输入上最高产生 27% 的无效输出，该缺陷需靠扩大规模而非增加输出预算来修复。GLiNER 的逐 span 置信度排序正确性良好（AUROC 0.76–0.86）但过度自信（ECE 0.24–0.47，经温度缩放减半）；阈值化带来小幅诚实的样本外 F1 提升；全本地小到大级联相对成本匹配的随机路由仅有小幅且依语料而定的增益；置信度与正确性相关、但与新颖性无关。所有数字均可由逐 span 记录离线复算。

Conclusion: 在设备端 NER 中，仅凭准确率不足以选型，金标准来源会改变范式排名；编码器在可部署性（体积、延迟、输出有效性）上明显占优，生成式模型需靠规模解决无效输出。GLiNER 的置信度可排序但需温度缩放校准，阈值化和本地级联的收益有限且依语料而定。研究强调评估的可复现性（逐 span 记录离线复算）与诚实性。

Abstract: Named-entity recognition (NER) is increasingly wanted on-device (no API, low latency, data kept local). The practitioner's question is not the leaderboard but which model is deployable, how to evaluate it without human annotation, and whether its confidence can be trusted. We answer these jointly. We place nine systems across three paradigms and 13 M to 8 B parameters: a classical tagger (spaCy), bidirectional-encoder specialists (GLiNER, 166 to 460 M), and generative LLMs run locally (Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B/4B-Instruct, DeepSeek-R1-1.5B/8B), on three datasets of differing character, and report accuracy plus two axes the literature omits: latency and output validity. Because our corpus (RSS-News) had no gold, we built silver gold from a cross-family LLM judge panel, then measured its fidelity against benchmark gold and a full human re-validation of the corpus (strict F1 0.95, an upper bound since the human gold was silver-seeded); gold provenance flips the paradigm ranking, moving from LLM-authored silver to human gold raises every encoder and lowers every generative model. On accuracy alone a 4 B instruct LLM is competitive (it leads on clean newswire), so the encoder's case is deployability: it matches or slightly trails at one-ninth to one-twenty-fourth the size, at millisecond-to-second latency, with zero malformed output, while the smallest generative models emit up to 27% invalid output on long inputs, a failure fixed by scale, not output budget. We then characterize GLiNER's per-span confidence: it ranks correctness well (AUROC 0.76 to 0.86) but is overconfident (ECE 0.24 to 0.47, halved by temperature scaling); thresholding gives a small honest out-of-sample F1 gain; an all-local small-to-large cascade gives a modest, corpus-dependent gain over cost-matched random routing; and confidence tracks correctness but not novelty. Every number recomputes offline from per-span records.

</details>


### [98] [SCM-based Fairness and Faithful Explainability for Legal Document Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00045)
*Yasmina El Kacemi,Seyed Sahand Mohammadi Ziabari,Ali Mohammed Mansoor Alsahag*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究在ECtHR语料上，将LegalBERT基线模型与一种在微调时惩罚刻板印象“温暖度/胜任力”表征的公平正则化变体进行对比，考察去偏干预是否同时影响公平性与SHAP解释忠实度。结果显示干预并未降低人口学不均衡、性能基本不变，但一致地降低了各随机种子下的解释充分性（sufficiency）；乱序词对对照复现了该退化，说明效应源于对比式表征正则化本身而非温暖度-胜任力结构。结论：解释行为的变化不代表公平性变化，公平性必须直接评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 法律决策支持中广泛使用LegalBERT等模型，引发对公平性与解释透明度的双重担忧，但二者通常被分开评估，尚不清楚改变公平性的去偏干预是否同时改变解释对模型推理的忠实度。本研究旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 在LexGLUE的ECtHR alleged-violations语料上，对比LegalBERT基线与公平正则化变体（微调时惩罚刻板印象温暖度与胜任力表征）。评估预测性能、人口学公平性及SHAP解释忠实度，跨5个随机种子；采用两种公平定义、性别轴的常规词对对照，并以乱序词对作为对照实验，在性能最优正则化强度下开展分析。

Result: 在性能最优正则化强度下，干预未降低人口学不均衡（该零结果在两种公平定义和性别轴词对对照下均成立），分类性能基本不变；然而干预在全部5个种子和3个阈值下一致降低了解释充分性。乱序词对对照同样复现了解释充分性的退化，而性能与公平性保持不变，表明效应来自对比式表征正则化，而非温暖度-胜任力结构本身。

Conclusion: 公平性与解释忠实度之间存在分离：解释行为的变化并不必然指示公平性的变化，因此公平性必须被直接评估，而不能以解释变化作为其代理指标。

Abstract: Transformer models such as LegalBERT are increasingly used in legal decision support, raising concerns about both fairness and the transparency of model explanations. These properties are usually evaluated separately, leaving open whether a debiasing intervention that changes fairness also changes how faithfully explanations reflect model reasoning. This study investigates that relationship on the ECtHR alleged-violations corpus from LexGLUE. It compares a LegalBERT baseline with a fairness-regularized variant that penalizes stereotypical warmth and competence representations during fine-tuning. The evaluation covers predictive performance, demographic fairness, and SHAP explanation faithfulness across five random seeds. At the performance-optimal regularization strength, the intervention does not reduce demographic disparity. This null result holds across two fairness definitions and a conventional word-pair control on the gender axis. Classification performance is largely unchanged. However, the intervention consistently degrades explanation sufficiency across all five seeds and three thresholds. A shuffled-pair control reproduces this degradation while leaving performance and fairness unchanged, indicating that the effect arises from contrastive representational regularization rather than specifically from the warmth and competence structure. The results demonstrate a dissociation between fairness and explanation faithfulness: changes in explanation behavior do not necessarily indicate changes in fairness, and fairness must therefore be evaluated directly.

</details>


### [99] [The First Token Is Not the Verdict: Hidden Costs of Reading LLM Judges Without Generating](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00054)
*Gnaneswar Villuri,Hashmath Shaik,Alex Doboli*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文指出：通过读取LLM评委首个生成token的logits（无需实际生成）来判定其裁决，会系统性地高估位置偏差，使该读数成为上界；原因在于评委并非总以裁决token开头，强制读取时会返回先展示的回复而非真正判断。作者建议报告评委"以裁决token开头"的比例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估LLM评委（LLM-as-a-judge）的裁决通常可通过受限解码或似然评分，仅读取首个生成token的logits，成本低且无需生成。作者发现这一便捷读数会扭曲位置偏差测量，导致对评委的审计结果失真，需要揭示其机制并量化影响。

Method: 对比"首token logits强制读取"与"完整生成后读取"两种裁决方式。在多个评委模型（Qwen3系列三种、Llama-3.1-8B、Phi-3.5-mini）和多种条件下，测量：(1) 评委不以裁决token开头的比例；(2) 在未提交裁决（未以裁决token开头）的924对样本上，交换两个回复位置后强制读取与生成后读取的翻转率差异；(3) 对位置偏差与评委准确率两个指标的影响幅度，并计算配对差值及95%置信区间。

Result: 1) 强制读取高估位置偏差：在所有测试条件下均表现为上界。2) 不以裁决token开头的比例：Qwen3三种评委为12%–49%，Llama-3.1-8B与Phi-3.5-mini低于3%。3) 在924个未提交裁决的对上，交换回复顺序后强制读数的翻转率高达89.7%，而生成后读取为47.5%，配对差值+0.422（95% CI [+0.365, +0.467]）。4) 失真具有指标特异性：位置偏差被移动42个百分点，而评委准确率在十分之七的条件下变化不足1点，因此误导的是审计者而非使用者。5) 次级失效：即使评委以裁决token开头，仍可能先写一个字母后推理转向相反裁决，发生率0–5.5%，且与服从率无相关性。

Conclusion: 首token logits读数会高估位置偏差，原因在于评委并非总以裁决token开头，强制读取会把"先展示的回复"而非真实判断当作裁决。该失真集中在位置偏差测量上，对准确率影响甚微。作者建议在报告任何位置偏差数据时，附上报导评委"以裁决token开头"的比例，该比例只需一次前向传播、无需标签即可获得。

Abstract: Reading an LLM judge's verdict from the logits of its first generated token is cheap, requires no generation, and is exactly what constrained decoding and likelihood-scoring evaluation harnesses produce. We show that this readout distorts position bias in one direction: it overstates it in every condition we test, so figures obtained this way behave as upper bounds. The mechanism is that judges do not always lead with a verdict token, on 12% to 49% of pairs for three Qwen3 judges and under 3% for Llama-3.1-8B and Phi-3.5-mini, and forcing a read on those pairs returns whichever response was shown first rather than a judgment. Pooled over the 924 pairs where a judge did not commit, the forced read flips on 89.7% of them when the responses are swapped, against 47.5% read after generation (paired difference +0.422, 95% CI [+0.365, +0.467]). The distortion is specific to what is measured: it moves position bias by 42 points while moving judge accuracy by under one point in seven of ten conditions, so it misleads whoever audits a judge rather than whoever uses one. A second, smaller failure occurs even when the judge does lead with a verdict token, since it sometimes opens with one letter and reasons its way to the other, on 0 to 5.5% of pairs at a rate uncorrelated with compliance. We recommend reporting the rate at which a judge leads with a verdict token, which costs one forward pass and no labels, alongside any position-bias figure.

</details>


### [100] [Measuring Human-Like Bias in LLMs? A Critique of Human-Derived Bias Constructs in LLM Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00070)
*Antonela Tommasel,Markus Schedl*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文批判性地审视了将人类中心偏见构念移植到LLM评估中的做法，指出其中存在的推断鸿沟，并提出一个分析框架以厘清评估结果的合理解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究者日益借用人类衍生的偏见构念（如内隐偏见、刻板印象激活，以及锚定、框架效应、确认偏误等认知偏差）来研究LLM。这类方法在直接提问可能掩盖偏见、或模型表面行为看似规范时提供了替代方案。然而，将人类偏见构念直接迁移到LLM上存在推断鸿沟，而现有研究缺乏对此问题的系统反思与规范框架。

Method: 本文采用批判性分析的方法，系统剖析人类中心偏见评估在LLM中的适用性问题。作者识别出推断鸿沟的三个来源：人类衍生构念的错配、人类与模型之间的本质差异、以及评估情境的差异。在此基础上，提出一个分析框架，围绕目标构念、操作化方式、推断范围以及人类类比限度四个维度，阐明这些要素如何关联到有充分依据的解释。

Result: 研究表明，将人类偏见构念应用于LLM评估时，由于构念错配、人机差异和评估情境不同，会模糊对模型偏见的多种不同解释；所提出的框架能够区分哪些评估结论有据可依、哪些是不当的人类类比。

Conclusion: 直接借用人类偏见构念评估LLM存在严重的推断风险，研究者应审慎对待人类类比，依据目标构念、操作化、推断范围与类比限度来界定结论的适用范围，从而提升LLM偏见研究的效度与解释力。

Abstract: Researchers increasingly use human-derived bias constructs to study Large Language Models (LLMs), including social-cognitive constructs such as implicit bias and stereotype activation, and cognitive biases such as anchoring, framing effects, and confirmation bias. Such approaches offer alternatives to overt bias probes, particularly when direct questioning may obscure bias or when model behaviour appears normatively acceptable. However, adapting human bias constructs to LLMs introduces an inferential gap. Psychological instruments were developed to study human cognition and social behaviour, whereas LLM evaluations rely on probabilities, text completions, rankings, or simulated decisions. This paper critiques human-centered bias evaluation in LLMs. We show how this gap arises from mismatches pertaining to human-derived constructs, human-model differences, and evaluation contexts, which can blur distinct interpretations of model bias. We then introduce a framework providing an analytical lens for relating these elements to warranted interpretations, with attention to target constructs, operationalizations, scope of inference, and limits of human analogy.

</details>


### [101] [Legal text classification in Korean sexual offense cases: from traditional machine learning to large language models with XAI insights](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00087)
*Jeongmin Lee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究在韩国性犯罪判例的十个类别上评估了从传统机器学习到大型语言模型(LLM)的多种法律文本分类方法，结果显示小规模微调模型（KLUE-BERT）准确率达99.3%，优于GPT-3.5/4.0等通用大模型，并通过可解释AI(XAI)分析模型决策与错分类案例，最后用真实案例数据KICS检验了模型的泛化局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 法律文本分类仍具挑战性，源于法律文本的复杂性以及法律类别间的细微差异；同时需要探究模型规模与领域适配/微调何者对法律文档分类更重要，并通过XAI提升模型透明度和可解释性。

Method: 以十类韩国性犯罪判例为数据集，对比传统机器学习模型、通用大语言模型（GPT-3.5、GPT-4.0）与在领域数据上微调的小规模模型（KLUE-BERT）；采用可解释AI(XAI)技术分析模型预测和错分类案例，识别影响决策的语言特征；并利用贴近真实法律案件记录的KICS数据评估模型泛化能力。

Result: KLUE-BERT微调模型取得最高99.3%的准确率，优于GPT-3.5、GPT-4.0及传统机器学习模型；XAI分析揭示了影响模型决策的语言特征及其在捕捉细微文本线索上的局限；在KICS数据上模型难以解读隐含的语境线索，泛化能力受限。

Conclusion: 在法律文档分类中，领域适配与微调比模型规模更重要；性能与可解释性对法律AI同等重要，XAI能提升法律文本分类的透明度；AI辅助工具有望在法律文档分类、法律信息检索和案件评估等任务中支持法律专业人士。

Abstract: The advancement of natural language processing (NLP) has expanded AI-based text classification in the legal domain. However, accurately classifying legal documents remains challenging due to the complexity of legal texts and subtle differences between legal categories. This study evaluates legal text classification models ranging from traditional machine learning techniques to large language models (LLMs) using ten categories of Korean sexual offense precedents. The results show that fine-tuning small-scale models such as KLUE-BERT on legal data outperforms general-purpose models such as GPT-3.5 and GPT-4.0, as well as traditional machine learning models. KLUE-BERT achieved the highest accuracy of 99.3%, indicating that domain adaptation and fine-tuning can be more important than model size for legal document classification. We further employ explainable AI (XAI) techniques to analyze model predictions and misclassification cases. XAI analysis identifies linguistic features influencing model decisions and limitations in capturing subtle textual cues. Using KICS data, which closely resembles real-world legal case records, we further evaluate the model's generalization capabilities and find that it struggles to interpret implicit contextual cues. These findings highlight the importance of both performance and interpretability in legal AI and demonstrate how XAI can improve transparency in legal text classification. AI-assisted tools can support legal professionals in tasks including document classification, legal information retrieval, and case assessment.

</details>


### [102] [BudgetSchemaBench: A Budget-Swept Diagnostic for Schema Context in Text-to-SQL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00092)
*Chen Shen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 BudgetSchemaBench，一个基于执行、针对结构化数据智能体在大规模目录下如何权衡"表覆盖"与"序列化细节"的诊断基准，并系统考察了不同 schema 预算与表示方式对执行准确率的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构化数据智能体需要把数据库 schema 塞进模型上下文窗口，但大型目录可能包含多个数据库和数千列，受成本约束，往往在上下文窗口填满之前就必须在"表覆盖范围"和"序列化细节"之间做出选择。现有研究缺乏对这一权衡的系统、客观、可执行验证的诊断工具。

Method: 构建 BudgetSchemaBench：从 gold SQL 机械推导相关性标签，避免人工或 LLM 标注的 ground truth。使用一个 80 个数据库的合并目录，在固定各检索器表排序不变的前提下，扫描四种 schema 上下文预算，比较三种表示方式；采用源命名空间检查排除"从错误数据库得到正确结果"的查询。评估覆盖三种条件：端到端检索、保证所需表的冻结-gold、以及移除所需表的探针。

Result: 在原始序列化 + 主求解器下，把预算从目录的 2.5% 提高到 50%，词法检索时 1,279 个留出问题的执行准确率提升 18 个百分点，而稠密检索仅提升 3 个百分点（稠密检索器在最小预算时已找到大部分所需表）。当所需表被移除时，94.6% 的正确预测精确命名了其中一张表，说明模型可能通过参数化知识重建缺失 schema。冻结-gold 条件下两个主求解器在三种表示之间最多相差 2 个百分点，最宽的成对 95% 置信区间将差异限定在 ±4 点以内。用另一家族的推理模型观察到相同的定性模式。

Conclusion: 当检索受覆盖率限制时，执行准确率对 schema 预算的敏感度高于对受测序列化方式的敏感度；该诊断工具及其构建与评估代码已公开。

Abstract: Data agents over structured sources must fit database schema into the model's context window. Large catalogs can span many databases and thousands of columns, so cost constraints may require choosing between table coverage and serialization detail well before the context window is full. We introduce BudgetSchemaBench, an execution-grounded diagnostic for this setting. Its construction derives relevance labels mechanically from gold SQL, without human- or LLM-authored ground truth. Using a pooled 80-database catalog, we sweep four schema-context budgets and compare three representations while keeping each retriever's table ranking fixed. A source-namespace check rejects queries that obtain the correct result from the wrong database. The evaluation covers three conditions: end-to-end retrieval; frozen-gold, in which the required tables are guaranteed; and a probe that removes those tables. For the primary solver with raw serialization, raising the budget from 2.5% to 50% of the catalog improves execution accuracy on 1,279 held-out questions by 18 percentage points under lexical retrieval but only 3 under dense retrieval; the dense retriever already finds most required tables at the smallest budget. When the required tables are removed, 94.6% of correct predictions name one of them exactly, consistent with reconstruction of absent schema from parametric knowledge. For the two main solvers in the frozen-gold condition, the three representations differ by at most 2 percentage points, and the widest paired 95% confidence interval bounds the difference within +/-4 points. We observe the same qualitative patterns with one reasoning model from a different family. When retrieval is coverage-limited, execution accuracy is more sensitive to the schema budget than to the tested serializations. The diagnostic and the code used to construct and evaluate it are publicly available.

</details>


### [103] [FACET at WMT 2026 Automated Translation Quality Evaluation Task](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00096)
*Ahrii Kim,Chanjun Park,Seong-heum Kim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出FACET，一种无参考的机器翻译质量评估方法，将评估分解为流畅性、准确性和一致性三个通道，每个通道仅获得其错误类型所需的上下文，通过单一固定模型提示三次并融合错误片段生成任务输出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器翻译中不同类型的错误需要不同的证据：意义是否保留只能对照源文判断，而目标端是否通顺、是否一致地指称同一实体可以仅凭目标文判断。因此，评估框架应为每种错误类型提供恰当的上下文，而非一刀切地输入所有信息。

Method: 提出FACET：将评估分解为流畅性（Fluency）、准确性（Accuracy）和一致性（Consistency）三个通道，每个通道只接收其错误类型所需的上下文。使用单一固定模型被提示三次，将合并后的错误片段产出三项任务输出——错误片段、质量分数和无错误标签，且不含任何训练组件。另提交省略一致性通道的FACET-C作为对照。

Result: 在无金标准标签的情况下对FACET的预测进行刻画：其系统排名将译后编辑的人工翻译排在首位；一致性通道改变了约十分之一的句段分数，但系统排名几乎保持不变。

Conclusion: FACET通过按错误类型分解评估并精准提供上下文，实现了无需训练组件的无参考质量评估，且一致性通道虽影响部分句段分数，但对整体系统排名影响有限。

Abstract: Different error types in machine translation require different evidence. Whether meaning is preserved can be judged only against the source, while whether the target is well-formed, or whether it names one entity consistently, can be judged from the target alone. We present FACET, our reference-free submission to the WMT26 Automated Translation Quality Evaluation Task, which decomposes evaluation into Fluency, Accuracy, and Consistency passes and gives each pass only the context its error type requires. A single fixed model is prompted three times, and the merged error spans yield the three task outputs, error spans, quality scores, and error-free labels, with no trained components. We also submit FACET-C, which omits the Consistency pass. Without gold labels, we characterize the predictions of FACET. Its system rankings place post-edited human translation first, and the Consistency pass changes about a tenth of segment scores while leaving the ranking nearly unchanged.

</details>


### [104] [Metric-Construction Coupling Inflates Measured Synthetic Dialect Recovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00164)
*Hyojung Han*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究：在韩语方言语料无法重新分发、只能发布模型权重的场景下，合成数据能在多大程度上恢复真实数据带来的监督收益，以及该恢复程度能否被独立于合成流程地度量。论文贡献 KoDialectBench（跨五个地区、三条轴线的 1000 条样本，以哈希标识和评分代码发布），发现数据恢复程度高度依赖任务轴，并揭示共享的“构式/评测词表”会显著高估合成数据的恢复效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 韩语方言语料虽可用但不可再分发，只能发布权重而无法基于底层数据复现训练与评测。这引出一个核心问题：合成数据能恢复多少真实数据的监督价值，以及这种恢复能否在不依赖特定合成流水线的情况下被独立测量，从而避免因评测指标与合成规则共享资源而导致的虚假的高恢复率。

Method: 作者构建 KoDialectBench，含跨 5 个地区的 1000 条样本、覆盖区域识别、理解、生成三条评测轴，并以标识符哈希 + 评分代码的形式发布（用户需用自己的授权副本重构样本）。实验设置多个合成数据臂（arms）作为训练源，对比“合成数据增益 / 真实数据增益”的恢复率；采用三类与合成流水线无关的度量（区域识别准确率、理解分数、基于参考的生成指标），以及依赖标记词表（marker lexicon）的方言度与区域匹配度指标。进一步通过“构式不相交臂”（construction-disjoint arm，从规则中隐去 20% 的标记类型）直接测试构式访问的影响；并定义“度量-构式覆盖率（MCC）”，扫描 MCC 从 0 到 1 时方言度恢复率的变化。

Result: 恢复率高度依赖任务轴：最佳合成臂在区域识别上达到真实数据增益的 91.2%，但理解轴上仅 63.7%。生成轴上结果依赖度量：deployed 标记词表报告方言度 92.3%、区域匹配 119.3%（后者甚至超过真实数据参考），而基于参考的生成仅达 72.4%。研究发现标记度量的评分词表完全包含在变换规则可生成的词表内。在完全相同训练规模（8,600 例）下，构式不相交臂使被隐去标记词表上的方言度恢复率从 91.8% 降至 8.1%、区域匹配恢复率从 101.9% 降至 25.6%，而三个与流水线无关的度量则完全未下降。MCC 扫描显示，方言度恢复率随 MCC 由 0 升至 1 而单调上升。

Conclusion: 合成数据的恢复能力显著且高度依赖评测轴与度量选择；当合成规则与评测指标共享同一构式/词表时，会实质性地高估合成数据的恢复估计。因此，评估合成数据监督价值时应使用独立于合成流水线的度量，并警惕共享构式与评测词表带来的夸大效应。

Abstract: Korean dialect corpora are available but not redistributable: weights may be released, while reproducing training and evaluation from the underlying data cannot be. We ask how much of that supervision synthetic data recovers, and whether that recovery can be measured independently of the synthesis pipeline. We contribute KoDialectBench, 1,000 items across five regions on three axes, released as identifier hashes and scoring code so users reconstruct the items from their own licensed copy. Recovery is strongly axis-dependent: our best synthetic arm reaches 91.2% of the real-data gain on region identification but 63.7% on comprehension. On generation the answer depends on the metric: the deployed marker lexicon reports 92.3% on dialectness and 119.3% on region match, the latter exceeding the real-data reference, whereas reference-based generation reaches 72.4%. We find the marker metrics' scoring inventory is entirely contained in the inventory our transformation rules can emit. We test the effect of construction access directly with an exact-form construction-disjoint arm that withholds 20% of marker types from the rules. At exactly matched training size (8,600 examples) it reduces dialectness recovery from 91.8% to 8.1% and region-match recovery from 101.9% to 25.6% on the held-out marker inventory, while the three pipeline-independent measurements do not fall at all. A complementary evaluator sweep defines metric-construction coverage (MCC) and finds measured dialectness recovery increasing monotonically as overlap rises from MCC=0 to MCC=1. Shared construction and evaluation inventories can therefore substantially inflate estimates of synthetic-data recovery.

</details>


### [105] [When a Data Artifact Isn't a Shortcut: Causal Auditing of Synthetic RLVR Corpora](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00202)
*Esther Xin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文对RLVR训练语料的构建方式开展审计，发现黄金答案与合成干扰项在可检测性上存在不对称，但该伪迹在当前预算下并未被策略实际利用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期多个RLVR数据管道通过遮蔽真实语料片段并让语言模型生成错误选项来构建数据，导致“正确答案=真实人类文本、干扰项=合成文本”这一正确性与来源相互纠缠，策略可能在原则上学会的是来源而非正确性。作者希望审计这一可能性。

Method: 在GooseReason-0.7M上开展两阶段审计：第一阶段用只读五个表面统计特征（不涉及语义）的分类器，对315,499个选项检验该不对称是否可见（报告AUROC），并针对代码域的低AUROC进行人工检查以解释成因；第二阶段做干预实验，构建改写匹配（paraphrase-matched）的控制语料，在训练集规模相同的两臂下、同一固定预算内训练两个策略，比较其“利用差距”（exploitation gap）。

Result: 表面特征分类器整体AUROC仅0.562，接近随机；但代码域AUROC为0.416、低于随机，人工检查发现代码干扰项是黄金答案的单算子变异而非自由书写的替代，导致两类几乎天然相同。干预实验中，未修改数据臂的利用差距为0.021，而控制臂为0.027，即未修改数据臂并未占优，可检测的伪迹在当前预算下未被利用。

Conclusion: 在给定预算下，可检测的伪迹与实际被利用之间发生了分离，结合领域特定（代码干扰项）的构造发现，这两点对策划此类语料的人具有参考价值；作者将审计以“基本仅用CPU的协议”形式发布。

Abstract: Several recent pipelines build RLVR training data by masking a span of real corpus text and asking a language model to invent plausible wrong answers around it. The correct option is therefore genuine human prose; every distractor is synthetic. Correctness and provenance become entangled, and a policy could in principle learn the second instead of the first. We audit that possibility in GooseReason-0.7M. First we ask whether the asymmetry is visible at all: a classifier reading only five surface statistics (never the meaning) reaches AUROC 0.562 over 315,499 options, barely above chance. The aggregate hides something, though. Code sits at 0.416, below chance, and manual inspection explains why: code distractors turn out to be single-operator mutations of the gold answer rather than freely written alternatives, so the two classes are nearly identical by construction. Detecting a signal is not the same as showing a model uses it, so we then run an intervention. We build a paraphrase-matched control corpus, hold training-set size identical across arms, and train two policies under one fixed budget. The exploitation gap does not favour the unmodified-data arm: 0.021 against 0.027 for the control. Under our budget, in other words, a detectable artifact went unexploited. We think that dissociation, along with the domain-specific construction finding, is worth knowing for anyone curating corpora of this kind, and we release the audit as a mostly CPU-only protocol.

</details>


### [106] [A Holistic Assessment of the Carbon Footprint of Noor, a Very Large Arabic Language Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00223)
*Imad Lakim,Ebtesam Almazrouei,Ibrahim Abu Alhaol,Merouane Debbah,Julien Launay*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出对超大规模语言模型 Noor（一个多任务阿拉伯语模型，参数量高达 13B）进行全生命周期碳足迹的整体评估，覆盖数据收集与存储、研发、预训练、未来推理及国际合作等外生成本，发现推理成本和外生因素对总碳预算影响显著，并讨论降低碳足迹的路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着更大规模语言模型日益普及，其极端规模和资源消耗导致巨大的碳足迹，而现有机器学习论文中的碳影响报告通常仅限于训练阶段的算力成本，缺乏对模型全生命周期（包括数据、研发、推理及外生成本）的整体评估，因此需要一种更全面的碳核算方法。

Method: 以一个实际项目 Noor（最大的多任务阿拉伯语语言模型，最高 13B 参数，利用零样本泛化通过自然语言指令支持广泛下游任务）为案例，对项目整体碳账单进行全生命周期评估：从数据收集与存储成本出发，纳入研发预算、预训练成本、未来推理服务估算，以及国际合作所需的其他外生成本，从而量化各项对总碳足迹的贡献。

Result: 研究发现，推理（inference）成本和外生因素（exogenous factors）可能对总碳预算产生显著影响，而不只是训练阶段的算力消耗主导碳足迹，说明仅报告训练成本会严重低估模型的真实环境影响。

Conclusion: 为准确评估超大规模语言模型的环境影响，必须采用覆盖训练、推理及各类外生成本的整体性评估方法；文章最后讨论了减少超大规模模型碳足迹的可行路径，倡导更全面、透明的碳影响报告。

Abstract: As ever larger language models grow more ubiquitous, it is crucial to consider their environmental impact. Characterised by extreme size and resource use, recent generations of models have been criticised for their voracious appetite for compute, and thus significant carbon footprint. Although reporting of carbon impact has grown more common in machine learning papers, this reporting is usually limited to compute resources used strictly for training. In this work, we propose a holistic assessment of the footprint of an extreme-scale language model, Noor. Noor is an ongoing project aiming to develop the largest multi-task Arabic language models -- with up to 13B parameters -- leveraging zero-shot generalisation to enable a wide range of downstream tasks via natural language instructions. We assess the total carbon bill of the entire project: starting with data collection and storage costs, including research and development budgets, pretraining costs, future serving estimates, and other exogenous costs necessary for this international cooperation. Notably, we find that inference costs and exogenous factors can have a significant impact on total budget. Finally, we discuss pathways to reduce the carbon footprint of extreme-scale models.

</details>


### [107] [CAVE-Mem: Boundary-Aware Experience Validation for Memory Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00238)
*Xinyu Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 CAVE-Mem，一个无需训练的框架，将经验建模为带适用性、边界和效用条件的"类型化干预算子"，只有当算子匹配当前记忆基底、答案契约、证据边界和交叉拟合效用时才干预，否则弃权，从而避免相关性驱动的经验复用带来的危害。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长期记忆智能体的经验记忆系统主要优化相关性，即检索与当前状态相似的过往搜索经验并注入提示。但相关经验在记忆基底、问题意图、答案粒度或证据边界发生变化时可能反而有害。现有系统缺乏对这种"相关但有害"情境的识别与规避机制。

Method: CAVE-Mem 将经验表示为一个类型化的干预算子（intervention operator），并附带适用性（applicability）、边界（boundary）和效用（utility）条件。流程上，系统首先获得一个基于记忆搜索的基础答案，然后仅当该算子与当前基底（substrate）、答案契约（answer contract）、证据边界（evidence boundary）匹配，且通过交叉拟合（cross-fitted）效用检验时，才允许算子修改基础答案；否则系统选择弃权（abstain）。

Result: 在长期对话记忆、多跳问答和长文档叙事推理三个任务上，CAVE-Mem 相比仅依赖相关性的经验复用方法取得了持续一致的性能提升。

Conclusion: CAVE-Mem 表明，通过引入类型化算子和明确的适用性/边界/效用条件，并在不满足条件时弃权，可以有效抑制相关但有害的经验复用，在多种长期记忆与推理场景下超越相关性驱动的基线方法。

Abstract: Long-term memory agents increasingly rely on it- erative search and reusable experience to answer questions over large personal, factual, or narrative histories. However, current experience-memory systems largely optimize relevance: they re- trieve past search lessons that appear similar to the current state and inject them into the prompt. A relevant experience can still be harmful when the memory substrate, question intent, answer granularity, or evidence boundary changes. We propose CAVE- Mem, a training-free framework that represents experience as a typed intervention operator with applicability, boundary, and utility conditions. CAVE-Mem first obtains a base memory-search answer, then allows an operator to change it only if the oper- ator matches the current substrate, answer contract, evidence boundary, and cross-fitted utility; otherwise the system abstains. Experiments across long-term conversational memory, multi-hop question answering, and long-document narrative reasoning show consistent gains over relevance-only experience reuse.

</details>


### [108] [Signed Lexical Confidence for Risk-Calibrated Intent Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00262)
*Yezhou Cheng,Zehua Yang,Bojun Lin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种带符号的词汇门控（signed lexical gate），将句子分类器的 logit 边际与稀疏词汇模型对预测意图的支持相结合，并通过独立二项校准选择运行阈值，在保留基分类器预测的前提下显著提升风险校准意图路由的覆盖率和误差排序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准置信度分数主要反映基础模型的表示，未充分利用互补证据。现有做法要么使用无符号词汇置信度（丢失信息），要么使用硬性一致规则（过于简单），都存在信息损失。作者希望在不改变基模型决策的前提下，引入更丰富的互补证据来改进选择性意图路由的可靠性。

Method: 引入"带符号词汇门控"：将句子分类器的 logit 边际与稀疏词汇模型对分类器预测意图的支持相结合。对词汇一致分配正证据，对词汇偏向的竞争意图分配负证据，从而保留比无符号词汇置信度或硬一致规则更多的信息。随后采用独立的二项（binomial）校准阶段，针对指定风险目标选择运行阈值。

Result: 在 BANKING77、CLINC150 和 HWU64 上各进行 10 次运行，相对于仅语义学习的门控，风险-覆盖率曲线下面积（AURCC）分别降低 15.8%、15.1% 和 11.8%。在 5% 名义错误目标下，BANKING77 和 HWU64 的可接受覆盖率分别提高 1.83 和 5.14 个百分点，而 CLINC150 已接近满覆盖。在更严格的 2% 目标下，同时二项程序在全部 30 个数据集-运行组合中均能产生非空策略。匹配控制实验显示，该特征相比测试的无符号词汇置信度特征改进了平均误差排序，相对二值一致规则在部分数据集上有增益。

Conclusion: 所提的两特征门控为风险校准的意图路由提供了一种紧凑、可解释的置信度增强方法，在保留基础分类器预测的同时显著改进了风险-覆盖率权衡与误差排序。

Abstract: Selective intent routing allows an assistant to act on reliable predictions while deferring uncertain requests. Standard confidence scores primarily reflect the base model's representation, leaving an opportunity to incorporate complementary evidence without changing its decisions. We introduce a signed lexical gate that combines a sentence classifier's logit margin with a sparse lexical model's support for the classifier's predicted intent. By assigning positive evidence to lexical agreement and negative evidence to a lexically favored competing intent, the gate retains more information than either unsigned lexical confidence or a hard agreement rule. An independent binomial calibration stage selects an operating threshold for a specified risk target. Across ten runs on BANKING77, CLINC150, and HWU64, the proposed score reduces area under the risk-coverage curve by 15.8%, 15.1%, and 11.8% relative to a learned semantic-only gate. At a nominal 5% error target, it increases accepted coverage by 1.83 and 5.14 percentage points on BANKING77 and HWU64, while CLINC150 is already near full coverage. At a stricter 2% target, the simultaneous binomial procedure yields a nonempty policy in all 30 dataset-run combinations at the available calibration budgets. Matched controls show that the proposed feature improves average error ranking over the tested unsigned lexical-confidence feature, with dataset-dependent gains over binary agreement. The resulting two-feature gate provides a compact, interpretable confidence enhancement for risk-calibrated intent routing while preserving the base classifier's predictions.

</details>


### [109] [Certainty Is Not Just Correctness: Rethinking Token-Level Certainty in LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00296)
*Yunfan Zhou,Ye Zhu,Zhihai Wang,Jianguo Yao,Haibing Guan,Xijun Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过受控实验系统评估了 token 级确定性作为 LLM 正确性代理的预测能力，揭示了其预测效果取决于预测目标、模型、确定性指标及聚合的 token 位置，并将这些发现应用于测试时计算，在降低 82.4% 生成 token 成本的同时将准确率从 78.71% 提升至 79.54%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: token 级确定性被广泛用作 LLM 训练与推理中的正确性代理，但其实际预测能力尚未被系统评估。作者认为确定性方法的效果既取决于确定性分数所包含的信息，也取决于分数如何使用，因此需要分预测目标、跨模型和任务来直接检验确定性的预测能力。

Method: 通过跨模型、跨任务的受控经验评估，直接衡量确定性的预测能力。研究区分两个预测目标：(1) 识别模型更可能答对的问题；(2) 区分同一问题的正确与错误回答。同时分析确定性在不同 token 类型和词内位置上的系统变化，以及问题难度和答案正确性信息在生成过程中的分布位置，并据此设计测试时计算策略（早期用确定性分配回答数量、近结尾处用确定性加权投票）。

Result: 确定性在"识别模型更可能答对的问题"上普遍优于"区分同一问题的正确与错误回答"。确定性随 token 类型和词内位置系统性变化，反映词与文本形式的局部特性。问题难度信息在生成早期出现，而较弱的答案正确性信息更集中于生成结尾。将发现应用于测试时计算：早期用确定性分配响应数量、近结尾处用确定性加权投票，相比固定采样多数投票基线，整体准确率由 78.71% 提升至 79.54%，同时生成 token 成本降低 82.4%。

Conclusion: 确定性所提供的决策信息取决于预测目标、模型、确定性指标以及聚合时包含的 token 位置，因此不能简单地将 token 级确定性等同于正确性。通过针对性地选择聚合位置（早段用于问题难度判断、结尾用于正确性判断），可在测试时计算中显著提升准确率并大幅降低成本，证明了这些发现的实际应用价值。

Abstract: Token-level certainty is widely used as a proxy for correctness in LLM training and inference. However, the performance of certainty-based methods depends both on the information in certainty scores and on how those scores are used. We therefore directly assess certainty's predictive ability through controlled empirical evaluations across models and tasks. We distinguish two prediction targets: identifying questions a model is more likely to answer correctly and distinguishing correct from incorrect responses to the same question. In our experiments, certainty is generally better at identifying questions a model is likely to answer correctly than at distinguishing correct from incorrect responses to the same question. Certainty also varies systematically across token types and positions within words, reflecting local properties of words and text form. Information about question difficulty appears early in generation, while the weaker information about answer correctness is more concentrated near the end. These findings show that the information certainty provides for decisions depends on the prediction target, the model, the certainty metric, and which token positions in the response are included in aggregation. We further demonstrate the practical value of these findings for test-time compute. We allocate the number of responses using certainty early in generation and weight answer votes using certainty near the end of each response. Compared with a fixed-sampling majority-voting baseline, this approach increases overall accuracy from 78.71\% to 79.54\% while reducing generated-token cost by 82.4\%.

</details>


### [110] [DuplexSpeechBench-Document Grounding: Benchmarking Document Grounding and Hallucinations in Voice Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00316)
*Puneet Mathur,Nedim Lipka,Zeyu Jin,Dinesh Manocha*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了面向语音智能体文档接地的基准 DuplexSpeechBench-Document Grounding (DSB-DG)，覆盖五个专业领域，通过三种故障模式（上下文饱和、接地衰减、主动接地）系统评估不同语音架构的接地准确性、幻觉与响应延迟，发现级联管线接地最准但开放权重系统存在上下文容量骤崩与多轮接地衰减等独特问题，表明上下文接地仍是全双工语音智能体尚未解决的关键挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语音智能体能够实现低延迟、自然的人机交互，但其能否将对回复的生成忠实扎根（grounding）于外部文档的能力仍未被充分探索，缺乏针对语音场景下文档接地质量的系统性评测。

Method: 作者提出 DSB-DG 基准，涵盖五个专业领域、50 篇文档、1,636 个经过对抗性验证的问答对；定义并评估三种故障模式：Context Saturation（测量随文档长度增加时的接地能力）、Grounding Decay（测量多轮对话中文档事实的保持程度）、Proactive Grounding（评估重新注入上下文是否缓解对话漂移）；并支持对接地准确性、幻觉和响应延迟的完全自动化评估，对比级联管线（ASR-LLM-TTS）、专有全双工/实时系统（Gemini-Live、GPT-Realtime）及开放权重 speech2speech 架构。

Result: 不同系统的有效接地容量差异显著：级联管线（ASR-LLM-TTS）接地准确率最高，Gemini-Live 与 GPT-Realtime 紧随其后；开放权重系统表现出独特的故障模式，尤其是突发的上下文容量骤崩和多轮接地衰减。总体而言，接地保真度随上下文和对话负载增加而下降，失败更多表现为无依据的生成（unsupported generation）而非拒绝回答（abstention）。

Conclusion: 上下文接地是可靠全双工语音智能体尚未解决的关键挑战；现有系统在长上下文、多轮对话负载下易出现接地退化，且倾向生成而非拒绝回答，需进一步研究以提升语音智能体的文档接地忠实度。

Abstract: Voice agents enable low-latency, natural interaction, yet their ability to faithfully ground responses in external documents remains underexplored. We introduce DuplexSpeechBench-Document Grounding (DSB-DG), a benchmark for evaluating document grounding in voice agents across five professional domains. DSB-DG targets three failure modes: Context Saturation, which measures grounding under increasing document length; Grounding Decay, which measures retention of document facts across multi-turn dialogue; and Proactive Grounding, which evaluates whether context re-injection mitigates conversational drift. The benchmark contains 1,636 adversarially verified QA pairs from 50 documents covering five professional domains, and supports fully automatic evaluation of grounding accuracy, hallucination, and response latency. Across systems spanning cascaded, proprietary full-duplex and real-time, and open-weight speech2speech architectures, we find substantial differences in effective grounding capacity. While cascaded pipeline (ASR-LLM-TTS) achieves the highest grounding accuracy, Gemini-Live and GPT-Realtime closely trail behind. Open-weight systems exhibit distinct failure modes, most notably an abrupt context-capacity collapse and multi-turn grounding decay. More broadly, grounding fidelity degrades with context and conversational load, and failures frequently manifest as unsupported generations rather than abstention. We show that contextual grounding as a key unresolved challenge for reliable full-duplex voice agents.

</details>


### [111] [Refusal Localizes, the Damage Relocates: Safety Layers Under Few-Sample Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00320)
*Jungseob Lee,Dongyub Jude Lee,Sugyeong Eo,Seongtae Hong,Seungyoon Lee,Heuiseok Lim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文测试了针对LLM微调攻击的防护手段，发现攻击后有害与良性提示仍线性可分、冻结特定深度的层可恢复拒答，但攻击者可绕过被识别的区域，并使跨多个检查点有效的修复方法失效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究已将LLM安全相关行为定位到特定层、方向和token，但尚不清楚这些定位是否足以支撑能抵御自适应微调攻击的防御。作者希望检验：基于成功的定位与恢复技术，能否构建在攻击方式变化下仍然有效的防护。

Method: 在四个模型家族的六个检查点上：(1) 对攻击后的隐藏状态进行线性可分性分析，并用"补丁式"恢复（将干净的完整隐藏状态注入受损模型）确定恢复拒答的转换深度；(2) 基于该深度构建逐层冻结防御并重复攻击；(3) 移除更新矩阵的前两个奇异方向以恢复拒答，并测试普通训练变化及攻击者分散更新的绕过效果；(4) 在良性微调上校准的光谱检测器检验其能否捕获修复失败。

Result: 攻击后有害与良性提示仍线性可分，在可复现的转换深度上补丁干净隐藏状态可恢复拒答；冻结至该深度后，即便施加100个有害示例，六个检查点的拒答率仍接近零，且恢复转换位于冻结边界之上。移除前两个奇异方向可在四个检查点的短时仅注意力微调后恢复拒答，但Llama-3.1-8B上普通训练变化会削弱该修复，且攻击者分散更新可使其失效；在良性微调上校准的光谱检测器漏掉该检查点上大部分修复失败。局部冻结仍有助于在少量有害示例无意混入训练数据时保持拒答。

Conclusion: 攻击者能够绕过通过恢复所识别的区域，并击败跨多个检查点有效的修复方法，因此作者提出五项针对自适应微调的防御检验标准。结果表明，依托行为定位的简单防御存在可被自适应绕过，但局部冻结在有害数据无意污染场景下仍具防护价值。

Abstract: Fine-tuning adapts aligned large language models (LLMs) to downstream tasks, but a few dozen harmful examples can remove their refusal of harmful requests. Prior work localizes safety-related behavior to specific layers, directions, and tokens, suggesting targets for protection. We test whether successful localization and recovery support defenses that survive changes in the attack. Across six checkpoints from four model families, harmful and benign prompts remain linearly separable after attack, and patching full clean hidden states into the compromised model restores refusal at a reproducible transition depth. Building on a prior layer-freezing defense, we freeze every layer up to this depth and repeat the attack. At a hundred harmful examples, refusal remains near zero on all six checkpoints, with recovery transitions above the frozen boundary. In a second study, removing the update's top two singular directions restores refusal after short attention-only fine-tunes on four checkpoints. On Llama-3.1-8B, ordinary training changes weaken this repair and an attacker who spreads the update defeats it. A spectral detector calibrated on benign Llama fine-tunes misses most repair failures on that checkpoint. Localized freezing can nevertheless help preserve refusal when a few harmful examples enter training data unintentionally. These results show that an attacker can bypass a region identified by recovery and defeat a repair that works across multiple checkpoints, motivating five checks for defenses against adaptive fine-tuning. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/refusal-relocates.

</details>


### [112] [CAST: Cost-Aware Speculative Trees from One-Pass Block Drafters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00321)
*Jungseob Lee,Sugyeong Eo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: CAST 是一种面向推测解码的成本感知推测树方法：将块草稿器一次前向已打分的多个候选 token 打包成树，在单次目标模型前向中并行验证，从而在不改动目标模型、草稿器权重和解码规则的前提下提升推理速度；树的宽度根据"下一个候选带来的预期收益是否大于其验证时间"动态确定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准块草稿器推测解码只验证得分最高的 token 链，丢弃了同一次前向中已经打分过的其他候选 token。这些候选本已获得分数，验证更多候选只需增加目标模型计算量而无需额外草稿开销，因此存在被浪费的并行验证机会。作者希望更充分地利用这些"免费"候选以加速推理。

Method: CAST 将块草稿器一次前向输出的多个候选 token 打包成一棵推测树，并在单次目标模型前向中并行验证整棵树；目标模型、草稿器权重与解码规则均保持不变。树的宽度通过"成本感知"准则自适应确定——只要下一个候选的预期收益超过其带来的额外验证时间，就继续加入候选，宽度由一次延迟测量直接决定，无需对不同宽度进行扫描调优。

Result: 在五个领域、三代 GPU、两种模型家族上评估，CAST 在其预测宽度下于全部八个设置中均快于标准链式解码，最高提速 43%。研究还发现最优宽度高度依赖于部署环境：在验证成本于某个核函数边界突增的情形下，128-token 的树仅比标准链快 2%，而预测宽度的树快了 20%。

Conclusion: CAST 通过将已打分的候选 token 组织为推测树并在单次前向中验证，以成本自适应方式选择树宽，能在不改变目标模型、草稿器权重和解码规则的情况下显著加速推测解码。作者进一步证明了 CAST 在贪心解码和采样解码下均不改变目标输出分布。

Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by drafting future tokens cheaply and verifying them with the target model in parallel. Block drafters score a whole block of future tokens in one forward pass, yet standard decoding verifies only the top-scoring chain and discards the other candidates. Because these candidates are already scored, verifying more of them adds target computation but no extra drafting. We introduce CAST (Cost-Aware Speculative Trees), which packs these candidates into a tree and verifies it in a single target pass, leaving the target model, drafter weights, and decoding rule untouched. To decide how wide the tree should be, CAST adds candidates while the expected gain from the next one outweighs the verification time it adds. The width therefore adapts to each deployment from a latency measurement, without sweeping over widths. We evaluate CAST across five domains on three GPU generations and two model families. At its predicted width, CAST is faster than the standard chain in all eight settings, by up to 43%. We also find that the best width depends strongly on the deployment. Where verification cost jumps at a kernel boundary, a 128-token tree is only 2% faster than the standard chain, whereas the tree at the predicted width is 20% faster. Furthermore, we prove that CAST leaves the target output distribution unchanged under both greedy and sampled decoding. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/CAST.

</details>


### [113] [Dissonant ballerinas and crafty carrots: a comparative multi-modal analysis of Italian brain rot](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00402)
*Anca Dinu,Andra-Maria Florescu,Marius Micluta-Campeanu,Stefana-Arina Tabusca,Claudiu Creanga,Andreiana Mihail*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文对意大利语和罗马尼亚语的"脑腐"（brain rot）梗图视频进行多模态对比分析，并构建了一个名为 CRIB 的人工标注数据集（240 个 TikTok 视频），发现视频节奏（剪辑速度与整体步调）而非文本或声学特征最能预测罗马尼亚语视频的流行度，同时揭示两种语言在文本与音频层面的显著差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: "脑腐"（brain rot）作为新兴网络文化现象具有广泛吸引力，但对其流行机制及跨语言/跨文化差异缺乏系统性研究；现有工作多局限于单一语言或单一模态，缺少可比较的多模态数据集与实证分析。

Method: 作者构建了名为 CRIB 的多模态数据集，人工精选 240 个 TikTok 视频，并按语言（意大利语、罗马尼亚语）与流行度分层；随后分别提取并分析文本、声学和视觉三类特征，考察它们与视频流行度的相关性，并进行跨语言对比。

Result: 研究发现：流行度与文本特征（情感、荒诞性、押韵）及声学特征（嗓音特征、声音情感）无显著相关性；在罗马尼亚语中，视频级动态特征——更快的剪辑速度和整体节奏——是视频成功的强预测因子。跨语言差异显著：意大利语脑腐文本更负面、困惑度更高、押韵更多，声音旋律音域更宽、响度更大；罗马尼亚语音频谱更亮、音高变化更不稳定。

Conclusion: 脑腐视频的流行更多由视频节奏动态驱动（至少在罗马尼亚语中如此），而非文本或声学内容特性；意大利语与罗马尼亚语在文本和音频上表现出系统性差异，说明脑腐这一网络现象具有显著的语言与文化特异性，为后续多模态、跨语言网络文化研究提供了新数据集与基线发现。

Abstract: This paper presents a comparative multi-modal analysis of Italian and Romanian brain rot memes, investigating the factors that contribute to its appeal and the linguistic and cultural distinctions between the two versions. To conduct this analysis, we introduce a multi-modal brain rot dataset named CRIB (Collection of Romanian and Italian Brain rot), a manually curated collection of 240 TikTok videos stratified by language (Italian, Romanian) and popularity, on which we examine textual, acoustic, and visual features. Our findings indicate that popularity is not significantly correlated with textual elements like sentiment, absurdity, or rhyme, or acoustic elements such as vocal features or sentiment of the sound. Instead, in Romanian language, video-level dynamics, specifically faster cutting speeds and a more rapid overall pace, are strong predictors of a video's success. The cross-linguistic analysis reveals significant differences. Italian brain rot is textually more negative, exhibits higher perplexity, and uses more rhyme, while its sound is characterized by higher melodic range and loudness. Romanian audio is spectrally brighter with more erratic pitch variations.

</details>


### [114] [LLM-as-a-Judge for Low-Resource Languages: Adapting Ragas and Comparative Ranking for Romanian](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00406)
*Claudiu Creanga,Liviu P. Dinu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究罗马尼亚语（低资源语言）RAG 系统的自动化评估，通过适配 Ragas 框架并采用 Gemini 2.5/3 等新一代模型验证"LLM-as-a-Judge"范式，发现评估策略需按指标定制：粒度分解最适合忠实度（96% 对齐），对比排序最适合答案相关性（90%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低资源语言（LRL）的 RAG 系统评估缺乏有效的参考基准指标，标准 reference-based 指标在罗马尼亚语等语言上表现不足，亟需探索自动化且可靠的人类对齐评估方案。

Method: 作者构建了 AdminRo-Eval 数据集（由母语者标注的罗马尼亚语行政文档），并基于下一代模型（Gemini 2.5 与 Gemini 3）适配 Ragas 框架。比较了三种评估方法——直接评分（direct scoring）、对比排序（comparative ranking）和粒度分解（granular decomposition），针对忠实度、答案相关性、上下文相关性三项指标逐一验证与人类判断的一致性。

Result: 评估策略与指标之间存在强耦合：粒度分解在忠实度上人类对齐率最高（使用 Gemini 2.5 Pro 达 96%），对比排序在答案相关性上表现最佳（90%）。轻量级模型在低资源语言的复杂推理上能力不足，而 Gemini 2.5 Pro 架构为罗马尼亚语 RAG 自动化评估建立了稳健且可迁移的基线。

Conclusion: "LLM-as-a-Judge"范式可有效迁移到罗马尼亚语等低资源语言，但需根据具体评估指标选择对应的评估策略；Gemini 2.5 Pro 可作为自动化 RAG 评估的可靠基线。

Abstract: Evaluating Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems remains a challenge for Low-Resource Languages (LRLs), where standard reference-based metrics fall short. This paper investigates the viability of the "LLM-as-a-Judge" paradigm for Romanian by adapting the Ragas framework using next-generation models (Gemini 2.5 and Gemini 3). We introduce AdminRo-Eval, a curated dataset of Romanian administrative documents annotated by native speakers, to serve as a ground truth for benchmarking automated evaluators. We compare three evaluation methodologies - direct scoring, comparative ranking, and granular decomposition - across metrics for Faithfulness, Answer Relevance, and Context Relevance. Our findings reveal that evaluation strategies must be metric-specific: granular decomposition achieves the highest human alignment for Faithfulness (96% with Gemini 2.5 Pro), while comparative ranking outperforms in Answer Relevance (90%). Furthermore, we demonstrate that while lightweight models struggle with complex reasoning in LRLs, the Gemini 2.5 Pro architecture establishes a robust, transferable baseline for automated Romanian RAG evaluation.

</details>


### [115] [UniBuc at SemEval-2024 Task 2: Tailored Prompting with Solar for Clinical NLI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00408)
*Marius Micluta-Campeanu,Claudiu Creanga,Ana-Maria Bucur,Ana Sabina Uban,Liviu P. Dinu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文介绍UniBuc团队参加SemEval 2024 Task 2（临床试验安全生物医学自然语言推理）的方案：使用SOLAR Instruct模型、不做微调，通过输入处理和定制提示（针对CTR各节，零样本与少样本）取得一致性得分0.72，排名第14，且错误分析发现模型倾向走捷径、依赖简单启发式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 参加SemEval 2024 Task 2竞赛，目标是在安全生物医学自然语言推理（NLI）任务中取得高一致性得分，探索不微调大语言模型、仅靠提示工程与输入操作的可行性。

Method: 采用SOLAR Instruct模型且不做微调；重点放在输入操纵（input manipulation）和定制提示（tailored prompting）上，针对临床试验报告（CTR）的不同章节分别定制提示，并在零样本（zero-shot）和少样本（few-shots）两种设置下进行推理。

Result: 在排行榜上取得一致性得分（consistency score）0.72，排名第14位。错误分析显示，模型倾向于走捷径并依赖简单启发式，尤其是在面对语义保持性变化（semantic-preserving changes）时表现不佳。

Conclusion: 不微调、仅靠定制提示的SOLAR Instruct能取得中等偏上的成绩，但模型存在严重依赖启发式与捷径的问题，对语义保持性扰动不够鲁棒，提示该任务仍需改进。

Abstract: This paper describes the approach of the UniBuc team in tackling the SemEval 2024 Task 2: Safe Biomedical Natural Language Inference for Clinical Trials. We used SOLAR Instruct, without any fine-tuning, while focusing on input manipulation and tailored prompting. By customizing prompts for individual CTR sections, in both zero-shot and few-shots settings, we managed to achieve a consistency score of 0.72, ranking 14th in the leaderboard. Our thorough error analysis revealed that our model has a tendency to take shortcuts and rely on simple heuristics, especially when dealing with semantic-preserving changes.

</details>


### [116] [EurekaBench: Measuring Agentic Ability to Discover New Scientific Insights](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00492)
