Abstract: Model intelligence and fast response jointly shape the quality of interaction with speech language models, yet remain difficult to achieve together. Explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) improves reasoning and audio understanding, but generating intermediate reasoning tokens delays responses. Describing fine-grained acoustic cues further lengthens CoT and increases latency. Latent reasoning can reduce this overhead, yet existing methods often trail CoT and remain limited by single-path supervision and reasoning budgets that do not adapt to problem difficulty. We introduce AURAL, which models a distribution over multiple plausible reasoning continuations in latent space and jointly predicts chunks of future states to reduce sequential forward passes and reasoning latency. To provide initial supervision for latent reasoning, we construct AuralReason-683K: 683K bilingual speech utterances (about 1,000 hours) with concise CoT for emotion recognition, empathetic dialogue, and general reasoning. AURAL-RL then explores beyond these traces, rewarding concise reasoning that yields high-quality answers and adapting reasoning effort to each problem. Across two backbones, AURAL-RL achieves performance comparable to CoT-RL, with larger gains over the respective supervised checkpoints on most metrics. Analysis further shows that harder questions elicit more latent reasoning steps. On Qwen2.5-Omni, it reduces time to the first answer token by 11.8x, from 1.22 to 0.10 s, versus 0.05 s for direct answering.

</details>


### [184] [Which LLM to pick? Online Active Model Selection for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01592)
*Alessandro Turrin,Patrik Okanovic,Torsten Hoefler,Nezihe Merve Gürel*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 ONLINE LLM PICKER，首个面向在线流式场景的大语言模型主动选择框架，在有限标注预算下挑选最有信息量的提示词进行标注，以低成本识别最优模型，节省最高达 71.67% 的标注成本并显著降低遗憾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 越来越多地用于处理流式数据，实践者依赖离线基准来选择模型，但这些基准信号只能近似真实性能；而可靠的标注反馈（oracle annotations）虽能提供真实反馈，却成本高昂、难以大规模获取。因此需要一个在在线设置下、利用有限标注预算就能准确识别最佳 LLM 的方法。

Method: 提出 ONLINE LLM PICKER 框架，针对任意查询流和有限标注预算，通过主动选择最有信息量（informative）的提示词进行标注，从而在候选语言模型集合中识别出最佳模型。

Result: 在 10 个数据集、超过 130 个语言模型的多任务实验中，ONLINE LLM PICKER 最高节省 71.67% 的标注成本，同时能可靠识别流上的最佳或接近最佳的模型。将该模型用于流中未标注提示词的顺序生成，遗憾（regret）最多降低 2.51 倍，表明其能在处理完全部流式提示词之前就识别出最佳或接近最佳的模型。

Conclusion: ONLINE LLM PICKER 能在标注预算受限的在线流式场景下，以远低于全量标注的成本高效挑选出最佳或接近最佳的 LLM，并通过提前确定模型显著减少后续生成过程的遗憾，验证了主动模型选择在大模型在线应用中的实用价值。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to process streaming data, with practitioners relying on benchmarks to select the best model even though these signals only approximate real performance. While oracle annotations can provide reliable feedback, they are often costly and difficult to obtain at scale. To address this challenge, we propose ONLINE LLM PICKER, the first framework for active model selection for LLMs in online settings. Given an arbitrary stream of queries and a limited annotation budget, ONLINE LLM PICKER selects the most informative prompts for annotation to identify the best LLM among candidate models. Across multiple tasks including 10 datasets, for over 130 language models, we show that ONLINE LLM PICKER saves annotation cost by up to 71.67% while reliably identifying the best or near-best model for the stream. We also show that using the returned model for sequential generation on unannotated prompts across the stream reduces regret by up to a factor of 2.51x, indicating that ONLINE LLM PICKER can identify the best or near-best model well before processing all streaming prompts.

</details>


### [185] [Can LLMs Reliably Annotate Bioassay Metadata to Improve Data Readiness?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01616)
*Laura van Weesep,Riccardo Tedoldi,Jens Sjölund,Hossein Azizpour,Susanne Winiwarter,Ola Engkvist,Jon Paul Janet,Samuel Genheden,Juan Viguera Diez*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究量化了PubChem中约200万项生物实验在BAO实验格式与物理检测方法字段上的缺失标注程度（36%缺乏实验格式、89%缺乏BioAssay类型、>99.9%缺乏BAO映射术语），并评估了七种开源与专有LLM从实验文本预测和审核元数据标注的能力。结果显示召回率对主要类别高达0.96，多数分歧源于银标签不一致而非LLM错误，且LLM能促使资深专家修正自身标签。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分子性质预测基础模型需要高度AI数据准备度（包括可靠元数据标注），但公共存储库和工业筛选数据库普遍存在缺失、不一致或混淆的实验标注。作者发现PubChem实验标注覆盖率极低，这驱动了对自动化实验元数据管理的需求。

Method: 研究者首先量化PubChem中BioAssay Ontology（BAO）实验格式与物理检测方法字段的标注缺失情况；随后构建基于PubChem和ChEMBL的评估集，评估七种开源与专有LLM对现有银标签（silver labels）的一致性；对分歧样本进行人工检查以判断来源；最后通过与一位资深工业策展人的定性研究，检验LLM生成证据能否促使专家修正自身标注。

Result: 对生化与细胞基实验格式，LLM召回率至少0.96，检测技术呈现相似模式，但欠表示类别上分歧增大。人工检查表明多数分歧源于银标签源之间的不一致而非LLM错误。在定性研究中，LLM生成的证据促使资深专家修订了部分自己的标签。整体上，专有与开源模型性能差异很小。

Conclusion: LLM可支持大规模实验元数据的标注与审核，但在这些标签进入下游机器学习流程前，仍需逐类别的可靠性估计和针对性人工审查。

Abstract: The emergence of foundation models for molecular property prediction requires a high degree of AI data readiness, including reliable metadata annotation. However, both public repositories and industrial screening databases suffer from missing, inconsistent, or conflated assay annotations. In this work, we quantify the extent of missing annotations in PubChem for the BioAssay Ontology (BAO) assay format and physical detection method fields and investigate whether open-source and proprietary large language models (LLMs) can reliably predict and audit metadata annotations directly from the assay text. In our assessment, we found that the annotation coverage across PubChem's $\sim$2 million bioassays is critically sparse, 36\% lacking an assay format, 89\% a BioAssay type, and >99.9\% any BAO-mapped assay format or detection technology term. This motivates the need for automated test-metadata curation. Using evaluation sets derived from PubChem and ChEMBL, we assess the agreement of seven open-source and proprietary LLMs with existing silver labels. Recall is at least 0.96 for biochemical and cell-based assay formats, with a similar pattern for detection technology, although disagreements increase on under-represented classes. Manual inspection shows that many of these disagreements trace back to inconsistencies between silver sources rather than to LLM error. Moreover, in a qualitative study with a senior industrial curator, LLM-generated evidence prompted the expert to revise some of their own labels, showing LLMs can flag potentially mislabeled assays. Across the study, performance differences between proprietary and open-source models were small. Together, these results suggest LLMs can support the large-scale annotation and auditing of assay metadata, though per-class reliability estimates and targeted human review remain necessary before such labels enter downstream ML pipelines.

</details>


### [186] [What Makes Something Hard(er)? Explaining Question Difficulty in Natural Language](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01627)
*Peng Cui,Qiaoyuan Zheng,Rudolf Debelak,Mrinmaya Sachan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种数据驱动方法，自动生成并验证自然语言假设，用于解释一道题为何比另一道题更难，将单纯的难度分数转化为可操作的因果性陈述。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 题目难度是基本属性，但现有方法只能输出单一描述性数字，无法解释造成难度的底层因素；作者希望揭示难度背后的可解释、可预测且具有因果性的因素。

Method: 先用大量LLM的作答经项目反应理论（IRT）估计题目难度；再采样易/难对比题集，让LLM提出候选解释假设；随后在留出题上验证并筛选这些假设。

Result: 在数学、逻辑、常识三类数据集上，所生成的假设可解释且具预测性：单独预测未见题难度可与先进黑盒回归器媲美或更优，作为额外特征还能进一步提升回归器；按假设编辑题目会按预期方向改变实测难度，表明假设是因果有效的难度因素。

Conclusion: 该方法将描述性难度分数转变为可操作的陈述，发现的假设既是预测性的难度信号，也是因果有效的难度因素。

Abstract: Difficulty is one of the most fundamental properties of a question: it determines whether the question can meaningfully discriminate between models of differing ability. Although a variety of methods can now estimate or predict difficulty automatically, they yield only a single descriptive number, with no account of the underlying factors that make a question difficult in the first place. In this work, we propose a data-driven approach that automatically generates and validates natural-language hypotheses explaining what makes one question harder than another. We first estimate each item's difficulty from the responses of a large pool of LLMs using Item Response Theory. We then sample contrasting sets of easy and hard questions and prompt an LLM to propose candidate explanations of the difference, which are subsequently validated and selected on held-out questions. Experimental results across three datasets spanning mathematical, logical, and commonsense reasoning show that our method produces interpretable and predictive hypotheses. On their own, they predict the difficulty of unseen questions competitively with, or better than, advanced black-box difficulty regressors; used as additional features, they further improve those regressors, implying that they discover difficulty signals that existing models fail to capture. Moreover, we demonstrate that editing questions according to a hypothesis can shift their measured difficulty in the expected direction, indicating that the discovered hypotheses are causally valid difficulty factors rather than post-hoc descriptions. Our approach thus turns a purely descriptive difficulty score into actionable statements.

</details>


### [187] [Yo-ByT5: Efficient and High-Fidelity Diacritic Restoration for Yorùbá](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01634)
*Ahmad Samuel Gali,Shamsuddeen Hassan Muhammad*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 Yo-ByT5，一个基于 ByT5-small 微调的字节级约鲁巴语自动变音符号恢复（ADR）模型，在 YAD 基准上以约一半参数量达到与最强模型 mT5-base 相当的性能，并保持更优的文本保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 约鲁巴语是一种依赖变音符号来消除词汇歧义的声调语言，但实际书写中常省略这些符号，从而阻碍下游自然语言处理任务。因此需要高效、可靠的自动变音符号恢复模型来解决这一问题。

Method: 作者引入 Yo-ByT5，即从 ByT5-small 微调而来的字节级自动变音符号恢复模型，并在 YAD 基准上以一致的评测协议，将其与五个已公开发布的约鲁巴语 ADR 模型及一个开源权重的大语言模型（LLM）进行对比评估。

Result: Yo-ByT5 达到 10.14% 的 DER 和 3.48% 的 CER，与最强现有模型 mT5-base 的性能持平，且参数量约为后者的一半，同时展现出更优的文本保真度。

Conclusion: Yo-ByT5 以更小的模型规模实现了与当前最佳模型相当的性能和高保真输出，作者同时公开了训练代码与模型输出，并呼吁构建更大规模、专门针对约鲁巴语变音符号恢复的基准数据集。

Abstract: Yorùbá is a widely spoken tonal language that depends on diacritics to avoid lexical ambiguity. However, it is often written without these diacritics, thereby hindering downstream Natural Language Processing (NLP) tasks. In this paper, we introduce Yo-ByT5, a byte-level Automatic Diacritic Restoration (ADR) model fine-tuned from ByT5-small. We evaluate Yo-ByT5 alongside five publicly released Yorùbá ADR models and one open-weight large language model (LLM) on the YAD benchmark under a consistent protocol. Our results demonstrate that Yo-ByT5 matches the performance of the strongest existing model, mT5-base, with a DER of 10.14% and a CER of 3.48%. Furthermore, it exhibits superior text fidelity despite using approximately half the parameter count of mT5-base. We also release our training code and model outputs, as well as call for the development of a larger, purpose-built benchmark for Yorùbá diacritic restoration.

</details>


### [188] [Compound interpretation is based on analogy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01688)
*Tian Shen,Harald Baayen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种无参数的"复合词类比模型"(CAM)，通过将词素嵌入与其所属复合词族的平均偏移向量相加来预测复合词语义，并在汉语复合词上对比CAOSS模型验证其预测准确性与认知合理性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复合词的意义如何从词素意义组合而来，是计算词汇语义学的核心问题。现有研究缺乏对不同组合机制（如全局线性变换 vs. 局部类比）在认知层面孰优孰劣的系统比较，需要更贴近实际的语言处理模型来评估复合词理解的计算与认知机制。

Method: 提出复合词类比模型(CAM)：将复合词两个词素的嵌入相加，并加入各自复合词族（family）的平均偏移向量(shift vectors)，从而利用语义空间中的局部类比结构，且无需训练参数。在汉语复合词上，将CAM与基于全局线性变换的CAOSS模型进行对比，采用训练集/留出集、以及按词频划分的训练-测试集检验泛化能力；进一步用两字复合词的视觉词汇判断反应时数据，检验模型衍生语义指标对行为数据的预测力。

Result: CAM在训练集和留出集上均持续优于CAOSS，仅三字复合词例外——因其词素族规模小且两词素族规模严重失衡，限制了类比泛化。按词频划分、更近似"从熟悉词泛化到新词"的评估中，CAM优势依然保持。在词汇判断任务中，CAM衍生的语义指标对反应时的预测优于CAOSS衍生指标。

Conclusion: 复合词意义更宜刻画为局部类比泛化，而非学习得到的全局线性变换；类比语义结构为复合词理解提供了认知上合理的（cognitively plausible）基础。

Abstract: How compound meanings are best predicted from constituent meanings remains a central question in computational models of lexical semantics. Comparing different computational models provides a way to evaluate alternative accounts of how semantic information is combined during compound comprehension. We propose a new model, the Compound Analogy Model (CAM), that predicts a compound's embedding by adding its constituent embeddings together with the average shift vectors of the two constituents' compound families. The resulting model is parameter-free and exploits local analogical structure in the semantic space. We evaluated CAM against the CAOSS model on Mandarin Chinese compounds. CAM consistently achieved higher prediction accuracy than CAOSS on both training and held-out data, with the exception of three-character compounds, for which analogical generalization is constrained by both small constituent families and a pronounced imbalance in family size between the two constituents. The advantage of CAM remained when evaluation was based on frequency-defined train-test splits that better approximate generalization from familiar to novel compounds. To assess the cognitive plausibility of the two models, we further examined whether model-derived semantic measures predict visual lexical decision latencies for two-character compounds. Predictors derived from CAM provided improved prediction for response latencies compared to predictors derived from the CAOSS model. These findings indicate that compound meaning is better characterized as local analogical generalization than as the application of a learned global linear transformation, and demonstrate that analogical semantic structure provides a cognitively plausible basis for compound comprehension.

</details>


### [189] [Acmite: Mitigating Gender Bias in LLMs through Concept-Guided Mutual Information](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01696)
*Tian Lan,Xiaoqing Cheng,Han Zhang,Jiang Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Acmite 是一个轻量级、概念引导的 LLM 去偏框架，它把刻板印象表示为结构化语义概念，用最大边际相关性（MMR）选取多样化概念，并基于互信息最小化的思想以 token 级 KL 散度近似输出与刻板概念之间的依赖，通过一个仅在输入与刻板概念足够相似时才激活的 LoRA 适配器，实现定向且有选择性的去偏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 去偏方法通常依赖显式偏见样本或预定义的群体词替换，对措辞敏感、难以捕捉跨语境的共性刻板印象概念；且它们只是抑制偏见输出，而未显式建模模型输出与潜在刻板概念之间的统计依赖。为此需要一种能显式刻画该依赖、定向且不过度损害通用能力的方法。

Method: Acmite 将刻板印象表示为结构化语义概念，使用最大边际相关性（MMR）选取多样化的去偏概念；受互信息最小化启发，用 token 级 KL 散度近似模型输出与刻板概念之间的依赖，同时保留任务语义。它冻结基座模型、仅训练一个轻量级 LoRA 适配器，并在推理时仅当输入与刻板相关概念足够相似才激活该适配器，否则直接使用原始模型。

Result: 在 BBQ、CrowS-Pairs 和 StereoSet 三个偏见基准上评估，并在 ARC-Challenge、GSM8K 和 PIQA 上评估通用能力保持。跨三个 LLM 的实验表明，Acmite 在互补的评估形式下有效减轻了性别偏见，同时在偏见无关任务上保持了有竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: Acmite 以概念引导、基于互信息最小化和轻量 LoRA 适配器的方式实现定向且有选择性的去偏，在多种评估格式下有效缓解性别偏见，同时在偏见无关任务上保持性能，为无需显式偏见样本或词替换的 LLM 去偏提供了更稳健的方案。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can reproduce social stereotypes from their training data, motivating extensive research on model debiasing. However, existing methods often rely on explicit biased examples or predefined group-term substitutions, making them sensitive to wording and less effective at capturing stereotype concepts shared across diverse contexts. More importantly, they typically suppress biased outputs without explicitly modeling the statistical dependence between model outputs and the underlying stereotype concepts. We propose Acmite, a lightweight concept-guided framework for targeted and selective debiasing. Acmite represents stereotypes as structured semantic concepts and uses maximal marginal relevance (MMR) to select diverse concepts for debiasing. Inspired by mutual information minimization, it approximates this dependence with token-level KL divergence while preserving task semantics. A lightweight LoRA adapter is trained with the base model frozen and activated at inference time only when the input is sufficiently similar to stereotype-related concepts; otherwise, the original model is used directly. We evaluate Acmite on BBQ, CrowS-Pairs, and StereoSet, and assess general capability preservation on ARC-Challenge, GSM8K, and PIQA. Experiments across three LLMs show that Acmite effectively mitigates gender bias across complementary evaluation formats while maintaining competitive performance on bias-unrelated tasks. Anonymous code and data are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Acmite-18E2/.

</details>


### [190] [Task-Oriented Rank Adaptation for Continual Learning in Text Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01702)
*Rey Sanchez Lopez,Eduardo Morales Manzanares,Hugo Jair Escalante*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 TORA（Task-Oriented Rank Adaptation），一种基于 LoRA 低秩结构几何相似性的动态适配器路由框架，用于在连续文本分类中决定知识迁移（Boosting）或任务隔离（Shielding），在 15 个基准上避免有害路由。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续学习在文本分类中面临灾难性遗忘与序列任务间的负迁移两大挑战。PEFT 方法（如 LoRA）虽能以低秩更新高效适配，但其紧凑表示通常孤立训练，难以在相关任务间复用。作者希望利用 LoRA 适配器的低秩结构来进行任务间兼容性判断，从而决定是否迁移知识。

Method: 提出 TORA，一个几何路由框架。它利用 LoRA 适配器的低秩结构，基于结构相似性判断新任务应“Boosting”（从最兼容的专家迁移知识）还是“Shielding”（隔离新任务以保护），并使用单一几何阈值进行决策，不依赖任务身份或预定义序列。

Result: 在 15 个多样化的文本分类基准上评估，TORA 持续避免有害路由决策：兼容任务在减少训练时间的同时超越其隔离训练的性能；结构上远距离的任务免受干扰且精度无损失。

Conclusion: TORA 通过单一几何阈值、不依赖任务身份或预定义序列，为序列文本分类系统中的动态适配器路由提供了一种简单而有效的方法。

Abstract: Continual learning (CL) in text classification faces two critical challenges: catastrophic forgetting and negative transfer across sequential tasks. Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) methods such as LoRA enable efficient adaptation by learning low-rank updates of the model parameters. However, these compact representations are normally trained in isolation, limiting their reuse across related tasks. We introduce Task-Oriented Rank Adaptation (TORA), a geometric routing framework that leverages the low-rank structure of LoRA adapters to decide whether to transfer knowledge from the most compatible expert (Boosting) or isolate the new task (Shielding) based on structural similarity. Evaluated across 15 diverse text classification benchmarks, TORA consistently avoids harmful routing decisions: compatible tasks exceed their isolated performance while reducing training time, and structurally distant tasks are protected from interference with no loss in accuracy. With a single geometric threshold and no reliance on task identities or predefined sequences, TORA provides a simple and effective approach for dynamic adapter routing in sequential text classification systems.

</details>


### [191] [A Matryoshka Hierarchical RAG for Efficient Multi-Hop Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01767)
*Gianluca Bonifazi,Christopher Buratti,Michele Marchetti,Federica Parlapiano,Giulia Quaglieri,Davide Traini,Domenico Ursino,Luca Virgili*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: MatRAG 是一种将 RAG 系统与 Matryoshka 表示学习（MRL）结合的分层框架，通过将文档聚类为粒度渐粗的 DAG 并用较低 Matryoshka 维度索引各层，在保证检索质量的同时降低索引与查询阶段的计算成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多跳问答的 RAG 系统需要在检索质量与计算成本之间取得平衡。现有系统要么在索引阶段依赖昂贵知识图谱（KG）或大语言模型（LLM）生成摘要，要么在查询阶段依赖迭代式 LLM 驱动检索，成本高昂。作者希望在不牺牲检索质量的前提下同时降低这两类成本。

Method: 提出 MatRAG，将 RAG 与 Matryoshka 表示学习（MRL）结合，使聚类结构的语义层级与 MRL 的嵌套结构对齐。具体做法：将文档语料组织为粒度逐层变粗的簇的有向无环图（DAG），每一层由较低的 Matryoshka 维度进行索引；并配以自顶向下遍历 DAG 的迭代式检索，以及控制跳数预算并对候选进行重排序的实体驱动机制。

Result: 在三个标准多跳问答基准上，与七个代表性基线对比评测，MatRAG 在检索质量上超越了最强的竞争方法；同时通过避免 KG 构建和 LLM 摘要降低了索引成本，并通过维度感知的相似度计算降低了查询时成本。

Conclusion: MatRAG 通过 MRL 与层次聚类 DAG 的结合，在提升多跳 QA 检索质量的同时显著降低索引与查询两端成本，为高效多跳 RAG 提供了一种有效方案。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems for multi-hop Question Answering (QA) must balance retrieval quality with computational cost. This cost is incurred during indexing time, through the use of expensive Knowledge Graphs (KGs) or Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate summaries, or during querying, through iterative LLM-driven retrieval. To reduce it while maintaining retrieval quality, we present MatRAG, a hierarchical framework that combines RAG systems with Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL). MatRAG addresses both kinds of cost by aligning the semantic hierarchy of a clustering structure with the nested structure of MRL. Specifically, it organizes the corpus of documents into a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) of clusters with progressively coarser granularity. Each level is indexed by a lower Matryoshka dimension. MatRAG pairs an iterative, top-down traversal of the DAG with an entity-driven mechanism that controls the hop budget and re-ranks candidates. We evaluated MatRAG on three standard multi-hop QA benchmarks against seven representative baselines. MatRAG outperforms its strongest competitors in terms of retrieval quality; furthermore, it reduces indexing costs by avoiding KG construction and LLM-based summarization, and lowers query-time costs through dimension-aware similarity.

</details>


### [192] [The Asymptotics of Language Model Alignment with Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01828)
*Haricharan Balasundaram,V. Arvind Rameshwar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文将 KL 约束强化学习与 best-of-n 两种语言模型对齐方法在输出序列服从马尔可夫链（而非 i.i.d.）时的渐近等价性推广，并在有限长度（尤其 m=1）情形下完全刻画了使两种方法分布 KL 散度为零的 LM 分布和奖励函数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Yang 等人已证明在输出为 m 长 i.i.d. token 序列、且 m 趋于无穷时，KL 约束 RL 与 best-of-n 两种对齐方法产生的分布渐近一致。但实际语言模型的输出序列通常具有记忆性（非独立），i.i.d. 假设不成立。因此需要将该渐近等价结论推广到马尔可夫情形，并回答 Yang 等人提出的有限长度（尤其 m=1）下何时两分布 KL 散度为零的问题。

Method: 将语言模型输出的 m 长 token 序列建模为马尔可夫链，沿用并扩展 Yang 等人的渐近分析框架，证明 m→∞ 时 KL 约束 RL 与 best-of-n 产生的分布渐近接近。针对有限长度输出序列，特别是 m=1 的情形，对 LM 分布和奖励函数进行完全刻画，精确刻画使得两种对齐方法所得分布 KL 散度为零的条件。

Result: 成功将两类对齐方法的渐近等价性从 i.i.d. 情形推广到马尔可夫（有记忆）token 序列情形；并针对 m=1 的有限长度情形，给出了使 KL 散度为零的 LM 分布与奖励函数的完整特征刻画，回答了 Yang 等人最初提出的开放问题。

Conclusion: 该工作填补了实际有记忆语言模型下 KL 约束 RL 与 best-of-n 对齐方法等价性分析的理论空白，并通过有限长度情形的完整刻画深化了对两种对齐方法何时完全一致的理解。

Abstract: Language model (LM) alignment broadly aims to perturb a given LM $Q$ into an aligned LM $q$ such that i) the outputs produced by $q$ and $Q$ are 'close' in probability, ii) $q$ has a higher expected reward than $Q$. Two common techniques for LM alignment are: KL-constrained RL, which requires knowledge of the LM distribution and is computationally expensive, and the best-of-$n$ algorithm, which requires only sampling from the LM. The work of Yang et al. established asymptotic closeness between the distributions produced by the two alignment methods for an $m$--length i.i.d. token sequence output by the LM, in the limit as $m$ increases to infinity. However, the i.i.d. assumption is not representative of practical LMs, whose output sequences often have memory. In this paper, we extend the asymptotic closeness result to the case when the $m$--length token sequence outputted by the LM is Markovian. Further, for finite-length output sequences -- particularly, when $m=1$ -- we provide a complete characterization of LM distributions and reward functions for which the KL-divergence between the distributions produced by the two alignment methods is zero -- a question first posed in Yang et al.

</details>


### [193] [Cross-Lingual Alignment for Decoder-Only Models using MoE Routers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01921)
*Lucas Bandarkar,Clark Peng,Ahmed Haj Ahmed,Aditi Khandelwal,Nanyun Peng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对解码器型大语言模型（LLM）的跨语言对比学习方法：不再对隐藏状态施加对齐损失，而是以混合专家（MoE）路由器输出作为对齐目标，从而在序列级实现可靠的跨语言表征对齐，并在多个开源 MoE 上验证其能同时改善隐藏表征对齐与多语言性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨语言对比学习是多语言编码器训练的核心组件，但由于解码器型 LLM 的多语言分词方式不一致，无法显式对齐表征。同时，越来越多的研究表明，即使在 LLM 中，更高的跨语言表征对齐也能带来更好的跨语言迁移效果。因此需要一种适配现代 LLM 架构约束的跨语言对比学习方法。

Method: 作者不在隐藏状态上施加辅助对齐损失，而是提出以 MoE 路由器的输出作为对齐目标。路由器输出更适合对大量 token 进行池化，从而在序列级别实现更可靠的跨语言比较。通过在四个开源 MoE 模型上进行受控的持续预训练实验，引入该路由对齐损失。

Result: 实验表明，引入路由损失不仅能隐式地对齐跨语言下的隐藏表征，而且在一套多样化的多语言评测集上提升了多语言性能。

Conclusion: 跨语言 MoE 路由器对齐具有显著潜力，为在架构受限的现代 LLM 中实现跨语言表征对齐提供了新思路，并可有效改善多语言任务表现。

Abstract: Cross-lingual contrastive learning has been a core component of multilingual encoder training, but the ability to explicitly align representations is not possible in decoder-only LLMs because of varying multilingual tokenization. However, a growing amount of research suggests that even in LLMs, higher cross-lingual representational alignment leads to improved cross-lingual transfer. In this paper, we propose a novel approach to reimagine cross-lingual contrastive learning given the architectural constraints of modern LLMs. Rather than applying an auxiliary alignment loss on hidden states, we propose using the outputs of the mixture-of-experts (MoE) routers as the target for alignment. Router outputs lend themselves better to pooling over many tokens, enabling more reliable cross-lingual comparisons at the sequence-level. Controlled continual pre-training experiments on four open-source MoEs show that incorporating this routing loss also aligns the underlying hidden representations across languages. Most importantly, this loss improves multilingual performance on our diverse evaluation suite, demonstrating the potential of cross-lingual MoE router alignment.

</details>

### [194] [Dynamic Spatial Bayesian Machine Learning Model: Applications to Intergenerational Economic Mobility and Geographic Income Inequality in the United States](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00072)
*Hammed A. Olayinka,Saheed O. Olayemi*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文提出面向高维时空面板数据的 DSP-BART-HS 模型（结合动态空间面板、贝叶斯加性回归树与 Horseshoe 收缩），在九类数据生成场景（各 200 次重复）中全面超越或统计上与最优估计器持平，并在美国县级面板的两个实证应用中展现出强预测能力，唯一例外是时间外推情境下 MTS-CAR-X 更具优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维时空面板数据普遍存在不规则空间拓扑、密集政策效应与个体层面非线性交互，传统结构空间计量模型、非参数机器学习和小域估计器在个体层面非线性主导方差时性能严重退化（落后三倍以上），因此需要一种能够同时处理层次结构、非线性、变量自动选择与空间扩散的灵活框架。

Method: 提出 DSP-BART-HS 模型，将动态空间面板结构、BART 树集成与 Horseshoe 收缩先验相结合；在九类数据生成场景 × 200 次重复中，与结构空间计量、非参数机器学习和小域估计器进行全面基准对比；考察零训练区域空间保持（spatial holdout）下的空间扩散机制；通过两个美国县级面板应用（代际经济流动性与地理收入不平等）在未见区域、随机与时间保持下验证，并辅以重复分割不确定性量化和配对显著性检验。

Result: DSP-BART-HS 在所有场景中均为最优或与最优估计器统计不可区分；传统区域-时间聚合比较器在个体非线性驱动方差时性能落后三倍以上；模型在零训练区域空间保持下仍保持强预测精度；实证中在未见区域与随机保持下表现优异，但时间外推下较轻的逐区域自回归设定 MTS-CAR-X 取得稳健且一致的领先。

Conclusion: DSP-BART-HS 为层次时空面板数据提供了强预测性能、自动变量选择与灵活推断，普适性强；但在时间外推这一特定任务上，MTS-CAR-X 的更轻量逐区域自回归结构更占优势，提示不同保持类型下模型设定需有所取舍。

Abstract: We develop a Dynamic Spatial Panel Bayesian Additive Regression Trees model with Horseshoe shrinkage (DSP-BART-HS) for high-dimensional spatio-temporal panel data. We jointly evaluate the model against a comprehensive suite of structural spatial econometrics, non-parametric machine learning methods, and small-area estimators across nine data-generating scenarios spanning 200 replicates each, including irregular spatial topologies, dense policy effects, and non-linear individual-level interactions. DSP-BART-HS is the best or statistically indistinguishable from the best estimator in every scenario. Conventional region-time-aggregate comparators suffer severe performance degradation -- trailing by a factor of three or more -- whenever individual-level non-linearity drives outcome variance, a limitation this framework's tree-ensemble design directly addresses. The model also maintains strong predictive accuracy under a zero-training-region spatial holdout via its spatial diffusion mechanism. We demonstrate practical utility across two U.S. county-level panel applications -- intergenerational economic mobility and geographic income inequality -- under genuine unseen-region, random, and temporal holdouts, with results validated through repeated-split uncertainty quantification and paired significance testing against every comparator. One clear limitation emerges: under temporal extrapolation specifically, a lighter per-region autoregressive specification (MTS-CAR-X) achieves a robust, and consistent advantage. DSP-BART-HS nonetheless establishes strong predictive performance, automated variable selection, and flexible inference for hierarchical spatio-temporal panel data.

</details>


### [195] [Variable Selection for Infectious Disease Transmission via Penalized Pairwise Accelerated Failure Time Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00176)
*Jeongjin Lee,Patrick M. Schnell,Grzegorz A. Rempala,Eben Kenah*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文提出一种带自适应LASSO惩罚的成对加速失效时间（AFT）模型，用于传染病传播研究中接触间隔的变量选择，能同时刻画传染性与易感性的协变量效应，并处理人群内部传播与外部感染源，且验证了其选择一致性与渐近正态性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传染病传播中，时间-事件结局的回归与变量选择受传播诱导的依赖性干扰，违反标准独立假设；成对生存分析通过建模有序对的接触间隔来应对该依赖，但现有方法缺乏在高维协变量下同时进行变量选择并兼顾传染性/易感性效应的稀疏建模工具。

Method: 提出带惩罚的成对加速失效时间模型刻画接触间隔；采用自适应LASSO惩罚的极大似然估计配合坐标下降算法进行变量选择，将分布型基线参数视为不带惩罚的冗余参数；在局部渐近框架下，利用随访期间所有处于传播风险中的有序对所累积的信息建立渐近理论。

Result: 在剖面似然正则条件下，建立了自适应LASSO估计量的选择一致性与渐近正态性；模拟研究表明，与无惩罚估计量和普通LASSO相比，该方法变量选择更准确、估计精度更高。实际数据分析中该方法得到稀疏且可解释的模型，并提高了所选协变量效应估计的精度。

Conclusion: 所提惩罚成对AFT模型能够有效处理传染病传播中的依赖结构，自适应LASSO在变量选择与估计精度上优于无惩罚和普通LASSO方法，并在2009年洛杉矶县家庭甲型H1N1流感监测数据上得到稀疏可解释模型，显著改善了如抗病毒预防对易感性效应等估计的精度。

Abstract: In infectious disease transmission, regression and variable selection for time-to-event outcomes are complicated by transmission-induced dependence that violates standard independence assumptions. Pairwise survival analysis addresses this dependence by modeling contact intervals in ordered pairs, defined as the time from the onset of infectiousness in the pair's first individual to their first infectious contact with the second individual. We propose a penalized pairwise accelerated failure time model for contact intervals that accommodates simultaneous covariate effects on infectiousness and susceptibility while jointly representing within-population transmission and infection from external sources. For variable selection with many candidate covariates, we develop adaptive LASSO penalized maximum likelihood estimation with a coordinate descent algorithm, treating distributional baseline parameters as unpenalized nuisance parameters. We establish selection consistency and asymptotic normality of the adaptive LASSO estimator under profile-likelihood regularity conditions in a local asymptotic regime in which information accumulates over all ordered pairs that are ever at risk of transmission during follow-up. Simulation studies show accurate variable selection and improved estimation accuracy compared with the unpenalized estimator and the LASSO. We illustrate the method using 2009 household influenza A (H1N1) surveillance data from Los Angeles County, where the adaptive LASSO produces a sparse, interpretable model and improves the precision of selected covariate effect estimates, including the effect of antiviral prophylaxis on susceptibility.

</details>


### [196] [Beyond Actor-Partner Associations: A Target-Trial Framework for Causal Spillover Effects in Longitudinal Dyadic Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00181)
*Subir Hait*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文将APIM（行动者-伴侣相依模型）问题构建为成对内干扰下的二元目标试验，明确了关联形式与因果形式之间的三项联系，并揭示了倾向值可分离分解所导致的精确单参数偏差（δ(H)=Cov(A₁,A₂|H)），通过模拟、诊断方法及应用（HRS退休与抑郁数据）展示了该框架的实际价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: APIM常用于描述一方暴露与自身及伴侣结局的关联，但其行动者与伴侣系数只有在额外的设计与识别假设下才具有因果解释。作者旨在弥合APIM这一关联模型与传统因果推断之间的鸿沟，明确二者如何对应、偏差从何而来，以及如何诊断和减轻这些偏差。

Method: 将APIM式问题表述为成对内干扰（within-dyad interference）下的二元目标试验（dyadic target trials）。在联合可交换性（joint exchangeability）、正性（positivity）及同质且正确设定的治疗相关条件均值假设下，建立APIM系数与因果对比之间的对应关系。针对二元成对治疗，通过将真实成员特定倾向值相乘（separate propensity factorization）推导出精确的单参数偏差δ(H)=Cov(A₁,A₂|H)，证明四个联合单元误差为(+δ,-δ,-δ,+δ)、总变差为2|δ|，并给出IPW对比偏差的闭式表示；进一步分析该偏差在AIPW中通过与结局回归误差的乘积体现。采用36情景模拟与"真实边缘因子化诊断"（true-marginal factorization diagnostic）评估偏差来源，并应用于2,400对HRS夫妇数据。

Result: 在残余依赖下的较大分离倾向值偏差主要属于因子化偏差（factorization bias）；灵活的AIPW能降低非线性模型偏差，但无法缓解弱支撑不稳定。在最强依赖条件下，即使对真实边缘分布进行因子化也会反转溢出（spillover）对比，并将交互作用放大到真实值的近五倍。应用分析中，联合退休罕见、残余治疗依赖显著，估计对支撑和倾向值截断（flooring）敏感。

Conclusion: 本文的贡献是从APIM问题到因果成对分析的"设计与诊断桥梁"，而非提出新的通用干扰或AIPW理论。核心要点是：APIM系数在特定假设下可等于因果对比；倾向值成员特定因子化会引入与Cov(A₁,A₂|H)成比例的精确偏差，可通过联合（而非分离）倾向值修正，并借助诊断与模拟加以识别和缓解。

Abstract: Actor-partner interdependence models (APIMs) describe how one member's exposure is associated with that member's and the partner's outcomes, but actor and partner coefficients are causal only under additional design and identification assumptions. We formulate APIM-style questions as dyadic target trials under within-dyad interference and make three links between the associational and causal formulations explicit. First, under joint exchangeability, positivity, and a homogeneous correctly specified treatment-related conditional mean, APIM actor, partner, interaction, and joint coefficients equal the corresponding causal contrasts. Second, for binary dyadic treatment, multiplying the true member-specific propensities induces an exact one-parameter discrepancy delta(H) = Cov(A_1, A_2 | H): the four joint-cell errors are (+delta, -delta, -delta, +delta), total variation is 2|delta|, and IPW contrast bias has a closed-form representation. Third, the same discrepancy affects AIPW through its product with outcome-regression error. A 36-scenario simulation and a true-marginal factorization diagnostic show that large separate-propensity bias under residual dependence is primarily factorization bias, while flexible AIPW reduces nonlinear-model bias but not weak-support instability. In the strongest dependence condition, factorizing even the true marginals reversed the spillover contrast and inflated the interaction to nearly five times its true value. We apply the framework to 2,400 Health and Retirement Study couples studying retirement transitions and later depressive symptoms. Joint retirement was rare, residual treatment dependence was substantial, and estimates were sensitive to support and propensity flooring. The contribution is a design-and-diagnostic bridge from APIM questions to causal dyadic analyses, not a new general interference or AIPW theory.

</details>


### [197] [Forecasting multiple density-valued time series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00215)
*Han Lin Shang*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文研究密度值时间序列的建模与预测，通过中心对数比变换和累积分布函数变换将密度函数双射映射到无约束函数空间，进而采用多总体函数时间序列建模和性别/地区差距建模两种方法，并利用1973–2024年日本次国家级年龄别生命表死亡数据评估其1至20步预测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 密度值时间序列（如年龄别死亡率分布）在实践中很常见，但密度函数非负且积分为1，不构成线性向量空间，难以直接套用标准时间序列方法，因此需要一种能将密度映射到无约束函数空间的变换，以便刻画其横截面与序列相关性。

Method: 提出两种双射变换：中心对数比（clr）变换和累积分布函数（CDF）变换，将密度映射到无约束函数空间；在此空间中采用两种建模方法：一是多总体函数时间序列模型以捕捉总体间相关性，二是性别与地区间的差距建模。用于平衡面板数据。

Result: 基于日本次国家级年龄别生命表死亡计数（1973–2024）的实证显示，两种变换下的两种方法均能进行1至20步点预测与区间预测，论文评估并比较了各自的预测精度，并给出了一般性建议。

Conclusion: 通过将密度双射变换到无约束函数空间，可以克服密度不构成线性向量空间的限制，使标准函数时间序列方法得以应用；不同变换与建模方法的组合在预测精度上各有优劣，作者据此提出了选择建议。

Abstract: Density-valued time series are common in practice. However, since these functions are non-negative and must integrate to one, they do not form a linear vector space, which complicates the direct application of standard time-series methods. To address these constraints, we introduce two transformations, based on the centered log-ratio transformation and the cumulative distribution function, for modeling and forecasting balanced panel data represented by multiple densities. Both transformations map densities bijectively into an unconstrained function space in which cross-sectional and serial dependence can be modeled directly. Within the resulting unconstrained space, we consider two approaches: multi-population functional time-series modeling to account for correlations among populations, and gap modeling between gender and region. Using Japanese subnational age-specific life-table death counts from 1973 to 2024, we evaluate and compare the one- to 20-step-ahead point and interval forecast accuracy of the two approaches for each transformation, and offer some general recommendations.

</details>


### [198] [Heteroskedastic Canonical Polyadic Tensor Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00498)
*Kyle Ritscher,Carlos Llosa-Vite*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文提出异方差 CP 分解（HCP），在低秩均值张量之外，用非恒定的低秩精度张量建模逐元素变异性，并开发交替块坐标上升算法同时恢复两者，计算复杂度与 CP-ALS 同阶，在合成实验与 EEG 应用中得到验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准 CP 分解最小化平方误差损失等价于假设高斯模型中张量各元素方差恒定，但现实中噪声常呈逐元素异方差性；恒定方差假设会扭曲对低秩信号的推断，因此需要显式建模条目级变异性。

Method: 提出异方差 CP（HCP）模型：均值张量为低秩 CP 结构，精度张量（方差倒数）也采用非恒定的低秩结构；在相应高斯似然下推导参数推断，并设计交替块坐标上升（alternating block-coordinate ascent）算法同时估计低秩均值与精度张量的因子矩阵，保持与 CP-ALS 相同的主导阶因子更新复杂度。

Result: HCP 在计算上具有竞争力（每因子更新复杂度与 CP-ALS 同阶）；合成实验和 EEG 应用表明该方法能够有效恢复低秩均值与逐元素变化的精度张量。

Conclusion: HCP 通过在低秩均值之外引入低秩异方差精度建模，克服了 CP 分解恒定方差假设的局限，并以与 CP-ALS 相当的计算成本实现了对噪声条目的自适应建模，在合成与真实数据上表现良好。

Abstract: When minimizing the squared-error loss, the popular CP decomposition can be interpreted as parameter inference in a Gaussian model with a low-rank mean tensor and constant variance across the tensor entries. We introduce heteroskedastic-CP (HCP), which models entrywise variability with a non-constant, low-rank precision tensor, and develop an alternating block-coordinate ascent method to recover both the low-rank mean and precision tensors from noisy observations. Our procedure is computationally competitive, with the same leading-order factor-update complexity as CP-ALS. We demonstrate HCP on synthetic experiments and an EEG application.

</details>


### [199] [Three-group variance-ratio tests for heteroscedasticity in linear regression: an exact null distribution and an outlier-resistant version](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00550)
*Ahmed El-Kotory,Ebrahim Khaled Ebrahim*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对线性回归中异方差性的稳健检验方法：将观测按任意选定变量排序并三等分，分别拟合回归并比较最大与最小误差尺度。最小二乘拟合下该比值精确服从Hartley最大F分布；采用最小截尾平方和拟合时对离群点稳健，其极限分布通过影响函数闭式导出。仿真涵盖72种设置，稳健检验的规模校正后平均功效最高(67%)，显著优于次优检验(45%)及White检验(56%)，且在重尾t3误差下仍保持领先(64%对35%)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有线性回归的异方差性检验在三种情形下会丧失水平或功效：数据含离群点、方差不单调、方差沿回归元之外的变量（如时间）变化。已有检验（如基于回归元的检验、White检验及已发表的两版稳健Goldfeld-Quandt检验）在这些情况下表现不佳或因实现问题无法维持名义水平。

Method: 将观测按任意选定变量排序，分成三等份，在各部分分别拟合回归，比较最大与最小误差尺度。用最小二乘拟合且误差正态时，比值精确服从三组Hartley最大F分布；用最小截尾平方和(LTS)拟合时对比值取平方近似为具有有效自由度的最大F比，其极限由裁剪方差的影响函数闭式导出。方法配套R包KOTORY实现，并进行72种设置的因子仿真（方差形态、排序变量、回归元个数、污染程度与样本量）。

Result: 稳健检验取得最高的规模校正后平均功效67%，次优检验仅45%；当方差沿回归元变化时稳健检验领先经离群点筛查后的White检验(67%对56%)；在重尾t3误差下领先为64%对35%。稳健检验还能追踪方差沿时间的变化并定位方差改变的数据区段；而两版已发表的稳健Goldfeld-Quandt检验按描述实现后无法维持名义水平。

Conclusion: 所提的基于排序三等分与稳健拟合的异方差检验同时解决了离群点、非单调方差和沿外部变量（如时间）变化三类难题，在多种仿真设置下功效领先，并能识别方差变化位置，方法以R包KOTORY公开提供。

Abstract: Tests for heteroscedasticity in linear regression lose their level or power in three situations: when the data contain outliers, when the variance is not monotone, and when it changes along a variable outside the regressors, such as time. The proposed tests sort the observations by any chosen variable, split them into three equal parts, fit the regression in each part and compare the largest with the smallest error scale. With least squares fits and normal errors, the ratio follows Hartley's maximum F distribution with three groups exactly. With least trimmed squares fits, the ratio resists outliers spread along the ordering. Its square is approximately a maximum F ratio with effective degrees of freedom, whose limit we derive in closed form from the influence function of the trimmed variance. A factorial simulation covered 72 settings of variance shape, ordering variable, number of regressors, contamination and sample size. The robust test had the highest mean size-adjusted power, 67%, against 45% for the next test; when the variance changed along a regressor, which all tests were given, it led White's test after an outlier screen, 67% against 56%. With heavy-tailed t3 errors its lead was similar, 64% against 35%. Unlike the tests built on the regressors, it can follow a variance changing along time, and it identifies the part of the data where the variance changes. Two published robust versions of the Goldfeld-Quandt test, as implemented from their descriptions, did not hold their nominal level. The R package KOTORY implements the methods.

</details>


### [200] [Probabilistic linkage with graphs: leveraging cluster structure to improve the accuracy of entity resolution at scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00566)
*Evelyn Lauren,Laura White,Trevor Graham Bell,Jacob Bor*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了11种图聚类算法在概率记录链接中的应用，发现来自相邻领域的Leiden、Louvain和标签传播算法在准确率和速度上均显著优于传统的传递闭包和马尔可夫聚类方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 概率记录链接会产生含噪声的成对链接，需要将其解析为不同的个体。传统传递闭包方法对每个链接独立应用固定阈值并生成连通分量，但随着人口规模增大，合并不同个体的风险上升，因此亟需利用图结构来提升链接准确率的更优方法。

Method: 作者在三个模拟数据集和一个真实世界数据集上，评估了11种聚类算法（其中5种为实体解析领域已有方法，6种来自相邻领域的图聚类算法），并针对链接图提出了一种定制化适配方案。重点比较了跨领域算法（Leiden、Louvain、标签传播）与传递闭包及马尔可夫聚类的性能。

Result: 跨领域算法（Leiden、Louvain、标签传播）准确率最高，相对传递闭包可将链接错误降低高达66%；同时这些算法的运行速度比实体解析文献中的主流方法马尔可夫聚类快达40倍，并可直接集成到现有大规模流水线中。

Conclusion: 来自相邻领域的图聚类算法在实体解析任务中表现优异，兼具更高准确率与更快速度，能够无缝集成到现有记录链接流水线，为大规模人口级推断提供了更可靠的个体聚类方案。

Abstract: Probabilistic record linkage identifies records belonging to the same entity even when identifiers are incomplete or imperfect, and is increasingly used to conduct population-level inferences from administrative data at scale. Linkage produces noisy pairwise links that must then be resolved into distinct individuals. The standard approach, transitive closure, applies a fixed threshold to each link independently and assigns clusters from the resulting connected components. However, the risk of merging distinct individuals grows with population size, motivating approaches that use graph structure to improve linkage accuracy. Clustering algorithms from adjacent fields solve the same graph-clustering task in other domains, yet have never been systematically evaluated for entity resolution. We evaluated eleven clustering algorithms -- five established in entity resolution and six from adjacent fields -- across three simulated datasets and one real-world dataset, and propose an adaptation tailored to linkage graphs. Cross-field algorithms -- Leiden, Louvain, label propagation -- were among the most accurate, reducing linkage error by up to 66% relative to transitive closure. The three algorithms also ran up to 40 times faster than Markov clustering (a leading approach in the entity resolution literature) and integrate directly into existing pipelines at scale.

</details>


### [201] [Nonparametric Identification of Latent Dimension under Heavy-Tailed and Mixed-Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00588)
*Chetkar Jha*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于秩变换的并行分析（Rank PA）方法，用于在高维、重尾误差和混合信号情形下稳健且一致地估计潜因子维数 r，克服传统 PA 在置换无法破坏信号时导致的零谱膨胀问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统并行分析（PA）虽被视为确定潜维数的金标准，但在高维混合信号和/或重尾误差分布下，其列置换机制（含各种现代变体）无法有效破坏信号结构，导致零谱被夸大、估计失效。因此需要一种能恢复置换下谱可交换性的非参数解决方案。

Method: 提出非参数方法 Rank PA：对数据矩阵进行秩变换（rank transformation），利用潜维数在秩变换后数据矩阵的“有序程度”中被唯一保留这一性质，恢复置换下的谱可交换性；并证明 Rank PA 在放宽条件下（不要求因子渗透性和限制性四阶矩假设）具有一致性。

Result: 证明 Rank PA 可一致估计因子个数，最多可处理 O(n^{1/3 − τ})（τ>0）量级的因子数；数值模拟及 FRED-MD 数据集分析进一步验证了方法的稳健表现。

Conclusion: Rank PA 通过秩变换恢复谱可交换性，在混合信号和重尾误差等高维困难情形下仍能一致估计潜维数，且理论条件宽松、实证表现稳健，是对经典平行分析的有效改进。

Abstract: Principal component analysis and factor analysis are foundational to the study of high-dimensional data, yet their efficacy depends entirely on correctly identifying the latent dimension $r$. While parallel analysis (PA) is widely regarded as the gold standard for this task, its performance suffers in high-dimensional regimes consisting of mixed signals and/or heavy-tailed error distributions. This arises because under the preceding conditions, column-wise permutation mechanism (or any modern variations) applied to the data matrix $\textbf{X}$ fails to destroy the signal, leading to an inflated null spectrum. To address this, we propose a nonparametric solution. We show that the latent dimension is uniquely preserved in the degree of order within the rank-transformed data matrix, which restores spectral exchangeability under permutation. We prove the consistency of Rank PA under relaxed conditions, requiring neither the pervasiveness of factors nor restrictive fourth moment assumptions. We establish that Rank PA can consistently estimate the number of factors up to the maximum of $O(n^{1/3 - τ})$ where $τ>0$. The robust performance of our remedy is demonstrated through numerical simulations and an analysis of the FRED-MD dataset.

</details>


### [202] [Foundation or Formula? A Simulation-Based Comparison of Google's TimesFM-3 and Classical Time-Series Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00589)
*Ebrahim Khaled Ebrahim,Somaia Mohamed Ali,Ahmed El-Kotory*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本研究通过生成九个已知过程的数据（模型不可能见过），系统比较了时序基础模型 TimesFM-3 与经典方法（ARIMA、指数平滑等）在 7200 条序列、12 步预测 horizon 上的表现。结果显示两者互不占优：TimesFM-3 的最大相对误差仅为最优方法的 1.31 倍，而每种经典方法在某场景下会达到至少 2.2 倍；经典方法在仅有两个季节周期时因回退到非季节模型而失败最严重。该稳健性在五个基础模型中为 TimesFM-3 所特有，且仅适用于短 horizon。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公共基准难以判定 TimesFM-3 等时序基础模型是否应取代 ARIMA 与指数平滑等经典方法，因为几乎没有基准数据集完全不在各模型的预训练语料中（存在数据泄露/污染风险）。因此需要在一个模型必然未见过的、过程已知的生成数据上进行公平的对照评测。

Method: 采用探索性对照研究：从九个已知数据生成过程生成 7200 条序列，使用预注册（pre-registered）协议，预测 horizon 为 12 步，并在 12 步之后扩展到 25–48 步。比较 TimesFM-3 与多种经典方法（自动 ARIMA、指数平滑等）及其简单历史基准。进一步检验了随机化参数、重尾噪声与异常值下的稳健性，并在 M4 月度 1000 条官方测试集与 101 条宏观序列（观察期晚于模型训练数据）上做了外部验证；同时对比了五个基础模型。

Result: 1) 两个家族互不占优：TimesFM-3 在任何场景下的误差都不超过最优方法的 1.31 倍，而每种经典方法在某处至少为 2.2 倍。2) 经典方法最大失败发生在仅有 2 个季节周期时，自动方法回退到非季节模型；4 个周期及以上时，自动 ARIMA 在季节 ARIMA 数据上比 TimesFM-3 准确 21–24%。3) 在五个基础模型中该稳健性为 TimesFM-3 特有，且仅限短 horizon：在 25–48 步，三个基础模型对水平持平（level stays flat）的饱和过程错误预测为下降，自动 ARIMA 在其他场景有更小的最坏情况。4) 在间歇性需求上 TimesFM-3 相比基于历史的简单基准无优势。5) 随机参数、重尾噪声与异常值不改变上述规律。6) M4 官方测试上 TimesFM-3 与第 5–7 名持平、逊于前四名；101 条宏观序列上与经典方法统计上持平。

Conclusion: 该研究刻画的是黑箱模型（TimesFM-3）在外推行为上的表现，而非其内在原因；所有发现均以所考察的过程类型与预测 horizon 为条件。没有充分证据表明时序基础模型应普遍取代经典方法，二者的优劣高度依赖于数据生成过程、季节周期数量与预测 horizon。

Abstract: Time-series foundation models such as Google's TimesFM-3 forecast series they were never trained on, but whether they should replace classical methods such as ARIMA and exponential smoothing is hard to settle on public benchmarks, because few benchmark datasets are absent from every model's pre-training corpus. This exploratory study compares TimesFM-3 with classical methods on data generated from nine known processes, which the model cannot have seen. Across 7200 series and a pre-registered protocol with a 12-step horizon, neither family dominates. TimesFM-3's error is never more than 1.31 times that of the best method in a scenario, whereas every classical method's is at least 2.2 times somewhere; the largest classical failures occur with only two seasonal cycles, where the automatic methods fall back to non-seasonal models. With four or more cycles automatic ARIMA is 21-24% more accurate than TimesFM-3 on seasonal ARIMA data. Among five foundation models this robustness is specific to TimesFM-3, and it holds only at short horizons: at steps 25 to 48 the three foundation models tested there forecast a decline on a saturating process whose level stays flat, and automatic ARIMA has the smaller worst case elsewhere. On intermittent demand TimesFM-3 shows no advantage over simple benchmarks built from the history. Randomised parameters, heavy-tailed noise and outliers leave these patterns qualitatively unchanged; on the official test period of 1000 M4 monthly series TimesFM-3 is level with the fifth- to seventh-ranked M4 entries, behind the four best, and on 101 macroeconomic series observed after the models' documented training data it is statistically level with the classical methods. The study characterises the behaviour of a black-box model, not the reasons for it, and its findings are conditional on the processes and horizons examined.

</details>


### [203] [Standardized Dynamic Borrowing: Uniform Control of Information Borrowing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00617)
*Huan Wang,Fei Wu,Yeh-Fong Chen*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文提出标准化动态借用（SDB）方法，通过贝叶斯因子及其上确界标准化来动态更新源信息与无借用组分的相对权重，从而在临床试验中实现透明、预设且可控的外部信息借用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动态借用方法可在临床试验中利用外部信息提升效率，但往往缺乏透明、可预先设定（prespecified）的借用控制机制，难以在操作特性（如功效与I类错误）约束下对借用程度进行清晰规定与解读。

Method: 作者提出标准化动态借用（SDB）框架：将“含源信息组分”与“无借用组分”组合，并利用以其在可容许目标数据上的上确界标准化后的贝叶斯因子来更新两组的相对几率。无借用组分的后验密度由目标数据似然归一化得到。预设的源组分初始权重构成其后验权重的尖锐一致上界，从而提供可解释的借用约束。在源与目标模型同属单参数正则指数族时，后验期望局部信息比有效样本量等于目标样本量加借用的源先验有效样本量，再减去一个非负的异质性惩罚项。对正态分布结局，借用程度取决于标准化的源-目标冲突Z分数，并按标准正态核递减。作者还联合选择初始权重与目标样本量，以满足预设的功效与I类错误要求。

Result: 在正态与二项分布的示例中，SDB能将源-目标相容性转化为数据自适应的借用程度；校准程序可在操作特性约束下预先设定源组分初始权重与目标样本量。后验期望的有效样本量可分解为目标样本量、借用的源先验有效样本量与异质性惩罚项，且借用随源-目标冲突Z分数按标准正态核递减。

Conclusion: SDB为动态借用提供了一套透明的框架，可用于预先设定、控制和解释临床试验中的动态借用，使借用程度在功效与I类错误的操作特性约束下具有清晰、可解释的界限。

Abstract: Dynamic borrowing can improve efficiency in clinical trials using external information, but existing methods may not offer transparent, prespecified control over borrowing. We introduce Standardized Dynamic Borrowing (SDB), which combines a source-informed component with a no-borrowing component and updates their relative odds using a Bayes factor standardized by its supremum over admissible target data. The posterior density under the no-borrowing component is obtained by normalizing the target-data likelihood. The prespecified source-component initial weight is a sharp uniform upper bound on its posterior weight, providing an interpretable borrowing constraint. When source and target models belong to the same one-parameter canonical exponential family, posterior expected local-information-ratio effective sample size equals target sample size plus borrowed source-prior effective sample size minus a nonnegative heterogeneity penalty. For normally distributed outcomes, borrowing depends on a standardized source-target conflict $Z$-score and decreases according to a standard normal kernel. We also jointly select the initial weight and target sample size to meet prespecified power and Type I error requirements. Normal and binomial illustrations demonstrate how SDB translates source-target compatibility into data-adaptive borrowing and how the calibration procedure prespecifies the source-component initial weight and target sample size under operating-characteristic constraints. These results provide a transparent framework for prespecifying, controlling, and interpreting dynamic borrowing.

</details>


### [204] [Discussion on "Principled type I error rate inflation in two-arm clinical trial designs with external control information borrowing" by Silvia Calderazzo, Manuel Wiesenfarth, Vivienn Weru, and Annette Kopp-Schneider](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00711)
*Tim Friede,Christian Röver*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文评论了Calderazzo等人关于贝叶斯借用外部对照数据检验程序的工作，指出其条件化方案的实际意义有限，并建议若核心担忧是假设违背，应通过调整似然函数而非条件化方案来解决。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于固定条件的频率学派I类错误或功效评估可能无法完全契合贝叶斯分析的目标，尤其在涉及信息先验的场合。作者关注Calderazzo等人在贝叶斯借用外部对照数据检验中的条件化适配，担心同时条件化参数与数据会引入问题。

Method: 作者以Calderazzo等人的示例案例为对象，进行批判性论证：一是评估其条件化方案的实际影响是否有限；二是指出若担忧在于假设违背，则调整似然函数是更合适的解决途径。

Result: 论证表明：(a) 该条件化方案的实际操作意义可能有限；(b) 若主要问题是假设违背，则应通过修改似然函数来更好地应对。

Conclusion: 作者认为Calderazzo等人提出的条件化方案实践价值有限，建议将关注点转向适应似然函数以处理假设违背，以更契合贝叶斯分析的初衷。

Abstract: Consideration of frequentist type-I error or power based on certain fixed conditions may not fully embrace the aims of a Bayesian analysis; this is particularly true in settings where informative priors are involved. Calderazzo et al. consider adaptations of a testing procedure involving Bayesian borrowing from external control data. Particular caution may be necessary here in order not to condition on parameters and data simultaneously. We consider their example case and argue that (a) the conditioning scheme may have limited practical implications, and (b) if the main concern are assumption violations, these might be better addressed by adapting the likelihood function.

</details>


### [205] [Factor Model Estimation for High-Dimensional Time Series with Heteroskedastic Noise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00766)
*Da Zhao,Jing Chen*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合同期协方差与滞后自协方差信息的因子载荷空间估计方法，利用HeteroPCA算法校正横截面异方差白噪声造成的对角污染，并推导了收敛速率，证明在特定条件下引入同期协方差可提升估计速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统仅依赖滞后自协方差的因子载荷估计在高维时间序列中可能因忽略同期信息而效率不足；同时，横截面异方差白噪声会在同期协方差矩阵中引入异质的对角噪声成分，导致估计偏差。作者希望整合同期协方差与滞后自协方差，并校正对角污染，从而提升因子载荷空间估计的精度。

Method: 作者构造一个结合同期协方差与滞后自协方差的组合估计矩阵，并应用HeteroPCA算法对该矩阵进行对角去噪校正，以消除横截面异方差白噪声的对角污染，同时保留序列依赖信息。该框架还支持在满足稀疏性与非相干条件的已知条目集合上处理噪声污染。在依赖观测的正则条件下，建立一致性并推导收敛速率。

Result: 在正则条件下证明估计量具有一致性，并给出收敛速率；识别出引入同期协方差后收敛速率相对纯滞后自协方差估计量得到改善的参数区域。数值模拟评估了载荷空间估计误差以及纳入同期协方差和对角校正的效果，S&P 500股票收益的实证应用展示了方法的实用性。

Conclusion: 结合同期协方差与滞后自协方差并辅以HeteroPCA对角校正，能够在存在横截面异方差噪声时更有效地估计因子载荷空间，并在特定条件下获得优于仅用滞后自协方差的收敛速率。

Abstract: Factor modeling provides a framework for extracting common components from high-dimensional time series. We develop an estimator of the factor loading space that combines contemporaneous covariance with lagged autocovariance information. Under cross-sectionally heteroskedastic white noise, the contemporaneous covariance contains heterogeneous diagonal noise contributions. We apply the existing HeteroPCA algorithm to the combined estimation matrix to correct this contamination while retaining information from serial dependence. The framework also accommodates noise contamination on a known set of entries subject to sparsity and incoherence conditions. Under regularity conditions for dependent observations, we establish consistency and derive convergence rates, identifying regimes in which incorporating contemporaneous covariance improves the rate relative to the lagged-autocovariance estimator. Simulations evaluate loading-space estimation error and the effects of contemporaneous covariance inclusion and diagonal correction. An application to S\&P 500 stock returns illustrates the method.

</details>


### [206] [Scalar-on-function regression with measurement error in the functional regressors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00867)
*Xiaochen Cai,Fenglin Xie,Todd Ogden*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文针对函数型协变量存在测量误差的标量-函数回归问题，提出一种模拟外推（SIMEX）方法，通过逐步添加误差方差并外推至零误差来校正系数函数估计的衰减，并通过模拟研究和DTI数据应用进行验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有标量-函数回归方法大多隐含假设函数型协变量被精确观测，但实际中函数型协变量常受测量误差污染。当回归子（regressor）函数存在误差时，系数函数的估计会发生衰减，导致估计有偏。因此需要一种能校正测量误差、恢复无偏系数函数估计的方法。

Method: 提出模拟外推（simulation-extrapolation, SIMEX）方法：首先估计误差方差，然后建立一系列人工添加的误差方差与对应系数函数估计之间的关系，最后将该序列外推至零误差情形。文中给出三种外推估计系数函数序列的方法（分别对应线性、二次等外推形式）。在模拟研究中，将SIMEX方法与基于平滑样条（smoothing splines）和函数型主成分分析（FPCA）的两种预平滑方法进行比较。

Result: 模拟研究表明，所提出的模拟外推方法在系数函数估计上优于（或可与）基于平滑样条和FPCA的预平滑方法，能有效校正测量误差导致的衰减。方法还具有良好扩展性，可推广到更复杂的噪声协方差结构、函数型预测变量的多次重复观测、广义响应以及2D/3D函数型预测变量等情形。

Conclusion: 本文提出的模拟外推方法为协变量带测量误差的标量-函数回归提供了一个有效的校正框架，能够缓解误差引起的系数函数估计衰减，且易于向多种更复杂场景扩展。通过扩散张量成像（DTI）数据的应用说明该方法在实际问题中的实用性。

Abstract: We consider the problem of scalar-on-function regression. Most existing methods implicitly assume that the functional covariates are observed exactly, but in practice, they are often contaminated by measurement error. Our goal, therefore, is to deal with the problem of scalar-on-function regression when the regressor functions are observed with error. In this paper, we propose a simulation-extrapolation method to correct for the attenuation of estimated coefficient functions caused by the error. The method first estimates the error variance, establishes the relationship between a sequence of added error variance and the corresponding estimates of coefficient functions, and then extrapolates to the zero-error. We describe three methods to extrapolate the sequence of estimated coefficient functions. In a simulation study, we compare the performance of the simulation-extrapolation method with two pre-smoothing methods based on smoothing splines and functional principal component analysis. Next, we discuss the extension of the method in several directions, allowing for more complex noise covariance structures, multiple replications of functional predictors, generalized responses, and 2D and 3D functional predictors. Finally, we illustrate the methods by an application to diffusion tensor imaging data.

</details>


### [207] [Modeling Bipartite Dynamic Networks: An Additive and Multiplicative Effects Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00900)
*Jing Luo*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文提出面向纵向二分网络（bipartite network）的可加性与乘性效应（AME）动态模型，给出建模假设、基于块坐标下降的估计方法及平方迭代加速技巧，并通过模拟与全球生产网络应用验证其优势，同时提供 R 包 RAMEN。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究者常分析两类不同行动者之间的互动，即二分网络。这类网络的相关（依赖）结构与单模网络不同，需要专门建模。现有方法难以同时刻画二分网络特有的依赖结构、纵向动态演化以及未观测的乘性潜在结构，因此需要开发适配二分纵向数据的模型。

Method: 作者首先区分二分网络的依赖结构并明确建模假设；然后提出二分动态 AME（可加性与乘性效应）模型，采用块坐标下降（block coordinate descent）进行估计；进一步引入平方迭代（squared iterative）方法提升计算效率。基于模拟研究和全球生产网络的实证应用评估模型表现，并发布 R 包 RAMEN 以便复现与应用。

Result: 模拟与实证表明，该模型改善了系数估计精度，更准确地还原数据生成过程，并更好地捕捉乘性潜在结构。在全球生产网络应用中，模型揭示了各国参与全球生产过程中随时间的演化模式，这些模式无法被观测协变量或静态设定所捕捉。

Conclusion: 针对二分纵向数据提出的动态 AME 模型在估计精度、模型拟合和数据生成过程恢复方面均优于现有方法，能够揭示被传统协变量与静态模型遗漏的动态潜在结构，并通过开源 R 包 RAMEN 提升了方法的可及性与可复现性。

Abstract: Researchers frequently study interactions between two distinct types of actors, represented as bipartite networks. These networks exhibit dependence patterns that differ from those in one-mode networks and therefore require models tailored to their structure. This paper develops an additive and multiplicative effects (AME) framework for longitudinal bipartite data. First, I distinguish the dependence structure and specify the corresponding modeling assumptions. Second, I introduce the bipartite dynamic AME model and develop an estimation procedure based on block coordinate descent. Third, I incorporate a squared iterative method to improve computational efficiency. Using simulations and an application to global production networks, I show that the model improves coefficient estimation, more accurately recovers the data-generating process, and better captures the multiplicative latent structure. The model reveals evolving patterns in countries' global production engagement that are not captured by observed covariates or static specifications. I provide an R package, RAMEN, to facilitate implementation.

</details>


### [208] [Quantile Social Autoregressive Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00933)
*Liyuan Wang,Danyang Huang,Wei Lan,Chih-Ling Tsai*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 现有同伴效应研究多依赖线性均值模型，无法捕捉极端同伴行为的影响。本文提出基于新型分位数社会规范的分位数社会自回归模型，直接估计分位数水平以识别最具影响力的同伴分布分段，并通过核光滑的伪响应工具建立一致的统计推断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性均值（linear-in-means）模型通过对同伴响应取平均，掩盖了同伴行为分布中的极端值或特定分位段对个体行为的差异化影响，无法识别究竟是哪一部分同伴（如表现的佼佼者或落后者）对个体影响最大。因此需要一个能自动识别“最具影响力的同伴行为分位段”的建模框架。

Method: 作者提出分位数社会自回归模型，用同伴响应的经验分位数（而非均值）定义“分位数社会规范”，并将分位数水平视为未知参数直接从数据中估计。为估计该模型，引入基于伪响应工具（pseudo-response instruments）的新矩条件；由于分位数社会规范不可微，对工具变量和残差施加核光滑以保证有效推断。同时建立均衡存在性与唯一性，推导识别条件，并证明估计量的一致性与渐近正态性。

Result: 证明所提估计量满足一致性并服从渐近正态分布；蒙特卡洛实验验证了估计量在有限样本下的良好表现；实证应用展示了估计出的分位数水平的可解释性及其对应的同伴效应，表明模型能识别出对个体行为影响最强的同伴分布分段。

Conclusion: 所提分位数社会自回归模型突破了线性均值模型的局限，能够在同一框架内识别最关键的同伴行为分位段及其同伴效应，且具备可靠的统计推断基础，为同伴效应研究提供了更灵活有效的工具。

Abstract: Research on modelling peer effects has predominantly relied on linear-in-means models. However, averaging peer responses prevents these models from capturing the effects of extreme peer behavior. To address this limitation, we propose a quantile social autoregressive model based on a novel quantile social norm, which uses empirical quantiles of peer responses. By treating the quantile level as an unknown parameter estimated directly from the data, our approach identifies which segment of the peer response distribution most strongly influences individual behavior. To estimate the model, we introduce new moment conditions using pseudo-response instruments. Because the quantile social norm is nonsmooth, we apply kernel smoothing to the instruments and residuals, ensuring valid statistical inference. Additionally, we establish equilibrium existence and uniqueness and derive the identification conditions. Furthermore, we prove the consistency and asymptotic normality of our proposed estimator. Finally, Monte Carlo experiments examine the finite-sample performance of the estimator, and an empirical application illustrates the interpretation of the estimated quantile levels and their corresponding peer effects.

</details>


### [209] [Testing Procedures for Strict Pleiotropy in Genetic Association Studies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00962)
*Eva Biswas,Nilanjan Chatterjee,Zheyu Wang*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文提出两种统计检验方法，用于识别仅基于GWAS z-score即可检测的"严格多效性"（strict pleiotropy，即一个SNP同时影响多个性状）位点，并确定其关联性状的最小数目；两种方法分别控制FWER和FDR，适用于独立或相关性状，并通过模拟及阿尔茨海默病生物标志物数据进行验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多效性是基因组生物学的基本特征，现有利用多效性提升检验效能的方法多关注"至少与一个性状相关"的SNP，而针对"严格多效性"（与多个性状相关）的识别方法要么仅适用于少数性状，要么随性状数量增加而计算困难，因此需要既能控制错误率、又能扩展到大量性状的新检验程序。

Method: 作者提出两种检验程序：第一种为频率学派方法，仅依赖GWAS提供的z-score，适用于独立及相关性状，并控制族错误率（FWER）；第二种基于局部错误发现率（local false discovery rate, lfdr），在维持FDR控制的同时提供更高的检验效能。两种方法均可判定SNP是否为严格多效性并确定其关联性状的最小数目。

Result: 通过大量模拟研究，与现有的严格多效性检验方法对比，所提方法在错误率控制与检验效能上表现良好；并将方法应用于阿尔茨海默病相关生物标志物，以区分代表生物标志物特异性变异的SNP与涉及疾病相关生物学的SNP。

Conclusion: 所提方法仅利用GWAS z-score即可有效识别严格多效性SNP并推断关联性状最小数目，能扩展到大量性状，兼具FWER或FDR控制与较高效能，为利用多效性研究复杂性状及疾病生物学提供了实用工具。

Abstract: Pleiotropy, the phenomenon in which a single genetic variant influences multiple traits, is a fundamental feature of genome biology and an important consideration in statistical genetics. Many statistical methods exist that leverage pleiotropy to increase the power of association tests, but they are often designed to identify SNPs which are associated with at least one of the underlying traits. Only a limited number of methods exist for identification of ``strict pleiotropy'', i.e. those associated with more than one trait, but these methods are either restricted to a small number of traits or become computationally challenging as the number of traits increases. In this paper, we develop two testing procedures to identify SNPs under strict pleiotropy and determine the corresponding minimum number of associated traits. Both methods rely only on z-scores available from genome-wide association studies (GWAS) and are applicable to independent as well as correlated traits. The first procedure is frequentist in nature and is designed to control the family-wise-error rate. The second procedure is based on the local false discovery rate and provides improved power while maintaining FDR control. We conduct extensive simulation studies to compare the performance of the proposed methods with alternative methods for testing strict pleiotropy. Finally, we demonstrate an application of the proposed methods to Alzheimer's disease-related biomarkers for the goal of distinguishing SNPs that may represent biomarker-specific variations from those that are related to disease-relevant biology.

</details>


### [210] [Augmented Patient Preference Incorporated Reinforcement Learning (APP-RL) to Estimate the Optimal Dynamic Treatment Regime](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01044)
*Yingchao Zhong,Lu Wang*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文提出 APP-RL 方法，在树型强化学习框架中通过数据增强融入患者潜在偏好，用于估计多阶段、多治疗场景下的最优动态治疗方案，并验证其稳健性、效率与可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动态治疗方案（DTR）文献通常仅纳入患者的病史信息，而忽视了患者自身的治疗偏好，这可能导致推荐的治疗方案与患者意愿不符，影响实际效果与依从性。

Method: 作者提出在树型强化学习方法中，通过数据增强（data augmentation）加入患者的潜在偏好。具体做法是：先根据患者对问卷的回答推导其在每个阶段偏好的后验分布，再用估计得到的偏好对多个结局进行加权，从而识别最优的逐阶段个性化决策。对于多阶段情形，在每一阶段生长一棵决策树，并利用反向归纳法递归地执行算法。

Result: 所提出的 APP-RL（Augmented Patient Preference incorporated Reinforcement Learning）方法稳健、高效，并能给出可解释的动态治疗方案估计；通过模拟研究对其有限样本表现进行了全面评估。

Conclusion: 将患者偏好纳入强化学习框架能够更全面、个性化地估计最优动态治疗方案，APP-RL 在兼顾稳健性与效率的同时保持了可解释性，为多阶段、多治疗的个性化医疗决策提供了新工具。

Abstract: Dynamic treatment regimes (DTRs) are sequential decision rules that individualize treatments to each patient at each treatment stage adapting to their past clinical course. Existing literature typically accommodates each individual's medical history, but overlooks a patient's preferences. We propose a method that incorporates a patient's latent preferences through data augmentation into a tree-based reinforcement learning method to estimate optimal dynamic treatment regimes for multi-stage, multi-treatment settings. For each patient at each stage, we derive the posterior distribution of preferences given responses to a questionnaire, and then subsequently weight multiple outcomes with the estimated preferences to identify the optimal stage-wise personalized decision. For multiple stage situations, we grow a decision tree at each stage and implement the algorithm recursively using backward induction. Our proposed method, named Augmented Patient Preference incorporated Reinforcement Learning (APP-RL) is robust, efficient, and leads to interpretable DTR estimation. The finite-sample performances of the proposed method has been thoroughly evaluated through simulation studies.

</details>


### [211] [Polylogarithmic Sparsity of Randomly Reweighted NPMLEs for Gaussian Mixtures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01088)
*Hansheng Jiang*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文证明，对高斯位置混合模型的非参数极大似然估计（NPMLE）的似然做一微小的随机扰动（随机再加权），可以得到恰好多对数稀疏（polylogarithmic sparsity）的解。所得的随机再加权 NPMLE 在高概率下唯一、原子数为 O((log n/log log n)^d + log n)、几乎最大化原似然，并以（到对数因子为止）参数速率的 Hellinger 速率估计混合密度，且无需任何支撑惩罚。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高斯位置混合的 NPMLE 是在无穷维混合分布空间上最大化似然。其最大化的混合分布可能不唯一，且原子数目的经典上界随样本量 n 线性增长，这导致估计量过于复杂、解释性差，并带来计算与统计上的负担。作者希望找到一种方法，在不引入支撑惩罚、且直接作用于估计量本身（而非其近似）的前提下，显著降低解的支持规模（稀疏性）。

Method: 对似然施加一个随 n 增大而趋于零的随机扰动：将普通似然替换为加权似然，其独立权重取为 Gamma 分布（在 n 增大时集中在 1 附近），得到随机再加权 NPMLE。证明的核心是正核混合的“有效维度原则”：拟合值的低维变动控制着最大化集合中每个极值点的支撑。由此推出随机扰动后的解在高概率下唯一且稀疏。

Result: 随机再加权 NPMLE 在高概率下：(1) 唯一；(2) 在 d 维情形下具有 O((log n/log log n)^d + log n) 个原子；(3) 几乎最大化普通似然；(4) 以参数速率（至多差对数因子）的 Hellinger 速率估计混合密度。数值实验表明，再加权 NPMLE 的 Hellinger 风险与支撑大小均与普通 NPMLE 相当。

Conclusion: 通过对似然施加消失的随机扰动，可在不牺牲统计效率的前提下，将 Gaussian 位置混合 NPMLE 的支持规模从线性降为多对数级别，并保证唯一性与近似最优似然。该方法直接作用于估计量本身，无需支撑惩罚，为高维混合模型的稀疏估计提供了新的理论工具与实用途径。

Abstract: The nonparametric maximum likelihood estimator (NPMLE) of a Gaussian location mixture maximizes the likelihood over the infinite-dimensional space of mixing distributions. The maximizing mixing distribution can be nonunique, and the classical bound on its number of atoms grows linearly with the sample size $n$. We show that a vanishingly small random perturbation of the likelihood yields exact polylogarithmic sparsity. The resulting randomly reweighted NPMLE maximizes a weighted likelihood whose independent weights, taken to be Gamma in our analysis, concentrate around one as $n$ grows. With high probability, it is unique, has $O\{(\log n/\log\log n)^d+\log n\}$ atoms in dimension $d$, nearly maximizes the ordinary likelihood, and estimates the mixture density at a Hellinger rate that is parametric up to logarithmic factors. This sparsity holds for the estimator itself, not for an approximation of it, and requires no support penalty. The proof rests on an effective-dimension principle for positive kernel mixtures: low-dimensional variation of the fitted values controls the support of every extreme point of the set of maximizers. Numerical illustrations verify that the reweighted NPMLE has Hellinger risk and support size comparable to those of the ordinary NPMLE.

</details>


### [212] [Certified Alpha Capacity: Statistical Evidence, Economic Lifetime, and Arbitrage under Decay](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01115)
*Nicolò Bonacorsi*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文研究交易信号能否在统计证据充分到足以可靠部署之前、其经济价值尚未衰减时被验证，通过用共同的Kullback-Leibler信息尺度统一度量统计证据与剩余机会，给出精确可行性阈值与一般信息下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际交易中信号的经济价值会随时间衰减，而统计验证需要积累证据，二者之间存在根本张力：一个信号可能在统计上被证实可靠之前就已失去盈利机会。本文旨在量化这一权衡，判定信号的可部署性边界。

Method: 将统计证据与剩余经济机会都映射到统一的Kullback-Leibler信息尺度上；在典型高斯模型下推导出精确的可行性阈值，并在此之外建立一般情形下的信息论下界（information lower bounds）。进一步结合有限信息预算分析生存前沿、搜索惩罚，并构建套利活动缩短可认证机会寿命的市场均衡模型，辅以回顾性资金费率（funding-rate）研究说明持续性（persistence）的作用。

Result: 得到高斯模型下的精确可行性阈值以及更一般情形下的信息下界；证明有限信息预算会产生生存前沿（survival frontiers）与搜索惩罚（search penalties），并在市场均衡中套利活动会缩短可认证套利机会的存续时间；资金费率实证研究印证了持续性的关键作用。

Conclusion: 统计验证所需的信息量与信号经济价值的衰减在统一信息尺度下可被严格刻画，只有当统计证据与剩余机会满足可行性阈值时信号才可可靠部署；套利竞争会侵蚀机会寿命，凸显了在衰减环境中进行高效统计推断和重视信号持续性的必要性。

Abstract: In this paper we study whether a trading signal can accumulate enough statistical evidence for reliable deployment before its economic value decays. We solve the problem by measuring statistical evidence and remaining opportunity on a common Kullback-Leibler information scale, obtaining an exact feasibility threshold in a canonical Gaussian model and general information lower bounds beyond it. We show that finite information budgets generate survival frontiers, search penalties, and a market equilibrium in which arbitrage activity shortens the lifetime of certifiable opportunities; a retrospective funding-rate study illustrates the role of persistence.

</details>


### [213] [Spatio-temporal coarse-grained Hawkes processes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01151)
*Tomoya Uda,Shinsuke Koyama*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文提出一种时空粗粒度Hawkes过程，用于直接从时空聚合的计数数据中建模，无需引入潜在事件时间或位置，并通过考虑bin内激发实现比传统二项泊松近似更高阶的近似。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时空Hawkes过程常用于建模自激事件数据，但传统推断方法需要每个事件的发生时间和位置；然而许多应用中只能获得按时间区间和空间区域聚合的计数。本文旨在解决这一数据可及性与建模需求之间的鸿沟。

Method: 提出时空粗粒度Hawkes过程，即一种离散时间计数模型，通过对时空bin内的时空调制效应取平均来构造有效激发核，并显式纳入同一时间bin内的激发；刻画其一阶、二阶性质，推导在时间与空间精细离散化联合极限下平稳均值与自协方差相对于对应聚合Hawkes过程的渐近近似误差。

Result: 理论分析表明，通过考虑bin内激发，该模型比传统二项泊松近似提供更高阶近似；数值实验验证了理论结果，并在广泛的聚合尺度下展示了精确近似。进一步开发了矩估计方法，并将其应用于地震发生数据（聚合ETAS模型）。

Conclusion: 所提方法为时空聚合事件数据的推断与预测提供了一种计算高效的替代方案，并在实际地震数据上得到验证。

Abstract: Spatio-temporal Hawkes processes are widely used to model self-exciting event data, but conventional inference methods require access to the occurrence time and location of every event. In many applications, however, observations are available only as counts aggregated over temporal intervals and spatial regions. We propose a spatio-temporal coarse-grained Hawkes process, a discrete-time count model that approximates aggregated observations generated by an underlying spatio-temporal Hawkes process. The proposed model constructs effective excitation kernels by averaging the temporal and spatial triggering effects over spatio-temporal bins while explicitly incorporating excitation occurring within the same temporal bin. This formulation enables direct modeling of aggregated count data without introducing latent event times or locations. We characterize the first- and second-order properties of the proposed process and derive asymptotic approximation errors for the stationary mean and autocovariance relative to those of the corresponding aggregated Hawkes process in the joint limit of fine temporal and spatial discretization. The analysis shows that the proposed model provides a higher-order approximation than the conventional binned Poisson approximation by accounting for intra-bin excitation. Numerical experiments confirm the theoretical results and demonstrate accurate approximation over a broad range of aggregation scales. We further develop a moment-based estimation procedure and apply the proposed framework to earthquake occurrence data through an aggregated Epidemic-Type Aftershock Sequence (ETAS) model. The results indicate that the proposed approach provides a computationally efficient alternative for inference and prediction from spatio-temporally aggregated event data.

</details>


### [214] [Testing and segmentation of joint and individual components in integrative multi-source factor models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01313)
*Kyoowon Kim,Sungkyu Jung*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文提出多源序贯对齐检验（MSSAT），利用联合分量在不同数据源中表现为紧密对齐的得分子空间这一几何观察，并通过推导对齐统计量的渐近零分布，构建了无需重采样的序贯检验程序来精确估计联合秩，在精度和计算速度上均优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多源数据整合的核心任务是区分共享（联合）结构与源特有（个体）变异，但现有的联合-个体模型依赖计算密集的优化或松弛的谱界，导致分离精度不佳且可扩展性差。

Method: 提出多源序贯对齐检验（MSSAT），基于真实联合分量在不同数据源间表现为紧密对齐的得分子空间这一几何特征，推导对齐统计量的渐近零分布，并据此构建严格的、无需重采样的序贯检验程序来准确估计联合秩。

Result: 大量模拟实验和真实数据应用（包括TCGA多组学数据集）表明，MSSAT相比竞争方法取得了更优的分离精度和显著更快的计算速度。

Conclusion: MSSAT通过几何对齐视角与渐近分布理论，提供了一种精确、快速且可扩展的多源联合结构分离与秩估计方法，有效弥补了现有方法在精度和可扩展性上的不足。

Abstract: Disentangling shared (joint) structures from source-specific (individual) variations is a fundamental task in multi-source data integration. Existing joint-individual models often rely on computationally intensive optimization or loose spectral bounds, leading to suboptimal separation accuracy and poor scalability. In this paper, we propose the Multi-Source Sequential Alignment Test (MSSAT). MSSAT leverages the geometric observation that true joint components manifest as closely aligned score subspaces across different data sources. By deriving the asymptotic null distribution of our alignment statistic, we develop a rigorous, resampling-free sequential testing procedure to accurately estimate the joint rank. Extensive simulations and real data applications, including a TCGA multi-omics dataset, demonstrate that MSSAT achieves superior separation accuracy and substantially faster computation compared to competing methods.

</details>


### [215] [Efficient Bayesian inference for multiple network data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01532)
*Francesco Barile,Sara Capozio,Bernardo Nipoti*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文研究中心化 Erdős–Rényi 分布的分布性质，并提出针对多网络数据的半共轭贝叶斯方法，配套提供 R 包 BayesCER。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有集中于单个网络、以 Erdős–Rényi 模型为基础的贝叶斯方法难以高效处理多个网络数据；同时中心化 Erdős–Rényi 分布的分布性质尚未被充分厘清，限制了其在贝叶斯框架下的可扩展推断。

Method: 作者首先分析中心化 Erdős–Rényi 分布（Lunagómez et al., 2021）的分布性质；在此基础上提出一种面向多网络数据的半共轭贝叶斯方法，并采用 Gibbs 抽样与经验贝叶斯两种推断策略，同时开发 R 包 BayesCER 实现整套方法。

Result: 模拟研究表明，Gibbs 抽样与经验贝叶斯均能准确恢复网络摘要统计量，且经验贝叶斯在计算效率上随网络规模扩展良好。

Conclusion: 所提出的半共轭贝叶斯方法能够高效、准确地处理多网络数据，经验贝叶斯在大规模网络场景下具有可扩展性，BayesCER 包为方法的实际应用提供了便捷实现。

Abstract: We investigate distributional properties of the centered Erdős--Rényi distribution (Lunagòmez et al., 2021) and propose a semi-conjugate Bayesian approach to multiple network data. In simulations, both Gibbs sampling and empirical Bayes accurately recover network summaries, with the latter scaling efficiently with network size. As a companion to this note, we provide the R package BayesCER, which implements the proposed methodology.

</details>


### [216] [Identifying Panel Conditioning with Refreshment Samples: Sharp Bounds and Design Assumptions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01654)
*Shoki Okubo*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文研究在面板数据中当流失（attrition）不受限时，refreshment 样本（补充样本）能识别出关于面板条件效应（panel conditioning）的哪些内容。核心结论：将条件效应建模为复访时的确定性单调映射后，一个候选映射与数据相容当且仅当留访者的潜在结果分布与其保留概率相除后（retention-scaled）被 refreshment 分布集合支配；每个这样的映射都能被某个明确的流失过程所合理化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面板调查中处理流失的标准做法是引入 refreshment 样本，但其背后的识别结论通常假设参与（复访）不改变测量。然而参与本身可能改变被调查者的回答（面板条件效应），而现有文献对这一情形下 refreshment 样本究竟识别了什么缺乏刻画，尤其当流失是任意（unrestricted）时。

Method: 将面板条件效应建模为复访时作用于潜在结果的一个确定性单调映射。在不限制流失的情况下，推导候选映射与观测数据相容的充要条件（retention-scaled 的留访者潜在结果分布被 refreshment 分布集合支配），并构造显式流失过程以合理化每个映射。进一步引入密度比条件刻画识别集，讨论均值效应的 trimming 界、全类别报告时的条件性检验、跨波次的 dropout 模式与 entry-wave 项，以及在显式选择限制下的各种匹配与校正方法（survival matching、symmetric matching、entry-wave correction）及其偏差与秩条件。

Result: 无流失时，映射在潜在结果支持集上被识别。存在流失时，密度比条件而非尾部行为单独决定识别集；对无约束映射，幸存者均值效应具有熟悉的 trimming 界；当某题项所有类别都被报告时，模型退化为“无条件效应”的检验。在队列内部，其它波次、dropout 模式与 entry-wave 项不改变识别集，除非有跨波次的选择限制。在显式选择限制下，survival matching、symmetric matching 与 entry-wave correction 能识别幸存者效应，文章给出各自偏差及 refreshment 计划识别条件路径曲率的秩条件。

Conclusion: refreshment 样本在以确定性单调映射刻画面板条件效应且流失不受限的框架下，仍能提供可检验且有界的识别信息；识别内容由 retention-scaled 分布的集合支配关系与密度比条件决定，并可借助显式选择限制下的匹配/校正方法进一步识别幸存者效应并推断条件路径的曲率，日本面板数据实证支持了这些结论。

Abstract: Refreshment samples are the standard remedy for panel attrition, and the identification results behind them maintain that participation does not change measurement. We characterize what a refreshment sample identifies about panel conditioning, modelled as a deterministic monotone map at reinterview, when attrition is unrestricted. A candidate map is consistent with the data if and only if the retention-scaled distribution of the stayers' implied latent outcomes is setwise dominated by the refreshment distribution; every such map is rationalized by an explicit attrition process. Without attrition the map is identified on the latent-outcome support; with attrition, a density-ratio condition governs the identified set, and tail behaviour alone does not determine it. For an unrestricted map the survivors' mean effect has the familiar trimming bounds; for an item with all categories reported, the model reduces to a test of no conditioning. Within a cohort, other waves, dropout patterns and entry-wave items leave the set unchanged unless restrictions link selection across waves. Under explicit selection restrictions, survival matching, symmetric matching and entry-wave correction identify survivor effects. We derive their biases and give rank conditions under which refreshment schedules identify curvature in the conditioning path. A Japanese panel illustrates the results.

</details>


### [217] [Markov chain Monte Carlo for predictively oriented posteriors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01818)
*Yann McLatchie,Louis Sharrock,David T. Frazier,Jeremias Knoblauch*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文为预测导向后验（predictively oriented posterior）构造了一个具有显式密度、可逐点求值的近似，并证明了其近似误差快速衰减，从而使其能够被经典蒙特卡洛采样算法所计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预测导向后验在模型误设（model misspecification）下仍能提供有原则的不确定性量化，但它没有显式密度，因而无法用经典蒙特卡洛采样算法计算。作者希望弥补这一计算上的缺陷，使该方法在实践上可实施。

Method: 推导出预测导向后验的一个近似形式，该近似具备可逐点求值的显式密度；同时证明该近似的误差随某个参数快速（rapidly）衰减，从而保证近似质量。

Result: 所得的近似后验拥有显式密度，可逐点求值且近似误差快速衰减，因此可直接套用经典蒙特卡洛采样算法进行计算与推断。

Conclusion: 该方法在流行病学、空间统计和低能核物理等案例研究中得到验证，表明其为模型误设情形下的不确定性量化提供了一条可计算的、有原则的途径。

Abstract: The predictively oriented posterior offers principled uncertainty quantification, even under model misspecification. However, it does not admit an explicit density and therefore cannot be computed using classical Monte Carlo sampling algorithms. We remedy this by deriving an approximation to the predictively oriented posterior whose density can be evaluated point-wise, and whose approximation error decays rapidly. These results are illustrated on case studies from epidemiology, spatial statistics, and low-energy nuclear physics.

</details>


### [218] [Generalized Engression Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01823)
*Xinwei Shen,Zijian Guo,Francis Bach*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 该论文提出"广义engression模型"（generalized engression），一种统一的非参数分布回归框架，可对连续、二值、分类、有序及排序等任意类型（含混合类型）的多变量结局，条件于协变量估计其联合分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有统计方法大多针对特定结局类型分别开发，且通常只估计条件分布的某个摘要（如各坐标的均值），而非结局向量的联合分布；缺乏能同时处理连续、离散及混合类型结局并刻画坐标间条件依赖的统一非参数分布回归方法。

Method: 方法基于engression（一种基于评分规则的深度生成模型），引入数据类型特定的链接函数（data-type-specific link function）与随机扰动（stochastic perturbation）以平滑损失，从而在链接不连续的情况下仍能进行基于梯度的训练；并针对连续、离散及混合结局建立了普适表示（universal representation）理论结果。

Result: 在模拟实验和两个真实应用中——社区生态学基准的242个物种，以及一个17维混合类型健康结局——该方法在边际评分上与类型特定模型相当，在联合分布上优于它们，并且达到或超过了专为联合物种分布建模设计的最新（state-of-the-art）模型。

Conclusion: 广义engression模型为任意类型（含混合类型）多变量结局的条件联合分布估计提供了一种统一、灵活且实用的深度分布回归方案，软件以Python实现并公开可用。

Abstract: We consider estimating the conditional distribution of a multivariate outcome given covariates when its coordinates may be continuous, binary, categorical, ordinal or rankings, and are conditionally dependent on one another. Different statistical methods have been developed for each outcome type, and most of them target a summary of the conditional distribution, such as the mean of each coordinate, rather than the joint distribution of the outcome vector. We develop generalized engression models, a unified nonparametric distributional regression framework for outcomes of any type. The proposed method builds upon engression, a scoring-rule-based deep generative model, and introduces a data-type-specific link function and a stochastic perturbation that smooths the loss, enabling gradient-based training even with discontinuous links. We establish universal representation results for continuous, discrete and mixed outcomes. In simulations and in two applications, 242 species in a community ecology benchmark and a 17-dimensional mixed-type health outcome, the method matches type-specific models on marginal scores, improves on them on the joint distribution, and matches or exceeds purpose-built state-of-the-art joint species distribution models. Software is available in Python.

</details>


### [219] [Transportability methods for failure-time outcomes under assumptions for relative effect measures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02041)
*Sarah E Robertson,Lan Wen,Lawson Ung,Jon A Steingrimsson,Issa J Dahabreh*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 该文提出在相对尺度（风险比）上做可交换性假设的因果推断识别方法——"风险比可移植性"，用于将临床试验结果外推至目标人群，并通过对NLST到NHIS的筛查策略全因死亡率分析证明其优于传统的分布可移植性方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在某些临床情境下，相对效应指标（如风险比）跨人群比绝对效应指标更为稳定，因此相对尺度上的可交换性假设可能比绝对尺度上更合理。然而现有大多扩展试验结果至目标人群的方法依赖强且常不可信的分布可交换性（分布可移植性）假设，缺乏在相对尺度上更合理的替代识别方法。
