Method: 作者针对失效时间结局，在更合理的相对尺度可交换性假设下提出识别结果，核心聚焦于风险比（风险比可移植性）。随后将该方法应用于NLST筛查策略对全因死亡率效应的估计，外推至来自NHIS的全国代表性目标人群；由于NHIS可获取全因死亡率数据且筛查无混杂，可对分布可移植性分析进行证伪检验（与观测到的基线风险对比）。

Result: 分布可移植性方法显著低估了死亡率风险；相比之下，风险比可移植性方法产生了与观测基线风险相符的合理估计值。

Conclusion: 在分布可移植性失效的特定情境下，基于相对尺度的假设可能更合理，风险比可移植性可作为更可靠的替代识别策略。

Abstract: In certain clinical areas, relative effect measures are believed to remain more constant across populations than absolute measures. This suggests that exchangeability assumptions on the relative scale may be more plausible than those on the absolute scale. Despite this, most methods for extending trial results to a target population rely on strong and often implausible distributional exchangeability assumptions between the trial and target population (distributional transportability).
  We propose identification results for failure-time outcomes under a more plausible assumption of exchangeability on the relative scale, focusing primarily on the risk ratio (risk ratio transportability). We applied these methods to estimate the effect of screening strategies on all-cause mortality, using data from the National Lung Screening Trial (NLST) to a nationally representative target population from the National Health Interview Survey (NHIS). All-cause mortality data was available from NHIS, along with no confounding of screening, allowing a falsification assessment of the distributional transportability analysis against the observed baseline risk.We found that this approach substantially underestimated mortality risk. In comparison, the risk ratio transportability approach produced reasonable estimates that matched the baseline risk.Thus, assumptions on relative scales may be more plausible in certain settings where distributional transportability fails.

</details>


<div id='stat.ML'></div>

# stat.ML [[Back]](#toc)

### [220] [Weighted Data Selection: Sharp Upper-Half and Five-Dimensional Laws](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00101)
*Zhongxuan Liu,Hongzhi Wang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文为有限加权最小二乘（采用最小范数学习器）给出了重加权训练支撑的风险精确律 Γ_d(n)=3-n/d，其中 ⌈3d/2⌉≤n≤2d−1；并在特定预算 (d,n)=(5,6) 下证明 Γ_5(6)=11/5，给出相应的下界构造，且上界在 Lean 4 中得到形式化验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究核心问题是：一个小规模的重加权训练支撑（reweighted training support）在最小范数最小二乘学习下究竟保留多少风险（即泛化误差或超额风险），希望在中间预算选择问题中精确刻画风险与样本量、特征维数的关系，并提供可严格验证的上下界。

Method: 采用有限加权最小二乘与最小范数学习器的分析框架。关键工具包括：平衡单纯形锚点降维、正权提升、独立线压缩来收紧上界；通过移位坐标对构造匹配下界。对 (d,n)=(5,6) 情形，借助电路覆盖（circuit covers）、比较二阶矩、电路平面概率以及极性面几何处理共享秩三电路，将 5 分解为 3+2 的单纯形块结构。

Result: 证明在 ⌈3d/2⌉≤n≤2d−1 区间上精确律 Γ_d(n)=3-n/d 成立；该保证覆盖任意观测特征秩，并适用于保持完整特征张成的选择。下界由移位坐标对达成。在 (d,n)=(5,6) 下进一步证明 Γ_5(6)=11/5，与 5=3+2 的单纯形块预测一致，并给出尖锐超额 6/5。数据集级上界与尖锐性构造已在 Lean 4 中验证。

Conclusion: 本文建立了中间预算选择问题中重加权训练支撑风险的一般单纯形块前沿，将这些精确风险律联系起来：上界通过锚点降维、正权提升与线压缩获得，下界通过移位坐标对与 (5,6) 情形下的电路/极性面几何构造达成，并实现形式化验证，展示了精确风险刻画在低预算加权最小二乘下的可行性。

Abstract: How much risk does a small reweighted training support retain? For finite weighted least squares with the minimum-norm learner, we prove the exact law $Γ_d(n)=3-n/d$ throughout $\lceil3d/2\rceil\leq n\leq2d-1$. The guarantee covers every observed feature rank and uses selections that preserve the full feature span. Balanced simplex anchors reduce dimension; positive-weight lifting and independent-line compression close the risk bound. Shifted coordinate pairs attain the matching lower bound. The complete dataset-level upper bound and sharpness construction are verified in Lean 4. At the smaller budget $(d,n)=(5,6)$, we also prove $Γ_5(6)=11/5$, matching the simplex-block prediction from $5=3+2$ over arbitrary interacting configurations. Circuit covers, comparison second moments, and circuit-plane probabilities give the sharp excess $6/5$, while polar-face geometry resolves shared rank-three circuits. The general simplex-block frontier connects these laws within the intermediate-budget selection problem.

</details>


### [221] [Transferable Graph Metanetworks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00420)
*Yuxin Ma,Adir Dayan,Yam Eitan,Haggai Maron,Soledad Villar*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出可迁移图元网络（Transferable Graph Metanetworks），通过不变性与连续性两组修改，使以权重为输入的元网络能在不同宽度的目标网络上跨尺寸泛化，并在 μP 参数化训练的输入上实现最多 42 倍宽度的稳健泛化，同时给出无限宽极限下的理论解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有权重空间网络（元网络）大多仅在一种或少数固定尺寸的输入网络上训练并在同分布内评估，跨尺寸的分布外泛化尝试有限且效果欠佳，导致"在小网络上训练、在更大网络上评估"的潜在效率收益远未实现。

Method: 提出 Transferable Graph Metanetworks，在图元网络范式上引入一组修改，使性能可跨不同宽度输入网络迁移。修改遵循两条原则：(1) 不变性——对不同宽度网络表示同一函数的方式保持不变；(2) 连续性——表示相似函数的权重应得到相似预测。并研究对从随机初始化独立训练的输入网络进行尺寸泛化的可行性，重点关注 μP（maximal-update parameterization）训练输入。

Result: 提出的修改在所有考虑的任务上显著提升了尺寸泛化性能；在 μP 参数化训练的输入网络上表现最强，达到训练宽度 42 倍时仍保持稳健。理论上利用无限宽极限理论证明了对 μP 训练输入的尺寸泛化保证，并解释了为何在其他参数化下会失效。

Conclusion: 通过引入不变性与连续性原则的修改，元网络实现了跨宽度的可迁移尺寸泛化，且在 μP 训练输入下具有坚实的理论保证，充分释放了小网络训练、大网络评估的效率优势。

Abstract: A weight space network (or metanetwork) takes the weights of another neural network as input and predicts properties of it. Most prior work trains such models on input networks of one or a few fixed sizes and evaluates them in-distribution. The few attempts at out-of-distribution size generalization remain limited in scope and have achieved only modest success. Consequently, the potential efficiency gains of training on small networks and evaluating on much larger ones remain largely unrealized. We propose Transferable Graph Metanetworks, which extend the graph metanetwork paradigm with a set of modifications that make performance transferable across input networks of different widths. The modifications follow two principles: invariance to the ways in which networks of different widths represent the same function, and continuity, such that weights representing similar functions receive similar predictions. We further study whether size generalization is possible for input networks trained independently from random initialization. Empirically, our modifications significantly improve size generalization on every task we consider. Performance is strongest on input networks trained under the maximal-update parameterization ($μ$P), where it remains robust up to $42\times$ the training width. Theoretically, we explain these observations with infinite-width limit theory: we prove size-generalization guarantees for our model on $μ$P-trained inputs, and explain why it can fail under other parameterizations.

</details>


### [222] [Learning to Cover Locally: Graph Neural Combinatorial Optimization under a Hard Information Horizon](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00422)
*Johannes F. Loevenich,Thies Moehlenhof,Laurin Holz,Maxime Schwarzer,Tobias Huerten,Roberto Rigolin F. Lopes*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究信息视界（information horizon）约束下的组合优化问题，将分布式局部集覆盖形式化并以OLSRv2协议的加权多点中继（MPR）选择为实例，从理论与实验两方面证明：决定求解质量的不是模型容量，而是信息视界本身。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统神经组合优化假设存在一个能读取全局实例的集中式求解器；但在许多真实分布式协议场景中，每个节点只能看到自己的k跳邻域且必须独立做出决策、再组合成全局可行解，这一硬性信息视界由协议而非建模者强加。作者希望理解并刻画这种硬信息视界下的可求解性，以及模型容量能否弥补信息视界的不足。

Method: 将问题形式化为"局部集覆盖"，并以OLSRv2中NP难的加权MPR 2跳覆盖选择作为实例。理论部分证明：(1) 任何确定性的、信息视界少一跳的选择器必然要么覆盖失败、要么距最优解有Δ倍差距；(2) L层GNN在决策节点读出恰好等价于L跳选择器，证明容量无法补偿覆盖半径；(3) 在协议规定的视界下，深度O(Δ)的GNN可复现RFC 7181的覆盖贪心，宽度O(c_max·Δ)时可复现其度量感知加权版本，并继承(1+lnΔ_2)近似比。实验部分采用3层GATv2搭配覆盖补全解码器，以CP-SAT最优解为教师进行行为克隆；并做两个迁移检验：对比OLSRv2原生代码与基数贪心，以及在真实营级机动数据集上评估冻结模型。

Result: 在100%覆盖率下，3层GATv2行为克隆模型达到cost/opt=1.030±0.001，优于贪心的1.138，弥合了79.1%的差距；而把同一学习器受限为单跳（相同实例、相同解码器与演示）时性能劣化至1.344，远差于贪心。迁移检验中：OLSRv2未修改的选择代码在200/200个单位代价实例上与基数贪心一致；在40308个真实营级机动实例上，冻结模型在完全覆盖下弥合了48%的差距。

Conclusion: 信息视界（而非模型容量）是决定局部分布式组合优化求解质量的最关键变量。在协议规定的视界内，图神经网络可以复现甚至超越贪心算法的性能，但一旦视界不足（少一跳），无论模型容量多大都无法弥补覆盖半径的缺失。这为在硬信息视界约束下设计神经组合优化方法提供了理论依据与实证支撑。

Abstract: Neural combinatorial optimization typically assumes a centralized solver that reads the whole instance. We study the opposite: combinatorial optimization under a hard information horizon, where every node commits to its share of a global solution seeing only its $k$-hop neighborhood, and those commitments must compose into a globally feasible solution. We formalize this as local set cover and instantiate it on weighted multipoint relay (MPR) selection, the NP-hard 2-hop covering problem of the Optimized Link State Routing Protocol version 2 (OLSRv2) routing protocol (RFC~7181), whose horizon is imposed by the protocol, not chosen by the modeler. We prove two results. Any deterministic selector whose horizon is one hop short must either fail coverage or land a factor $Δ$ from optimal, and an $L$-layer graph neural network (GNN) read out at the deciding node is exactly an $L$-hop selector, so capacity cannot buy back radius. Conversely, at the horizon a \ac{GNN} of depth $O(Δ)$ reproduces the RFC~7181 covering greedy, and at width $O(c_{\max}Δ)$ its metric-aware weighted analogue, inheriting the $(1+\lnΔ_2)$-approximation in both cases. Empirically, a 3-layer \ac{GATv2} with a coverage-completing decoder, behavior-cloned from the CP-SAT optimum, reaches $\text{cost}/\text{opt}=1.030\pm0.001$ against greedy's $1.138$, closing $79.1\%$ of the gap at $100\%$ coverage. Restricting the same learner to one hop, on identical instances with the same decoder and demonstrations, collapses it to $1.344$, far worse than greedy. Two transfer checks target real-world networks. OLSRv2's unmodified selection code matches our cardinality greedy on $200/200$ unit-cost instances, and on $40{,}308$ instances of real battalion mobility the frozen model closes $48\%$ of the gap at full coverage. The information horizon, not the model capacity, is the most significant variable.

</details>


### [223] [Target-Dependent Limits of Causal Repair: A Leading-Log Frontier in a Gaussian Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00424)
*Qinchuan Cheng,Jiaqi Liu,Ruixuan Xie*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文在已知干预几何的标量高斯因果实验中，量化"因果预测器可提升的潜在幅度"与"实际学到的修复所带来的增益"之间的差距，刻画了统一学习MSE η下联合优化学习器与评估器时的评估误差下界，并给出幅度丰富情形下的尖锐前导对数前沿及可达的判定-弃权规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 知道一个因果预测器"可能"带来多大改进，并不等于知道实际学到的修复获得了多少真实增益。现有工作多关注效应（幅度）的可估性，而本文关注的是"已实现的训练修复相对于拟合参照的平方损失增益"这一评估目标，其信息需求与效应识别不同，需单独刻画评估的根本难度。

Method: 作者在一个标量高斯因果实验中进行分析，干预几何已知：辅助数据在有限污染下识别效应幅度，诊断信息识别方向。目标是已实现修复相对拟合参照的平方损失增益。通过对学习器与评估器在均匀学习MSE η下做联合优化（避免"不做修复"的平凡解），在通常的1/k学习尺度下推导评估下界；在幅度丰富情形下用前导对数分析刻画评估指数的尖锐前沿，并构造未知冗余参数下的判定-弃权规则，再通过精确高斯模拟将前沿迁移到自适应采样，辅以有限网格实验验证。

Result: 在1/k学习尺度下，任何可行学习器都受到k^{-2}的评估下界，即使oracle势能以更快速率估计。在幅度丰富情形下，评估指数以首个相对阶等于min{ℓ_k, 2kη_k/U}，其中 ℓ_k=log(1/(k²E_k))，E_k为辅助精度；该指数可由判定-弃权规则在未知冗余参数下达至。文章还界定了临界容忍窗口，并将前沿经精确高斯模拟迁移到自适应采样。有限网格实验区分了符号尾抑制与总MSE，并暴露出有限预算下的保守行为。

Conclusion: 评估目标（已实现修复的增益）改变了信息需求，与单纯的因果可识别性不同；本文结果仅限于该实验设定，并非一般性的因果可识别性声明。

Abstract: Knowing how much a causal predictor could improve need not reveal the gain of the repair actually learned. We quantify this gap in a scalar Gaussian causal experiment with known intervention geometry: auxiliary data identify effect magnitude up to bounded contamination, while diagnostics identify direction. The target is the squared-loss gain of the realized trained repair relative to a fitted reference. Jointly optimizing the learner and assessor under uniform learning MSE $η$ avoids the trivial solution of making no repair. At the usual $1/k$ learning scale, every feasible learner incurs a $k^{-2}$ assessment floor, even when oracle potential is estimable at a faster rate. In the magnitude-rich regime, we characterize a sharp leading-log frontier: the assessment exponent is $\min{\ell_k,2kη_k/U}$ to first relative order, where $\ell_k=\log(1/(k^2E_k))$ and $E_k$ is auxiliary precision. A diagnostic-abstention rule attains this exponent with unknown nuisance parameters. We also bound the critical allowance window and transfer the frontier to adaptive sampling by exact Gaussian simulation. Finite-grid experiments distinguish sign-tail suppression from total MSE and expose conservative finite-budget behavior. The result isolates how the assessment target changes information requirements in this experiment; it is not a general causal identifiability claim.

</details>


### [224] [ChainLoRA: Geometry-Preserving Task Vector Merging for Continual Learning in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00431)
*Hang Yin,Haozhe Wang,Yuhua Luo,Zhangqi Pan,Xiaoxing Wang,Junchi Yan*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: ChainLoRA 是一种无需回放的持续参数高效微调框架，通过链式更新的任务向量几何与自适应SVD合并，在严格参数预算下兼顾知识保留与新任务适应，并在多个基准上取得领先性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型的持续参数高效微调需要在保留旧知识、适应新任务和严格参数预算之间取得平衡。现有方法在遗忘机制上缺乏几何层面的清晰刻画，且回放方法面临存储与隐私成本，因此需要设计一种无回放、参数可控且能同时抑制遗忘与任务干扰的持续合并框架。

Method: ChainLoRA 提出链式更新的任务向量几何框架：训练阶段采用链式初始化与单边正交性代理（one-sided orthogonality proxy），仅依赖最后一个载体，使历史状态足迹与正则化开销不随任务流增长而增加；合并阶段采用自适应SVD提取共享载体，并通过 Procrustes 对齐将其匹配到最新任务。理论分析表明 Procrustes 对齐促进共享与任务特定成分的几何近似分离，单边代理约束任务间干扰，同时引入有效秩惩罚提升任务子空间利用效率。

Result: 实验表明，ChainLoRA 在 Large 和 SuperNI 基准上的无回放方法中达到最先进性能，在 Standard CL 上保持竞争力，并在三个基准上均取得接近回放方法的平均分数。

Conclusion: ChainLoRA 通过链式更新任务向量几何与自适应SVD合并，成功在无回放设定下实现参数高效且抗遗忘的持续学习，验证了几何视角下遗忘刻画与 Procrustes 对齐机制的有效性，为持续参数高效微调提供了新思路。

Abstract: Continual parameter-efficient fine-tuning for large language models (LLMs) must balance retention of previously acquired knowledge, adaptation to new tasks, and strict parameter budgets. We present \textbf{ChainLoRA}, a replay-free continual merging framework built on chain-updated task-vector geometry. From a parameter-merging perspective, we formulate a geometric view of forgetting through a measurable interaction between task updates, separating directional overlap from coefficient coupling. Building on this view, ChainLoRA combines chain-updated training with post-stream adaptive SVD merging. During training, initialization and a one-sided orthogonality proxy use only the last carrier, keeping their historical-state footprint and regularization overhead constant as the task stream grows. At merging time, Adaptive SVD extracts a shared carrier and aligns it to the latest task through Procrustes adaptation. Our theoretical analysis shows that Procrustes adaptation facilitates geometric approximate separation of shared and task-specific components. The one-sided proxy further bounds inter-task interference. An effective-rank penalty additionally promotes efficient utilization of the task subspace during continual learning. Experiments show that ChainLoRA achieves state-of-the-art performance among the evaluated replay-free methods on the Large and SuperNI benchmarks, while remaining competitive on Standard CL and attaining almost the closest average scores to the evaluated replay-based method across all three benchmarks.

</details>


### [225] [Fractional Laplace Neural Operators: Exact Architectures, an Expressivity Frontier at Criticality, and Certified Stability for Memory-Driven Network Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00515)
*Mauricio Herrera-Marín*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出分数拉普拉斯神经算子（fLNO），将Volterra预解式的非有理Laplace符号结构嵌入可学习的算子映射中，实现精确记忆结构、物理坐标与稳定性保证的共存。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经算子学习函数空间之间的映射，但遗传网络动力学由具有非有理Laplace符号的Volterra预解式描述；现有有限有理实现受制于分支点产生的非整数临界渐近，需要一种能精确嵌入该记忆结构的算子学习架构。

Method: 对于可交换的激励—拉普拉斯对，用单个块图谱层精确表示完整线性Volterra解算子；建立有限有理实现的表达力边界（紧频率窗上的几何逼近、半线上的根指数最优速率）；构造可训练参数化以强制稳定性裕度；提出graphon传递定理区分真正算子一致性与参数共享；在共同数据基准与受控近临界实验中验证。

Result: 正有理算子在有限时域可达到或超过fLNO精度；受控近临界实验中fLNO以少得多的参数更忠实恢复分支坐标，且不受约束的有理拟合会越过稳定边界而认证参数化不会；四参数谱律从48节点迁移到192节点无重训练，相对误差0.51–0.62%；在智利余震序列及智利与21个意大利地区的更新模型中实现带显式不确定性的结构化推断。

Conclusion: fLNO是一种算子学习架构，使精确记忆结构、物理坐标和稳定性保证与竞争性精度共存，为具有非有理分数记忆的遗传动力学提供可训练且稳定性可认证的算子学习方案。

Abstract: Neural operators learn maps between function spaces, while hereditary network dynamics are described by Volterra resolvents with non-rational Laplace symbols. We introduce a fractional Laplace neural operator (fLNO) that embeds this structure in the learned map. For commuting excitation--Laplacian pairs, one block graph-spectral layer represents the full linear Volterra solution operator exactly. We establish an expressivity frontier for finite rational realizations: they approximate fractional memory geometrically on compact frequency windows, but cannot reproduce the non-integer critical asymptotics generated by a branch point, and on the half-line the best rational rate is root-exponential. The same theory yields trainable parametrizations that enforce a prescribed stability margin by construction, and a graphon-transfer theorem separates genuine operator consistency from parameter sharing. In a common-data benchmark, positive rational operators can match or exceed fLNO accuracy on finite horizons, whereas in controlled near-critical experiments fLNO recovers the branching coordinate more faithfully with far fewer parameters; unconstrained rational fits can cross the stability boundary, while certified parametrizations cannot. A four-parameter spectral law transfers without retraining from graphs of size 48 to 192 with 0.51--0.62% relative error. Applications to Chilean aftershock sequences and to renewal models for Chile and 21 Italian regions illustrate structured inference with explicit uncertainty. The contribution is an operator-learning architecture in which exact memory structure, physical coordinates and stability guarantees coexist with competitive accuracy.

</details>


### [226] [Adaptive Conformal Prediction for Image Regression Models with Application to an Inertial Confinement Fusion Emulator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00535)
*Carrie J. Lei-Cramer,Michael S. Jones,Laura J. Wendelberger*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出 ACPNN，一种基于最近邻的输入自适应共形预测框架，用于图像回归的不确定性量化，通过高斯过程学习带自动相关性确定（ARD）核的缩放距离度量定义邻域，并在惯性约束聚变扩散模型上验证其可靠性与自适应性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学机器学习中黑盒图像模型在高风险场景下广泛应用，但多数方法只提供点估计而缺乏预测不确定性量化；同时模型内部的可访问性与可解释性有限，难以评估输入空间不同区域的可靠性。因此亟需能提供输入依赖型不确定性估计的方法，以指导模型开发与下游实验。

Method: 提出自适应最近邻共形预测（ACPNN）：利用邻近样本信息生成局部自适应的不确定性估计，保持低计算成本；邻域结构由经高斯过程与自动相关性确定（ARD）核学习的缩放距离度量定义，从而实现输入自适应的共形预测。

Result: ACPNN 在用于模拟惯性约束聚变（ICF）仿真的扩散模型上验证有效，实现了可靠且自适应的不确定性量化。

Conclusion: ACPNN 为图像回归提供了一种输入自适应的共形不确定性量化方案，能以较低计算开销获得可靠、局部自适应的预测区间，有望支撑高风险场景下的模型开发与实验决策。

Abstract: Uncertainty quantification is critical in scientific machine learning, where black-box, image-based models are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings. In many such applications, model outputs inform costly decisions, yet most methods provide only point estimates without quantifying predictive uncertainty. This challenge is compounded by the limited accessibility and interpretability of model internals, making it difficult to assess reliability across different regions of the input space. As a result, there is a growing need for methods that can provide input-dependent uncertainty estimates to guide both model development and downstream experimentation. To address this need, we propose Adaptive Conformal Prediction using Nearest Neighbors (ACPNN), an input-adaptive conformal framework for image regression. ACPNN leverages information from neighboring samples to produce locally adaptive uncertainty estimates while maintaining low computational cost. The neighborhood structure is defined using a scaled distance metric learned via a Gaussian Process with an automatic relevance determination (ARD) kernel. We demonstrate the effectiveness of ACPNN on a diffusion model for emulating inertial confinement fusion (ICF) simulations, showing that it achieves reliable and adaptive uncertainty quantification.

</details>


### [227] [Learning to Price Electricity for Optimal Demand Response](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00755)
*Jing Shang,Mohammad Mehrabi,Xinyang Zhou,Mahmoud Saleh,Andrey Bernstein,Stefan Wager*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于神经网络的上下文能源定价算法，将定价建模为Stackelberg博弈，并利用均值场解表示从上下文特征学习到可行价格信号的映射，实验表明融入上下文信息能显著提升需求响应项目的价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 利用时变电价塑造消费者需求响应、使能源需求与可再生能源生产更好对齐具有重要意义。然而，最优价格通常随时间变化，依赖于天气预测、日出日落时间、星期模式等复杂信号，现有方法无法高效利用这些丰富的上下文信息。

Method: 提出基于神经网络的上下文能源定价算法，将定价问题建模为Stackelberg博弈（电网作为领导者、消费者作为跟随者），并利用Mehrabi等人（2024）提出的均值场解表示，学习从上下文特征到可行价格信号的受约束映射。

Result: 在多个美国城市的电网模拟中验证了该方法，结果表明融入上下文信息能够显著提高需求响应项目的价值。

Conclusion: 基于神经网络并利用均值场表示的上下文定价方法能够有效捕捉复杂上下文信号对最优价格的影响，相较于不考虑上下文的方法可大幅提升需求响应效益，为上下文能源定价提供了有效的新途径。

Abstract: There is considerable interest in using time-varying electricity prices to shape consumer demand response, and better align energy demand with renewable production. However, optimal prices generally vary over time in response to complex signals such as weather forecasts, sunrise/sunset times, and day-of-week patterns; and existing methods are not able to make efficient use of such rich contextual information. Here, we propose a neural-network-based algorithm for contextual energy pricing, modeling pricing as a Stackelberg game and leveraging a mean-field solution representation from Mehrabi et al.~(2024). The approach learns constrained mappings from contextual features to feasible price signals. We validate our approach by simulating the energy grid in several US cities, and show that incorporating contextual information can considerably increase the value of the demand response programs.

</details>


### [228] [Inference for stochastic differential equations driven by weighted sub-fractional Brownian motion using neural networks and the Euler approximation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00793)
*J. H. Ramirez-Gonzalez*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究由加权次分数布朗族高斯过程驱动的随机微分方程中漂移、扩散与噪声协方差的估计问题，通过欧拉近似重建高斯驱动增量并构造轨迹似然，用神经网络与径向基表示模型参数，并在20种系数设置下与两种神经方法对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典扩散模型通常假设布朗运动驱动，但实际数据驱动噪声可能具有非独立增量或非马尔可夫的高斯结构（如次分数布朗族），其协方差涉及时间权重 f 和协方差指数 β，难以用标准参数方法同时估计漂移、扩散系数及噪声协方差结构。

Method: 对给定观测时域 T 和已知初值 x0 的 SDE，采用欧拉近似重建高斯驱动增量，利用其联合密度构造轨迹似然；漂移 a、扩散 σ 及归一化时间权重 f 分别用神经网络和径向基函数表示建模；协方差指数 β 与扩散尺度通过似然剖分（likelihood profile）估计；在20种系数设置下与两种基于神经网络的方法在相同模拟轨迹上对比。

Result: 所提方法在模拟实验中成功估计漂移、扩散与噪声协方差，并与两种神经替代方法在相同轨迹和20种系数设置下进行数值比较，验证了该估计方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 利用高斯过程（加权次分数布朗族）驱动的 SDE 模型，结合欧拉近似、轨迹似然以及神经网络/径向基表示，能够有效估计漂移、扩散系数和噪声协方差，并在多种系数设置下展现了与神经方法的可比性能。

Abstract: We consider the estimation of drift, diffusion, and noise covariance from discrete observations of stochastic differential equations driven by Gaussian processes. For a fixed observation horizon $T>0$ and a known initial state $x_0\in\mathbb R$, we study \begin{equation*}
  dX_t=a(X_t)\,dt+σ(X_t)\,dZ_t^{β,f},
  \qquad X_0=x_0,\quad 0\leq t\leq T. \end{equation*} \smallskip\noindent Here $a:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ is the drift coefficient, $σ:\mathbb R\to(0,\infty)$ is the diffusion coefficient, and $Z^{β,f}$ is a centered Gaussian process from the weighted sub-fractional Brownian family, with covariance \begin{equation*}
  \operatorname{Cov}(Z_s^{β,f},Z_t^{β,f})
  =\int_0^{s\wedge t} f(r)q_β(s-r,t-r)\,dr,
  \qquad 0\leq s,t\leq T. \end{equation*} \smallskip\noindent Here $s\wedge t=\min\{s,t\}$. The temporal weight $f:[0,T]\to[0,\infty)$ is measurable, bounded, and positive almost everywhere, and $β\in(0,2)$ is the covariance exponent. For $u,v\geq0$, the kernel is $q_β(u,v)=[u^β+v^β-(u+v)^β]/(1-β)$ when $β\ne1$. Its continuous extension at $β=1$ is $q_1(u,v)=(u+v)\log(u+v)-u\log u-v\log v$, with $0\log0=0$.
  Using the Euler approximation, we reconstruct the Gaussian driving increments from observed transitions and use their joint density to obtain a trajectory likelihood. Neural and radial-basis representations model the drift, diffusion, and normalized temporal weight, while a likelihood profile estimates the covariance exponent and diffusion scale. We compare the method with two neural alternatives on the same simulated trajectories in twenty coefficient settings.

</details>


### [229] [Block Optimism for Nonstationary Bandits with Latent Linear Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00911)
*Taehyun Hwang,Hyunjun Choi,Heesang Ann,Min-hwan Oh*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究具有潜在线性动态的内生非平稳随机赌博机问题，其中动作同时影响即时奖励和隐含状态演化。作者将既有探索后承诺法的 O~(T^{2/3}) 遗憾改进至 O~(√T)，通过自适应分块乐观策略（UCB 分块算法）实现，是该模型下首个 √T 级遗憾保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法（explore-then-commit）通过均匀探索估计潜在动态后提交开环动作序列，仅能达到 O~(T^{2/3}) 遗憾。这一速率存在改进空间：由于动作会持续影响隐状态演化、奖励具有历史依赖性，长期规划复杂，作者希望借助自适应乐观探索与循环近似，把遗憾提升到 √T 量级。

Method: 核心步骤是循环近似（cyclic approximation）：在稳定动态下，无限记忆的奖励过程可被截断，开环基准可通过对有限记忆的分块级代理进行优化来近似。基于该归约，作者提出基于 UCB 的分块算法，为截断后的动态参数维护置信集，并以乐观方式选择动作块，实现自适应分块级乐观探索。

Result: 证明了该算法的遗憾上界为 O~(√T)，相比同一模型下此前的 O~(T^{2/3}) 保证有显著改进。作者指出这是针对具有双线性奖励观测与开环动作序列基准的潜在线性动态赌博机问题，首个 √T 遗憾保证。

Conclusion: 通过自适应分块乐观与循环近似，可将潜在线性动态赌博机问题的遗憾从 O~(T^{2/3}) 降至 O~(√T)，实现该模型下最优量级的遗憾保证。

Abstract: We study an endogenous nonstationary stochastic bandit problem with latent linear dynamics, where actions affect both immediate rewards and the future evolution of an unobserved latent state. Rewards are bilinear in the current action and latent state, inducing history-dependent rewards and a nontrivial long-horizon planning problem. The existing explore-then-commit approach achieves $\tilde{O}(T^{2/3})$ regret by uniformly exploring to estimate the latent dynamics and then committing to an optimized open-loop action sequence. We show that this rate can be improved via adaptive block-level optimism. Our key step is a cyclic approximation: under stable dynamics, the infinite-memory reward process can be truncated, and the open-loop benchmark can be approximated by optimizing a finite-memory block-level proxy. Building on this reduction, we propose a UCB-based block algorithm that maintains confidence sets for the truncated dynamics parameters and selects blocks optimistically. We prove a regret bound of order $\tilde{O}(\sqrt T)$, significantly improving over the previous $\tilde{O}(T^{2/3})$ guarantee for the same model. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first $\tilde{O}(\sqrt T)$ regret guarantee for latent linear-dynamics bandits with bilinear reward observations and an open-loop action-sequence benchmark.

</details>


### [230] [The Price of Correlated Tests: How Strict Should a Model Release Gate Be?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00993)
*Marco Pollanen*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文将机器学习模型上线前的"测试放行关卡"本身视为设计问题：在满足所需可靠性目标的前提下，选择让模型通过的门槛（需通过的最少测试数），以保留尽可能多的好模型；并用两类别潜因子模型量化相关成本，给出可证明性质、数值结果与基于精确二项式界限的验证方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型上线前通常需通过一整套自动化测试，但"全部通过"的严格要求既可能会误拒许多本可服务好用户的模型，又无法说明通过模型的实际可信度。作者希望把"放行关卡"设计成可控的权衡问题，在可靠性目标与保留好模型数量之间取得最优平衡。

Method: 采用两类别潜因子模型，将误放行差模型与误拒好模型两类成本显式化，并把每次计算归结为一维积分。在此基础上证明：当两类共享同一潜相关时，越严格的关卡总是提升可靠性，因此保留最多好模型的关卡就是在仍能达到目标前提下的最宽松关卡。作者还给出基于精确二项式界限的验证流程，可在关卡从固定候选短列表中选出的情况下，利用带标签数据对关卡进行认证。

Result: 在"全通过"关卡下，任何不要求绝对完美的可靠性目标在模型内都可实现，但随着测试套件规模增大，被保留的好模型比例趋于零；测试之间的相关性决定代价。某配置下，99% 的目标需 8 个独立测试，但在潜相关 0.3 时需 74 个、0.5 时需 5,182 个测试，此时关卡保留的好模型不足十分之一。

Conclusion: 测试放行关卡应作为设计问题求解：在满足可靠性目标的前提下采用最宽松的门槛可保留最多好模型，且测试间的相关性是决定所需测试规模与代价的关键因素；所提验证方法能在标签数据下对选定关卡进行可靠认证。

Abstract: Before a machine learning model ships, it often has to pass a suite of automated tests. Requiring every test to pass looks safe, yet it can reject many models that would have served users well, and it does not say how trustworthy a passing model actually is. We treat the release gate as a design problem: choose how many tests a model must pass so that cleared models meet a stated reliability target, while keeping as many good models as possible. A two-class latent-factor model makes both costs explicit and reduces each calculation to a one-dimensional integral. We prove that when both classes share the same latent correlation, a stricter gate always raises reliability, so the gate that keeps the most good models is the most lenient one that still meets the target. Under pass-all gating, any reliability target short of perfection is attainable within the model, but the share of good models kept tends to zero as the suite grows. Correlation between tests sets the price. In one configuration, a 99 percent target needs 8 independent tests, but 74 tests at a latent correlation of 0.3 and 5,182 at 0.5, where the gate keeps fewer than one good model in ten. We also give a validation procedure, built on exact binomial bounds, that certifies a gate from labelled data even when the gate is chosen from a fixed shortlist.

</details>


### [231] [Tolerance-Based Fairness Auditing: Violation Certification and Sensitivity Screening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01005)
*Jie Tang,Chuanlong Xie,Lixing Zhu*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文针对算法公平性审计，提出一个基于容忍阈值的统一统计框架，涵盖违规认证与敏感性筛查两类互补目标，并分别配套不同的经验似然检验方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 算法日益普及引发对算法不公平的担忧，实践中可容忍的不公平程度取决于法律、伦理或应用场景。给定预设容忍阈值后，如何判断群体差异是否超出允许范围，是不同审计目标下需要解决的核心统计问题。

Method: 提出统一的基于容忍度的公平审计框架。针对违规认证目标（优先控制误报违规），构建受约束经验似然检验，采用最小不利点标定，并可结合误标率控制实现多子群的同步审计；针对敏感性筛查目标（优先减少漏报违规），构建分裂经验似然与校正分裂经验似然检验，采用自适应边界代理原则，适用于预警场景。

Result: 数值实验表明，两类程序在错误控制与敏感性之间存在不同的权衡；COMPAS 数据分析将该框架应用于预测性公平审计，验证了其实际有效性。

Conclusion: 该统一框架能够依据审计目标（认证或筛查）灵活选择检验方法，在可控的错误率下有效判定群体差异是否超越容忍阈值，为透明化公平审计提供了系统化的统计工具。

Abstract: As artificial intelligence is increasingly deployed, algorithmic unfairness has raised growing concerns and intensified demands for transparent fairness auditing. In practice, the tolerable degree of algorithmic unfairness depends on the specific legal, ethical, or application context. Given a prespecified tolerance threshold, an important statistical question is how to determine whether a group disparity exceeds the allowable tolerance across different auditing objectives. To address this problem, we develop a unified tolerance-based fairness auditing framework for two complementary auditing objectives: violation certification, which prioritizes control of false violation declarations, and sensitivity screening, which prioritizes reducing missed violations. For the first objective, we develop a constrained empirical likelihood test for formal settings that uses least-favorable-point calibration and can be combined with false flagging rate control for simultaneous subgroup auditing. For the second objective, we develop split empirical likelihood and adjusted split empirical likelihood tests using an adaptive boundary-proxy principle for early-warning settings. Numerical experiments show the distinct error-control--sensitivity trade-offs of these procedures. A COMPAS analysis illustrates the framework in predictive fairness auditing.

</details>


### [232] [Posterior sampling by source-space MCMC via prior-based few-step transport maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01034)
*Hoang Phuc Hau Luu,Marcelo Hartmann,Zhongjian Wang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于源空间的广义贝叶斯推断框架，用单步/少步改进的 MeanFlow（iMF）映射表达隐式先验，并在其高斯源空间进行后验采样，结合 Wasserstein 误差界与混合 MCMC（并行回火 + pCN/分裂 HMC）实现高效、稳定的后验近似，并在 CLIP 引导的图像先验上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代贝叶斯推断越来越多地使用仅以样本形式呈现的信息性隐式先验（历史集成、模拟器输出、预训练生成模型），且在测试时引导（广义贝叶斯）中需要显式正权重（如指数化奖励）对隐式先验进行倾斜；现有方法在采样效率与后验稳定性上存在不足，缺乏统一的理论与算法框架。

Method: 用单步或几步改进的 MeanFlow（iMF）映射表示先验，在其高斯源空间进行后验采样；建立精确后验与学习后验之间的 Wasserstein 误差界（由联合总体 iMF 与辅助速度损失分解为训练次优性和模型类逼近误差）；在 iMF 源空间采用带预条件 Crank-Nicolson 更新的并行回火，并引入结合分裂 Hamiltonian Monte Carlo 的混合变体以提升采样效率。

Result: 合成实验表明该框架能准确且高效地近似后验分布；在 CLIP 引导的 ImageNet 实验中，能引导预训练的 iMF 图像先验朝向文本指定的偏好方向生成。

Conclusion: 所提出的源空间广义贝叶斯推断框架通过廉价少步先验传输与后验稳定性保证，有效解决了隐式先验下的（广义）贝叶斯推断问题，在理论与实验上均展现出准确性与高效性。

Abstract: Bayesian inference increasingly uses informative but implicit priors represented only by samples, such as historical ensembles, simulator outputs, and pretrained generative models. The same computational problem appears in the test-time guidance task (generalized Bayes), where an explicit positive weight, e.g., an exponentiated reward, tilts an implicit prior. We develop a framework for source-space generalized Bayesian inference that combines inexpensive few-step prior transports with posterior stability guarantees. Specifically, we represent the prior using a one- or few-step improved MeanFlow (iMF) map and perform posterior sampling in its Gaussian source space. We establish Wasserstein error bounds between the exact and learned posteriors in terms of the joint population iMF and auxiliary-velocity loss, decomposed into training suboptimality and model-class approximation error. In the iMF source space, we adopt parallel tempering with preconditioned Crank-Nicolson updates and introduce a hybrid variant that incorporates split Hamiltonian Monte Carlo to improve sampling efficiency. Synthetic experiments show that the proposed framework can approximate posterior distributions accurately and efficiently, while CLIP-guided ImageNet experiments demonstrate its ability to steer a pretrained iMF image prior toward text-specified preferences.

</details>


### [233] [Optimal Transport Meets Reinforcement Learning: A Survey](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01413)
*Yujie Zhu,Charles A. Hepburn,Matthew Thorpe,Giovanni Montana*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本综述系统梳理了最优传输（OT）在强化学习中的使用，涵盖OT的作用、比较的分布、OT公式及时间结构处理，并讨论了代价设计与计算挑战、开放问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL算法常需比较概率分布（状态访问分布、动作分布、转移分布），但常用散度（如KL）在分布重叠较弱时失效；而模仿学习、离线RL及分布偏移部署中弱重叠场景普遍存在。OT通过"移动"概率质量并纳入任务几何的ground cost，提供了更有效的度量，因此需要系统总结OT在RL中的应用。

Method: 本文为综述性研究。作者对现有将OT引入RL目标与算法的方法进行分类梳理，对每种方法识别四个维度：OT所扮演的角色、被比较的分布、采用的OT公式（如Wasserstein距离、Sinkhorn正则、非平衡OT等），以及对时间结构的处理方式；同时分析不同OT选择的动机、ground cost设计的实际考量、计算挑战，并总结开放问题。

Result: 文章构建了OT在RL中的统一分类框架，涵盖模仿学习、离线RL、模型学习与分布偏移部署等场景；总结了各方法的OT角色、分布、公式与时间处理，指出了ground cost设计、可扩展性等实际问题，并归纳出可扩展轨迹级传输、质量不匹配的规范化处理、OT正则化RL的理论分析等开放难题。

Conclusion: OT为弱重叠分布下的RL提供了更具几何意义的度量替代方案，但仍面临可扩展性、质量不匹配处理与理论分析的挑战，是未来值得深入的方向。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms frequently compare probability distributions, such as state visitation distributions induced by policies and experts, action distributions from learned policies and offline datasets, or transition distributions from learned models and environments. However, commonly used divergences may become ineffective when these distributions overlap weakly, which is frequently encountered in imitation learning, offline RL, and deployment under distribution shift. Optimal transport (OT) offers an alternative by measuring the cost of \emph{moving} probability mass from one distribution to another under a ground cost that encodes task geometry. This survey covers how OT is used inside RL objectives and algorithms. For each method, we identify: the role OT plays, the distributions compared, the OT formulation used, and the treatment of temporal structure. Beyond categorising existing methods, we discuss the motivations behind different OT choices, practical considerations such as cost design and computational challenges, and highlight open problems including scalable trajectory-level transport, principled handling of mass mismatch, and theoretical analysis for OT-regularised RL.

</details>


### [234] [Zero Flux: Flow-Based Comparison of High-Dimensional Discrete Distributions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01472)
*Leyang Wang,Yakun Wang,Song Liu,Taiji Suzuki*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出“零通量”（Zero Flux）准则，将基于流匹配的分布比较思想从连续域推广到高维离散分布，通过局部概率通量衡量两个离散分布之间的差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 比较高维离散分布面临状态空间指数增长和交互结构复杂的挑战。现有基于流匹配（flow matching）的连续分布比较方法（中点向量场消失当且仅当两分布相同）无法自然适用于离散分布，因此需要一种适配离散场景的推广方案。

Method: 作者将流匹配的向量场准则推广到离散域，提出基于局部概率通量的“零通量”准则。在独立耦合条件下，证明所有局部概率通量在中间点消失当且仅当两个分布相同。该差异度将联合分布差异分解为较小的局部贡献，并可由样本高效估计，同时建立估计量的有限样本误差界。

Result: 在合成数据和真实类别数据上的实验表明，该方法能可靠地恢复稀疏依赖信号，并在高维情形下稳定追踪分布漂移。

Conclusion: 零通量准则为高维离散分布比较提供了一种新思路，将整体差异分解为局部贡献并具备有限样本保证，在稀疏依赖检测和分布漂移追踪等任务上表现出良好的实际效果。

Abstract: Comparing two high-dimensional discrete distributions has always been a challenging task due to the exponentially growing state space and complex changes in interactions. A recent work suggests comparing distributions through a vector field trained using flow matching between two continuous distributions. The resulting vector field at mid-point vanishes if and only if two distributions identical. However, such a flow-based criterion does not naturally apply to discrete distributions. We extend this principle to the discrete domain and introduce the \emph{Zero Flux} criterion, a discrepancy based on local probability fluxes. Under independent coupling, we show that all local probability fluxes vanish at the midpoint if and only if two distributions are the same. This discrepancy decomposes the joint distributional difference into smaller, local contributions and can be efficiently estimated from samples. We establish finite sample error bounds for our estimator. Experiments on synthetic and real categorical data demonstrate reliable recovery of sparse dependence signals and stable tracking of distribution shifts in high dimensions.

</details>


### [235] [The hidden advantage of mask resampling: a theory of masked autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01578)
*Jorge Medina Moreira,Lorenzo Bardone,Lenka Zdeborová*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文通过高维模型从理论上证明掩码线性重构在共享潜在结构、异构噪声的数据上能以线性样本复杂度恢复潜在特征，而未掩码重构（等价于PCA）在相同条件下失败；同时量化了掩码重采样的统计优势，并通过受理论指导的实验揭示了标准训练流程（随机裁剪与翻转）会掩盖动态掩码相对静态掩码的下游优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究掩码预测（masked prediction）为何能学到未掩码重构无法学到的有用表征，并厘清"掩码预测目标"与"掩码多样性"各自带来的收益，解释为何标准训练实践可能掩盖掩码重采样的优势。

Method: 构建一个高维MAE模型，数据具有共享潜在结构与异构噪声；在理论上证明掩码线性重构的样本复杂度优势（与PCA对比），并引入每样本固定K个掩码的集合来刻画掩码多样性对特征恢复与下游性能的影响；随后根据理论预测设计实验，移除随机裁剪与翻转后对比CNN自编码器与视觉Transformer中动态掩码与静态掩码的下游表现，并用BERT做下游语言任务的补充实验。

Result: 理论证明掩码线性重构能以线性样本复杂度恢复潜在特征，而等价于PCA的未掩码重构失败；更大掩码多样性可降低样本复杂度。实验发现随机裁剪与翻转会通过不断更新预测任务而掩盖掩码重采样的优势，移除这些变换后动态掩码在CNN自编码器和视觉Transformer上均优于静态掩码；BERT实验亦显示更大掩码多样性带来下游语言任务收益。

Conclusion: 该工作区分了掩码预测目标本身与掩码多样性的不同作用，表明掩码重采样的统计优势在标准训练增强下被掩盖，而一个可解的理论框架能指导实验揭示这些被隐藏的优势。

Abstract: Why can masked prediction learn useful representations that unmasked reconstruction misses? We study this question in a high-dimensional model of a masked autoencoder (MAE) trained on data with shared latent structure and heterogeneous noise. We prove that masked linear reconstruction can recover the latent feature at linear sample complexity in regimes where unmasked linear reconstruction, equivalent to PCA, fails. The analysis also quantifies the statistical advantage of mask resampling, an established ingredient of masked pretraining. By introducing a fixed collection of $K$ masks per sample, we characterize its effect on feature recovery and downstream performance, identifying regimes where greater mask diversity lowers sample complexity. Guided by this prediction, we find that random cropping and flipping in standard image-training pipelines can obscure the advantage of mask resampling by renewing the prediction task even when the patch mask is fixed. Removing these transformations reveals a downstream advantage for dynamic over static masking in CNN autoencoders and vision transformers. A complementary BERT pilot finds benefits from greater mask diversity on downstream language tasks. Our results separate the benefit of the masked prediction objective from that of mask diversity, and show how a tractable theory can guide experiments that uncover advantages hidden by standard training practices.

</details>


### [236] [Error-Corrected Inference-Time Scaling for Imperfect Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01933)
*Zuokai Wen,Louis Grenioux,Weinan E,Jiequn Han*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出能量基费曼-卡茨校正器（EBFKC），在不重新训练的前提下，利用参考能量在场（on the fly）校正预训练扩散模型的误差（端点不匹配与概率路径追踪误差），并通过序贯蒙特卡洛实现，在多个任务上显著优于标准推理时扩展基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推理时扩展方法依赖更多粒子的蒙特卡洛采样，但前提假设预训练模型是精确的。现实中模型因数据与训练限制并不完美，增加粒子只能降低蒙特卡洛误差，无法消除端点与目标分布的不匹配，也无法纠正对指定概率路径的追踪误差。因此需要一个能在模型不完美时仍准确校正采样误差的框架。

Method: 提出能量基费曼-卡茨校正器（EBFKC）。首先推导费曼-卡茨动力学，使得即便模型不完美，在连续时间群体极限下也能精确追踪指定路径；随后用带方差控制引导的序贯蒙特卡洛近似该动力学。为消除端点不匹配，将预训练能量作为沿扩散路径的代理（surrogate），并逐步纳入学习到的能量与目标终端能量之间的差异。

Result: 在高斯混合模型、粒子系统、丙氨酸二肽和丙氨酸四肽上的实验表明，在退火与奖励倾斜（reward tilting）设置下，EBFKC 能紧密匹配目标分布和分子自由能剖面，而标准推理时扩展基线仍保留显著采样误差。

Conclusion: EBFKC 通过费曼-卡茨动力学与序贯蒙特卡洛相结合，能在不重新训练的情况下校正预训练能量基扩散模型的路径追踪误差与端点不匹配，实现对目标分布和分子自由能剖面的高精度采样，显著优于依赖更多粒子但未校正模型误差的传统推理时扩展方法。

Abstract: Inference-time scaling adapts pretrained diffusion models to new sampling tasks without additional training. Existing methods rely primarily on Monte Carlo sampling with more particles, yet are premised on the pretrained model being exact. In practice, data and training limitations make the model imperfect, and these methods inherit its error. More particles reduce Monte Carlo error but cannot remove the mismatch between the endpoint and the desired target or the error in tracking the prescribed probability path. We introduce the Energy-based Feynman-Kac Corrector (EBFKC), a framework for energy-based diffusion models that corrects these errors on the fly given a reference energy. We first derive Feynman-Kac dynamics that track a prescribed path exactly in the continuous-time population limit even when the model is imperfect, and approximate these dynamics using sequential Monte Carlo with variance-controlling guidance. To remove the endpoint mismatch, we use the pretrained energy as a surrogate along the diffusion path and progressively incorporate the discrepancy between the learned and target terminal energies. Experiments on Gaussian mixture models, particle systems, alanine dipeptide, and alanine tetrapeptide show that our method closely matches target distributions and molecular free-energy profiles under annealing and reward tilting, whereas standard inference-time scaling baselines retain substantial sampling errors.

</details>


### [237] [Wasserstein Gradient Flows and Forward-Only Diffusion Are Not Enough for Multimodal Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02081)
*Daniel McBride,Pratik Khandagale,Cristina Garcia-Cardona,Yen Ting Lin*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文指出，基于 Wasserstein 梯度流（WGF）与仅正向扩散过程（FODP）的采样算法，其所谓"指数级快速收敛"的保证具有误导性：它们与过阻尼正向扩散共享相同的密度演化，因而继承亚稳态与慢混合特性，在分离良好的多峰分布上需要指数级长的混合时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大量 WGF 与 FODP 采样算法声称具有指数级快速收敛的理论保证，并被解读为能高效采样复杂多峰分布。作者认为这一解读存在根本性误导，需要澄清这类方法的真实动力学局限。

Method: 运用 Jordan-Kinderlehrer-Otto (JKO) 格式与 Otto 变分理论，证明标准 WGF 采样动力学与过阻尼正向扩散具有相同的密度演化；再结合谱分析与平均首次通过时间（MFPT）两种互补工具进行分析；并对常见的对数线性退火调度开展研究。

Result: 分离良好的多峰性会引发与谱间隙小、模式间转移罕见相对应的指数级长混合时间。对对数线性退火调度，引入中间分布并不能消除总传输时间的指数级标度。该局限是结构性的，源于纯局部、梯度驱动的传输机制。

Conclusion: 这是标准形式下 WGF 与 FODP 采样的根本性局限，未来应发展本质非局部的机制以实现高效多峰采样。

Abstract: There has been a proliferation of sampling algorithms based on Wasserstein gradient flows (WGF) and forward-only diffusion processes (FODP), often accompanied by theoretical guarantees of exponentially fast convergence to the target distribution. These guarantees are frequently interpreted as evidence that such methods can efficiently sample complex multimodal distributions, often supported by empirical results. In this work, we argue that this interpretation is fundamentally misleading. By invoking the Jordan-Kinderlehrer-Otto (JKO) scheme and Otto calculus, we establish that the canonical WGF sampling dynamics and overdamped forward diffusion share the same density evolution and therefore inherit the same metastability and slow-mixing phenomena long understood in nonequilibrium statistical physics. We analyze this family of samplers using two complementary tools -- spectral analysis and mean first-passage time (MFPT) analysis -- and show that well-separated multimodality can induce exponentially long mixing times associated with small spectral gaps and rare inter-mode transitions. For the commonly adopted log-linear annealing schedule studied here, we find that introducing intermediate distributions does not remove the exponential scaling of the total transport time. The limitation is structural rather than implementation-specific: purely local, gradient-driven transport mechanisms can require exponentially long times to transport probability mass across well-separated modes. We argue that this represents a fundamental limitation of WGF- and FODP-based sampling in their standard forms, and motivates future development of fundamentally nonlocal mechanisms for efficient multimodal sampling.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [238] [Heavy-Tailed Memory Traces in Long-Horizon Language Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00010)
*Xinyuan Song,Zekun Cai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文研究长程语言智能体中外部记忆的分布形状：在有限上下文与重复检索下，记忆呈现“核心-长尾”结构。作者提出核心-尾世界模型（CTWM），用单一指数 τ 分配提示预算并保留摘要化尾部，在多个基准上实现 token 节省且保持准确率，表明重尾记忆痕迹既是诊断信号也是实用的控制信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有外部记忆系统通常只以任务成功率或 token 成本来评判，忽略了记忆使用的“形状”。作者认为在有限上下文和重复检索条件下，智能体记忆会集中在少数核心状态，而罕见状态落入长尾，预测误差在长尾处累积。因此需要审计并利用这种核心-长尾分布。

Method: 首先进行保守尾审计，对比随机游走智能体与语义 LLM 策略产生的检索痕迹分布（对数正态 vs 截断幂律）；随后提出 Core-Tail World Model（CTWM），一种基于秩的记忆控制器，用单一指数 τ 分配提示预算，并对尾部状态进行摘要化保留。在 Synthetic Graph World、ALFWorld 和 LongMemEval 上与图记忆基线做配对对比。

Result: 审计显示集中现象可复现但依赖策略：随机游走产生对数正态兼容的痕迹，语义 LLM 策略产生最强的截断幂律兼容核心-尾痕迹。CTWM 在 Synthetic Graph World 上保持完整的州与转移覆盖，提示 token 减少 5.9%，下半部分尾部预测误差降低 13.6%；在 ALFWorld 上获得一致的 token 节省，在 LongMemEval 上 token 减少 24.48% 且总体准确率持平。

Conclusion: 重尾记忆痕迹不仅是有限检索的诊断特征，还可作为 token 高效智能体世界模型的实用控制信号。CTWM 通过秩基预算分配与尾部摘要，在保持覆盖率与准确率的同时显著降低 token 成本。

Abstract: Long-horizon language agents increasingly rely on external memory as a frozen world model, yet current memory systems are usually judged only by task success or token cost. We argue that the missing object is the shape of memory use: under finite context and repeated retrieval, agent memory can concentrate on a small core while leaving rare states in a long tail where prediction errors accumulate. We study this effect through a conservative tail audit and find that concentration is reproducible but policy-dependent. Random-walk agents produce log-normal-compatible retrieval artifacts, whereas semantic LLM policies yield the strongest truncated-power-law-compatible core--tail traces. Motivated by this audit, we propose Core--Tail World Model (CTWM), a rank-based memory controller that allocates prompt budget with a single exponent $τ$ while retaining a summarized tail. On Synthetic Graph World, CTWM preserves full state and transition coverage, reduces prompt tokens by 5.9%, and lowers bottom-half tail prediction error by 13.6% relative to a graph-memory baseline. The same paired comparison gives consistent token savings on ALFWorld and a 24.48% token reduction on LongMemEval with aggregate accuracy parity. These results suggest that heavy-tailed memory traces are not only a diagnostic of finite retrieval, but also a practical control signal for token-efficient agent world models.

</details>


### [239] [When Do Causal World Models Help Modular LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00012)
*Xinyuan Song,Zekun Cai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 FedCausalCompose，一个面向模块化 LLM 智能体的因果世界模型框架，指出观测型世界模型在存在未阻断后门路径时存在不可消除的干预误差，并揭示因果接口在智能体中的有效性取决于接口的统计可识别性与可被智能体在行动时利用的呈现形式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模块化 LLM 智能体通过多个服务模块（如订单、支付、库存、发货）行动，一个模块的动作会改变另一模块的有效转移，但标准世界模型只拟合观测轨迹，无法识别支付授权发货、库存中介效应或隐藏触发器解释二者的因果结构，这一观测与干预之间的缺口构成核心动机。

Method: 提出 FedCausalCompose 因果世界模型框架，利用本地动作提供跨模块接口的干预-响应证据；先证明观测世界模型在未阻断后门路径下产生不可约的干预误差、接口恢复随干预-响应覆盖度提升、Oracle 因果组合在控制覆盖度和局部机制误差时可超越非因果下界，随后在诊断性智能体设置中实证验证。

Result: 因果接口在结构化工具环境中收益最大（API 签名暴露前置条件与下游效应）；对话与叙事环境中智能体常忽略原始边列表，除非提供简短注意锚点使因果信息在决策时相关。

Conclusion: 为因果世界模型在 LLM 智能体中的应用确定了具体条件：因果结构只有在跨模块接口既统计可识别、又以智能体行动时可利用的形式呈现时才真正有帮助。

Abstract: LLM agents increasingly act through modular systems, such as order, payment, inventory, and shipment services, where actions in one module change which transitions are valid in another. Standard world models usually fit observational traces, but this is not the quantity needed for intervention-time planning: a trace may show that payment precedes shipment without identifying whether payment authorizes shipment, inventory mediates the effect, or a hidden trigger explains both. We study this gap through FedCausalCompose, a causal world-model framework for modular LLM agents in which local actions provide intervention-response evidence for cross-module interfaces. We first show that observational world models incur an irreducible interventional error under unblocked back-door paths, that interface recovery improves with intervention-response coverage, and that an oracle causal composition can beat the non-causal lower bound when coverage and local mechanism errors are controlled. We then test the resulting prediction in diagnostic agent settings. Causal interfaces help most in structured tool environments, where API signatures expose preconditions and downstream effects. In contrast, dialogue and narrative environments often ignore raw edge lists unless a short attention anchor makes the causal information decision-relevant. These results identify a concrete condition for causal world models in LLM agents: causal structure helps when cross-module interfaces are both statistically identifiable and presented in a form the agent can use at action time.

</details>


### [240] [From Proposal to Verified Effect: Praxa, an Evidence-Bound Harness for Governed AI Agent Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00015)
*Stefan G. Creadore*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Praxa，一种显式分离大语言模型智能体"提议—授权—派发—经验证的外部效果—服务推广"五阶段主张的智能体框架，并通过四条证据通道进行验证；但证据有限，尚不能证明其在生产中的安全性与用户收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型智能体能够提出并执行动作，但"提议、授权、派发、经过验证的外部效果、服务推广"是不同性质的声明，现有系统往往混淆这些边界。作者希望构建一个能显式区分这些状态、从而让"从授权到实际效果"的转换变得可检验、可问责的架构。

Method: 提出 Praxa 智能体载体（harness），通过确定性准入（deterministic admission）、代理执行（brokered execution）、外部回读（external read-back）、对账（reconciliation）和评审后推广（reviewed promotion）五个机制，显式表示上述状态转移。并设计了四类证据通道：①仓库本地审计（固定版本下的单元测试、Workerd 测试、文件插桩、覆盖率下限）；②提供商支持的 Terminal-Bench Core 0.1.1 试点（基线臂 vs 可靠性层臂）；③双序协调代理开发对比（基线 vs 源码作者候选实现）；④部署中的源码/配置证据（反射、召回记账、内存编译、工具健康路径）。

Result: 证据一：作者运行的仓库本地审计在固定版本下通过 1,027/1,027 单元测试和 89/89 Workerd 测试，插桩了全部 363 个预期源文件且满足四项覆盖率下限；但缺少原始逐测试记录与独立复现。证据二：12 个精选任务的 Terminal-Bench 试点中，基线与可靠性层臂各通过 17/36 严格试验，可靠性层多消耗 37.49% 输入 token、50.73% 输出 token，试点不支持其优越性。证据三：调试后双序对比中，基线与候选均完成 180/180 试验、测量精度相同、完全封闭崩溃恢复、零受保护违规；候选少用 37.11% token、端点成本估算低 33.84%、步骤少 11.63%，但这不能证明质量、延迟或生产行为的改善。证据四：部署证据显示有界反射、召回记账、内存编译与工具健康路径，但无生产结果提升。

Conclusion: Praxa 的核心贡献是一个"证据受限的架构"，使从授权到实际效果的转换显式化、可测试。但现有证据并不能证明对抗性安全、生产安全性、通用专家优势、自主递归优化或用户收益。

Abstract: Large-language-model agents can propose and execute actions, but proposal, authority, dispatch, verified external effect, and serving promotion are different claims. We present Praxa, an agent harness that represents these states explicitly through deterministic admission, brokered execution, external read-back, reconciliation, and reviewed promotion. We report four evidence lanes. First, an author-run repository-local audit at a pinned revision passed 1,027/1,027 unit tests and 89/89 Workerd tests, instrumented all 363 expected source files, and met four coverage floors; raw per-test transcripts and independent reproduction are unavailable. Second, in a provider-backed Terminal-Bench Core 0.1.1 pilot across 12 curated tasks, baseline and reliability-layer arms each passed 17/36 strict trials. The reliability layer used 37.49% more input and 50.73% more output tokens, so the pilot does not support superiority. Third, in a post-debug, two-order coordination-proxy development comparison, baseline and a source-authored candidate each completed 180/180 trials with equal measured accuracy, full hermetic crash recovery, and zero protected violations. The candidate used 37.11% fewer tokens, 33.84% lower estimated endpoint cost, and 11.63% fewer steps; this does not establish improved quality, latency, or production behavior. Fourth, deployed source/configuration evidence shows bounded reflection, recall accounting, memory compilation, and tool-health paths, but no production outcome lift. Praxa's supported contribution is an evidence-bound architecture that makes authority-to-effect transitions explicit and testable. Current evidence does not establish adversarial security, production safety, general specialist superiority, autonomous recursive optimization, or user benefit.

</details>


### [241] [What Do Rationales Communicate? A Message-Intervention Study in Role-Specialized QA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00018)
*Jiameng Zhang,Hongqiu Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种"消息干预"诊断方法，固定证据与候选答案、仅改变reasoner传给verifier的rationale，发现忠实的rationale对最终答案准确率几乎没有增益，而损坏的rationale会强烈改变verifier的支持判断（尤其在显式检查提示下），但最终答案变化较小，且存在大量"损坏过度信任"（corruption-overtrust）问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 角色分工的QA流水线日益普遍地将rationale从reasoner传给verifier，但这一消息传递究竟带来了什么尚不清楚：是更准的答案、更强的支持度评估，还是新的失败面。作者希望厘清rationale共享的真实价值与潜在风险。

Method: 提出消息干预（message-intervention）诊断：固定证据和候选答案，只改变跨reasoner—verifier边界传递的rationale。在MuSiQue、HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA共400个样本上，以DeepSeek为生成器和验证器，比较无rationale、忠实rationale、无害改写rationale与损坏rationale的影响；并加入盲验证提示与显式rationale检查提示两种条件，辅以跨模型、跨任务边界检查及人工审计。

Result: 忠实rationale相比无rationale几乎不提升答案准确率；损坏rationale强烈改变支持判断。盲验证提示下，无害改写只使支持判断偏移0–2.5%，损坏rationale偏移10–22%；显式rationale检查提示将这一模式放大到34–55%。最终答案变化较小（2–30%），仅2.9–35.3%的损坏支持翻转伴随答案改变。人工审计发现16/42个有效损坏案例属于"损坏过度信任"（corruption-overtrust），盲态人类对模型接受的损坏rationale中9/10持拒绝或不确定态度。跨模型与任务边界检查显示该通道有时活跃、放大、惰性，或被折叠进任务标签。

Conclusion: rationale共享应作为一种"验证消息机制"来评估，而不仅仅是提升答案准确率的途径；其对支持度评估的影响显著且存在被损坏rationale操纵的失败面，值得警惕。

Abstract: Role-specialized QA pipelines increasingly pass rationales from a reasoner to a verifier, but it is unclear what this message actually buys: better answers, stronger support assessment, or a new failure surface. We introduce a message-intervention diagnostic that fixes the evidence and candidate answer while varying only the rationale passed across the reasoner-to-verifier boundary. On 400 MuSiQue, HotpotQA, and 2WikiMultiHopQA examples with DeepSeek as generator and verifier, faithful rationales add almost no answer accuracy over no rationale, while corrupted rationales strongly alter support judgments. Under a blind verifier prompt, harmless paraphrases shift support by only 0--2.5%, whereas corrupted rationales shift support by 10--22%; an explicit rationale-checking prompt amplifies the same pattern to 34--55%. Final answers move less (2--30%), and only 2.9--35.3% of corrupted support flips co-occur with answer changes. Human audits show why this matters: 16/42 valid corruptions are corruption-overtrust cases, and blind humans reject or mark unclear 9/10 audited corrupted rationales that the model accepts. Cross-model and task-boundary checks show when the channel is active, amplified, inert, or folded into the task label. Rationale sharing should be evaluated as a verification-message mechanism, not merely as a route to higher answer accuracy.

</details>


### [242] [Measuring the Microtask Eligibility Gap: When Is an Off-the-Shelf SLM Enough for an Agent Harness?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00025)
*Jundong Hu,Shekar Ramachandran*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文构建了一个由4个围绕LLM规划器的微任务组成的基准，检验现成小语言模型（SLM）是否能达到预设阈值。结果显示16个配置（4任务×4模型）全部不合格；通过logprob决策阈值诊断将失败分为能力不足与可调解码阈值两类；4-bit量化（RTN/GPTQ/AWQ）造成与模型规模相关的损伤，但未使任何配置合格，且结果在Llama-3.x及不同锚点、提示措辞上稳健。实用启示：将SLM置于满足置信区间阈值的基线之后，仅在基线不合格处使用SLM（如BM25之上的4B重排序器）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体框架越来越希望在围绕前沿LLM规划器的微任务上运行SLM（自动审批shell命令、写记忆、选工具、排序历史轮次）。作者想探究：现成SLM能否达到从业者定义的阈值；若失败，原因是什么；以及量化是否会改变结论。

Method: 构建4个微任务的基准，使用固定提示和自动度量，每个任务预设阈值τ，锚定在一个廉价的非LLM基线上，并采用置信区间感知的合格规则（仅当置信界超过τ时配置才算通过）。在Qwen3 0.6/1.7/4/8B最优设置下（FP16、贪心解码、单一冻结提示、无微调）扫描。用logprob决策阈值诊断（T1/T3/T4，T2通过上下文长度/级联探针）分离能力缺陷与可调阈值失败；对4-bit量化（RTN/GPTQ/AWQ）检验损伤。

Result: 16个配置（4任务×4模型）中0个合格，经原始输出和解析器行为验证。logprob诊断将失败分为能力缺陷和可通过调整解码阈值解决的失败（4种机制）。量化造成的损伤取决于模型规模，且未使任何配置变为合格（在可重建的硬标签任务T1/T3上认证，在T2/T4上用诊断/窗口鲁棒性验证），说明差距更多取决于模型规模而非精度。结果在Llama-3.x上复现（12/12不合格），并对锚点选择（τ扫描）和提示措辞稳健（原始加上每单元3个中性改述，共0/112合格）。

Conclusion: 实用启示是：将SLM放在满足置信区间阈值的基线之后，仅在基线无法达到阈值处使用SLM——例如，在BM25短名单之上的4B重排序器优于BM25（+0.047 [0.020, 0.073]），但自身并不满足合格认证。

Abstract: Agent harnesses increasingly want to run small language models (SLMs) on the microtasks around a frontier large language model (LLM) planner: auto-approving shell commands, writing memory, selecting tools, ranking past turns. We ask whether off-the-shelf SLMs meet practitioner-defined thresholds and, when they fail, why, and whether quantization changes the answer. We build a benchmark of 4 such microtasks with fixed prompts and automatic metrics, each with a pre-specified threshold $τ$ anchored to a cheap non-LLM baseline and a CI-aware eligibility rule (a configuration passes only if its confidence bound clears $τ$). Sweeping Qwen3 0.6/1.7/4/8B at their best (FP16, greedy, one frozen prompt, no tuning), we find an eligibility gap: 0 of 16 (4 tasks $\times$ 4 models) configurations pass (verified by checking the raw outputs and parser behavior). A logprob decision-threshold diagnostic (T1/T3/T4; T2 via a context-length/cascade probe) separates the failures into capability deficits and failures that can be addressed by changing the decoding threshold (4 regimes). Quantization to 4-bit (RTN/GPTQ/AWQ) does damage that depends on model size and moves no configuration into eligibility (certified on the reconstructable hard-label tasks T1/T3, diagnostic/windowed robustness on T2/T4), so the gap tracks model size more than precision; it replicates on Llama-3.x (12/12 ineligible) and is robust to the anchor choice (a $τ$-sweep) and to prompt wording (0/112 eligible across the original plus 3 neutral paraphrases per cell). The practical implication: place SLMs behind a baseline that meets the CI-backed threshold, and use the SLM only where the baseline fails to meet the threshold; e.g. a 4B re-ranker over a BM25 shortlist beats BM25 ($+0.047$ [0.020, 0.073], without itself certifying eligibility).

</details>


### [243] [Characterizing a Configuration Where Inference-Time PRM-Pruned Fragment Grafting Is Inert: Evidence from Three Reasoning LMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00047)
*Khawaja Murad ul Hassan,Mehran Ebrahimi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文隔离并测试了"PRM剪枝片段嫁接"(PPFG)这一最小成本的跨轨迹步骤级迁移机制,发现其在完整MATH500上与独立并行思维链基线在统计上无差别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 并行思维链中"多样性坍缩"促使研究者采用推理时干预:当过程奖励模型(PRM)剪枝一条推理链时,提取其高PRM前缀并作为上下文示范嫁接到仍在解码的兄弟链上。此前片段嫁接工作仅在附加补偿成分下才报告收益,本文旨在最严格的成本最小化操作点上检验该机制本身的因果效力。

Method: 在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct + Math-Shepherd、完整MATH500(n=500,三个随机种子)上测试PPFG的停滞触发(stagnation-targeting)与随机触发(random-targeting)两种变体,以独立并行CoT为基线。通过322个停滞规则注入事件的四桶分类表征失效原因;进行复合门细化扫描、随机对照、跨三基座模型/六基准/第二PRM的复现、双单侧检验(TOST)等价性分析、逐事件抽查、幸存兄弟反事实估计与事后oracle上界分析。

Result: PPFG在所有可测轴向上与独立并行CoT基线统计不可区分。四桶分类显示仅14%的注入事件真正瞄准了挣扎中的链,其余落在已成功、接近完成或处于PRM平顶的链上(这些状态救援嫁接无法改变)。任何复合门细化都无法同时实现良好瞄准与充分密度;随机对照以2.4倍触发率达到相同等价,表明惰性并非启发式特有。结果在三个基座LLM、六个基准、第二个PRM及兼容门扫描中均复现;TOST分析在全部12个Qwen/LLaMA单元上将等价性提升为正向等价。逐事件抽查发现被注入链以2.75倍于匹配步的速率被剪枝,但幸存兄弟反事实未发现群体级补偿。事后oracle将选择PPFG优于独立基线的每问题潜在收益上界限制在+0.13个百分点。

Conclusion: PPFG作为最成本最小化的跨轨迹步骤级迁移操作化形式,在其测试的操作点上对并行CoT是惰性的、无群体级增益且不能与基线区分。本文贡献了一套用于确立推理时机制"零效应"的等价性检验模板,并将所有结论严格限定于所测试的操作点范围。

Abstract: Diversity collapse in parallel chain-of-thought has motivated inference-time interventions built on a natural design: when a process reward model (PRM) prunes a chain, its high-PRM prefix is extracted and grafted verbatim as an in-context demonstration into a still-decoding sibling. We isolate this mechanism, PRM-Pruned Fragment Grafting (PPFG), as the most cost-minimal operationalization of cross-trajectory step-level transfer, and test it at the operating point where prior fragment-grafting work reports gains only under additional compensating ingredients. On Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct with Math-Shepherd on full MATH500 (n=500, three seeds), PPFG in both stagnation- and random-targeting variants is statistically indistinguishable from an independent parallel-CoT baseline on every measured axis. We characterize why: a four-bucket classification of 322 stagnation-rule injection events shows only 14% targeted a genuinely struggling chain; the rest landed on chains that had already succeeded, were near completion, or sat on a flat PRM plateau, states a rescue graft cannot change. No compound-gate refinement jointly achieves well-targeted firing and adequate density, and a random control matches the same parity at 2.4x the firing rate, so the inertness is not heuristic-specific. The finding replicates across three base LMs, six benchmarks, a second PRM, and a compatibility-gate sweep; two-one-sided-tests analysis promotes the parity to positive equivalence on all twelve Qwen/LLaMA cells. A per-event spot-check finds injected chains prune at 2.75x the matched-step rate, but a surviving-sibling counterfactual finds no population-level compensation. A hindsight oracle bounds any per-problem gain from choosing PPFG over independent at +0.13 pp. We contribute an equivalence-testing template for establishing inference-time mechanism nulls, with every claim scoped to its tested operating point.

</details>


### [244] [Gradient-Aligned Pair Selection for Personalized Preference Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00061)
*Ruoming Jin,Xinyu Li,Hao Zhou,Jianfeng Zhu,Ruixin Guo,Feodor Dragan,Lei Xu,Haixun Wang,Yang Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 GAP-DPO，将个性化偏好学习形式化为几何对齐的优化问题，指出偏好对的选择（而非启发式预处理）是决定 DPO 是否推进个性化的几何决策，并通过实验验证其优于标准 DPO 变体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个性化 LLM 需要对齐用户特定偏好，但现有 DPO 方法依赖似然极值等启发式准则选择偏好对，使优化与显式用户效用解耦，可能导致个性化效果退化。作者希望从优化几何角度重新审视偏好对选择，建立统一原则。

Method: 作者将个性化偏好学习形式化为几何对齐优化问题，分析期望用户效用梯度与 DPO 更新方向之间的一阶交互，揭示在离策略采样下，当偏好边际与效用梯度方向对齐时，DPO 更新由纯纠错信号转变为类强化更新。基于此提出 GAP-DPO，一种迭代算法，执行效用感知、几何对齐的偏好对选择，并通过逐轮重新生成控制分布偏移。

Result: 在个性化文本生成基准上，GAP-DPO 相较标准 DPO 变体一致提升了风格保真度、偏好对齐度和生成质量，验证了梯度对齐作为个性化偏好优化统一原则的有效性。

Conclusion: 研究确立了梯度对齐是统一个性化偏好优化的原则，并证明偏好对选择是优化几何的内在组成部分，而非启发式预处理步骤。

Abstract: Personalizing large language models (LLMs) requires aligning generation behavior with user-specific preferences rather than aggregate quality. While Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) provides a stable framework for preference learning, its effectiveness in personalized settings critically depends on how preference pairs are selected. Existing approaches typically rely on heuristic criteria, such as likelihood-based extremes, which decouple optimization from explicit user utility and can lead to degraded personalization. We formalize personalized preference learning as a geometry-aligned optimization problem by analyzing the first-order interaction between gradients of expected user utility and DPO update directions. Our analysis reveals that, under off-policy sampling, the DPO update transitions from a purely error-corrective signal to a reinforcement-like update when preference margins are directionally aligned with utility gradients. This perspective exposes pair selection as a geometric decision that governs whether preference optimization advances or hinders personalization. Motivated by this insight, we propose GAP-DPO (Geometry-Aligned Preference DPO), an iterative algorithm that performs utility-aware, geometry-aligned pair selection while controlling distribution shift via epoch-wise regeneration. Experiments on personalized text generation benchmarks show that GAP-DPO consistently improves stylistic fidelity, preference alignment, and generation quality compared to standard DPO variants. Together, our results establish gradient alignment as a unifying principle for personalized preference optimization and demonstrate that pair selection is an intrinsic component of the optimization geometry rather than a heuristic preprocessing step.

</details>


### [245] [K-Dense BYOK: An Open-Source AI Research Assistant That Runs Locally and Keeps a Hash-Chained Lab Notebook](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00074)
*Aubrey M. Brueckner,Darshil Patel,Yuhuan He,Timothy Kassis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: K-Dense BYOK 是一个免费开源、运行在研究者自己电脑上的 AI 科研助手，通过把工作记录为不可篡改的"观察到的事实"并附带可复现的环境记录，在 20 个跨学科任务上超越了托管平台。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决通用聊天助手/编码代理在科研中的关键缺陷：模型"过度声称"（overclaiming）以及结果难以核查与复现。此前对九个前沿模型的基准测试显示，过度声称是最常见失败，因此目标不是禁止模型声称，而是让声称为"可核查"。

Method: K-Dense BYOK 采用"自带密钥（BYOK）"方式，研究者自选模型（托管或本地），应用提供运行环境、科研脚手架和完整记录。每项目为普通文件夹，数据/代码/结果/记录归研究者管理。核心机制包括：(1) 内置科学流程库、引导式工作流模板、研究数据目录，以及可将工作转交的"审稿人/写作者"角色；(2) Living Lab Notebook（活实验记录本），条目只增不删并链入论证；(3) 通过"观察代理行为"而非"采信代理自述"来记录事件，写进代理没有工具可写的日志。软件环境记录目前仍由代理以文件形式写出，尚未纳入观察日志。

Result: 在 20 个跨学科研究提示词、预先固定的评分标准下，K-Dense BYOK 在科学质量和研究执行两方面均领先两个托管平台。其交付物是唯一记录了所运行软件环境的，也是唯一通常附带可重新生成结果的命令的；使用同一前沿模型的托管平台两者都未提供。

Conclusion: 通过"记录实际发生的事"而非仅依赖模型自述，并保留可复现的软件环境记录，K-Dense BYOK 有效缓解了模型过度声称问题并提升了科研可复现性。代码以 MIT 协议开源，未来可进一步将软件环境本身纳入观察日志。

Abstract: K-Dense BYOK (bring your own keys) is a free, open-source AI research assistant for scientists in any field that runs on the researcher's own computer. The researcher supplies access to a model of their choice, hosted or running locally, and the application supplies everything else: a place for the work to run, a layer of scientific scaffolding, and a complete record. Each project is an ordinary folder, so the data, the code, the results, and the record stay on a machine the researcher administers and can be read years later without the application. Three things separate it from a chat assistant or a general-purpose coding agent. It ships a library of written scientific procedures, guided workflow templates, catalogs of where research data can be found, and reviewer and writer roles the agent can hand work to. It keeps a Living Lab Notebook whose entries link into an argument and are added to but never erased. And it records what happened by watching what the agent does rather than by taking the agent's word for it, in a log the agent has no tool that can write to. That choice targets the most common failure, model overclaiming, in our earlier benchmark of nine frontier models, by making claims checkable rather than preventing them. On twenty interdisciplinary research prompts, scored under a rubric fixed in advance, K-Dense BYOK led two managed platforms on both scientific quality and research execution. Its deliverables were the only ones that recorded the software they ran in, and the only ones that usually arrived with a command that regenerates the results. One of the managed platforms ran the same frontier model and supplied neither. Those environment records were files the agent wrote, not part of the observed log, which does not yet capture the software environment itself. The code is available under the MIT license at https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/k-dense-byok.

</details>


### [246] [Scientific Agents: Evaluating Profession-Specific System Prompts on Scientific Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00084)
*Timothy Kassis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究表明,详细的专业特定系统提示会显著增加 token 消耗和成本,却未能带来一致的准确率提升,建议当前模型和任务下不应默认加载完整职业配置文件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着 AGENTS.md 等职业特定系统提示配置文件的流行,人们普遍假设更详细、更专业的系统提示能提升模型在特定领域的表现,但这一假设缺乏大规模实证检验,且未考虑其带来的 token 和成本负担。

Method: 作者构建了 Scientific Agents 语料库(503 个专业特定 AGENTS.md 配置文件),使用 Gemini 3.8 Flash 通过 OpenRouter 在 Pi agent 框架中进行评估。将匹配的配置文件与四个对照条件比较:极简基线("You are a helpful assistant")、配置文件的开头角色句、通用科学严谨指南、以及不相关领域的配置文件。在 9 个基于文本的科学基准(4,531 个抽样问题、100 个匹配配置文件)上进行测试,4,488 个条目在 API 错误重试后完成了全部五个条件,并使用自动化规则评分。另在 60 个工具型 BioMysteryBench 生物信息学问题上进行了三组基线/配置文件对比实验。

Result: 配置文件与基线的平均准确率差异为 -0.6 个百分点(95% bootstrap 区间 [-1.5, +0.2]),没有任何基准显示出统计上明确的改进。匹配配置文件的输出 token 是基线的 1.5-2.3 倍,每次成功调用的成本是基线的 2.2-4.5 倍。在 BioMysteryBench 上,配置文件平均解决率为 46.7%,基线为 56.7%,差异 -10.0 个百分点(95% 区间 [-16.7, -3.3]),主要因配置文件下更频繁触发 token 和时间限制停止。一个例外是:在 SuperGPQA 上,提供商 API 频繁掉线导致短基线只有 54.0% 的条目有正确首通答案,而配置文件为 71.6%;但通用和不匹配提示同样可靠,说明这一优势来自提示长度或格式而非领域专长。

Conclusion: 对于所测试的模型和任务,默认加载完整职业配置文件并不能提高准确率,反而大幅增加成本;选择性检索配置文件相关片段或开放式科学任务是否会改变这一结论,仍有待进一步测试。

Abstract: Detailed profession-specific system prompts raise token use and estimated cost per response without a consistent accuracy gain. We evaluate Scientific Agents, an open-source corpus of 503 profession-specific AGENTS.md profiles, with Gemini 3.8 Flash via OpenRouter in the Pi agent harness. We compare matched profiles with four controls: a minimal baseline ("You are a helpful assistant"), the profile's opening role sentence, a generic scientific rigor guide, and a profile from an unrelated domain. Across nine text-based science benchmarks (4,531 sampled questions, 100 matched profiles), 4,488 items completed all five conditions after API-error retries, scored with automated, rule-based grading. The average profile-baseline accuracy difference is -0.6 percentage points (95% bootstrap interval [-1.5, +0.2] across fixed tasks), and no benchmark shows a statistically clear improvement. Matched profiles produced 1.5-2.3 times as many output tokens and cost 2.2-4.5 times more per successful call. On 60 tool-using BioMysteryBench bioinformatics problems (three runs each for baseline and profile), mean solve rates were 46.7% with the profile and 56.7% at baseline, a difference of -10.0 percentage points (95% interval [-16.7, -3.3]) driven by more frequent token- and time-limit stops under the profile. Longer prompts had one unexpected operational advantage: on SuperGPQA, frequent provider API drops left the short baseline with a correct first-pass answer on only 54.0% of items, against 71.6% with the profile. Generic and mismatched prompts were about as reliable, so this gain comes from prompt length or formatting rather than domain expertise. For the tested model and tasks, loading full profession profiles by default does not improve accuracy and costs considerably more; whether selective retrieval of profile sections or open-ended scientific tasks would change this remains to be tested.

</details>


### [247] [Comedic Fool's Gold: Reward Exploits and Countermeasures in Conversational Humor](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00197)
*Sam Larson*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究对话幽默任务中自动化奖励设计，发现基于嵌入的惊喜奖励与观众笑声模型两类奖励均存在可被利用的捷径，并通过逐步修订奖励进行强化学习训练，最终虽提升综合评分但幽默专项改进未达预期目标，揭示了奖励设计中"防漏洞"与"保意图"之间的普遍困境。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化奖励设计在语言模型幽默生成中面临核心挑战：奖励容易被模型利用捷径（reward hacking）获得虚高分数，而简单的反制措施又可能误伤真正符合意图的行为。作者旨在系统性地研究这些漏洞及其反制措施的权衡。

Method: 作者设计了两种自动化奖励：(1) 基于嵌入的"可理解惊喜"（understandable surprise）奖励，并加入流畅度过滤器作为反制；(2) 预测观众被逗笑的"观众模型"奖励。通过受控测试检验这些奖励对词序打乱回复、笑声线索等攻击的鲁棒性，再对观众模型奖励引入跨说话者笑声线索归一化处理。最后进行三次强化学习训练，逐轮修订奖励。

Result: 受控测试显示，基于嵌入的惊喜奖励对词序打乱的回复与机智回复的接受度相同；加入流畅度过滤器虽能识别打乱回复，但组合奖励也会误拒部分机智回复且未通过进一步验证。观众模型的预测笑声易受任一说话者消息中笑声线索的影响，跨说话者归一化能阻断已覆盖的攻击，但未匹配的表达仍可被利用。三次强化学习中，最终一次将综合评估分数提升0.0903，零分会话减少40%，但幽默专项改进未达到预注册（preregistered）目标。

Conclusion: 该研究揭示了自动化奖励设计中的普遍挑战：反制措施必须在阻断可被利用的捷径的同时，保留奖励本意鼓励的行为。仅在指标上提升并不等于真正实现了幽默能力的改进，奖励工程需要更审慎的设计与验证。

Abstract: We investigate automated rewards for training language models in conversational humor, focusing on reward exploits and countermeasures. Two approaches aim to capture understandable surprise and predicted audience amusement. Controlled tests show that an embedding-based surprise reward accepts word-shuffled replies as readily as witty ones. A fluency filter detects the shuffles, but the combined reward also rejects some witty replies and fails further validation. An audience model's predicted laughter is instead vulnerable to laughter cues in either speaker's messages. Normalizing these cues across speakers blocks the covered attacks, although unmatched expressions remain exploitable. Three reinforcement-learning runs evaluate training with successive reward revisions. The final run improves the combined evaluation score by 0.0903 and reduces zero-score sessions by 40%, but its humor-specific improvement remains below our preregistered target. These findings illustrate a broader challenge for automated reward design: countermeasures must block exploitable shortcuts while preserving the behavior the reward was intended to encourage.

</details>


### [248] [EviGraph: Proof-Carrying Selective Recommendation over Temporal Public-Service Knowledge Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00212)
*Yixi Zhou,Sikun Wang,Lei Fan,Fan Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 EviGraph，用于公共服务推荐中区分关键决策需求与可留待未决的信息，通过语言智能体将需求与时间知识图谱中的证据相连接，并用确定性检查器判断推荐是否得到支持，从而减少不必要的弃权。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公共服务推荐需要与服务范围、日期等相匹配的证据，但若把所有缺失细节都视为决定性因素，会不必要地拒绝本可提供的推荐。需要一种方法来区分哪些信息是决策所必需的，哪些可以保持未决。

Method: 提出 EviGraph 框架：由语言智能体将关键决策需求与时间知识图谱中的证据相关联，再由确定性检查器（deterministic checker）判定推荐是否得到支持；核心是区分关键决策要求与可未决信息，而非单纯追加验证。

Result: 在双语香港公共服务基准（含可执行的策略引用）上的评估表明，这种区分显著减少了不必要的弃权；但额外验证反而会撤回本已得到支持的推荐，且未提升决策质量。

Conclusion: 可靠的循证导航取决于明确界定一个决策必须确立哪些条件，而不是简单地增加更多验证环节。

Abstract: Public-service recommendations require evidence that matches the requested service, scope, and date. Yet treating every missing detail as decisive can withhold useful recommendations. We introduce EviGraph, which distinguishes critical decision requirements from information that can remain unresolved. A language agent links these requirements to evidence in a temporal knowledge graph, while a deterministic checker establishes whether a recommendation is supported. Evaluation on a bilingual Hong Kong public-service benchmark with executable policy references shows that this distinction reduces unnecessary abstention. Additional verification, however, can withdraw supported recommendations without improving decision quality. These findings suggest that reliable evidence-based navigation depends on specifying what must be established for a decision, rather than simply adding more verification.

</details>


### [249] [Build2SPARQL: A Large-Scale Text-to-SPARQL Benchmark Dataset for Building Knowledge Graph Querying](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00224)
*Wooyoung Jung*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Build2SPARQL，一个面向楼宇自动化知识图谱的大规模 text-to-SPARQL 基准，通过由图谱遍历代码生成并验证 SPARQL、仅用大模型生成自然语言问题的管线，产出 6,136 条可执行查询与 30,680 个问题，并展示了检索增强可将模型准确率大幅提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 楼宇自动化系统越来越多地用 Brick、ASHRAE 223P 等本体表示为语义知识图谱，为 AI 应用提供了机器可读的基础。text-to-SPARQL 是其中极具前景的应用方向，能让楼宇运营者通过语言智能体查询图谱，但该领域进展受限于缺少大规模的自然语言/SPARQL 配对基准。

Method: 提出 KG-grounded（知识图谱锚定）的生成管线：SPARQL 查询完全由图遍历代码生成并验证，保证查询正确性不依赖模型行为；大语言模型仅负责生成自然语言问题。该管线挖掘六类查询模式（线性链、分支、UNION、聚合、OPTIONAL、属性过滤），并以五种词汇语域（vocabulary registers）为每个查询生成不同措辞。应用于 201 个楼宇知识图谱（180 个 Brick、21 个 ASHRAE 223P）。

Result: 产出 6,136 条可执行 SPARQL 查询和 30,680 个自然语言问题。对 300 个问题做双评分员人工验证，得到 98.8% 语义保真度、98.8% 自然度、84.0% 操作可行性。在三个开源权重语言模型上做检索增强评测，精确匹配准确率从零样本的 0.2–20% 提升至三样本检索的 56–65%。

Conclusion: Build2SPARQL 提供了一个大规模、查询正确性独立于模型行为的楼宇知识图谱 text-to-SPARQL 基准，有效缓解了数据稀缺问题；检索增强显著提升了开源模型的准确率，验证了该基准对推动楼宇图谱自然语言查询应用的实用价值。

Abstract: Building automation systems are increasingly represented as semantic knowledge graphs (KGs) using ontologies such as Brick and ASHRAE 223P, creating a machine-readable substrate for artificial-intelligence applications. One promising application is translating natural-language questions into SPARQL (text-to-SPARQL), which would let building operators query these graphs through language agents, but progress is limited by the scarcity of large natural-language/SPARQL benchmarks. This paper presents Build2SPARQL, a large-scale benchmark for building KGs generated by a KG-grounded pipeline: SPARQL queries are produced and validated entirely by graph-traversal code, while large language models generate only the natural-language questions, keeping query correctness independent of model behavior. The pipeline mines six query-pattern families -- linear chains, branching, UNION, aggregation, OPTIONAL, and attribute-filtered -- and phrases each query across five vocabulary registers. Applied to 201 building KGs (180 Brick, 21 ASHRAE 223P), it yields 6,136 executable SPARQL queries and 30,680 questions. A two-rater human validation of 300 questions found 98.8% semantic fidelity, 98.8% naturalness, and 84.0% operational plausibility. A retrieval-augmented evaluation across three open-weight language models raised exact-match accuracy from 0.2-20% (zero-shot) to 56-65% (three-shot retrieved).

</details>


### [250] [Robust Is Salient: An Informed Adversary Moves the Optimal Signal onto the Salience Pole](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00233)
*Cris Huynh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文引入一个知情对抗者到强制选择任务中，证明在受限信号信道下，最保护真相的信号恰是最精确描述真相的信号；对抗者鲁棒最优与先前研究中的“显著性极”在108个确认项上完全一致，且在20万项目中仅2748项不同（差异恰好源于显著性到贝叶斯坐标未定义处），显示鲁棒性由完全贝叶斯判别转向显著性，且这一重合构成一种结构性测量限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究知情对抗者共享受限信号信道时，何种信号能最有效地保护真相，并揭示该鲁棒最优解与既有“显著性”启发式目标之间是否存在可区分的差异，以及这种重合对经验评估带来的限制。

Method: 将“欺骗：香港谋杀案”抽象为强制选择任务，引入一个知道目标、观察信号、并用说服预算 β 为最强错误答案辩护的对抗者。分析随 β 增大信号从后验最大化选项迁移到边际最大化选项；β=0 时复现原 oracle 模型（听众温度 τ=1）。在108个确认项与20万项目池上与显著性极对照，并让七种语言模型在两种对抗者框架下作答，对照精确的零效应率。

Result: 对抗者鲁棒最优在108项上与显著性极完全对齐；20万项中仅2748项（1.374%）不同，且差异恰位于显著性到贝叶斯坐标未定义的区域。18.2%的项目池在有限预算下最优解发生迁移，且每项的临界预算是精确的。两种对抗者框架使七个语言模型在108项中30至77项改变所选选项，而精确零效应率表明无法判定这一移动是朝向对抗者感知最优还是朝向显著性，因为二者完全相同。

Conclusion: 对抗者鲁棒最优与显著性目标在可定义处完全相同，这并非零结果而是结构性限制：在评估对抗者感知之前，应先廉价地检验鲁棒目标是否与启发式目标在评估项上重合；若重合，则任何测量都无法区分二者。

Abstract: When an informed adversary shares the audience of a constrained signalling channel, the signal that best protects the truth is the signal that best describes it. On 108 confirmatory items, the adversary-robust optimum aligns exactly with the salience pole from prior work. Across a 200,000-item pool, the two differ on only 2,748 items --- lying exactly where the prior salience-to-Bayes coordinate is undefined. Where defined, robustness is achieved by moving from Bayesian discrimination entirely to salience. We show this by introducing an adversary to a forced-choice task (abstracted from Deception: Murder in Hong Kong). The adversary knows the target, observes the signal, and argues for the strongest wrong answer using a persuasion budget, $β$. As $β$ grows, the optimal signal shifts from the posterior-maximizing option to the margin-maximizing one; at $β= 0$, the game reproduces the original oracle model with a listener temperature of $τ= 1$. This effect is real: 18.2 percent of the pool has an optimum that shifts under a finite budget, and each item's critical budget is exact. This coincidence structurally limits empirical evaluation. Two adversary framings change the chosen option of seven language models on 30 to 77 of 108 items against an exact no-effect rate. Yet, no measurement can determine whether this movement is toward the adversary-aware optimum or toward salience, because the two options are identical. This is a structural limit, not a null result. The diagnostic check is cheap: before evaluating adversary-awareness, verify whether the robust target coincides with a heuristic target on the evaluation items.

</details>


### [251] [Conflicting Supervision Moves Commitment, Not Capability: A 12.29σ arrangement effect that is exactly zero under a convention-agnostic score](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00234)
*Wenhui Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究数据排列顺序（ordering）与学习率调度（lr scheduler）如何共同决定模型在两种互不兼容但均正确的书写约定（convention）之间最终"承诺"哪一种。核心发现：调度器扮演"平均算子"角色；常数学习率会在最后一步同时保留大步长与未收缩的残差，从而放大顺序效应；衰减型（cosine）调度则将其压制，使不同排列收敛到难以区分的状态。该论文将排列效应与调度效应分离为两个相乘因子（block period 与端点权重），并给出受控测量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前关于"数据顺序是否影响预训练"的报告多把观察当成背景条件，缺乏对机制与两个部件（排列 vs. 调度）分离的严格证明和受控测量。作者指出学习率调度不是背景，而是决定顺序效应大小的"平均算子"，需要通过理论界与对照实验把排列、调度两个因素的贡献分开。

Method: 在固定语料、固定预算、仅改变路径的前提下，对同一语料做十种不同排列，并在仅 lr_scheduler_type 不同的两组调度族下各跑两遍。证明一个界：排列只以"block period"、调度只以"端点能把多少权重放到运行中的任意单一时刻"这两个相乘因子进入顺序效应。用 convention 标记进 prompt 的臂作为对照，并用 acc_A、acc_B 及 convention-agnostic 指标（acc_A+acc_B、union ceiling）衡量承诺程度。

Result: 常数学习率下，十种排列的内部跨度达 allocation share 0.2221、contrast floors 11.63，且随排列的分块（blocked）程度单调；同一十臂在普遍使用的单一 cosine 调度下只占据约两个可区分状态（而自身分辨率允许约十个）。十二臂中 acc_A+acc_B 恒定性在 9.7% 以内，而 allocation share 从 0.04 到 0.87，即 12.29-sigma 的排列切换在 convention-agnostic 指标下恰为零。标记 convention 的臂使切换坍缩，并达到 union 上限的 87.5%。

Conclusion: "顺序有影响"与"顺序无影响"是同一个旋钮的两端；调度器（衰减与否）是该旋钮的真正控制者。路径写入的是模型对某种约定的承诺，而精确匹配类基准（exact-match）无法观测到这一承诺。衰减调度通过阻止"大步长与未收缩残差同时出现"来抑制顺序效应，而常数调度恰在最后一步实现了这一点。标记约定可消除切换并将性能提升至接近 union 上限。

Abstract: "Train a model on the same problems written under two incompatible conventions, both correct, and ask what the ordering of that data writes into the parameters. The learning-rate schedule is not a background condition for that question. It is the averaging operator, and it decides the answer. We prove a bound in which the arrangement and the schedule enter the ordering effect as separate multiplied factors: the arrangement only as a block period, the schedule only as how much weight the endpoint can place on any one moment of the run. A decaying schedule cannot put a large step size and an uncontracted remainder at the same moment; a constant one does exactly that at the last step.
