Result: 在多个 LLM 和基准上，HHR 性能优于现有方法：LongBench 平均分数提升 1.10 分；在 128K 上下文长度下，Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 实现最高 3.30 倍解码加速和 2.83 倍端到端加速。

Conclusion: HHR 通过 GKR 与 LHP 的协同，有效解决了哈希检索中 Hamming 距离与注意力相关性的失配问题，显著提升哈希稀疏注意力的保真度，在保持性能的同时实现长上下文推理的显著加速。代码已开源。

Abstract: Efficient long-context inference is essential for large language models (LLMs), yet it poses a severe computational bottleneck. Hash-based retrieval offers an efficient alternative by encoding queries and keys into binary codes and using Hamming distance for key selection. However, this leads to a critical mismatch between Hamming distance and attention relevance. Query-Key logits depend jointly on directional similarity and feature magnitudes, whereas hash binarization discards magnitude information, causing both false-positive retrieval of low-logit keys and false-negative omission of high-logit keys. To address these failures, we propose Hierarchical Hash Retrieval (HHR), a coarse-to-fine framework that progressively improves retrieval accuracy through Geometry-Aware Key Routing (GKR) and Learned Hash Projection (LHP). GKR learns a head-wise orthogonal transformation to redistribute feature magnitudes and derive more discriminative page-level logit bounds, enabling effective pruning of low-logit keys while preserving important candidates. LHP then learns a head-wise projection space that aligns Hamming distance with the true Query-Key relevance ranking for fine-grained retrieval. By combining GKR and LHP, HHR suppresses false positives and recovers false negatives, substantially improving the fidelity of hash-based sparse attention. Extensive experiments across diverse LLMs and benchmarks demonstrate that HHR achieves superior performance over existing methods. For example, on LongBench, HHR improves the average score by 1.10 points and, at a context length of 128K, achieves up to a 3.30x decoding speedup and a 2.83x end-to-end speedup for Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/lianjunl13-sudo/HHR.

</details>


### [318] [Learning to Ask: Information Acquisition for SLM-LLM Collaboration, under a budget](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01236)
*Yongjun Kim,Xiaoxiao Li,Jaeho Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出将小模型与大模型的协作重新定义为"信息获取问题"而非"计算分配问题"，在API预算约束下让SLM作为主推理者、仅在需要时向黑盒LLM顾问发出针对性查询，并通过三阶段RLVR框架联合学习是否调用、如何提问以及如何利用信息，在数学推理和编码任务上取得更好的性能-成本权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SLM-LLM协作多被建模为计算分配问题（决定哪部分推理由哪个模型处理），但在黑盒API场景下效率低下，原因在于粗粒度委派以及模型切换时上下文的重复传输。因此需要一种更节省通信开销、仅在必要时获取信息的协作范式。

Method: 将SLM-LLM协作形式化为API预算约束下的信息获取问题：SLM作为主推理者，仅在需要时向黑盒LLM顾问发出针对性查询，而非委派推理过程。为实现该策略，开发了一个三阶段RLVR（带可验证奖励的强化学习）框架，联合学习是否调用顾问、如何构造有用的查询、以及如何将协作信息整合进推理过程，并对顾问调用与信息使用进行联合优化。

Result: 在数学推理与编码任务上，该方法相比现有协作基线改善了性能-成本权衡，并在部分场景下达到或超过oracle级别的问题级路由效果；该策略还可迁移到其他顾问模型家族而无需额外训练。

Conclusion: 将SLM-LLM协作重构为信息获取问题能更高效地利用API预算，三阶段RLVR框架学习出的按需查询策略在性能-成本上优于传统计算分配范式，并具备跨模型家族的迁移能力。

Abstract: Collaboration between a small language model (SLM) and a large language model (LLM) offers an opportunity to combine the efficiency of smaller models with the strong reasoning capabilities of larger ones. Existing approaches primarily frame such collaboration as a computation allocation problem, determining which model should handle each portion of the reasoning process. In black-box API-based settings, however, this paradigm can be inefficient due to coarse-grained delegation or repeated transmission of context across model switches. In this work, we instead formulate SLM-LLM collaboration as an information acquisition problem, under an API budget constraint. The SLM remains the primary reasoner and selectively queries a black-box LLM advisor only when needed, issuing targeted queries rather than delegating the reasoning process itself. To realize this strategy, we develop a three-stage RLVR framework that learns whether to call the advisor, how to formulate useful queries, and how to integrate the collaboration into the reasoning process by jointly refining advisor invocation and information use. Across mathematical reasoning and coding tasks, our approach improves the performance--cost tradeoff over existing collaboration baselines and, in some settings, matches or exceeds oracle problem-level routing. Finally, we show that our strategy can transfer to other advisor model families, without further training.

</details>


### [319] [Revision-Aware Independent Agent Graphs for Dynamic Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01249)
*Yan Luo,Selim-Antoine Lali,Jeremy Moebel,Iliass Khoutaibi,Ahmadou Aidara,Mengyu Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究动态任务路由问题——事件流不断修订任务绑定，系统需在每个查询时刻选择有效的文档版本来求解。作者将六个基准（MMLU、MMLU-Pro、MedMCQA、MATH、GPQA、HumanEval）改造成 31,119 个动态片段、373,428 个时间归类查询，并提出 RIAG 多智能体策略，在显著降低调用成本的同时大幅提升联合路由-答案准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统推理协议只提供固定、预设的任务，无法检验智能体是否能传播相关更新、保留未受影响的工作或重建历史任务绑定。因此需要一种能应对动态任务绑定变化的评测方式，并解决"每次事件后重算浪费工作"与"不加区分地复用导致过时结论"之间的核心权衡。

Method: 将六个广泛使用的基准改造为动态任务路由数据集（31,119 个动态片段、373,428 个时态归类查询）；提出 Revision-Aware Independent Agent Graph（RIAG），一种有界多智能体策略，将确定性时间解析与任务推理分离，按不可变文档身份缓存解，每个新任务以两次未暴露尝试开始，并有条件地调用审计与修复，每个文档版本最多四次调用。

Result: 在该数据集上，同构 RIAG 达到 54.24% 的联合路由-答案准确率，成本仅 0.62 次调用/查询；而最强对比方法为 32.22% 准确率、18.00 次调用/查询。异构 RIAG 达到 49.78% 准确率、0.63 次调用/查询。

Conclusion: 动态任务路由暴露了传统固定任务协议无法捕捉的挑战。RIAG 通过缓存、时间解析与条件审计修复的结合，以极低的调用成本显著优于重算型方法，表明将文档身份、版本解析与推理解耦是有前景的方向。

Abstract: Conventional reasoning protocols present a fixed, preselected task, so they cannot test whether an agent propagates relevant updates, preserves unaffected work, or reconstructs a historical task binding. We therefore study \emph{dynamic task routing}, in which an event stream revises task bindings and a system must select the document version valid at each query time before solving it. To study this problem, we repurpose six widely used benchmarks: MMLU, MMLU-Pro, MedMCQA, MATH, GPQA, and HumanEval into 31{,}119 dynamic episodes comprising 373{,}428 temporally categorized queries. This setting exposes a central trade-off: recomputing after every event wastes work, whereas unguarded reuse returns stale conclusions. We introduce the Revision-Aware Independent Agent Graph (RIAG), a bounded multi-agent policy that separates deterministic temporal resolution from task reasoning. RIAG caches solutions by immutable document identity, starts each fresh task with two unexposed attempts, and conditionally invokes audit and repair, using at most four calls per document version. On this collection, homogeneous RIAG achieves 54.24\% joint routing-and-answer accuracy at 0.62 calls/query, compared with 32.22\% at 18.00 calls/query for the strongest comparison method; heterogeneous RIAG reaches 49.78\% at 0.63 calls/query.

</details>


### [320] [DeFA: Dependency-Guided Failure Attribution for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01256)
*Bo Deng,Xinlei Zheng,Yi Wei,Kang Zhou,Chongyang Tao,Renzhao Liang,Xuanren Chen,Lifan Guo,Chi Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DeFA 是一种依赖引导的智能体（agent）失败归因框架，通过构建事件依赖图和失败传播图来定位决定性错误、责任智能体及错误类别，并借助分段与摘要技术支持长轨迹，诊断结果还能用于后续任务的智能体改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体执行中的错误与其可见后果之间往往间隔许多步骤，导致决定性错误的定位需要同时理解步骤内容与步骤间的依赖关系。现有方法难以有效处理这种长轨迹、跨步骤的错误因果归因问题。

Method: DeFA 将协议关系与语义依赖融合为横跨整个轨迹的事件依赖图；随后识别可能违反任务需求的事件，并追踪其来源与后续影响以构建失败传播图；最后利用步骤证据及步骤在失败传播中的角色定位决定性错误、责任智能体和错误类别。为支持长轨迹，DeFA 将执行过程划分为多个分段，将当前分段的详细内容与其他分段的摘要结合，使局部诊断能够访问全局执行上下文。此外，DeFA 的诊断反馈被用于 Trace2Skill 的技能演化。

Result: 在 Who and When 及 Who and When Pro 文本子集上，DeFA 在所有评测骨干下均取得最高的责任智能体与精确步骤准确率，并在 Pro 上取得与分类法对齐方法中最高的失败模式准确率。在图像和视频轨迹上的实验证明其适用于多模态失败归因。消融实验支持了分段、事件依赖图和失败传播图的贡献。将 DeFA 诊断反馈用于 Trace2Skill 技能演化，使下游任务准确率相比原生流水线提升 6-15 个百分点。

Conclusion: DeFA 通过依赖引导的失败归因有效解决了长轨迹、跨步骤的 LLM 智能体错误定位问题，具有高准确率、多模态适用性，并且其诊断结果能反哺智能体在后续任务中的改进，展现出较强的实用价值。

Abstract: Errors in LLM agent executions and their visible consequences can be separated by many steps, making decisive-error localization a matter of understanding both step content and step dependencies. We introduce DeFA, a dependency-guided framework for agent failure attribution. DeFA first combines protocol relations and semantic dependencies into an event dependency graph spanning the trajectory. It then identifies events that may violate task requirements and traces their sources and subsequent effects to construct a failure propagation graph. Finally, DeFA uses step evidence and the steps' roles in failure propagation to identify the decisive error, responsible agent, and error category. To support long trajectories, DeFA partitions executions into segments and combines the current segment's detailed content with summaries of the other segments, giving local diagnosis access to global execution context. Across Who and When and the Who and When Pro text subset, DeFA achieves the highest responsible-agent and exact step accuracy with all evaluated backbones, and the highest failure-mode accuracy among taxonomy-aligned methods on Pro. Further experiments on image and video trajectories demonstrate its applicability to multimodal failure attribution. Ablations support the contributions of segmentation, the event dependency graph, and the failure propagation graph. Using DeFA's diagnostic feedback for skill evolution in Trace2Skill improves downstream task accuracy by 6-15 percentage points over the native pipeline, showing that the diagnoses can also support agent improvement on subsequent tasks.

</details>


### [321] [Feedback Without the Wait: Piloting a Generative AI Practice Platform in a Large Maths Class](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01262)
*Lili Chen,Gavin Buskes,Yuxin Ren,Chin Tong Leong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文设计并试运行了一个生成式人工智能（GenAI）练习平台，在电气工程课程的自定进度练习中提供即时、阶梯式反馈，将人工监督从实时评分前移到事先的答案验证，以调和反馈即时性与可信度之间的张力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 及时且具体的反馈对学习影响最大，但在师生比高的大班电气工程课上难以维持；学生遇到问题可能要等数天才能知道错在哪里。GenAI 虽能规模化提供对话式反馈，但用其批改计分作业会引发信任与问责问题，而保留人工把关又会重新引入延迟、削弱反馈价值。由此形成即时性与可信度之间的根本张力。

Method: 设计与试运行一个 GenAI 练习平台，在自定进度的练习中提供即时、阶梯式（scaffolded）反馈；将人工监督从实时评分环节前移至解决方案的事先验证（upfront verification）。随后研究学生如何与该工具互动、如何评价反馈的价值与可靠性，并归纳可迁移到其他工程学科的经验。

Result: 论文为实践性试点研究，重点关注学生使用行为、对反馈价值与可靠性的感知，以及经验的可迁移性（具体数据结果在摘要中未展开）。

Conclusion: 通过把人工把关从事后实时评分前置为事先答案验证，可以在电气工程练习场景中兼顾反馈的即时性与可信度；该方法有望推广至其他工程学科。

Abstract: Timely and specific feedback is one of the strongest influences on student learning, yet it is difficult to sustain in large electrical engineering classes where the ratio of students to demonstrators is high and a learner who is stuck may wait days to find out why an approach was wrong. Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) offers a way to scale conversational feedback, but using it to grade assessed work raises trust and accountability concerns, and keeping a human in the loop to assure its judgements reintroduces the very delay that erodes the value of feedback. The result is a tension between the immediacy that makes feedback so impactful and the human oversight that makes it trustworthy. In this work, we set out to resolve that tension in practice by designing and piloting a GenAI practice platform that delivers immediate, scaffolded feedback during self-directed practice. This relocates human oversight from real-time grading to the upfront verification of solutions. Our goal was to understand how students engaged with the tool, how they perceived the value and reliability of its feedback, and what lessons transfer to other engineering subjects.

</details>


### [322] [SCOPE-AD: Sequential cost-aware ordinal-belief planning with energy-based models for diagnostic agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01278)
*Ziwen Yu,Ivan Koychev,Elizabeth Coulthard,Ting Zhou,Bolin Chen,Dian Hong,Zinuo You,Yujiao Wang,Anthony Mulholland,Qiang Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 SCOPE-AD，一种顺序、成本感知的序数信念规划诊断智能体，利用基于能量的模型与蒸馏到 Qwen 的策略，在 ADNI 上以仅 50.46 美元的平均获取成本取得 77.70% 的 Macro-F1，比最强基线高 9.34 个百分点，支持选择性获取实现高性价比诊断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AD 诊断需要在异质测试成本和患者负担下顺序地获取证据，而固定模态预测器无法联合决策"获取哪个测试"以及"现有证据何时足够用于诊断"，因此需要一种能动态决定获取/诊断动作且受预算与可用性约束的智能体。

Method: 提出 SCOPE-AD：用掩码感知的序数模型沿 CN—MCI—AD 有序连续体表示不确定性；回顾性训练记录为基于能量的教师模型提供采样的 Bellman 目标，再将教师动作分布蒸馏到 Qwen 策略；部署时智能体在可用性与预算约束下选择获取或诊断动作（无法访问未获取值），每次获取后更新证据与序数信念再进入下一决策。

Result: 在 ADNI 上，SCOPE-AD 取得 77.70% 的 Macro-F1，平均获取成本为 50.46 美元，比评估的最强基线高 9.34 个百分点；全模态评估的 Macro-F1 仅提升 1.89 点，但获取成本增加 116.7 倍。

Conclusion: SCOPE-AD 表明选择性获取能以远低于全模态的成本实现接近的诊断性能，为成本效益高的 AD 诊断提供了有力支持。

Abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) diagnosis requires sequential evidence acquisition under heterogeneous test costs and patient burden. Fixed-modality predictors do not jointly decide which test to acquire or when the available evidence is sufficient for diagnosis. We propose SCOPE-AD (Sequential Cost-Aware Ordinal-Belief Planning with Energy-Based Models for Diagnostic Agents) for cost-aware classification of cognitively normal (CN), mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and AD cases. A mask-aware ordinal model represents uncertainty along the ordered CN--MCI--AD continuum. Retrospective training records provide sampled Bellman targets for an energy-based teacher, whose action distributions are distilled into a Qwen policy. At deployment, the agent selects acquisition or diagnosis actions under availability and budget constraints without access to unacquired values. After each acquisition, the evidence and ordinal belief are updated before the next decision. On ADNI, SCOPE-AD achieves 77.70\% Macro-F1 at an average acquisition cost of \$50.46, exceeding the strongest evaluated baseline by 9.34 percentage points. Full-modality evaluation raises Macro-F1 by only 1.89 points while increasing acquisition cost by 116.7 times. These results support selective acquisition for cost-effective diagnosis.

</details>


### [323] [Trustworthy Data- and ML-Ops for Intelligent Transportation Systems and Logistics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01282)
*Antonio Emanuele Cinà,Giovanni Scodeller,Cecilia Caterina Pasquale,Silvia Siri,Davide Anguita,Fabio Roli,Simona Sacone,Luca Oneto*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统综述了智能交通与物流（ITS&L）领域中可信的数据运维（DataOps）与机器学习运维（MLOps）的现状，梳理了其必要性、关键组成、工具、实践案例及可信AI议题，并展望了未来的挑战与方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ITS&L作为现代社会经济的基石，高度依赖数据、人工智能特别是机器学习；但当前文献缺乏对可信DataOps与MLOps在该领域的系统梳理，亟需填补这一空白，以提升交通与物流服务的效率、可靠性及决策精度。

Method: 采用综合性文献综述方法：先识别现有研究空白以明确贡献定位，随后系统探讨DataOps与MLOps的复杂性，涵盖必要性、关键组件、可用工具、实践见解及ITS&L相关案例研究；并专门分析AI可信性问题，考察增强AI系统可信度的方法与工具，最后讨论持续挑战与前景。

Result: 建立了对ITS&L中DataOps与MLOps的基础性理解，指出了提升效率、可靠性与决策精度的关键要素，并明确了可信AI在真实ITS&L场景中的必要方法、工具及当前尚未解决的挑战，为后续研究与创新规划了路径。

Conclusion: 可信DataOps与MLOps对构建更高效、可持续且可信的智能交通与物流系统至关重要。本文不仅为该领域奠定理论基础，也为研究人员、行业从业者和政策制定者提供了重要参考，并指明了进一步研究与创新的方向。

Abstract: The rapid evolution of Intelligent Transportation Systems and Logistics (ITS\&L) has become a cornerstone of the modern social economy, relying heavily on the integration of Data, Artificial Intelligence (AI), and, more specifically, Machine Learning (ML). This paper provides a comprehensive review of Trustworthy Data and Machine Learning Operations (DataOps and MLOps) in the ITS\&L domain, underscoring their importance in improving efficiency, reliability, and decision-making precision within transportation and logistics services. We begin by identifying gaps in current literature, offering clear context for our contribution. Subsequently, we explore the complexities of DataOps and MLOps, discussing their necessity, key components, available tools, practical insights, and case studies relevant to ITS\&L. Additionally, we address the critical issue of Trustworthiness in AI applications, examining methods and tools designed to strengthen confidence in AI systems - especially in real-world ITS\&L scenarios. The paper concludes with a discussion of persisting challenges and future prospects in this rapidly advancing field, aiming to serve as a vital resource for researchers, industry practitioners, and policy makers. Overall, this work not only establishes a foundational understanding of DataOps and MLOps in ITS\&L but also charts a path for further research and innovation in developing more efficient, sustainable, and trustworthy intelligent transportation and logistics systems.

</details>


### [324] [ITC-MoE: Importance-guided Token-aware Compression for MoE Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01296)
*Lianjun Liu,Shipeng Li,You Huang,Weiqi Yan,Mingte Qiu,Huazhong Liu,Xiaofeng Zhu,Yunshan Zhong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 ITC-MoE，一种面向混合专家(MoE)扩散语言模型(DLM)的重要性引导、token 感知压缩框架。它通过自适应 Tucker 压缩与 token 感知的补偿/路由，在大幅降低计算与存储成本的同时保持生成质量，最高实现 7.22 倍端到端加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE DLM 拥有大量专家参数，带来高昂的计算与存储开销，而现有低秩压缩方法依赖静态分解和固定秩分配，忽略了 MoE DLM 的两个独有特性：(1) 跨模式非均匀冗余——参数冗余度和对秩截断的敏感性在输入、输出、专家三个模式上各不相同；(2) token 级利用率差异——热 token 与冷 token 呈现不同的谱特性和专家激活模式。因此需要针对这些特性设计专门的压缩框架。

Method: 提出 ITC-MoE 框架，包含两个互补组件：(1) 重要性引导的自适应 Tucker 压缩(IATC)——将激活与梯度重要性融入专家权重变换，跨输入/输出/专家多模式联合分解专家权重，并在固定参数预算下自适应分配秩；(2) Token 感知补偿与路由(TCR)——对压缩敏感的热 token 施加轻量低秩补偿，对路由模式集中的冷 token 限制候选专家集合。二者联合使压缩容量和推理执行同时适应参数冗余与 token 级差异。

Result: 在 SDAR-30B-A3B-Chat-b32 上，ITC-MoE 在 30% 压缩预算下于 MultiArith 任务保持 96.33% 的准确率，并获得最高 7.22 倍的端到端加速，证明其能在显著降低计算与存储成本的同时维持生成质量。

Conclusion: 通过联合考虑参数冗余与 token 级利用率差异，ITC-MoE 有效压缩了 MoE DLM 并加速推理，在保持生成质量的前提下实现了更高的压缩比与加速比，代码已开源。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) offer flexible parallel decoding and increased model capacity, but their large number of expert parameters incurs substantial computation and storage costs. Existing low-rank MoE compression methods largely rely on static factorization and fixed rank allocation, which overlook the distinctive properties of MoE DLMs. Specifically, we identify two properties: cross-mode non-uniform redundancy, where parameter redundancy and sensitivity to rank truncation vary across the input, output, and expert modes, and token-wise utilization variation, where hot and cold tokens exhibit distinct spectral characteristics and expert activation patterns. To address these challenges, we propose ITC-MoE, an Importance-guided Token-aware Compression framework for MoE DLMs. ITC-MoE consists of two complementary components. First, Importance-guided Adaptive Tucker Compression (IATC) incorporates activation and gradient importance into expert weight transformation, jointly factorizes expert weights across multiple modes, and adaptively allocates ranks under a fixed parameter budget. Second, Token-aware Compensation and Routing (TCR) applies lightweight low-rank compensation to compression-sensitive hot tokens and restricts the candidate expert set for cold tokens with concentrated routing patterns. By jointly adapting compression capacity and inference execution to both parameter redundancy and token-wise variation, ITC-MoE substantially reduces the computation and storage costs of MoE DLMs while preserving their generation quality. For example, on SDAR-30B-A3B-Chat-b32, ITC-MoE maintains an accuracy of 96.33% on MultiArith under a 30% compression budget, while achieving up to a 7.22x end-to-end speedup. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/lianjunl13-sudo/ITC-MoE.

</details>


### [325] [Questionnaire-Guided Disaggregation of Energy Appliance Use for Domestic Smart Meter Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01297)
*Achal Nanjundamurthy,Rupam Misra,Suzanne Little,Alan F. Smeaton*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需标签的非侵入式负荷分解（NILM）系统，通过结合高功率负载的事件检测与问卷引导的估计，将30分钟分辨率的智能电表用电数据分解为9类电器，并在多个数据集上取得最低的整体分解误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 爱尔兰智能电表以30分钟分辨率记录用电数据，虽能支持分时电价计费，但粒度太粗无法捕捉家用电器级别的用电情况；现有分解方法在缺乏逐电器子计量标签的情况下难以获得可靠结果，因此需要一种标签无关的实用分解方案。

Method: 提出一种混合式标签无关分解系统：对高功率负载采用事件检测方法，对低功率/难以事件化的电器采用问卷引导估计，二者结合将总用电分解为9类电器。评估使用四类数据集（含商用对照的校准家庭、带逐电器子计量的公开基准UK-DALE与REFIT、以及2,968户爱尔兰用户超过4,800年的智能电表数据），并与两个独立开发的分解系统进行对比。

Result: 混合方法在所有数据集的所有建筑上均取得最低的整体（whole-decomposition）误差；在54个配对月份的月度性能上也优于对比系统（p<0.001，Holm校正）。该方法能为家庭提供用电模式分析及针对部分电器的降耗或错峰用电建议。

Conclusion: 通过将用电数据与问卷结果相结合，本标签无关的混合分解系统可在无需逐电器标注的情况下实现可靠的电器级分解，并在多个基准与大样本实测数据上优于对比方法，具备为家庭提供节电降费建议的实际应用价值。

Abstract: Ireland's smart metering programme records electricity use at 30-minute resolution, with smart meters installed in over 80\% of households as of late 2025. While this is useful for billing of smart, time-of-use tariffs, it is too coarse to capture use of domestic appliances. We present a label-free disaggregation system that breaks usage data into 9 appliance categories by combining event detection for high-power loads with questionnaire-guided estimation. Our evaluation draws on four datasets: a calibration household with a commercial comparator, two public benchmarks (UK-DALE and REFIT) with per-appliance sub-metering, and a smart meter dataset of more than 4,800 years of use from 2,968 Irish consumers. Compared against two independently developed disaggregation systems our hybrid method combining analysis of usage data with questionnaire results, achieves the lowest whole-decomposition error on all buildings across the datasets, with better month-level performance over 54 paired months ($p<0.001$, Holm-corrected). Our method provides useful advice on a household's energy consumption patterns and advice on how to reduce or shift usage on some appliances in order to reduce costs.

</details>


### [326] [DAYJOB: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Professional Work](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01306)
*Stephanie Finley,Liudas Panavas,Thomas Mikkelson,Cam Hinton,Stacey Ganss,Bradley Monton,Emily Kendall,Michelle Spradlin,Lydia Bye,Michael O'Brien,Lauren Ylvisaker,Derek Ray,Suhaas Garre,Sushant Mehta,Edwin Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 DAYJOB 基准，包含由医疗和金融专业人士构建的 130 个真实工作任务，用于评估智能体完成专业工作的能力；最强模型 Claude Opus 5.5 的通过率仅为约 24%，多数模型几乎无法通过。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 专业工作通常始于一段简短的请求，需要工作者自行判断真正需求、哪些文档相关以及请求的前提是否成立。现有基准难以评估智能体在这种开放式、长时程、多文档专业工作场景下的真实能力，因此需要构建贴近真实专业任务、由专业人士设计的高难度基准。

Method: 构建 DAYJOB 基准，包含 130 个由医疗（50 个）和金融（80 个）专业人士设计的工作任务；每个任务封装为一个 Harbor 容器环境，并配有专家编写的二元判定标准评分细则（医疗中位 47.5 条、金融中位 57.5 条），由智能体裁判对交付文件逐条判定，任务仅当满足全部标准才算通过。评估了 13 家开发者的 30 个模型配置。

Result: 医疗任务平均需专业工作者 13.6 小时、金融任务 16.6 小时。最强模型 Claude Opus 5.5 的通过率为医疗 24.7%、金融 23.9%；中位配置通过率仅为医疗 0.6%、金融 2.5%。案例研究发现，智能体会接受与记录相矛盾的请求前提，并在其他方面一致的分析中继续使用错误输入。

Conclusion: DAYJOB 揭示了当前智能体在真实专业工作环境中能力严重不足，现有最强模型通过率仍不足四分之一，且存在接受错误前提、沿用错误输入等系统性缺陷。作者公开了全部医疗任务、80 个金融任务中的 50 个、评估工具与排行榜，以推动该领域研究。

Abstract: Professional work often starts with a brief request that leaves the professional to work out what is needed, which documents matter, and whether the request's premise holds. We introduce DAYJOB, a benchmark of 130 tasks built by professionals in healthcare (50) and finance (80). The tasks are estimated to take a professional 13.6 hours on average in healthcare and 16.6 in finance. Each task is a containerized Harbor environment with an expert rubric of binary criteria (median 47.5 and 57.5 per task) that an agentic judge applies to the delivered files, and an attempt passes only if it meets every criterion. Across 30 model configurations from 13 developers, the strongest, Claude Opus 5.5, passes 24.7% of healthcare and 23.9% of finance attempts, and the median configuration passes 0.6% and 2.5%. In case studies, agents accept premises that the record contradicts and carry wrong inputs through otherwise consistent analyses. We release all healthcare tasks, 50 of the 80 finance tasks, the evaluation harness, and the leaderboard.

</details>


### [327] [ProtoFlow: Prototype-Guided Flow Matching for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01320)
*Shibo Feng,Wanjin Feng,Yang Qiu,Deheng Ye,Peilin Zhao,Chunyan Miao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ProtoFlow 将向量量化自编码与基于原型先验的流匹配相结合，用训练好的 VQ 码本构建结构化先验，替代传统流匹配的高斯先验，实现高效、非自回归的多变量时间序列预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于 VQ 的时序预测方法通常依赖自回归式 token 生成，存在曝光偏差与训练/推理不一致问题；流匹配虽提供非自回归替代方案，但现有形式多从通用高斯先验初始化传输，未能利用已学习到的码本原型信息。作者认为训练好的 VQ 码本已捕捉了代表性潜在原型，可作为更具信息量的先验。

Method: ProtoFlow 框架分三步：1) 通过向量量化自编码将多变量序列映射到离散潜在空间；2) 从学习到的码本构建结构化先验；3) 采用基于 DiT 的整流流（rectified flow），在历史观测条件下，将样本从该原型先验传输到未来潜在表示。核心是将通用噪声初始化替换为学习的原型先验。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，ProtoFlow 一致取得了更优的预测性能，且由于采用非自回归生成，推理过程高效。原型先验还避免了自回归 token 预测的 rollout 不匹配，并加速了训练收敛。

Conclusion: 通过将 VQ 码本原型作为流匹配的信息性先验，ProtoFlow 有效结合了离散潜在建模与高效非自回归生成的优势，在保证高效推理的同时提升了多变量时间序列预测精度。

Abstract: Generative modeling has shown strong promise for multivariate time mseries (MTS) forecasting, especially scale to high-dimensional settings. Diffusion-based methods achieve competitive performance but typically require many sampling steps at inference. VAE-based non-iterative forecasting frameworks have therefore emerged as an efficient alternative. Within this line of work, vector quantization (VQ) enables controllable latent space modeling by mapping multivariate series into compact discrete representations. Existing VQ-based forecasting methods, however, typically rely on autoregressive (AR) token generation, which suffers from exposure bias and training-inference mismatch. Flow matching provides an efficient non-autoregressive alternative for latent forecasting, but existing formulations usually initialize transport from a generic Gaussian prior. We instead observe that the trained VQ codebook already captures representative latent prototypes and can thus serve as a more informative prior for flow matching. Based on this insight, we propose ProtoFlow, a forecasting framework that combines vector-quantized autoencoding with Prototype-prior Flow matching. Our method first maps multivariate sequences into a discrete latent space, then constructs a structured prior from the learned codebook, and finally learns a DiT-based rectified flow to transport samples from this prior to future latent representations conditioned on historical observations. By replacing generic noise initialization with a learned prototype prior, ProtoFlow avoids the rollout mismatch of AR token prediction and promotes faster training convergence. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets show that it consistently achieves superior forecasting performance with efficient inference.

</details>


### [328] [TRACE: Trajectory Return Attribution and Contrastive Erasure for Multi-Turn Safety](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01323)
*Fengpeng Li,Kemou Li,Qizhou Wang,Haiwei Wu,Jiantao Zhou,Di Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 TRACE，一种令牌级训练目标，通过轨迹回报归因与对比擦除来抑制多轮对话中的越狱风险，在 35 个模型-攻击组合上取得最低攻击成功率，且通用能力下降极小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全对齐的 LLM 会拒绝单轮有害请求，但在目标被拆分到多轮对话时却可能服从。现有偏好优化目标只对单轮完整回复打分，无法约束未见历史下的多轮风险，因此需要一种能显式控制多轮轨迹风险的对齐方法。

Method: 作者先给出充分条件：在有监督单轮语境下的抑制可为多轮轨迹风险提供上界，该上界考虑覆盖率、迁移松弛和泄漏，并刻画相对于基策略风险预算的收缩。基于此提出 TRACE 令牌级目标：(1) 在安全回复上，每个令牌按“拒绝对应优势”的折扣回报加权，该优势由冻结参考模型与其“拒绝消融”副本比较得到，使早期回复令牌能从后期拒绝对应证据中获得信用；(2) 在被拒回复的高差距位置，将观测令牌与策略选择的替代方案组合进擦除目标；(3) 用梯度范数惩罚替代保留集。

Result: 在 5 个开放权重模型和 7 种多轮攻击上，TRACE 在全部 35 个模型-攻击组合中取得最低攻击成功率（ASR），而 MMLU 与 HellaSwag 上的模型通用能力最多仅下降 1.23 分。

Conclusion: 通过将多轮风险抑制原则转化为令牌级擦除目标，TRACE 能在显著降低多轮越狱攻击成功率的同时几乎不损害模型的通用能力，为多轮安全对齐提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Safety-aligned large language models (LLMs) often refuse a harmful request but comply once the same goal is spread over several turns. Preference objectives score whole responses to single prompts, so their training loss alone cannot control risk on unseen histories. Our analysis gives sufficient conditions under which suppression at supervised single-turn contexts yields a bound on multi-turn trajectory risk. The bound accounts for coverage, transfer slack, and leakage, and characterizes contraction relative to a base-policy risk budget evaluated on the trained policy's contexts. TRACE (Trajectory Return Attribution and Contrastive Erasure) turns this principle into a token-level objective. On the safe response, each token is weighted by the discounted return of a refusal-attributable advantage. The advantage compares a frozen reference model with its refusal-ablated copy, allowing earlier response tokens to receive credit from later refusal-related evidence. At high-gap positions on rejected responses, TRACE combines the observed token with policy-selected alternatives in the erasure target. A gradient-norm penalty replaces the retain set. Across five open-weight models and seven multi-turn attacks, TRACE gives the lowest attack success rate (ASR) in all 35 model and attack pairs, while the model utility evaluated on MMLU and HellaSwag drop by at most 1\.23 points. Source code can be found in the supplemental material.

</details>


### [329] [PPO-HRAP: Proximal Policy Optimization with a Hybrid Regime-Aware Policy for Risk-Controlled Trading](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01325)
*Duong Hien Chi Kien,Thanh Trung Huynh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 PPO-HRAP，一种融合近端策略优化（PPO）与可解释市场状态先验的混合交易策略，通过将学习到的动作与波动率感知的状态目标敞口相混合，在 SPY 上显著降低回撤并提升风险调整后收益，且在 QQQ、DIA 上表现领先。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习交易普遍难以同时兼顾上行参与和回撤控制：纯盈利导向策略在上涨资产上易退化为被动做多，而过度惩罚风险的奖励在波动期会变得过于保守。因此需要一种能根据市场波动状态自适应权衡攻守的策略。

Method: 提出 PPO-HRAP。智能体同时观察市场特征与组合状态变量；奖励由组合对数收益、以 VIX 为条件的回撤增加惩罚、目标敞口偏离惩罚及换手成本组合而成；执行动作时，将 PPO 演员网络输出与基于状态推导的目标敞口进行混合。指数为标的资产（SPY、QQQ、DIA），测试窗口为 2020–2022，多随机种子（五种子）及单次跨资产实验进行验证。

Result: 在 SPY 留出测试集上，PPO-HRAP 实现总收益 27.62%、年化收益 8.48%、夏普比率 0.6447、索提诺比率 0.8588、Calmar 比率 0.4592，并将最大回撤从买入持有的 34.10% 降至 18.47%。五种子下总收益均值 0.2725±0.0109、夏普均值 0.6219±0.0565，表现稳定。QQQ 与 DIA 的单次实验中，该方法在总收益与夏普比率上均排名第一。

Conclusion: 将学习动作与波动率感知的状态先验相融合，是提升风险调整后交易行为的实用方法；但当前策略仍存在换手率过高、以及除 SPY 之外的跨资产稳健性仅有单次实验证据等局限。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning for trading often struggles to balance upside participation with drawdown control. Profit-only policies can collapse toward passive long exposure on upward-drifting assets, while aggressively risk-penalized rewards can become too defensive during volatile periods. This paper proposes PPO-HRAP, a hybrid regime-aware policy that combines Proximal Policy Optimization with an interpretable regime prior. The agent observes both market features and portfolio-state variables, receives a reward combining portfolio log return, VIX-conditioned drawdown-increase penalty, target-exposure deviation, and turnover cost, and executes a blended action between the PPO actor output and a regime-derived target exposure. On the held-out 2020-2022 SPY test window, PPO-HRAP achieves 27.62% total return, 8.48% annualized return, 0.6447 Sharpe ratio, 0.8588 Sortino ratio, and 0.4592 Calmar ratio, while reducing maximum drawdown from 34.10% for Buy and Hold to 18.47%. Across five SPY seeds, PPO-HRAP remains stable with mean total return $0.2725 \pm 0.0109$ and mean Sharpe ratio $0.6219 \pm 0.0565$. Single-run cross-asset tests on QQQ and DIA further show that the proposed method ranks first on total return and Sharpe ratio for all three reported assets. These results suggest that blending learned actions with a volatility-aware regime prior is a practical way to improve risk-adjusted trading behavior, although the current policy still incurs high turnover and cross-asset robustness beyond SPY remains limited to single-run evidence.

</details>


### [330] [An ontology for cross-sectoral crisis management: core and public health modules](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01326)
*Aldo Gangemi,Rita T. Sousa,Luigi Asprino,Giorgia Lodi,Andrea G. Nuzzolese,Valentina Presutti,Johannes Gysen,Diana F. Sousa,Luigi Spagnolo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出欧洲危机管理本体（ECMO），一个模块化的OWL本体，作为灾害风险降低与响应的跨部门参考。ECMO核心模块捕捉灾害、事件、暴露、影响与响应措施等关键概念，领域模块（如公共卫生模块）对齐SNOMED CT和ICD-11。作者用ECMO表示来自EIOS的流行病学情报数据，构建了从非结构化新闻生成知识图谱的端到端流水线，初步验证了其在一致、统一知识表示上的作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 危机管理领域缺乏跨部门、可共享且能一致表示领域知识的参考本体，导致灾害风险降低与响应中出现知识异构、歧义和集成困难，尤其体现在灾害类型与事件表现之间的模糊性上，需要一种提供形式化约束（guardrails）的本体资源。

Method: 构建模块化、基于OWL的本体ECMO，组织为本体模块网络：ECMO-CORE捕获危机管理基础概念，采用本体设计模式（ODP）与OWL2 punning技术消解灾害类型与事件表现的歧义；领域模块如公共卫生模块对齐SNOMED CT与ICD-11。为验证实用性，使用ECMO表示联合研究中心EIOS系统的数据，构建端到端流水线，从非结构化流行病学新闻填充符合ECMO的知识图谱。

Result: ECMO提供了实现一致、统一知识表示与集成所需的形式化约束（guardrails），通过Epidemic Intelligence from Open Sources（EIOS）数据成功构建端到端、填充ECMO合规知识图谱的流水线。本体公开发布于Zenodo（DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20070268），采用CC BY 4.0许可。

Conclusion: ECMO作为一个模块化、跨部门的OWL本体，能够为灾害风险降低与响应提供一致可靠的知识表示框架，并通过对齐SNOMED CT、ICD-11等标准及实际EIOS数据流水线验证了其实用性。全文没有明确结论句，以上为基于摘要的概括。

Abstract: This paper presents the European Crisis Management Ontology (ECMO), a modular OWL-based ontology intended as a cross-sectoral reference for disaster risk reduction and response. ECMO is designed to be organised as a network of ontological modules. Among the modules, ECMO-CORE captures fundamental crisis management concepts such as hazard, event, exposure, impact, and response measure and uses ontology design patterns and the OWL2 punning technique to resolve ambiguities between hazard types and event manifestations. In addition, domain-specific modules are defined as in the case of the public health module aligned with SNOMED CT and ICD-11. To demonstrate the resource's utility, we used ECMO to represent the data of the Epidemic Intelligence from Open Sources system of the Joint Research Centre to generate an end-to-end pipeline that populates an ECMO-compliant knowledge graph from unstructured epidemiological news. Initial results demonstrate that ECMO provides the formal guardrails necessary for consistent and unified knowledge representation and integration. The ontology is publicly available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20070268 and is released under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) license.

</details>


### [331] [Verify Claims, Not Scores: Evidence-Based Verification of Modular Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01348)
*Ali Atiah Alzahrani*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向模块化 agent（规划-行动-检查-细化）的"声明特定验证审计"协议，不以聚合任务分数评估 agent，而是审计其证据：每条结论记录支撑证据、四种判定（supported / unsupported / unresolved / not evaluated）及成立边界，并借助 Oracle 策略、逐一组件替换和验证器摸底三件工具定位价值损失来源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开发者修改 agent 的某个组件（控制器、学习模型或验证器）时，通常只能看到聚合任务分数，无法判断改进是否可达成、价值损失源于哪个组件、以及 agent 自身检查实际证明了什么，因此需要一种能揭示这些信息的评估方式。

Method: 提出声明特定验证审计协议，对 plan/act/check/refine 的模块化 agent 审计证据而非分数：每个结论记录证据、四种判定（supported、unsupported、unresolved、not evaluated）及成立边界。三件工具支撑：1) Oracle 策略在明确动作集下度量可达改进，区分低分源于评估设置而非环境；2) 逐一用完美对应物替换组件以定位价值损失，当下游组件可能掩盖效果时将零结果记为 unresolved；3) 单独测试验证器分数是否真的界定了它被认为所代表的数量。协议应用于受约束组合配置 agent，在已知隐藏状态的合成市场环境中验证。

Result: 审计显示：完美状态信息的价值取决于用于度量它的动作集；场景生成器丢弃了大部分 regime 信号，且更好的局部保真度并未改善决策；运行时验证器可被绕过而对结果无可见影响。这些实证发现特定于所研究的 agent 与环境。

Conclusion: 主要贡献在于审计协议本身及其强制的证据性区分，而非具体经验结论；后者局限于特定 agent 与环境。

Abstract: When developers change one component of an agent, such as its controller, a learned model or its verifier, they usually judge the change by an aggregate task score. That score cannot tell whether improvement was attainable, which component lost value, or what the agent's own checks certify. We introduce a claim-specific verification audit for modular agents that plan, act, check and refine. Instead of scoring the agent, the audit scores the evidence: each conclusion is recorded with the evidence behind it, one of four verdicts (supported, unsupported, unresolved or not evaluated) and the boundary within which it holds. Three tools supply that evidence. Oracle policies measure attainable improvement under an explicitly stated action set, so that a low value can be traced to the evaluation rather than to the environment. Replacing one component at a time with a perfect counterpart locates lost value, with null results read as unresolved whenever a downstream component could mask them. A separate test asks whether the verifier's score identifies the quantity it is read as bounding. Applied to a constrained portfolio-allocation agent in a synthetic market with known hidden regimes, the audit shows that the value of perfect regime information depends on the action set used to measure it, that the scenario generator discards most of the regime signal while better local fidelity does not improve decisions, and that the runtime verifier can be bypassed with no visible change in outcomes. The contribution is the protocol and the evidential distinctions it enforces; the empirical findings are specific to the agent and environment studied.

</details>


### [332] [Generation Provenance Before Behavior Attribution: Auditing Synthetic Speech Research Objects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01378)
*Sidi Chang,Peiying Zhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种"生成溯源基底"（generation-provenance substrate），用于将合成研究对象的来源规格、生成内容、波形、目标、事实要求、质量信号、审查谱系和不可变清单身份绑定，从而为合成训练数据的行为归因建立候选因果图与审计单位；并通过一个日本照护交接语音管线的案例（113项资产、1.552小时六类场景合成语音）进行受限审计，揭示人工证据的选择性与来源特异性，同时指出生成溯源是行为归因的必要而非充分条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将模型行为归因到合成训练数据，必须先知道每条训练项由什么生成、再估计其因果效应；而单纯的波形-标签对无法保留这一来源知识，因此需要一种能显式绑定生成来源与内容的溯源机制。

Method: 设计生成溯源基底契约，将来源规格、生成内容、波形、目标、事实要求、质量信号、审查谱系与不可变清单身份绑定为一体；明确由"生产者与选择机制"而非存储位置/变量名决定证据含义。在私有日本照护交接管线中审计该基底：113项资产、1.552小时六类场景合成语音，全部具链式音频、转写、候选笔记与事实核对清单；两个 faithful-only 清单在场景-种子上互斥并不可变版本化。

Result: 审计发现：尽管所有资产都有链接音频、转写、候选笔记与事实核对清单，但人工证据是选择性的且来源特异；上游精确归因仍受浮动生成器别名、缺失的逐片段TTS与代码戳、未版本化的核对提示词所阻断。结论是生成溯源必要但不充分：它定义了候选因果图与审计单位，而真正的贡献性归因仍需冻结训练运行及干预/影响证据。全文明确不宣称因果训练数据归因、临床有效性或不受限公开。

Conclusion: 本文贡献一个紧凑的溯源契约、一套审计协议及一个有界案例研究，论证生成溯源是合成数据行为归因的必要基础（界定候选因果图与审计单元），但不能单独完成归因；贡献性归因仍需冻结训练与干预/影响证据。可提供受控研究访问，但不主张因果训练数据归因、临床有效性或公开释放。

Abstract: Attributing model behavior to synthetic training data requires knowing what produced each training item before estimating what that item caused. A waveform-label pair does not preserve this knowledge. We propose a generation-provenance substrate in which a synthetic research object binds source specification, generated content, waveform, target, fact requirements, quality signals, review lineage, and immutable manifest identity. Producer and selection mechanism determine evidentiary meaning; storage location and variable name do not. We audit this substrate in a private Japanese care-handoff pipeline. A 113-asset review population contains 1.552 hours of synthetic speech across six scenario families; all items have linked audio, transcripts, candidate notes, and fact checklists, but human evidence is selective and source-specific. Two faithful-only manifests are scenario-seed-disjoint and immutably versioned, while exact upstream attribution remains blocked by floating generator aliases, missing per-clip TTS and code stamps, and an unversioned checking prompt. We argue that generation provenance is necessary but not sufficient for behavior attribution: it defines the candidate causal graph and audit units, whereas contributive attribution still requires frozen training runs and intervention or influence evidence. The paper contributes a compact provenance contract, an audit protocol, and a bounded case study for synthetic-data attribution; controlled research access may be offered, but we do not claim causal training-data attribution, clinical validity, or unrestricted public release.

</details>


### [333] [Gacha Decoding: Eliciting Diverse Generations Through Instruction Following](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01382)
*Scott Geng,Yufei Zhang,Joseph Lee,Jerry Li,Marjan Ghazvininejad,Pang Wei Koh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Gacha Decoding，一种推理时方法，将多样性视为指令遵循问题，通过结合语言模型的指令遵循能力与外部随机数生成器（RNG）来规模化地发现并实现响应空间中的不同模式，在保持质量的同时大幅提升生成多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成多样性方法主要依赖于语言模型的 token 熵，但存在长期观察到的张力：随着模型能力（指令遵循能力）增强，token 熵和传统方法下的多样性反而下降。作者希望打破这一张力，让多样性随模型能力同步提升，而非衰退。

Method: 提出 Gacha Decoding：将多样性建模为指令遵循任务。不再单纯依赖 LM 的 token 熵，而是将 LM 的指令遵循能力与外部 RNG 工具的随机性相结合（"planning with dice"），从而规模化地识别并实现响应空间中的不同模式。

Result: 在开放域（真实对话、创意写作、图像生成规划、蛋白质设计）中，Gacha Decoding 在同等质量下显著优于现有多样性方法：Vendi 指标最高达次优方法的 2.4 倍，以少一个数量级的样本量（11.0 倍）达到相同数量的高质量模式，并能发现其他方法均无法发现的新模式。随着底层 LM 指令遵循能力增强，Gacha 下的多样性持续提升，即使其 token 熵与传统方法多样性下降。

Conclusion: 指令遵循能力（而非仅 token 熵）可以驱动生成多样性。Gacha Decoding 翻转了多样性与模型能力之间的传统张力，表明更强的指令遵循者能在推理时产生更丰富的、高质量的多样化响应。

Abstract: We introduce Gacha Decoding, an inference-time method for eliciting diverse language model generations that scales with model capability. Across open-ended domains (in-the-wild chat, creative writing, planning for image generation, and protein design), Gacha Decoding significantly outperforms existing generation diversity approaches at equal quality (up to 2.4x Vendi over the next-best prior approach), reaching the same number of high-quality modes with over an order of magnitude fewer samples (11.0x) and discovering novel modes that no other approach surfaces. Our key insight is to treat diversity as an instruction-following problem: rather than relying on the LM's token entropy, we combine its instruction-following capability with randomness from an external RNG tool to scalably identify and realize distinct modes of the response space. This approach of "planning with dice" enables Gacha to invert the long-observed tension between diversity and model capability. As the underlying LM becomes a better instruction follower, diversity under Gacha Decoding consistently improves--even as its token entropy and diversity under prior approaches decline. Together, our results highlight that instruction following, rather than token entropy alone, can drive generation diversity.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [334] [Reverse Item Response Theory for Sparsity-Robust Ranking in Fragmented Cancer Drug-Response Matrices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00002)
*Jung Min Kang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出“逆向项目反应理论（reverse IRT）”，将癌症类型视为具有耐药能力的潜在“被试”、药物视为具有逃逸难度的“项目”，用于药物基因组学药物反应分析，并在GDSC2数据上验证其稳健性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 药物基因组学药物反应数据的评价往往碎片化、存在大量缺失，传统的简单平均等方法在高缺失率下难以稳健恢复潜在的耐药/敏感性排序，需要一种在共享潜在尺度上统一估计癌症类型耐药性和药物广谱活性的方法。

Method: 引入逆向项目反应理论（reverse IRT），将癌症类型建模为具有耐药能力的潜在“被试”，将药物建模为具有逃逸难度的“项目”；在GDSC2数据库242,036条药物敏感性测量上估计癌症类型水平的体外耐药性和药物水平的广谱活性，并通过四种缺失机制（MCAR、癌症偏倚、药物偏倚稀疏）、留出预测Brier评分、Bootstrap置信区间及PRISM跨平台复现进行验证。

Result: 在60%缺失率下（MCAR、癌症偏倚、药物偏倚三种稀疏情形），reverse IRT比简单平均更好地恢复全数据潜在排序，优势Delta-rho为+0.089至+0.095；留出预测中IRT在五种方法中取得最佳Brier评分；Bootstrap置信区间显示28种癌症类型中19种具有稳定的耐药/敏感分类；PRISM跨平台复现显示82%方向一致但秩相关较弱（rho=0.25）。

Conclusion: reverse IRT的贡献在于碎片化评价情境下的方法学稳健性，而非构建一个普适的临床耐药排行榜；其排序恢复和预测性能优于简单平均等方法，但跨平台弱秩相关提示结果不宜直接推广为通用的临床耐药排序。

Abstract: We introduce reverse Item Response Theory (IRT) to pharmacogenomic drug-response analysis by treating cancer types as latent "subjects" with resistance ability and drugs as "items" with evasion difficulty. Applied to 242,036 drug sensitivity measurements from the Genomics of Drug Sensitivity in Cancer (GDSC2) database, the model estimates cancer-type-level in-vitro resistance and drug-level broad activity on a shared latent scale. Validation across four missingness regimes demonstrates that reverse IRT better recovers the full-data latent ranking than simple averaging, with advantages of Delta-rho = +0.089 to +0.095 at 60% missingness under MCAR, cancer-biased, and drug-biased sparsity. Held-out prediction confirms IRT achieves the best Brier score among five evaluated methods. Bootstrap confidence intervals show 19 of 28 cancer types have stable resistant/sensitive classifications. Cross-platform PRISM replication shows 82% directional agreement but weak rank-order correlation (rho = 0.25), indicating the contribution is methodological robustness under fragmented evaluation, not a universal clinical resistance leaderboard.

</details>


### [335] [How Far is Adam from Natural Gradient Descent?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00004)
*Vihaan Paka-Hegde*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究Adam优化器完整更新规则（含动量）与自然梯度下降(NGD)的几何关系，将其视为对角经验Fisher近似并受对角截断、经验标签替换和时滞影响。作者用尺度不变的γ(Δθ)度量在四种损失景观下测量Adam相对真实NGD的几何偏差，发现偏差具有上下文依赖性：良态下偏差低，病态下偏差显著上升，神经网络中达约10^3。更高几何漂移与较慢初始优化相关但不损害最终目标最小化。改进经验Fisher(iEF)路径比标准经验Fisher(EF)更稳定。作者认为Adam的实用优化能力可能源于结构近似误差与动量平滑的平衡，而非紧密追随自然梯度路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Adam是深度学习中的标准优化器，但其与自然梯度下降(NGD)的几何关系仍存在未解问题。作者旨在厘清Adam完整更新规则（含动量）在几何意义上与真实NGD的偏差程度及其在不同损失景观下的表现。

Method: 将Adam完整更新规则（含动量）建模为受对角截断、经验标签替换和时滞约束的对角经验Fisher近似。引入尺度不变的γ(Δθ)度量来量化Adam相对真实NGD的几何偏差。在四种损失景观上实验：良态线性回归、病态线性回归、逻辑回归和非凸小型神经网络。同时对比标准经验Fisher(EF)与改进经验Fisher(iEF)的路径稳定性。

Result: Adam的几何轨迹具有上下文依赖性：良态条件下偏差保持低位，病态条件下偏差显著上升，在神经网络中偏差可达约10^3。更高的几何漂移与较慢的初始优化相关，但不损害最终目标最小化，Adam始终能达到低损失。改进经验Fisher(iEF)比标准经验Fisher(EF)追踪更稳定的路径，后者频繁振荡或发散。

Conclusion: Adam的实用优化能力可能源于结构近似误差与动量平滑之间的平衡，而非紧密追踪自然梯度路径。这一发现挑战了将Adam有效性简单归因于其接近自然梯度下降的观点。

Abstract: Adam is the standard optimizer in deep learning, yet its geometric relationship to natural gradient descent (NGD) contains unresolved questions. We study Adam's full update rule, including momentum, as a diagonal empirical Fisher approximation subject to diagonal truncation, empirical label substitution, and temporal lag. Using the scale-invariant $γ(Δθ)$ metric, we measure Adam's geometric deviation from true NGD across four loss landscapes: well-conditioned linear regression, ill-conditioned linear regression, logistic regression, and a non-convex small neural network. Adam's geometric trajectory is context-dependent. Deviation remains low in well-conditioned settings but rises significantly under ill-conditioning, reaching misalignments of $\approx 10^3$ in the neural network. Higher geometric drift correlates with slower initial optimization but does not degrade final objective minimization; Adam consistently reaches low loss. Furthermore, the improved empirical Fisher (iEF) tracks more stable paths than the standard empirical Fisher (EF), which frequently oscillates or diverges. Our results suggest Adam's practical optimization power may stem from a balance of structural approximation errors and momentum smoothing rather than close tracking of the natural gradient path.

</details>


### [336] [FourierQK: Filter Shape, Admissibility and the Leakage-Coverage Law](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00009)
*Athanasios Zeris*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过受控消融实验系统研究了频率折叠注意力（FourierQK）中带通滤波器的最优形状及其作用机理，发现DC与Nyquist分量有害、单尺度最优带宽约σ≈2 bins（段落尺度~70 tokens）、可容许的Mexican Hat DOG滤波器优于高斯滤波器、双侧FFT泄漏随频谱覆盖单调增长、因果Morlet在字符尺度无法超越基线，并据此将FourierQK定位为适用于双向注意力（编码器式）的机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 频率折叠注意力用学习频率上的带通滤波内积替代标准Q/K点积并取得显著增益，但何种滤波器形状最优以及为何最优尚不明确，因此需要系统检验滤波器属性（DC抑制、Nyquist抑制、带宽、中心频率、多尺度覆盖）的作用机制。

Method: 在字符级语言建模任务（TinyShakespeare，6层GPT）上进行受控消融实验，针对DC抑制、Nyquist抑制、带宽、中心频率、多尺度覆盖五个假设分别设计实验，对比不同滤波器形状（高斯、Mexican Hat DOG、因果Morlet）及超参数，以BASE-DOT为基线测量验证损失（val）与增益（Δ nats）。

Result: 主要发现：(1) DC与Nyquist分量主动有害（val≈2.0，等价于相位随机化），证明振荡带通结构不可或缺；(2) 最优单尺度带宽为σ≈2 bins，中心频率位于段落尺度（~70 tokens），相对BASE-DOT获得Δ=+1.15 nats的干净增益；(3) 可容许滤波器（零均值Mexican Hat DOG m=2）优于同尺度非可容许高斯，并对双侧FFT泄漏提供部分防护；(4) 双侧FFT泄漏随频谱覆盖单调增长——窄带滤波器（gap>+4）干净，宽带滤波器（gap<+2）泄漏；(5) 字符尺度的因果时域Morlet（K=128 taps仅覆盖T=256上下文的50%）无法超越BASE-DOT，从而催生了词级MorletQK实验。

Conclusion: FourierQK在双向注意力场景（编码器式，如BERT）中有效，因为训练与推理时均可获得全序列上下文；而自回归生成需要因果频谱变体，如MorletQK（解码器式，如GPT）。代码已开源。

Abstract: Frequency-collapse attention [Zeris, 2026e] achieves large gains over standard dot-product attention by replacing the Q/K dot product with a bandpass-filtered inner product at a learned frequency. A natural follow-up question is: which filter shape works best, and why? We test five hypotheses about filter properties -- DC suppression, Nyquist suppression, bandwidth, centre frequency, and multi-scale coverage -- using a controlled ablation on character-level language modelling (TinyShakespeare, 6-layer GPT). Our main findings are: (1) DC and Nyquist components are actively harmful (val ~= 2.0, equivalent to phase randomisation), confirming that oscillatory bandpass structure is essential, not just any low-dimensional spectral summary; (2) the optimal single-scale bandwidth is sigma ~= 2 bins centred at paragraph scale (~70 tokens), giving a clean gain of Delta = +1.15 nats over BASE-DOT; (3) admissible filters (zero-mean, Mexican Hat DOG m = 2) outperform non-admissible Gaussians at the same scale and provide partial protection against bilateral FFT leakage; (4) bilateral FFT leakage scales monotonically with spectral coverage -- narrowband filters (gap > +4) are clean, wideband filters (gap < +2) are leaky; and (5) causal time-domain Morlet at character scale cannot beat BASE-DOT (K=128 taps covers 50% of T=256 context), motivating word-level experiments in the companion MorletQK paper [Zeris, 2026f]. Together, findings (1)-(5) characterise FourierQK as effective in bidirectional attention settings (encoder-style, e.g. BERT), where full-sequence context is available at both training and inference time; autoregressive generation requires a causal spectral variant such as MorletQK [Zeris, 2026f] (decoder-style, e.g. GPT). Code available at: https://github.com/AthanasiosZeris/energy-gated-attention

</details>


### [337] [Integrating Fairness and Explainability in a Multiple Instance Reinforcement Learning System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00035)
*Bente Hinkenhuis,Seyed Sahand Mohammadi Ziabari,Ali Mohammed Mansoor Alsahag*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究构建了一个结合强化学习多实例学习、对抗性去偏和偏好条件超网络的学生风险预测框架。基线模型分类性能出色，但两个超网络扩展均出现模式坍缩，偏好权重变化无法连续控制公平性与性能的权衡，表明仅靠偏好条件无法保证可控的多目标行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学生表现预测需要既准确又透明的模型以支持有效干预，同时人口统计信息会引入预测不公平的风险，因此需要在可解释的预测框架中嵌入公平性，并实现性能与公平性之间可控的权衡。

Method: 提出一个多目标框架：用多实例学习（MIL）将每个学生表示为弱标记交互的"包"，由强化学习（RL）智能体筛选信息量大的实例供下游分类；结合对抗性去偏实现 Equalized Odds；并评估两种超网络变体，用用户定义的偏好标量连续控制性能与公平性之间的权衡。

Result: 底层 RL-MIL 基线取得很强的分类性能，但两种超网络扩展均发生模式坍缩——改变偏好权重几乎没有沿预期的公平性-性能前沿产生系统性移动。失效归因于目标支配、条件机制中梯度传播薄弱，以及动态生成参数之间的交互作用。

Conclusion: 公平性目标可以整合进可解释的 RL-MIL 流程，但仅靠偏好条件无法保证可控的多目标行为；稳健的公平 RL-MIL 需要显式的梯度平衡机制、目标分离以及稳定性分析。

Abstract: Predicting student performance from educational interaction data requires models that are both accurate and sufficiently transparent to support meaningful intervention, while demographic information introduces an additional risk of unfair predictions. This study investigates a multi-objective framework that combines reinforcement learning-based multiple instance learning (RL-MIL), adversarial debiasing, and preference-conditioned hypernetworks for student-at-risk prediction. MIL represents each student as a bag of weakly labeled interactions, while an RL agent selects informative instances for downstream classification. Two hypernetwork variants are evaluated to determine whether a user-defined preference scalar can continuously control the trade-off between predictive performance and Equalized Odds. The underlying RL-MIL baseline achieves strong classification performance, but both hypernetwork extensions exhibit mode collapse: changing the preference weight produces little systematic movement along the intended fairness-performance frontier. The failure is associated with objective dominance, weak gradient propagation through the conditioning mechanism, and interactions between dynamically generated parameters. The results show that fairness objectives can be incorporated into an interpretable RL-MIL pipeline, but preference conditioning alone does not guarantee controllable multi-objective behavior. Robust fair RL-MIL therefore requires explicit mechanisms for gradient balancing, objective separation, and stability analysis.

</details>


### [338] [Fast Polynomial Transcendentals for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00049)
*Robert Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究用短多项式程序加速LLM中的SFU（特殊函数单元）运算，并在NVIDIA Blackwell GPU上验证了多种替换方案的吞吐提升及对训练行为的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GPU各代在矩阵、特殊函数和内存流水线上的扩展速率不同，导致内核瓶颈随硬件演化而迁移；FlashAttention-4在NVIDIA Blackwell上暴露了这一失衡。作者希望验证短多项式程序能否加速LLM中其他依赖特殊函数单元（SFU）的操作，如sigmoid、tanh、SiLU等激活函数。

Method: 作者先在隔离的IEEE FP16扫描中对比原生PyTorch评估与打包的FMA（融合乘加）程序，覆盖L2驻留和高带宽内存（HBM）驻留工作集。随后在四个GB200集成任务中，用度3或度4的BF16多项式程序替换原生sigmoid、tanh和SiLU：密集SiLU、tanh软封顶注意力、sigmoid注意力和路由专家的Swish门控线性单元（SwiGLU）。这些程序在消费内核内部结合了分析对称性、目标格式舍入和打包算术。

Result: 隔离路径在L2中提升1.19–2.19倍，在HBM中提升1.00–1.70倍。密集SiLU、tanh软封顶注意力和路由专家替换分别使完整训练步吞吐提升2.7%、2.9%和8.0%；sigmoid注意力替换使完整注意力前向提升7.4%，完整GPU步提升0.3%。同一检查点的开放权重消融实验及每任务一次配对预训练比较扩展了对模型行为的评估。在约1000亿token的常见训练进展下，四个任务的最终平滑训练损失差异（多项式减原生）范围为-0.107至+0.079。

Conclusion: 短多项式程序能够有效加速LLM中依赖SFU的运算，在稀疏训练步吞吐上带来2.7%–8.0%的实质提升，同时训练损失差异保持在较小范围内（-0.107至+0.079），表明这种近似替换在性能和模型行为质量之间取得了可接受的平衡。

Abstract: Graphics processing unit (GPU) generations scale matrix, special-function, and memory pipelines at different rates, so kernel bottlenecks move as hardware evolves. FlashAttention-4 exposed this imbalance inside attention on NVIDIA Blackwell. We test whether short polynomial programs can accelerate other special-function-unit (SFU) operations in large language models (LLMs). We first compare native PyTorch evaluation with packed fused multiply--add (FMA) programs in an isolated IEEE binary16 (FP16) sweep spanning L2-resident and high-bandwidth-memory (HBM)-resident working sets. We then replace native sigmoid, tanh, and sigmoid linear unit (SiLU) with degree-3 or degree-4 bfloat16 (BF16) programs in four GB200 integration tasks: dense SiLU, tanh-softcapped attention, sigmoid attention, and routed-expert Swish-gated linear unit (SwiGLU). The programs combine analytical symmetry, target-format rounding, and packed arithmetic inside consuming kernels. The isolated paths improve by 1.19--2.19x in L2 and 1.00--1.70x in HBM. The dense-SiLU, tanh-softcapped-attention, and routed-expert substitutions improve complete training-step throughput by 2.7\%, 2.9\%, and 8.0\%, respectively. The sigmoid-attention substitution improves complete-attention forward by 7.4\% and the complete GPU step by 0.3\%. Same-checkpoint open-weight ablations and one paired pre-training comparison per task extend the evaluation to model behavior. At common horizons near 100 billion tokens, the final smoothed training-loss differences (polynomial minus native) range from $-0.107$ to $+0.079$ across the four tasks.

</details>


### [339] [SW-KAN: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks with Stieltjes-Wigert q-Orthogonal Polynomials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00050)
*Amirhosein Azarpour,Seyyed Moein Kazemi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 SW-KAN，一种基于 Stieltjes-Wigert q-正交多项式的 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络，通过指数-tanh 映射与数值稳定的三项递推，解决多项式 KAN 中无界输入与有界/半无限正交基之间的域不匹配问题，在图像分类与函数逼近上取得更优的精度-效率权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多项式基 KAN 变体虽然降低了原始 B-spline 实现的计算开销，但存在一个根本性且未被充分研究的挑战：无界实值输入与正交多项式基的有界或半无限支撑之间存在域不匹配，制约了模型性能与稳定性。

Method: 提出 Stieltjes-Wigert Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (SW-KAN)，采用定义在半无限域 (0, ∞) 上的 Stieltjes-Wigert q-正交多项式；引入平滑的指数-of-tanh 映射以稳定桥接域差距并保持梯度良态；利用数值稳定的三项递推以 O(N) 复杂度计算多项式展开，无需调用特殊函数；同时利用 Stieltjes-Wigert 多项式的对数正态权重结构与可学习 q 参数提供归纳偏置。

Result: 在图像分类与连续函数逼近等综合实验中，SW-KAN 在多个任务上取得更优的精度-效率权衡；在特征维度降低和训练数据有限的资源受限条件下表现稳健；在标准基准上优于既有多项式 KAN 基线，并能够以极少的参数逼近复杂多元函数。

Conclusion: SW-KAN 通过解决域不匹配问题并引入有效的归纳偏置，成为资源受限场景下高效函数逼近与分类的有力替代方案，展示了 q-正交多项式在 KAN 架构中的潜力。

Abstract: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) represent a paradigmatic shift in deep learning by replacing fixed node activations with learnable univariate functions on edges, offering enhanced interpretability and parameter efficiency. While recent polynomial-based KAN variants have addressed the computational overhead of original B-spline implementations, they introduce a fundamental yet underexplored challenge: the domain mismatch between unbounded real-valued inputs and the bounded or semi-infinite support of orthogonal polynomial bases. To address this limitation, we propose the Stieltjes-Wigert Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (SW-KAN), a novel architecture that employs Stieltjes-Wigert q-orthogonal polynomials defined on the semi-infinite domain (0, infinity). We introduce a smooth exponential-of-tanh mapping that stably bridges the domain gap while preserving well-conditioned gradients, and leverage a numerically stable three-term recurrence that evaluates polynomial expansions in O(N) operations without special-function calls. Through comprehensive experiments spanning image classification and continuous function approximation, we demonstrate that SW-KAN achieves superior accuracy-efficiency trade-offs across diverse tasks. The log-normal weight structure and learnable q-parameter of Stieltjes-Wigert polynomials provide a distinct inductive bias that enables robust performance under resource-constrained conditions, including reduced feature dimensionality and limited training data. The proposed architecture not only outperforms established polynomial KAN baselines on standard benchmarks but also exhibits strong representational capacity for approximating complex multivariate functions with remarkably few parameters, making it a compelling alternative for efficient function approximation and classification in resource-constrained settings.

</details>


### [340] [Format-Aware Fusion for Fast FP4 Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00053)
*Robert Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"格式感知融合"（format-aware fusion），将FP4量化的各个生产者与其尺度域和消费者布局协同设计，显著提升FP4 Tensor Core在大型语言模型预训练中的实际吞吐，并以Llama-3系8B/1600亿token预训练验证了该方法相比bfloat16和Transformer Engine FP8的加速与质量权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FP4 Tensor Core虽能加速矩阵乘法，但尺度计算、操作数打包、布局构建和反向保存状态等开销会抵消其性能收益，导致理论算力无法转化为实际训练吞吐。

Method: 提出格式感知融合，将每个量化生产者与其尺度域和消费者布局协同设计，支持原生mxfp、全局nvfp及协作线程组本地nvfp三种格式；最高效的自定义路线结合了带行梯度随机舍入的mxfp和固定符号32值Hadamard权重梯度预条件；同时对比了Transformer Engine（含四个末端bfloat16块）方案。

Result: 在相同加速器上，bfloat16达18.8K、Transformer Engine FP8达27.6K tokens/s/GPU，而最快自定义路线达37.9K；mxfp（行梯度随机舍入+Hadamard权重梯度预条件）达37.2K，bfloat16模型FLOP利用率为86.3%，训练损失终点比原始bfloat16高2.11%；Transformer Engine四末端bfloat16块方案达27.1K，比bfloat16高0.87%。下游排名与训练损失排名不一致，表明FP4结果同时取决于尺度契约、操作数和执行路径。

Conclusion: FP4训练的性能与质量效果并非由单一因素决定，而是联合依赖于尺度契约、操作数与执行路径；格式感知的协同设计能在几乎不损失甚至略优于bfloat16的质量下，实现约2倍的训练吞吐。

Abstract: Four-bit floating-point (FP4) Tensor Cores accelerate matrix multiplication, but scale computation, operand packing, layout construction, and saved backward state can erase the gain. We present \emph{format-aware fusion}, which co-designs each quantization producer with its scale domain and consumer layout for native \mxfp{}, global \nvfp{}, and cooperative-thread-array-local \nvfp{}. We evaluate Llama-3-family 8B pretraining through 160 billion tokens using bfloat16 output projections and compiled cross entropy. In matched same-accelerator probes, bfloat16 and Transformer Engine \nvfp{} reach 18.8K and 27.6K tokens/s/GPU, while our fastest custom route reaches 37.9K. \mxfp{} with row-gradient stochastic rounding and fixed-sign 32-value Hadamard weight-gradient preconditioning reaches 37.2K tokens/s/GPU (86.3\% bfloat16 model FLOP utilization) and ends 2.11\% above the raw bfloat16 training-loss endpoint. A Transformer Engine recipe with four final bfloat16 blocks ends 0.87\% above bfloat16 at 27.1K tokens/s/GPU. Downstream rankings differ from training-loss rankings, showing that FP4 outcomes depend jointly on scale contract, operand, and execution path.

</details>


### [341] ["very likely" Means "uncertain"? How LLMs Diverge from Humans in Linguistic Uncertainty Quantification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00083)
*Jinhao Duan,Zicheng Liu,Zijie Liu,Kaidi Xu,Tianlong Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究LLM在语言化不确定性表达上与人类的差异，并提出一种基于优化的算法METHODNAME，从LLM输出中学习最优的不确定性标记映射，以实现标记级别的置信语义对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类通过语言标记表达不确定性，而现有LLM不确定性量化(UQ)多依赖似然或一致性信号、忽视语言信号。从认知角度看，准确的语言不确定性反映元认知监控（"知道自己不知道"）。因此有必要探究LLM与人类在语言化不确定性上的差异，以及语言标记能否可靠地量化LLM的不确定性。

Method: 作者先从心理学与决策科学文献中整理人类不确定性标记语料库，并对LLM进行基准测试。随后提出METHODNAME——一种新颖的基于优化的算法，直接从LLM输出中学习不确定性标记上的最优不确定性分布：通过拟合"标记-不确定性"映射以最好地解释经验正确率，从而发现每个语言标记应承载的概率质量，而非通过重复采样估计不确定性。

Result: 实验观察到LLM对语言不确定性的数值编码水平与人类存在显著差异。METHODNAME使人与LLM之间能够在标记层面直接比较置信语义，解耦了这种不匹配，并揭示了语言表达中系统性的置信偏差。

Conclusion: LLM与人类在语言化不确定性表达上存在系统性差异；语言标记可被用于可靠量化LLM不确定性。METHODNAME通过优化学习最优的标记-不确定性映射，为标记级别的置信语义对比提供了有效工具，有助于解耦并暴露LLM的置信偏差。

Abstract: Humans express uncertainty verbally via markers (e.g., "possible," "likely"), yet most LLM uncertainty quantification (UQ) relies on costing likelihood- or consistency-based signals. From a cognitive perspective, accurate verbal uncertainty reflects metacognitive monitoring, representing knowledge boundaries ("knowing that you don't know") to support regulation and information seeking. In this paper, we investigate how LLMs diverge from humans in verbal uncertainty quantification and whether verbal markers can reliably quantify LLM uncertainty. We curate a corpus of human uncertainty markers from psychology and decision-science literature and benchmark LLMs against it. We observe that LLMs encode verbal uncertainty with numerical levels that differ substantially from those of humans. We then introduce METHODNAME, a novel optimization-based algorithm that learns an optimal uncertainty profile over uncertainty markers directly from LLM outputs. By fitting a marker-uncertainty mapping to best explain empirical correctness, METHODNAME discovers how much probability mass each verbal marker should convey, rather than estimating uncertainty via repeated sampling. METHODNAME enables a direct, marker-level comparison of confidence semantics between humans and LLMs, disentangling mismatch and revealing systematic confidence disparities in verbal expressions.

</details>


### [342] [Nous: Learning and Certifying Memory Decisions Before Source Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00094)
*Pranav Singh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究基于信念的记忆系统，证明在证据存在噪声、复制或过期的情况下，记忆系统无需先校准信息源即可学会并认证更优决策。核心结论是：学习与认证决策所需记录数可比信源校准少一个二次方量级（决策 Theta(l^-2) 对校准 Theta(l^-4)）。作者据此提出有限样本认证方法，并在 MiniGrid 记忆环境中验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于信念的记忆系统需要关于当前状态的可靠决策，但其证据可能含有噪声、被复制或已过期。现有做法通常假定必须先对信息源进行校准（估计源可靠性）才能改善决策，而信源校准在持久性 l 趋近于零时需要 Theta(l^-4) 条记录，代价昂贵。本文希望厘清：学习决策、校准信源与认证决策改进这三者能否分离，并回答"记忆是否必须校准其来源才能改进决策"这一核心问题。

Method: 作者将学习、校准与修订认证（revision certification）三者分离处理。在一个四模型隐马尔可夫族上，分别刻画学习未知贝叶斯决策、认证其相对信息性基准（incumbent）的改进、以及固定精度信源估计所需记录数。进一步在未知"身份+背景"报告信道下，刻画策略改进的尖锐可识别区间，并利用可观测的见证区域（witness regions）构造有限样本认证，且无需纯类锚点（pure-class anchors）。稳健性扩展容忍有界历史依赖的模型误设与条件复制；分离训练的见证区域适用于任意历史空间并给出显式功效条件。最后将策略界收据（policy-bound receipts）集成到 Nous Dimensions，并在三个 MiniGrid 记忆环境中引入噪声报告接口进行测试（45,000 条留出可变状态历史与 9,000 个回合），并与强基线与既有认证方法对比。

Result: 学习未知贝叶斯决策需 Theta(l^-2) 条记录，认证其相对信息性基准的改进需 O(l^-2) 条同分布新记录，而固定精度信源估计需 Theta(l^-4) 条记录——因此学习与认证有用决策所需的记录数可比信源校准少一个二次方量级。更广泛的模型类仍保持该决策速率与信源下界。在未知身份+背景报告信道下，作者刻画了策略改进的尖锐可识别区间并给出有限样本认证。实验表明，新认证在 MiniGrid 中对常数基准接受 9/9 改进、对 last-write-wins 接受 4/9，而旧认证均为 0；强基线保持竞争性或更优。

Conclusion: 本文提供了一个统计性论述，说明记忆决策可以在不恢复信源可靠性的情况下被学习并被（统计上）证明合理，而非提出一个普遍更优的记忆算法。该方法通过分离学习、校准与决策认证，量化展示了决策速率与信源估计下界之间的二次方差距，并给出了在未知信道与稳健性条件下的有限样本认证框架，实验结果验证了新认证的有效性。

Abstract: Belief-based agent memory needs reliable decisions about current state, yet its evidence may be noisy, copied, or stale. Must a memory calibrate its sources before it can improve its decisions? We separate learning, calibration, and revision certification. On one four-model hidden Markov family, learning an unknown Bayes decision requires Theta(l^-2) records and certifying its improvement over an informative incumbent takes O(l^-2) fresh records from the same observation law, while fixed-precision source estimation requires Theta(l^-4) as persistence l vanishes. Thus learning and certifying useful decisions can require quadratically fewer records than source calibration. A broader model class retains the decision rate and source lower bound. Under an unknown identity-plus-background report channel, we characterize the sharp identified interval for policy improvement and derive a finite-sample certificate using observable witness regions, without pure-class anchors. A robustness extension tolerates bounded history-dependent misspecification and conditional copying; split-trained witnesses apply to arbitrary history spaces with explicit power conditions. We integrate policy-bound receipts with Nous Dimensions and test 45,000 held-out mutable-state histories and 9,000 episodes in three external MiniGrid memory environments with an introduced noisy-report interface. The new certificate accepts 9/9 improvements over a constant incumbent and 4/9 over last-write-wins, versus none for the earlier certificate in MiniGrid. Strong established inference baselines remain competitive or better. The result is a statistical account of when memory decisions can be learned and justified without recovering source reliability, not a universally superior memory algorithm.

</details>


### [343] [One Mastery Threshold Does Not Fit All Knowledge Tracing Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00095)
*Xianghui Meng,Yujing Zhang,Jionghao Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 掌握阈值在不同知识追踪模型下会产生截然不同的学生进阶决策；文章在四个教育数据集上比较六种KT模型、12个阈值，发现模型输出含义不同（潜在掌握概率 vs. 下一题正确概率）导致阈值不可通用，需按模型与教学优先项重新校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然教学系统依赖掌握阈值决定学生何时停止练习并进阶，但同一数值阈值在底层知识追踪模型改变时会导致决策不一致；已有研究缺乏对不同模型、不同阈值及其在绩效、练习负担、进阶机会与公平性等方面影响的系统比较。

Method: 在四个公开教育数据集上考察六种知识追踪模型（含BKT与多种神经模型），评估从0.50到0.99的12个阈值，使用进阶后表现、进阶覆盖率、练习负担以及不同先前绩效组之间的差异等指标；并在30个预设教学情境下识别能平衡表现、额外练习与进阶机会的最佳阈值。

Result: BKT对阈值变化相对不敏感，而神经模型随阈值升高变得显著更具选择性；原因在于BKT估计潜在掌握概率、神经模型估计下一题正确概率，相同截断值不代表相同掌握水平。最佳平衡阈值随模型和情境差异很大：半数情境下神经模型与BKT所选阈值相差超过0.10，但当更优先减少额外练习并允许更多学生进阶时差距缩小。更严格的阈值并不能可靠缩小绩效差距，反而可能不成比例地限制进阶，强先前绩效学生进阶频率最高可达弱先前绩效学生的3.26倍。

Conclusion: 掌握阈值应在知识追踪模型或教学优先项发生变化时重新校准，并应依据其对表现、练习、进阶与公平获取的影响进行评估，而非沿用固定数值。

Abstract: Tutoring systems use mastery thresholds to decide when students can stop practicing and advance, but the same numerical threshold can lead to very different decisions when the underlying knowledge tracing (KT) model changes. We examine six KT models across four public educational datasets and evaluate 12 thresholds from 0.50 to 0.99 using post-advancement performance, advancement coverage, practice burden, and disparities across prior-performance groups. We also identify thresholds that balance performance, extra practice, and advancement under 30 predefined instructional settings. Bayesian Knowledge Tracing (BKT) is relatively insensitive to threshold changes, while neural models become much more selective as thresholds increase. This partly reflects different model outputs: BKT estimates latent mastery probability, whereas neural models estimate the probability of a correct next response, so the same cutoff does not represent the same level of mastery. The best-balanced threshold varied substantially across models and settings. In half of the tested settings, neural models and BKT differed by more than 0.10 in their selected thresholds, although this gap became smaller when greater priority was placed on reducing extra practice and allowing more students to advance. Stricter thresholds also did not reliably reduce performance gaps and could disproportionately restrict advancement, with stronger-prior students advancing up to 3.26 times as often as weaker-prior students. These results show that mastery thresholds should be recalibrated when the KT model or instructional priorities change and evaluated by their effects on performance, practice, advancement, and access.

</details>


### [344] [Uncertainty-Aware Learning from Multi-Expert Interval Targets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00102)
*Samira Alkaee Taleghan,Younghyun Koo,Andrew P. Barrett,Farnoush Banaei-Kashani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对多专家标注数据中同时存在的标注内不精确（区间）与专家间差异两类不确定性，提出保留个体专家区间、分离并验证预测不确定性成分的方法，在海冰浓度任务上MAE较硬标签降低31%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法将多专家标签的不确定性分开处理：多专家方法将标签坍缩为共识值，区间目标方法只给出单一预测，预测不确定性方法又很少用观测到的专家分歧来验证其不确定性估计。因此需要一种能同时保留个体专家区间、区分标注内不精确与专家间变异、并验证相应预测不确定性成分的方法。

Method: 提出三阶段方法：1）将异构标签词汇统一调和到公共概率标签空间，分离编码差异与专家判断；2）保留个体标签区间，用基于Cramér距离的合适目标训练Beta分布混合模型；3）将预测不确定性分解为成分内（within-component）、成分间（between-component）与模型不确定性，并引入“分解匹配”（decomposition matching）使预测成分与目标标签侧来源对齐。

Result: 在海冰浓度任务上，该方法MAE相较硬标签降低31%，并优于聚合、区间分布和区间回归等基线方法。

Conclusion: 通过保留并区分两类标签不确定性且验证不确定性分解的对应关系，该方法在保留专家分歧信息的同时显著提升预测性能，为处理多专家区间标签提供了有效框架。

Abstract: Many machine learning (ML) applications rely on expert labels, and qualified experts may provide different but plausible interpretations of the same observation. Such variation across expert labels may reflect genuine disagreement or ambiguity rather than annotation error. When individual experts additionally report intervals rather than exact values, the supervision contains two distinct sources of label uncertainty: within-label imprecision and between-expert variation. Existing methods treat these forms separately: multi-expert approaches collapse labels to a consensus, interval-target methods often yield a single prediction, and predictive-uncertainty methods rarely validate their uncertainty estimates against observed expert disagreement. To address this problem, we propose an approach that preserves individual expert intervals, separates within-label imprecision from between-expert variation, and validates the corresponding predictive uncertainty components. First, heterogeneous label vocabularies are harmonized into a common probabilistic label space, separating encoding differences from expert judgement. Second, individual label intervals are retained and modeled with a mixture of Beta distributions trained using a proper Cramér-distance objective, preserving distinct expert-reported labels. Third, we decompose predictive uncertainty into within-component, between-component, and model uncertainty, and evaluate whether these components correspond to within-label uncertainty, between-label uncertainty, and model error, respectively. Because this correspondence is not guaranteed, we introduce decomposition matching, which aligns the predictive components to their intended label-side sources. On sea-ice concentration the model reduces MAE by 31\% over hard labels and outperforms aggregation, interval-distribution, and interval-regression baselines.

</details>


### [345] [The Hidden Costs of 99% Accuracy: A Trustworthiness Audit of the Telco Customer Churn Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00118)
*Soumyadeep Roy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对 IBM Telco Customer Churn 基准数据集（n=7,043）上普遍报道的高准确率（最高99.01%）提出审计，揭示四种被准确率/F1 导向报告所掩盖的可信度缺陷：SMOTE 预分割泄漏、TotalCharges 字段冗余、校准方法缺陷及成本最优阈值与 F1 最优阈值的巨大差异，并提出四项报告清单与可复现实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 客户流失预测文献以准确率和 F1 为中心报告结果，IBM Telco 基准上普遍出现超过95%甚至99%的测试准确率，但这些高指标掩盖了数据泄漏、特征冗余、校准失效和决策阈值错配等可信度问题，导致模型在真实部署中不可靠且代价高昂。

Method: 作者对 IBM Telco Customer Churn 基准进行四方面审计：(1) 对十种分类器、十五个随机种子，比较预分割 SMOTE 与相同泄漏流水线下的类别加权，并用 Wilcoxon 检验量化 SMOTE 过度采样的机制（约36%合成训练点为测试集实例的最近邻插值）；(2) 用 R²=0.999 检验 TotalCharges 与 tenure×MonthlyCharges 的近似决定关系，分析删除该字段对准确率及 TreeSHAP 排名的影响，并提出 R²>0.95 的预建模冗余诊断；(3) 在15种子校准审计中对比 isotonic regression、temperature scaling 等在类别加权树集成（预测概率双峰分布）上的表现；(4) 在 50 美元挽留成本与24个月客户生命周期价值代理下比较成本最优决策阈值与 F1 最优阈值；并在 Iranian Telecom Churn（域内）和 Bank Customer Churn（跨域）上复现 F1（泄漏）与 F2（冗余）发现。

Result: 预分割 SMOTE 使流失类 F1 平均虚增13.1个百分点（每分类器 Wilcoxon p<10⁻⁴），约36%合成训练点为测试集最近邻插值，而类别加权无此虚增；删除 TotalCharges 使准确率变化不足0.2个百分点，但 TreeSHAP 仍将其列为第9大平均绝对归因值，污染 SHAP 解释；isotonic regression 是最稳健的默认校准方法，temperature scaling 在双峰概率分布上失效；成本最优阈值约为 F1 最优阈值的1/5至1/10，每千名客户可节省约77,000美元；F1 泄漏发现可跨域泛化，F2 冗余发现仅在电信域内泛化。

Conclusion: 高准确率/F1 报告掩盖了流失预测中的系统性可信度缺陷。作者提出四要素报告清单——流水线披露、冗余诊断、校准审计与成本敏感阈值——并发布可复现实现，以推动流失预测研究从单纯追求指标转向可部署、可信的评估实践。

Abstract: Customer churn prediction on the IBM Telco Customer Churn benchmark (n = 7,043) routinely reports test accuracies above 95%, with the most cited published study reporting 99.01%. We audit this benchmark for four trustworthiness failures invisible to the accuracy- and F1-centred reporting that dominates the literature. First, pre-split SMOTE inflates churn-class F1 by 13.1 percentage points across ten classifiers and fifteen seeds (Wilcoxon p < 10^-4 per classifier); the same leaky pipeline ordering paired with class weighting yields no inflation, isolating the effect to SMOTE's geometric construction. We measure the mechanism directly: approximately 36% of synthetic training points are nearest-neighbour interpolations of test-set instances. Second, the TotalCharges field is approximately determined by tenure multiplied by MonthlyCharges (R2 = 0.999); removing it changes accuracy by less than 0.2 percentage points, yet TreeSHAP ranks it ninth in mean absolute attribution - a pattern that materially corrupts SHAP-based interpretation. We propose an R2 > 0.95 pre-modelling diagnostic. Third, in a 15-seed calibration audit, isotonic regression is the strongest default; temperature scaling fails on class-weighted tree ensembles whose predicted-probability distribution is bimodal. Fourth, the cost-optimal decision threshold (under a 50 USD retention offer and 24-month CLV proxy) is approximately 5-10 times lower than the F1-optimal threshold, saving approximately 77,000 USD per 1,000 customers. We replicate F1 and F2 on Iranian Telecom Churn (within domain) and Bank Customer Churn (across domain): F1 generalises; F2 generalises only within telecom. We synthesise these findings into a four-component reporting checklist - pipeline disclosure, redundancy diagnostic, calibration audit, and cost-sensitive thresholds - and release a reproducible implementation.

</details>


### [346] [Generalized Biomedicine Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00120)
*Luyao Tang,Yingkai Yang,Hanqi Chen,Jiewei Zheng,Chaoqi Chen,Cheng Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对真实临床中医学影像面临的开放世界偏移（长尾罕见病、细微病灶、层级分类），提出广义生物医学发现（GBD）任务与统一基准，并设计认知启发的 SCAN 方法（预测抑制→惊奇唤起显著性→互补容纳），显著提升新概念发现能力并保持已有临床知识，可插拔地融入现有架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实医学影像存在三类开放世界偏移：长尾分布的罕见病、被正常解剖主导的细微病灶、以及层级化分类体系；而现有开放世界范式多假设平坦且均衡的标签空间，无法应对这些生物医学需求。核心矛盾在于占主导的已知模式形成一个视觉流形，掩盖了细微的新颖性，导致难以发现未知概念。

Method: 提出 SCAN（Surprise-evoked Complementary AccommodatioN），遵循认知启发的感知进程三步走：1）预测性抑制（predictive suppression），过滤掉预期中的正常模式；2）惊奇唤起显著性（surprise-evoked salience），突出显示意外偏差；3）互补容纳（complementary accommodation），将这些偏移整合进全局表示。同时构建了覆盖长尾、异常与分类学感知发现的统一基准 GBD。

Result: 大量实验表明，SCAN 在提升新概念发现效果的同时，大体上保留了已有临床知识；并且能够即插即用地融入现有架构，在医学影像的"已知-未知"权衡中表现更好。

Conclusion: 该工作系统化地定义了广义生物医学发现问题并给出统一基准，SCAN 方法借助认知启发的感知机制有效缓解了已知模式对细微新颖性的遮蔽，为医学影像开放世界学习中平衡已知与未知提供了新思路，代码已开源。

Abstract: In real-world clinical practice, medical images face open-world shifts: (i) long-tailed rare diseases, (ii) subtle lesions dominated by normal anatomy, and (iii) hierarchical taxonomies. Yet most open-world paradigms assume flat, balanced label spaces, leaving these biomedical demands unresolved. We introduce Generalized Biomedicine Discovery (GBD) and a unified benchmark spanning long-tail, anomaly, and taxonomy-aware discovery. Our key insight is that dominant known patterns form a visual manifold that masks subtle novelty. Inspired by expert diagnosis, we propose SCAN (Surprise-evoked Complementary AccommodatioN), which follows a cognition-inspired perceptual progression: it applies predictive suppression to filter expected norms, triggers surprise-evoked salience to highlight unexpected deviations, and performs complementary accommodation to integrate these shifts into global representations. Extensive experiments show that SCAN improves novel concept discovery while generally preserving established clinical knowledge, and it plugs into existing architectures to better navigate the known-unknown trade-off in medical imaging. Code is available at https://github.com/lytang63/generalized-biomedicine-discovery.

</details>


### [347] [Classification Based on Association Rules Algorithm for Breast Cancer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00174)
*Ali Alsalama,Ahmed Kubba,Ghaith Jamjoum,Zaher Al Aghbari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于加权分类的关联规则数据挖掘方法，用于乳腺癌分类，包含规则生成、规则剪枝和规则预测三个核心算法，并通过测试样本验证其可行性与性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 乳腺癌是全球女性死亡率的重要成因，发病率居各类癌症前列。为满足乳腺癌早期检测的需求，研究者日益青睐基于关联规则的分类方法，因为关联规则挖掘产生的规则易于被医学专业人员理解。

Method: 本文提出一种新颖的基于加权分类的关联规则数据挖掘技术，实现包含三个核心算法：规则生成（Rule Generation）用于识别频繁项集并生成关联规则；规则剪枝（Rule Pruning）依据特定准则剔除规则，并根据其对训练数据的影响力将规则分为主组（major）与次组（minor）；规则预测（Rule Prediction）利用剪枝后的规则对测试数据进行分类。

Result: 最终的预测算法在多个测试样本上进行了测试，结果表明该方法具备可行性和良好的分类性能。

Conclusion: 基于加权分类的关联规则方法能够有效用于乳腺癌分类，生成的规则易于理解，方法具有一定的可行性和性能，有助于乳腺癌的早期检测。

Abstract: Breast cancer is a significant contributor to female mortality across the world, displaying one of the highest oc currence rates among the various cancer types. In response to the need for early breast cancer detection, researchers have increasingly turned to association rule-based classification as a favored method. Association Rule mining is a data mining approach which offers the benefit of yielding results that are readily understandable for medical professionals. This paper introduces a novel association rule-based data mining technique for breast cancer classification based on a weighted classification approach. This implementation employs three core algorithms: Rule Generation, Rule Pruning, and Rule Prediction. Rule Generation identifies frequent itemsets and creates association rules. Rule Pruning eliminates rules using specific criteria and separates them into major and minor groups based on their influence on training data. Rule Prediction applies the pruned rules to classify test data. The final prediction algorithm was tested on several testing samples to show the feasibility and performance of the approach.

</details>


### [348] [Four Ways to Grow a Classifier and Why One of Them Cannot Learn](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00180)
*Cagri Temel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在统一的实验协议下，系统检验了构造式分类器中四种"增长"决策各自的收益，并对其中"最自然的加深软决策树方法"给出精确诊断：该方法导致新增层梯度恒为零、完全无法学习，并给出随机扰动的简单修复；其余三种决策各买到一样东西（更小网络、稀疏性、或一无所获）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 构造式分类器在训练过程中通过添加结构（如树的层级、隐藏单元、叶分裂）来增长模型，但缺乏对这些增长决策实际价值的严格度量和诊断。作者希望在同一固定协议下，明确每种增长决策到底"买到"了什么，并特别找出其中一种看似合理却无效的做法及其原因。

Method: 在树结构和构造式模型上，于同一固定协议下评估四种增长决策：(1) 加深软决策树的自然方式——把每个叶子变成一扇门，门的两孩子继承父节点的类别分布（保证函数不变）；(2) 安装前先向残差误差拟合一个新隐藏单元；(3) 分裂期望误差最大的叶子；(4) 在节点获得更具表现力的分裂前要求统计显著性。对无效的加深方法，作者从梯度角度给出数学证明，并提出用对孩子的随机小扰动作为修复。实验采用三个随机种子的五折交叉验证，在 Iris、Wine、Digits 等数据集上进行，所有数字由测量脚本直接插入。

Result: 核心诊断：最自然的加深方式使每个新门的梯度恒等于零；当门取 1/2 时，两个孩子获得完全相同的梯度，因此新增层永远无法学习。与 Net2Net 用噪声打破对称、或最速下降用二阶信息逃离鞍点不同，这里的一阶信息不是弱而是完全缺失。该构造在三个种子的五折交叉验证下，相比从零训练的同深度模型，在 Iris 上损失 19.6 个准确率点、Wine 上 19.1 个、Digits 上 55.6 个。修复方法（对孩子的随机小扰动）几乎不依赖扰动大小。其余决策：先拟合残差再装新单元能获得更小的网络（但非更准确，且在 Digits 上显著损失准确率）；分裂期望误差最大的叶子能获得稀疏性（0.885 准确率仅需 3.7 次分裂，而完整深度六树需 63 个），但在更难问题上损失 4.3 点；要求统计显著性才给予更复杂分裂则一无所获（树更大且更不准确）。

Conclusion: 深入软决策树的自然方式在数学上注定失败（梯度恒为零），必须通过随机扰动打破退化才能学习；实用规则是：添加参数后断言其梯度非零。其余增长决策各有明确、有限的收益。这一诊断澄清了构造式学习中结构与优化的交互，并为设计安全的模型增长策略提供了可操作的检验标准。

Abstract: Constructive classifiers add structure while they train: a level to a tree, a unit to a hidden layer, a split at a leaf. This paper asks what each of four such growth decisions actually buys, measured under one fixed protocol in tree-structured and constructive models, and gives an exact diagnosis and a fix for the one that buys nothing.
  The diagnosis concerns the most natural way to deepen a soft decision tree: turn every leaf into a gate whose two children inherit the parent's class distribution, so that the function is unchanged. I prove that this leaves the gradient of every new gate identically zero and, with the gate at 1/2, gives the two children identical gradients, so the added level can never learn. Unlike the symmetry that Net2Net breaks with noise or the saddle point that splitting steepest descent escapes with second-order information, first-order information here is not weak but absent. Over three seeds of five-fold cross-validation the construction loses 19.6 accuracy points on Iris, 19.1 on Wine and 55.6 on Digits against the same depth trained from scratch. The fix is a small random perturbation of the children, whose size barely matters. The practical rule is one line in a test: after adding parameters, assert that their gradient is nonzero.
  The other three decisions each buy one thing. Fitting a new hidden unit to the residual error before installing it buys a smaller network on every dataset, though not a more accurate one, and on Digits it costs accuracy significantly. Splitting the leaf with the largest expected error buys sparsity, reaching 0.885 with 3.7 splits where a complete depth-six tree uses 63, but loses 4.3 points on a harder problem. Requiring statistical significance before a node receives a more expressive split buys nothing: the tree gets larger and less accurate.
  Every number in the paper is inserted from the measurement script.

</details>
