### [349] [Uncertainty-Aware RL-Controlled Adaptive 3D Mapping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00188)
*Alpay Ozkan,Tunc Ozan Aydin,Marc Pollefeys,Jelena Trisovic,Daniel Barath*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于语义熵、几何曲率与纹理丰富度的体素自适应细分框架，并引入强化学习智能体在用户指定内存预算下自动学习体素细分策略，实现了精度-内存权衡的显式可控，在合成与真实数据集上优于 MAP-ADAPT 和固定分辨率基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 固定分辨率的体素网格在均匀区域浪费内存、在复杂区域丢失细节，效率低下。现有自适应方法（如 MAP-ADAPT）依赖几何启发式和用户自定义语义类别列表，需要专家调参、难以泛化到未见物体，且缺乏显式的内存控制机制。

Method: 提出基于语义熵（刻画标签不确定性）结合几何曲率与纹理丰富度作为场景复杂度线索的自适应体素细分方法，实现无需语义分类体系的原则性分辨率分配；进一步引入强化学习智能体，在用户指定的目标内存预算约束下学习体素细分策略，用单一直观控制参数替代手工调阈值。

Result: 所得多分辨率 TSDF 在合成与真实数据集上相较 MAP-ADAPT 和固定分辨率基线，取得了更高的几何精度、更好的语义一致性以及更优的精度-内存权衡。

Conclusion: 通过语义熵驱动的原则性分辨率分配与强化学习实现的内存可控细分，有效解决了固定分辨率与启发式自适应方法在效率、泛化性和内存控制上的不足，代码与模型已开源。

Abstract: Voxel-based volumetric mapping is fundamental to 3D reconstruction, yet fixed-resolution grids remain inherently inefficient - wasting memory in uniform regions and losing detail in complex ones. Existing adaptive methods, such as MAP-ADAPT, partially address this by varying resolution based on geometry and user-defined semantic class lists, but these heuristics require expert tuning, lack generalization to unseen objects, and provide no explicit mechanism to control memory usage. We propose an adaptive framework that refines voxels based on semantic entropy, which captures label uncertainty, together with geometric curvature and texture richness as scene complexity cues, yielding principled resolution allocation without reliance on semantic taxonomies. To make the accuracy-memory trade-off explicit and user-controlled, we further introduce a reinforcement learning agent that learns voxel subdivision policies under a user-specified target memory budget, replacing hand-tuned thresholds with a single intuitive control parameter. The resulting multi-resolution TSDF achieves higher geometric accuracy, better semantic consistency, and improved memory-accuracy trade-offs compared to MAP-ADAPT and fixed-resolution baselines on both synthetic and real-world datasets. Our code and models are available at https://github.com/alpayozkan/UnRL.

</details>


### [350] [Energy Time-Series Imputation with Differentially Private Diffusion Models via Clipping-Aware Objective Conditioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00209)
*Huizhen Huang,Yu Li,Tao Huang,Chen Hou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向隐私敏感能源时序插补的扩散模型训练方法，通过剪裁感知的目标条件化（timestep-aware objective conditioning）缓解差分隐私训练中低信噪比时步的梯度放大与剪裁问题，从而提升插补效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 能源时序系统常含敏感时间信息，需在差分隐私（DP-SGD）下进行可靠的缺失值恢复。但余弦扩散调度下，晚期时步信噪比低，标准 ε-预测会产生大的预剪裁梯度，这些梯度更易被剪裁，削弱训练优化信号，损害插补质量。

Method: 将目标函数与剪裁之间的相互作用建模为固定阈值 DP-SGD 下的目标优化问题，提出时步感知的目标条件化。具体采用 v-预测缓解晚期时步梯度放大，以静态损失加权作为均匀缩放控制，并引入扩散调度感知的动态加权以在剪裁前实现更强的衰减。

Result: 在五个真实能源时序数据集上，覆盖随机点缺失、连续块缺失、持续停电以及多种缺失程度四种场景。在匹配的 DP-SGD 设置下，所提方法相比 ε-预测基线一致地提升插补效用；梯度诊断显示预剪裁梯度范数的上尾更低、剪裁比例降低，且在晚期低 SNR 时步衰减更强。

Conclusion: 剪裁感知的目标条件化对差分隐私下的能源时序插补有效，能抑制晚期低 SNR 时步的梯度放大、降低剪裁损失，从而在隐私约束下保持更高的插补精度。

Abstract: Reliable recovery of missing measurements is important for monitoring and analysis in energy time-series systems, where fine-grained measurements may contain sensitive temporal information. Diffusion models trained with differentially private stochastic gradient descent (DP-SGD) provide a promising framework for privacy-sensitive energy time-series imputation. Under cosine diffusion schedules, late timesteps correspond to low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) conditions, where standard $\varepsilon$-prediction can induce large pre-clipping gradients. Such gradients are more likely to be clipped, reducing the retained optimization signal. The artificial intelligence (AI) contribution lies in formulating this objective--clipping interaction as an objective optimization problem under fixed-threshold DP-SGD and developing timestep-aware objective conditioning for diffusion-based energy time-series imputation. The method adopts $v$-prediction to mitigate late-timestep gradient amplification, uses static loss weighting as a uniform-scaling control, and introduces diffusion-schedule-aware dynamic weighting for stronger attenuation before clipping. For the engineering application, we evaluate the method on five real-world energy time-series datasets across random point missingness, contiguous block missingness, persistent outages, and multiple missing-data severities. Under matched DP-SGD settings, the proposed method consistently improves imputation utility over the $\varepsilon$-prediction baseline. Gradient diagnostics reveal lower upper-tail pre-clipping gradient norms, reduced clipping fractions, and stronger attenuation at late low-SNR timesteps, supporting the effectiveness of clipping-aware objective conditioning for energy time-series imputation.

</details>


### [351] [Useful to Whom? Sample Value Is Defined Only Relative to the Learner](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00221)
*Yangze Liu,Xiao-Long Yin,Zhongyi Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究核心集选择中"易样本优先"与"几何覆盖"两种准则之间的交叉边界是否随目标学习器（网络结构、容量）变化。通过冻结所选集合并仅更换训练学习器的受控实验，作者证明该边界确实依赖于学习器，并识别出输入网格、步长（stride）和架构（CNN vs ViT）等能移动边界的网络结构因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 核心集选择面临一个关键问题：不同选择准则（如易优先、几何覆盖）在不同预算区间各有优势，其交叉边界是固定的还是取决于具体的学习器？现有研究多默认边界由数据决定，但若学习器会改变同一批样本的相对价值，那么选择策略的优劣就应与目标学习器绑定评估。这一疑问是推动本文的核心动机。

Method: 作者采用"冻结子集干预"的受控实验设计：先按不同准则选出无标签数据集，固定所选子集不变，仅改变训练所用的学习器，观察交叉边界如何移动。具体包括：(1) 在低分辨率 ImageNet-100 上将 ResNet-18 宽度加倍，观察边界移动；(2) 扫描宽度与输入网格的交互，在保持图像信息不变的前提下放大网格，并调节 stride（尤其是移除最后一个下采样 stride）以复现或反转网格效应；(3) 在原生 224px 的 ImageNet-1k 协议下，用 LFrac 与 EL2N 两种探针检验宽度效应；(4) 将卷积系统替换为 ViT，观察几何覆盖是否在整个测量区间胜出。

Result: 在低分辨率 ImageNet-100 上，ResNet-18 宽度加倍使交叉边界从每类 57 个样本移至 85 个，说明学习器改变了同批样本的相对价值。放大输入网格（保留相同图像信息）使边界左移，且该位移随宽度增加而减弱；仅移除最后一个下采样 stride 即可复现左移。原生 224px ImageNet-1k 下，宽度效应较小且依赖探针：LFrac 近乎平坦，EL2N 则适度右移。将卷积系统换成 ViT 后，几何覆盖在整个测量范围内占优，即使易样本子集来自卷积代理。

Conclusion: 研究通过冻结子集干预确立了核心集选择边界的"学习器依赖性"，并指出输入网格、stride、架构等网络结构可移动该边界，但并未给出普适的缩放定律。其实际含义明确：一种选择策略所偏好的预算区间必须针对具体目标学习器来评估。

Abstract: What kind of data does a model need in order to learn? Coreset selection makes this question concrete: under a budget, keep the samples most useful for training. Easy-first and geometric coverage criteria can win in different budget regimes, separated by a crossover boundary. We ask whether this boundary is fixed by the data or changes with the target learner. Controlled experiments freeze the selected subsets and manipulate only the training learner. On low-resolution ImageNet-100, doubling ResNet-18's width moves the crossover from 57 to 85 samples per class: the learner changes the relative value of the same samples. A wider sweep reveals an interaction between input grid and capacity. Enlarging the grid while retaining the same image information shifts the boundary left, and this shift weakens as width increases. Stride controls reproduce and reverse the grid effect without changing the input grid; removing only the last downsampling stride is sufficient to recover the leftward shift. Under the native-224px ImageNet-1k protocol, width effects are smaller and depend on the probe: LFrac remains nearly flat, while EL2N shifts modestly right. Swapping the convolutional learning system for a ViT makes coverage win throughout the measured range, even when the easy subsets come from the convolutional proxy. These results establish learner dependence through frozen-subset interventions and identify network structure that can move the boundary. They do not yield a universal scaling law. Their practical implication is direct: a selection strategy's preferred budget regime must be evaluated with respect to the target learner.

</details>


### [352] [Constant-Memory Recall: Learned Associations in a Fixed Matrix State](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00232)
*Samuel Larson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该摘要研究了一个小规模 DeltaNet 变体，利用固定 token 特定键偏置，用 32 KiB 循环矩阵状态记住每序列 32 个新键值对，在三个训练种子下达到 99.95% 的召回准确率，且上下文延长到 1,798 个 token 仍保持近完美召回；但参数匹配的向量和 Transformer 基线仍接近随机水平，导致无法进行记忆效率比较。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 固定大小循环记忆在推理时限制存储增长，但其召回成功与否取决于任务和训练方式。作者希望探究一个具有固定 token 特定键偏置的小型 DeltaNet 变体，在记忆新键值对任务上的召回能力及其容量极限，从而为循环记忆的记忆效率评估奠定基础。

Method: 作者采用一个小型 DeltaNet 变体，为每个 token 赋予固定的键偏置（fixed token-specific key biases），训练其每个序列记住 32 个新的键值对。模型使用 32 KiB 的循环矩阵状态，在三个不同训练种子下进行训练，并测试：在序列的值中进行选择时的召回准确率；将 pre-query 上下文用填充内容延长至 1,798 个 token（但不新增键值对）时的召回；以及将首个记忆块清零对召回的影响。此外还进行了 48 对键值的探索性测试（训练预算仅为原始训练的四分之一），并构建了参数匹配的向量基线（vector baseline）和 Transformer 基线用于对比。

Result: 在三个训练种子下，DeltaNet 变体在选择序列内值时达到 99.95% 的平均准确率；当填充内容将 pre-query 上下文延长至 1,798 个 token（不增加配对数）时，召回仍接近完美；将首个记忆块清零会消除这种召回能力。48 对的探索性测试在四分之一训练预算后仍接近随机水平，未能定位容量上限。参数匹配的向量基线和 Transformer 基线仍接近随机水平，即便对 Transformer 进行额外训练搜索后亦然。

Conclusion: 固定 token 特定键偏置的小型 DeltaNet 变体能够以仅 32 KiB 的循环矩阵状态高精度地实现新键值对的召回，并在长上下文下保持稳定，证明循环记忆的记忆效率潜力。然而，由于参数匹配的向量和 Transformer 基线未能超过随机水平，这一未解决的基线失败使作者无法完成与这些基线之间的记忆效率对比，容量极限也尚未定位。

Abstract: Fixed-size recurrent memory limits storage growth during inference, but successful recall depends on the task and training. We study a small DeltaNet variant with fixed token-specific key biases, trained to remember 32 new key-value pairings per sequence. With 32 KiB of recurrent matrix state, it achieves 99.95% mean accuracy across three training seeds when choosing among the sequence's values. Recall remains near perfect when filler extends the pre-query context to 1,798 tokens without adding pairings. Zeroing the first memory block removes this recall. An exploratory 48-pair test remains near chance after one quarter of the primary training budget and does not locate a capacity limit. Parameter-matched vector and Transformer baselines remain near chance, including the Transformer after additional training searches. This unresolved baseline failure prevents a memory-efficiency comparison.

</details>


### [353] [How Many Categories Are Enough? Distribution-Free Certification Limits for Few-Shot Anomaly Thresholds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00236)
*Gia Huy Thai,Nguyen Thai Anh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文研究少样本异常检测器在部署时所需的受控虚警率（FAR）报警阈值能否用少量正常样本（图像或类别级）可靠标定。结果显示目标类留一图像标定分辨率受限且对分布偏移脆弱；推导出类别数可行性下界（α=0.20/0.10/0.05 分别至少需 14/29/59 个 iid 类别）；并提出 CRESS 协议，发现仅用 3–4 个类别时所有配置只能返回 fail-closed 阈值 τ*=0，类别级 UCB 最低仅 0.950，而图像级分析虽能在 36.7%–60.3% 目标单元中选出正阈值，但其界只对所选源混合成立，不能外推到新类别的边缘风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 少样本异常检测器通常用排序指标（如 AUROC）评估，但实际部署需要带受控虚警率的报警阈值。作者关心：对一个未见过的类别，需要多少正常证据（以图像或类别为单位）才能可靠地标定这样一个阈值，并使其 FAR 得到统计保证。

Method: 采用冻结的 DINOv2 主成分分析（PCA）残差排序器，在 15 个 MVTec 和 12 个 VisA 类别、四种损坏类型下进行实验。首先用目标类留一图像（LOIO）标定评估其分辨率和鲁棒性；其次推导类别计数可行性演算，证明任何确定性、一致有效、无分布的 95% 上置信界（UCB）所需的最少 iid 类别数；最后提出跨类别可靠性估计与源支持（CRESS）协议，将源类别划分为参考、提案与认证三个不相交角色，并对比类别级与图像级分析。

Result: LOIO 标定存在分辨率限制（rank 值不能低于 1/(k+1)），且在 α=0.20、k=4 时高斯损坏 MVTec 上经验 FAR 达 0.341，为标称水平的 1.7 倍，对偏移脆弱。类别数演算表明：即使类别损失全为零且不计多重性，95% UCB 在 α=0.20/0.10/0.05 下分别至少需要 14/29/59 个 iid 类别，且该数量必要而非充分。CRESS 协议下，仅用 3–4 个认证类别时全部 960 个冻结配置都返回 fail-closed 阈值 τ*=0，最小类别级 UCB 为 0.950；图像级分析则在 36.7%–60.3% 目标单元中选出正阈值，但这些界仅对所选源混合有效，不能外推到新类别抽取的边缘风险。

Conclusion: 论文贡献在于给出了定量的可行性边界，并提出一个具备估计目标感知（estimand-aware）能力的 CRESS 协议，明确界定了何时源证据能够或不能支撑可迁移的可靠性声明。总体上，用少量类别/图像可靠地标定 FAR 阈值在统计上极难，现有基于源类别的证据不足以对未见类别提供有效的虚警率保证。

Abstract: Few-shot anomaly detectors are judged by ranking metrics, yet deployment requires an alarm threshold with a controlled false-alarm rate (FAR). We ask how much normal evidence, in images or category units, is needed to certify such a threshold for an unseen category. Using a frozen DINOv2 principal component analysis (PCA) residual ranker on 15 MVTec and 12 VisA categories under four corruption types, we show that target-only leave-one-image-out (LOIO) calibration is resolution-limited and shift-fragile: rank values cannot fall below $1/(k+1)$, and at the attainable level $α=0.20$, empirical FAR reaches 0.341 on Gaussian-corrupted MVTec at $k=4$, 1.7 times the nominal level. A category-count feasibility calculus is then derived: even with all-zero category losses and no multiplicity charged, any deterministic, uniformly valid, distribution-free 95% upper confidence bound (UCB) requires at least 14, 29, and 59 independent and identically distributed (iid) category draws at $α=0.20$, $0.10$, and $0.05$; these counts are necessary but not sufficient. The Cross-category Reliability Estimation with Source Support (CRESS) protocol splits source categories into disjoint reference, proposal, and certification roles. With only three or four certification categories, all 960 frozen configurations return the fail-closed threshold $τ^\star=0$, and the smallest category-level UCB is 0.950. Image-unit analyses of the same archive select positive thresholds in 36.7% to 60.3% of target cells; these bounds hold for the selected source mixture, not for the marginal risk of a new-category draw. The contribution is a quantitative feasibility boundary and an estimand-aware protocol specifying when source evidence can, and cannot, support a transferable reliability claim.

</details>


### [354] [Partial AUC Maximization from Positive-unlabeled Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00284)
*Atsutoshi Kumagai,Tomoharu Iwata,Taishi Nishiyama,Hiroshi Takahashi,Kazuki Adachi,Yasuhiro Fujiwara*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种仅利用正例与无标签（PU）数据来最大化部分受试者工作特征曲线下面积（pAUC）的方法，无需负例标签，并通过十个真实数据集验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: pAUC 是二元分类的重要性能指标，但现有最大化 pAUC 的方法通常需要正负样本标签。实践中负例数据常因隐私或标注专业门槛高而难以获取，因此需要一种无需负例即可训练高 pAUC 分类器的方法。

Method: 在经验风险最小化框架下，作者证明了 pAUC（包括其依赖假阳性率 FPR 的阈值）可以仅用正例密度与边缘密度表示，并据此从 PU 数据推导出经验估计量；随后通过最大化该平滑后的经验 pAUC 估计量来训练分类器。

Result: 在十个真实世界数据集上的实验结果表明，所提方法能够仅利用正例和无标签数据有效训练出高 pAUC 分类器，验证了其有效性。

Conclusion: 该方法成功将 pAUC 最大化问题迁移到 PU 学习场景，摆脱了对负例标签的依赖，为隐私受限或负例标注困难的真实应用提供了可行方案。

Abstract: The partial area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (pAUC) is an important performance metric for binary classification that summarizes true positive rates within a specific range of false positive rates (FPRs). Classifiers that achieve high pAUC need to be obtained in many real-world applications such as cybersecurity, medical care, and advertising. Although many methods for maximizing the pAUC have been proposed, they typically require both labeled positive and negative data for training. However, in practice, labeled negative data are often difficult to collect due to privacy concerns or the need for high expertise to annotate them. In this paper, we propose a method for maximizing the pAUC from positive and unlabeled (PU) data without negative data. Within an empirical risk minimization framework, we show that the pAUC, including its FPR-dependent thresholds, can be represented using only the positive and marginal densities, and derive an empirical estimator from PU data. A classifier is then trained by maximizing the derived smoothed empirical pAUC estimator. We experimentally demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method with ten real-world datasets.

</details>


### [355] [Contingent Exposure Routing for Financial AI: Outage Risk and the Cost of Indivisible Decisions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00239)
*Shivam Gupta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出一种可审计的故障转移路由压力测试框架，研究金融机构在端点故障后共享备份所导致的决策错误集中风险，并通过随机化路由与舍入策略在不可分决策下降低预期平方价格位移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型故障转移虽能恢复可用性，但会改变共享决策错误的金融机构集合，产生新的集中性风险。现有路由方案缺乏对故障后价格冲击的量化与可审计的评估手段，尤其是在端点数量增长、备份共享以及决策不可分等真实约束下，风险的衰减行为并不清楚。

Method: 通过局部市场冲击响应矩阵刻画停机条件路由，以预期平方价格位移为风险指标；在对称构造下分析共享备份随主端点数量增长时的集中下界，以及均衡回退风险随幸存端点数的衰减；对不可分决策，推导独立随机化路由的精确二阶矩与有效敞口粒度，并用条件期望舍入给出无耦合配额的有限智能体界；另设计保持端点计数的交换过程并与对偶下界对比。实验覆盖60个合成组合网络与11,340次情景评估，并对1,024条记录的API响应在重平衡任务上回放验证。

Result: 共享备份在端点数量增长时仍留下O(1)阶的集中下界，而均衡回退风险随幸存端点数近似反比下降。在中心反馈、独立误差设定下，交换过程在单端点和双端点移除时分别降低风险6.57%和10.53%；API回放任务上的保留样本降幅为3.30%（配对自助区间2.07–4.57%）。强对齐误差、劣质端点及不可分性会限制分散化收益。

Conclusion: 该贡献是一个可审计的路由压力测试与实现分析框架，用于量化故障转移引发的决策错误集中，而非对真实市场崩盘概率的估计。随机化路由结合舍入与交换程序能在不可分决策下有效降低风险，但分散化效果受误差相关性、端点质量和粒度约束限制。

Abstract: Model failover restores availability, but changes which financial institutions share decision errors. We formulate outage-contingent routing through a local market-impact response matrix and study expected squared price displacement. A symmetric construction shows that a shared backup can leave an order-one concentration floor as the number of primary endpoints grows, while balanced fallback risk decreases inversely with the surviving endpoint count. For indivisible decisions, we derive the exact second moment of independent randomized routing and an effective-exposure granularity that determines its gap from fractional allocation. Conditional-expectation rounding gives a finite-agent bound without coupled quotas; a separate swap procedure preserves endpoint counts and is assessed against dual lower bounds. Across 60 synthetic portfolio networks and 11,340 scenario evaluations, the latter reduces risk by 6.57% and 10.53% for single and double endpoint removals at the central feedback setting with independent errors. A replay of 1,024 recorded API responses on constructed rebalancing tasks gives a smaller held-out reduction of 3.30% (paired bootstrap interval 2.07--4.57%). Strongly aligned errors, inferior endpoints, and indivisibility limit diversification. The contribution is an auditable routing stress test and implementation analysis, not an estimate of real-market crash probabilities.

</details>


### [356] [M$^2$Weather: A Benchmark for Joint Multi-Station and Multi-Variable Weather Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00370)
*Rongwen Li,Xiao Wang,Mingyang Wang,Hongwu Liu,Changjian Chen,Zhuo Tang,Kenli Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 M²Weather 基准，用于联合多站点、多变量的天气预测，通过多尺度数据（法国、欧洲、全球）、统一训练评估协议和一个轻量级即插即用适配器，系统检验站点间与变量间关系对预测的贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 站点天气预测同时受站点间复杂空间依赖和天气变量间强物理耦合影响，但现有研究往往分开考虑这两类关系，且使用不同数据集和实验设定，难以系统评估两者各自及联合的贡献。

Method: 构建 M²Weather 基准：通过多准则质量控制与站点分层收集 2809 个高质量站点，覆盖法国、欧洲、全球三个空间尺度及 5 个物理耦合变量；制定统一训练与评估协议以保证不同站点-变量建模范式可公平比较；设计轻量级、即插即用适配器，在不重新训练模型的前提下引入缺失的站点或变量关系，用于公平高效地探究站点-变量关系。

Result: 对 16 个代表性模型进行系统评估，结果表明联合建模站点与变量关系能带来收益；补齐缺失关系后，所有适配模型在三个数据集上的 MSE 均进一步下降。

Conclusion: 站点间与变量间的互补信息是改进站点天气预测的重要资源，联合建模两类关系是提升预测性能的有效途径。

Abstract: Station weather forecasting is fundamentally shaped by both complex spatial dependencies across stations and strong physical coupling among weather variables. However, existing studies often consider these relationships separately and use different datasets and experimental settings, hindering systematic assessment of their individual and joint contributions. In this paper, we introduce $M^2$Weather, a benchmark for joint multi-station and multi-variable weather forecasting. Through multi-criteria quality control and station stratification, we collect 2,809 high-quality stations with 5 physically coupled weather variables across three spatial scales: France, Europe, and Global. This multi-scale design lets us examine whether conclusions persist from national to global station networks. We also introduce unified training and evaluation protocols to enable fair comparison of different station-variable modeling paradigms. To further examine the benefits of modeling station-variable relationships, we design a lightweight, plug-and-play adapter. With a trained weather forecasting model, this adapter can introduce missing station or variable relationships without retraining the model. This enables fair and efficient investigation of station-variable relationships. Systematic evaluation of 16 representative models shows the benefits of jointly modeling station and variable relationships. Completing missing relationships further reduces MSE for all adapted models on all three datasets. Together, these results identify the complementary information across stations and variables as an important resource for improving station weather forecasting. Our code can be obtained at https://github.com/hnu-vis/M2-Weather.

</details>


### [357] [The Null Is the Hard Part: Exact Tests for Memorization in Generative Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00251)
*Sushovan Majhi,Pramita Bagchi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出生成模型记忆审计缺乏零分布（null distribution）会导致错误结论，并提出基于置换检验和校准对照的两种零假设与稳健审计方法，用于检测图像生成模型的记忆/复制行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有记忆审计方法（如 MemBench）通过将相似度分数与固定阈值比较得出结论，但没有零分布，因而可能产生错误结论；数据复制检验按自身零假设也会将大量不复制任何内容的生成器误判为复制。因此亟需为记忆检测建立正确的零假设与统计校准。

Method: 提出两类零假设与对应统计检验：(1) 模型级零假设——给定模型样本，训练图像与留出图像可交换，通过随机重贴标签构成置换检验，在留出图像为随机划分时对任意统计量精确成立；(2) 单图像级零假设——将图像在随机图像中排序、或用独立生成结果重采样，并与匹配对照进行校准，控制 5% 假发现率（FDR）。推荐尺度受限统计量为交欧拉特征廓线（Intersection Euler Characteristic Profile）的小尺度质量，可用于计数被复制的独立图像并检验两个模型是否复制相同图像。

Result: 按 MemBench 规则，基准的缓解措施将 Stable Diffusion 的记忆约减半；但在假发现控制审计下，三分之二的认证图像在随机提示扰动下不再被检出，六分之五在注意力重缩放下不再检出，全部在嵌入优化下不再检出。数据复制检验按自身零假设标记了 24 个生成器中的 10 个，而它们并未复制任何内容。置换检验下最近邻偏好仍在其中 7 个上触发，而限定在近似重复尺度的计数在 0 个上触发（McNemar p=0.016）。校准审计在 5% FDR 下认证 MemBench 61 张图像中的 36 张，留出对照在 0.01% 的校准划分中被认证，每图两次生成即可恢复该计数；校准最大值（读取偶发而非典型复制）认证 46 张。

Conclusion: 对于记忆审计，零分布（而非相似度分数）才是关键难点。通过置换检验和校准对照可显著修正现有审计的结论，避免高估或低估复制行为，并推荐交欧拉特征廓线的小尺度质量作为尺度受限统计量以稳健检测记忆。

Abstract: Memorization audits of generative models read similarity scores against thresholds, with no null distribution, and the conclusions they support can be wrong. By MemBench's rule, the benchmark's mitigations roughly halve Stable Diffusion's memorization; audited with false-discovery control, two thirds of the certified images are no longer detected under random prompt perturbations, five sixths under attention rescaling, and all of them under embedding optimization. The field's data-copying test, read against its own null, flags ten of twenty-four generators that reproduce nothing. We argue that for memorization the null is the hard part, and supply two. For a whole model, training and held-out images are exchangeable given its samples, and relabelling them is a permutation test, exact for any statistic when the held-out images are a random split; under it, a nearest-neighbour preference still fires on seven of those twenty-four, and a count restricted to the near-duplicate scale on none (McNemar p=0.016). For single images, the natural nulls fail twice, measurably: ranking an image among random images yields 596 false discoveries among 2,365 controls, and resampling independent generations makes the null three times too narrow. Calibrated against matched controls, the audit certifies 36 of 61 MemBench images at 5% false-discovery rate, held-out controls are certified in 0.01% of calibration splits, and on this benchmark two generations per image recover that count. A calibrated maximum, which reads occasional rather than typical copying, certifies 46. As the scale-restricted statistic we recommend the small-scale mass of the Intersection Euler Characteristic Profile, which also counts distinct images copied and tests whether two models copy the same ones.

</details>


### [358] [STCFormer: Adaptive Spatio-Temporal Modeling with Dynamic Cluster Transformer for Station-based Weather Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00377)
*Rongwen Li,Haixin Xie,Mingyang Wang,Hongwu Liu,Kun Fang,Changjian Chen,Zhuo Tang,Kenli Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: STCFormer 提出一种自适应时空 Transformer，在每个时间片段内根据站点局部演化动态分组，并结合簇内细粒度局部注意力与跨簇全局注意力，在8项天气预测任务上取得最低24小时均方误差，并在48项对比中47项排名第一或第二。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于聚类的选择性建模虽优于稠密交互，但存在两个不足：一是观测窗口内共享固定分组会掩盖站点关系的局部动态变化；二是仅依赖簇内交互可能丢失跨簇的全局上下文。同时，选择性交互相比稠密连接的理论优势尚缺乏形式化理解。

Method: 提出 STCFormer，其核心为 Cluster-Guided Attention Block，在每个时间片段内依据站点局部演化动态分组，将簇内细粒度局部注意力与基于区域状态摘要的全局注意力相结合。作者进一步推导出簇条件局部注意力的 Lipschitz 上界不超过全连接对应形式，从理论上解释其鲁棒性优势，并据此设计 InfoLoss 以引导学习。

Result: 在三个真实天气数据集、覆盖八个气温与风速预测任务的实验中，STCFormer 在所有八个任务上取得最低的 24 小时均方误差，并在跨指标与预测时长的 48 项对比中 47 项排名第一或第二。消融实验和案例研究验证了局部自适应分组及互补的局部-全局交互带来的收益。

Conclusion: STCFormer 通过局部自适应分组与互补的局部-全局注意力，有效建模站点间时空依赖，并在理论与实验层面证明选择性交互优于稠密连接，在天气预测任务上表现出显著的准确性优势。代码已开源。

Abstract: Station-based weather forecasting supports daily life and economic activity, yet accurate forecasts require modeling complex spatial dependencies among stations. Recent clustering-based selective modeling offers a promising alternative to dense inter-station interactions. However, a grouping shared across an observation window may obscure local changes in station relationships, while intra-cluster interactions alone may miss important global context. The theoretical advantages of selective interactions over dense connectivity also remain insufficiently understood. We therefore propose STCFormer, an adaptive spatio-temporal Transformer that dynamically groups stations according to their local evolution within each temporal patch. Its Cluster-Guided Attention Block combines fine-grained local attention within clusters and global attention over regional state summaries, allowing each station to access information beyond its own cluster. We further show that a derived Lipschitz upper bound for cluster-conditioned local attention is no larger than its fully connected counterpart, explaining a potential robustness benefit and motivating the design of InfoLoss. Experiments on three real-world weather datasets spanning eight temperature and wind forecasting tasks show that STCFormer achieves the lowest 24-hour mean squared error on all eight tasks and ranks first or second in 47 of 48 comparisons across metrics and forecasting horizons. Ablations and case studies further confirm the benefits of locally adaptive grouping and complementary local-global interactions. Our code can be obtained at https://github.com/hnu-vis/STCFormer.

</details>


### [359] [Sharp Oracle-Regret Tradeoffs for Projection-Free Online Convex Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00254)
*Vaneet Aggarwal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: We characterize the regret attainable in online convex optimization when access to the feasible set is limited to an exact linear optimization oracle. The learner is given an inscribed ball and a diameter bound and must remain feasible on every consistent instance. For convex $G$-Lipschitz losses, diameter at most $D$, a total allowance of $Q$ oracle calls, and a strict limit of $B$ calls per round, the dimension-free minimax expected regret is $Θ(GD\max\{\sqrt T,T/(1+\min\{Q,BT\})^{1/4}\})$. The lower bound applies to arbitrary randomized learners. Universal feasibility first forces each action into the hull of the supplied ball and the preceding oracle replies. A fixed-body construction then couples fresh phase directions to a shared simplex, making useful replies costly repeatedly even though all losses have a common minimizer. A counted approximate-gradient method with interleaved blocks attains the matching rate. Total-budget and strict per-round guarantees follow as special cases, including the $T^{3/4}$ rate with one call per round and the quadratic total budget needed for $\sqrt T$ regret. For prescribed smoothness $β$, an analytic construction yields a curvature-dependent lower bound and identifies the threshold above which the general characterization remains sharp.

</details>


### [360] [FAER: Auditable Utility-Aligned Trajectory Replay for Language Model Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00385)
*Miaobo Hu,Shuhao Hu,Xiaobo Guo,Xin Wang,Bokun Wang,Tianshu Fu,Daren Zha,Jun Xiao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 FAER，一个可审计的全轨迹回放框架，用于弥合“回放选择”与“下游学习器效用”之间的差距，并在 GSM8K 上验证其优于固定选择器、均匀采样与格式反馈等方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有回放选择器常按格式反馈、置信度、新鲜度或响应长度对缓存轨迹排序，但这些代理指标与缓存级正确性、下游学习器实际效用并非同一目标，存在“选择到学习”的差距，需要形式化并解决这一差距。

Method: 形式化“选择到学习”差距，并提出 FAER 可审计全轨迹回放框架：其免训练的固定选择器作为协议基线；FAER-UTILITY 是基于不相交校准块拟合的“学习器感知”选择器。以归一化梯度对齐作为基线，用一次性的优化器感知虚拟更新构造幅值感知的效用曲面。审计合约在评估标签接入前冻结已观测字段与回放轨迹。

Result: 在 GSM8K 上使用 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 的配对学习器研究：128 次更新下固定选择器质量 0.6329，均匀采样 0.5482，格式反馈 0.6037。仅用元数据的交叉拟合校准在 8 个种子上达到 0.6476±0.0139（中位数 0.6481；配对 95% 区间 [+0.079,+0.122]），目标运行 63,276 token，含校准的总成本为 189,642 token、3.48 GPU 小时。完整 FAER-UTILITY 行达到 0.6624（62,844 token、4.26 GPU 小时）。格式反馈选出的记录正确性为 0.6953，而固定选择器为 0.3594，尽管二者下游排序不同。完整对比还呈现了学习器感知消融、同种子差距、策略优化行及严格零样本迁移。

Conclusion: FAER 通过冻结字段与轨迹的可审计合约，以及学习器感知的效用选择器，能有效提升回放质量并缩小选择与下游效用之间的差距，且成本可控，优于统一采样与格式反馈等基线。

Abstract: Replay selectors often rank cached trajectories by format feedback, confidence, freshness, or response length, although cache-level correctness and downstream learner utility are distinct objectives. We formalize this selection-to-learning gap and introduce FAER as an auditable full-trajectory replay framework. Its training-free fixed selector is a protocol baseline; FAER-UTILITY is the learner-aware selector fitted on disjoint calibration blocks. The normalized gradient alignment is reported as a baseline, while a disposable optimizer-aware virtual update supplies a magnitude-aware utility surface. The audit contract freezes observed fields and replay traces before evaluation labels are joined. On GSM8K with Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, the matched learner study reports quality 0.6329 for the fixed selector, compared with 0.5482 for uniform and 0.6037 for format-feedback under 128 updates. Metadata-only cross-fitted calibration reaches $0.6476\!\pm\!0.0139$ over eight seeds (median 0.6481; paired 95% interval $[+0.079,+0.122]$) at 63,276 target-run tokens; its recorded full cost is 189,642 tokens and 3.48 GPU-hours including calibration. The completed FAER-UTILITY row reaches 0.6624 at 62,844 target-run tokens and 4.26 GPU-hours. Format-feedback selects records with correctness 0.6953, compared with 0.3594 for the fixed selector, despite the different downstream ranking. The completed comparison surfaces report the learner-aware ablation, same-seed gap, policy-optimization rows, and strict zero-shot transfer.

</details>


### [361] [Verification Pulses and the Cost of Escaping Wrong Consensus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00256)
*Shivam Gupta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究在异步二元寄存器中，固定验证预算的时机与投放对象如何影响群体从错误共识中恢复的概率，并给出临界预算窗口的渐近刻画。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 外部验证能纠正个别输出，但可能让自我强化的群体仍停留在错误共识的吸引域内。因此需要理解在固定验证预算约束下，验证的时序安排与目标选择如何决定能否穿越吸引域边界、实现恢复。

Method: 对一般非线性响应，在峰值验证约束下推导穿越吸引域边界所需的最小“燃料”；对有限群体，用精确的出生-死亡过程计算脉冲验证后仍落入错误共识的概率；并将理论结果与一个预先登记的语言模型实验（13,392 条响应、含校准与 108 条留出轨迹）进行对比。

Result: 主渐近结果给出临界预算窗口：主项为 N log(x0/b)，修正项为 O(√N)，方差来自重复验证目标与验证停止后自主放大的各自贡献。示例中，16 个多数更新槽、14 个初始错误时，9 次随机检查即越过平均场预算阈值，但在精确模型中需 23 次才能以 95% 概率最终恢复。实验拟合出不同响应机制，但四个调整后的时间表比较区间均含零；分布审计发现适度的平均预测误差可能掩盖对终端共识占据率的大幅低估。

Conclusion: 结果支持在明确更新的合约下进行风险校准的重置调度，并将其与针对不同目标的检查及无限制证据广播明确区分。

Abstract: External verification can correct individual outputs while leaving a self-reinforcing population in the basin of a wrong consensus. We study how the timing and addressing of a fixed verification budget affect recovery in an asynchronous binary register. For a general nonlinear response, we derive the minimum fuel required to cross a basin boundary under a peak verification constraint. For a finite population, an exact birth--death calculation gives the probability of subsequent wrong consensus after a pulse. Our main asymptotic result identifies the critical budget window: a leading term $N\log(x_0/b)$ and a correction of order $\sqrt N$, with separate variance contributions from repeated verification targets and autonomous amplification after verification stops. The distinction is substantial: with 16 majority-updated slots and 14 initially wrong, 9 random checks cross the mean-field budget threshold, whereas 23 are required for 95% eventual recovery in the exact model. A prospectively specified experiment records 13,392 language-model responses, including calibration and 108 held-out trajectories. Calibration produces different fitted response regimes, but all four adjusted schedule-comparison intervals include zero. A distributional audit also finds that modest mean-prediction error can conceal a large underestimate of terminal consensus occupancy. The results support risk-calibrated reset scheduling under a specified update contract, while explicitly separating it from distinct-target checking and unrestricted evidence broadcast.

</details>


### [362] [MatrixReward: Reward from Rubric Matrix for Open-Ended Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00389)
*Zihan Shen,Qi Liu,Zixuan Yang,Yiqun Chen,Chenglong Zhao,Xiaozhao Wang,Lei He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MatrixReward 提出一种基于逐条评分标准(rollout-by-rubric)胜率矩阵的奖励构造方法，通过相对比较与数据相关权重来替代传统点式打分，在开放式问答基准上优于最强基线约2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放式问题生成缺乏标准答案，需要有效的奖励机制；而逐点打分式评分标准(pointwise rubric)提供的信息有限——既无法刻画同一提示下不同样本答案的相对优劣，将其合并为单一分数还可能掩盖答案间的差异。

Method: 提出 MatrixReward：先对同一提示下的每对采样响应在各评分标准下进行比较，构建 rollout×rubric 的胜率矩阵；利用每列数据的离散程度衡量该评分标准对当前 rollouts 的区分能力，利用列间相关性识别评分标准的重复冗余，从而得到数据相关(data-dependent)的评分标准权重，并与先验权重结合。随后对矩阵做列归一化与加权，以各评分标准下观测到的最大值与最小值分别定义正、负理想剖面，再根据每个 rollout 到正负理想点的距离计算相对接近度，作为其质量奖励。

Result: 在四个开放式问答应答基准上，使用 Qwen3-8B 评估，MatrixReward 取得平均 63.02 分，比最强基线高出约 2.0%。

Conclusion: 实验表明，基于相对比较构造的矩阵能够比传统打分方式更合理地构造适用于开放式生成强化学习的奖励。

Abstract: Open-ended query generation lacks standard answers, thus necessitating an effective reward mechanism. Pointwise scoring rubrics provide limited information about the relative quality of sample answers under the same prompt; merging multiple rubric judgments into a single score may also mask the differences between these answers. We propose MatrixReward, which constructs rewards from a rollout-by-rubric win-rate matrix obtained by comparing every pair of sampled responses under each rubric. The spread of each matrix column captures how strongly that rubric distinguishes the current rollouts, while correlations between columns reveal rubric repetition; together, these statistics yield data-dependent rubric weights. We combine these weights with the prior weights of rubrics. After column normalization and weighting, the observed per-rubric maxima and minima define positive and negative ideal profiles. Each rollout's distances to these two ideals determine its relative-closeness quality reward. Evaluated using Qwen3-8B on four open-ended query-answering benchmarks, MatrixReward achieves an average score of 63.02, outperforming the strongest baseline by approximately 2.0%. These results support the idea that matrices derived from relative comparisons can be used to construct rewards more reasonably for open-ended generative reinforcement learning.

</details>


### [363] [Attention Manifolds: Steering or Blocking Language Models by Editing Learned B-Spline Surfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00257)
*Naveen Mysore*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"注意力流形"：可学习的2D B样条曲面S_d(q_d, k_d)，根据query-key交互调节每个value维度的提取，而不仅是注意力权重。在LLaMA 1B/3B上以0.3%参数开销降低困惑度2-2.5点，显著改变输出并提升质量，还具备可编辑性与安全导向的应用潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准transformer注意力中，一个源token向所有接收方发送相同的value向量，query只决定"关注多少"（权重），而不决定"提取什么"（内容）。作者认为这一限制阻碍了模型根据具体的query-key交互来动态调制所提取的信息，因此希望引入一种能按维度、依赖query-key关系来调制value的机制。

Method: 引入"注意力流形"：每个value维度d对应一个由query分量q_d与key分量k_d构成的张量积三次B样条曲面S_d(q_d,k_d)，用于调制该维度的value。所有曲面初始化为零以保持预训练行为不变。将该模块应用于LLaMA 3.2-1B-Instruct和3B-Instruct进行微调，参数开销仅0.3%。

Result: WikiText-2验证困惑度降低2-2.5点。在112个多样化prompt上，曲面改变了1B模型69%、3B模型83%的贪心解码输出，在歧义与多义词输入上改变率达94-100%。输出质量提升：纠正事实错误（CAP定理）、提高精确性（海森堡不确定性原理）、增加具体性（引用圣奥古斯丁）。曲面可机械编辑：反转某层系数可改变9/10个prompt的输出（KL~0.010）。将系数设为-1可形成"注意力墙"阻断特定维度的value流动，初步实验中层级墙将爆炸装置prompt从具体指令重定向为一般性教育内容。

Conclusion: 注意力流形以极小参数代价为注意力机制增加了query-key依赖的逐维度value调制能力，既能提升语言模型质量，又提供了可解释、可编辑的几何化模型控制接口，并初步展示了其在安全导向模型塑造方面的潜力。

Abstract: In standard transformer attention, a source token sends the same value vector to every receiver. The query determines \emph{how much} to attend but not \emph{what} to extract. This work introduces \textbf{attention manifolds}: learned 2D B-spline surfaces $S_d(q_d, k_d)$ that modulate each value dimension based on the query-key interaction. Each surface is a tensor-product cubic B-spline initialized to zero, preserving pretrained behavior. Applied to LLaMA 3.2-1B-Instruct and 3B-Instruct, attention manifolds reduce WikiText-2 validation perplexity by 2--2.5 points with 0.3\% parameter overhead. Across 112 diverse prompts, surfaces change greedy-decoded output for 69\% (1B) to 83\% (3B) of cases, with the strongest effects on ambiguous and polysemous inputs (94--100\% change rate). The surfaces improve output quality: correcting factual errors (\emph{``the CAP theorem has three main components''} $\to$ \emph{``it is impossible to guarantee all three''}), increasing precision (\emph{``impossible to know certain properties''} $\to$ \emph{``impossible to know both position and momentum''}), and adding specificity (a generic quote $\to$ an attributed Saint Augustine citation, consistently at both scales). The learned surfaces are also mechanically editable: inverting a layer's coefficients changes greedy output for 9/10 prompts (KL~0.010), providing a geometric mechanism for model steering. Setting surface coefficients to $-1$ creates ``attention walls'' that block value flow through specific dimensions. In a preliminary experiment, a layer-wide wall redirects an explosive-device prompt from specific instructions to general educational content, suggesting a path toward safety-oriented manifold shaping.

</details>


### [364] [RACE: Residual-Aware Test-Time Adaptation for Neighbor-Rich Time-Series Foundation Model Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00405)
*Hao-Nan Shi,Tong Wu,Chen-Cong Sun,Yuan Jiang,Han-Jia Ye,De-Chuan Zhan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 RACE（Residual-Aware Correction of Forecasting Errors），一个两阶段框架，在无需修改时序基础模型（TSFM）骨干的情况下，利用同域邻居历史序列的残差信息来校正预测误差，并在 CGM 和 Web/云负载两个领域上跨四个 TSFM 验证了效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TSFM 在预测任务上表现优异，但其逐序列推理方式不适合"邻居丰富"的预测场景（如 CGM 与 Web/云负载）。这些场景中历史序列共享有用结构但邻居并非同等相关，且不同 TSFM 与任务间的残差模式各异，直接微调或简单拼接检索序列都存在成本高、迁移性差、未验证邻居是否支持当前预测等问题。

Method: 作者将问题形式化为"测试时邻域缩放"（test-time neighborhood scaling），即不修改骨干而利用同域邻居证据。提出两阶段框架 RACE：先检索与查询兼容的邻居，将其残差对齐到查询尺度，并聚合一致证据得到无需训练的 RACE-TF 校正；完整 RACE 再使用一个轻量级、领域特定的门控（Gate）判断何时施加校正有益，且该训练工作流可跨 TSFM 骨干复用。

Result: 在四个 TSFM 上，RACE 在两个主要领域的全部三个领域聚合指标上均有提升，且在高误差查询上增益最大。在单领域内，基于一个 TSFM 训练的门控无需适配即可迁移到其他骨干，所产生的流水线在全部 72 项跨骨干指标对比中均优于匹配的冻结目标（基准）。

Conclusion: RACE 提供了一种可迁移、低成本且训练工作流可复用的测试时邻居校正方案，能在不修改任何 TSFM 骨干的前提下，利用同域历史邻居的残差证据持续提升预测性能，尤其惠及高误差查询。

Abstract: Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) perform strongly across forecasting tasks, but their per-series inference is ill-suited to neighbor-rich forecasting, where each query has access to related but nonidentical historical series. Continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) and Web/cloud workloads exemplify this setting: CGM trajectories share physiological patterns but vary across individuals, devices, and conditions, while Web/cloud workloads combine common operating regimes with non-stationarity, heavy tails, and bursts. These histories share useful structure, yet neighbors are not equally relevant. Existing methods either fine-tune TSFMs for each target domain, incurring additional costs and offering limited transferability across backbones, or append retrieved series without verifying whether they support the current forecast. The key challenges are conflicting residual evidence from neighboring series and residual patterns that vary across TSFMs and forecasting tasks. We formulate test-time neighborhood scaling: using same-domain neighbor evidence without modifying the backbone. We propose RACE (Residual-Aware Correction of Forecasting Errors), a two-stage framework for using historical neighbors. We first retrieve query-compatible neighbors, align their residuals to the query scale, and aggregate coherent evidence into the training-free RACE-TF correction. Full RACE then uses a lightweight, domain-specific Gate to determine when applying the correction is beneficial, with a reusable training workflow across TSFM backbones. Across four TSFMs, RACE improves all three domain-aggregate metrics on both primary domains, with the largest gains on high-error queries. Within each domain, a Gate trained on one TSFM transfers to other backbones without adaptation, and the resulting pipeline improves all 72 cross-backbone metric comparisons over the matched frozen targets.

</details>


### [365] [Large Language Bayes Is Not Reparameterisation-Invariant](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00265)
*Jian Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示大语言模型贝叶斯（LLB）方法对候选概率程序的加权取决于程序写法——证据下界（ELBO）不受重参数化不变性保护，导致同一测度被赋予不同权重，并论证等价程序检测的统计困境与验证式修正的必要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLB通过采样候选概率程序、运行近似推理并按指数化证据下界加权求平均来回答非正式建模问题，但其权重的合理性缺乏对"写法依赖性"的审视，可能引入系统性偏差。

Method: 作者分析log边际似然的重参数化不变性与证据下界的非不变性；在eight schools、不同似然族、维度与漏斗严重度上比较centered/non-centered写法、重要性加权与全协方差高斯后验匹配下的权重差异；利用Hilbert距离的尖锐界刻画模型后验与下游目标误差；并对六种语言模型的360个程序统计其centered写法占比、进行等价程序检测与自生成重参数化的验证。

Result: 同一测度在eight schools上权重差达6.1×，重要性加权降至2.2×，全协方差高斯匹配仍留1.9×（64维达8.9×）；跨设置差异最高31.9×且符号反转；能反转对八个自然竞争模型的贝叶斯因子；误差由证据下界不足的散布Δ经尖锐Hilbert距离界控制；六模型写法从0%到100% centered不等且模型内稳定；统计检测等价程序在实用样本量下会错误合并真不同的模型，而验证自生成重参数化可闭合窗口。

Conclusion: LLB的加权机制存在写法非不变性缺陷，影响模型后验与下游推断，无法仅靠重要性加权或后验匹配消除；需通过验证重参数化（而非统计检测）来闭合偏差窗口。

Abstract: Large Language Bayes (LLB) answers an informal modelling question by sampling candidate probabilistic programs from a language model, running approximate inference on each, and averaging them with weights proportional to an exponentiated evidence bound. We show that this weighting depends on how a model is written. The log marginal likelihood is invariant to reparameterisation; the evidence bound is not. On eight schools the centered and non-centered programs are the same measure to $5.7\times10^{-14}$, yet their weights differ by $6.1\times$; importance weighting reduces this only to $2.2\times$, and reproducing the inference LLB actually runs, a full-covariance Gaussian matched to the posterior moments, still leaves $1.9\times$ on eight schools and $8.9\times$ in $64$ dimensions. Across likelihood families, dimensions and funnel severities the discrepancy reaches $31.9\times$ and reverses sign, so no single writing is uniformly preferable. It inverts Bayes factors against eight natural competitors, and the induced error in the model posterior, and in any downstream target, is controlled by the spread $Δ$ of the bound shortfalls through a known sharp Hilbert-distance bound. Across $360$ programs from six language models the parameterisation written ranges from $0\%$ to $100\%$ centered and is stable within a model. Detecting equivalent programs statistically can falsely merge genuinely different models at practical sample budgets; verifying reparameterisations we generate ourselves cannot, and closes the window.

</details>


### [366] [VANDAM: Viewing a nucleotide sequence with DNA molecular priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00411)
*Jeremy Levy,Ariel Larey,Yury Nahshan,Raizy Kellerman,Elay Dahan,Amit Bleiweiss,Guy Leib,Omri Nayshool,Dan Ofer,Tal Zinger,Dan Dominissini,Gideon Rechavi,Marissa Wirth,Simon Lee,Dung Hoang,Noam D. Beckmann,Shane O'Connell,Nicole Bussola,Alexander W. Charney,Yoli Shavit,Nati Daniel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: VANDAM 是一个在基因组基础模型（GFM）训练中引入 DNA 分子先验的框架，通过自监督预测区域分子属性并在有功能标签时注入局部分子特征，显著提升了多种架构和下游基因组任务的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基因组基础模型将 DNA 视为字符串，采用掩码 token 预测目标进行预训练，但这一抽象缺失了对生物学功能至关重要的生化、结构和物理属性。作者认为，许多分子属性可通过成熟生物物理模型从序列估算，其价值不在于提供独立模态，而在于引入可供训练目标显式利用的先验，从而弥补字符串表征的不足。

Method: 提出 VANDAM 框架，将 DNA 分子先验融入 GFM 训练：在自监督训练阶段，从池化后的表征预测区域性分子属性；当存在功能标签且可奖励保留分子先验时，额外在输入处注入局部分子特征。该框架可兼容多个架构家族，并与基于 token 的目标形成互补。

Result: VANDAM 在四种架构家族和九个留出的基因组任务上一致提升了下游性能；探测实验表明，引入的分子先验能够泛化到其他未见过的分子属性。

Conclusion: 通过在 GFM 预训练中显式注入并预测 DNA 分子先验，VANDAM 弥补了纯 token 建模缺乏生化、结构及物理约束的缺陷，有效提升了下游任务表现，并展现出对未见分子属性的泛化能力，为更富生物学语义的基因组基础模型训练提供了方向。

Abstract: Contemporary Genomic Foundation Models (GFMs) rely on a DNA-as-a-string paradigm that employs masked token prediction objectives for pretraining. However, this abstraction does not explicitly model the biochemical, structural, and physical properties essential to biological function. Many molecular properties can be estimated from sequence using established biophysical models, so their utility lies not in providing an independent modality, but in introducing priors that training objectives can explicitly exploit. We introduce VANDAM, a framework that extends the training of GFMs with DNA molecular priors. In self-supervised training, VANDAM predicts regional molecular properties from pooled representations. When functional labels are available and can reward retaining molecular priors, local features are additionally injected at the input. VANDAM consistently improves downstream performance across four architecture families and nine held-out genomic tasks by complementing token-based objectives. Probing experiments further demonstrate that the use of molecular priors generalizes to other unseen molecular properties.

</details>


### [367] [MOVE: Multimodal Open-world Verification and Expansion for Graph Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00268)
*Zekai Chen,Jiayang Xing,Xun Wu,Miao Zhang,Xunkai Li,Kairui Yang,Zhengyu Wu,Xu Wang,Rong-Hua Li,Guoren Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 MOVE，一个多模态开放世界类别验证与扩展框架，通过联合多模态信息识别未知节点、用多模态 LLM 生成候选类别，并在多模态证据一致支持时才选择性扩展类别空间，平均性能提升 11.87%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态图学习面临部署后出现新类别的挑战，而模型使用固定标签空间训练。现有方法虽能检测未知节点并用 LLM 生成候选类别描述，但未判断现有类别是否不足以覆盖这些节点，也未验证生成类别是否可靠到足以扩展类别空间。

Method: MOVE 联合视觉 token、文本属性和图上下文识别无法归入现有类别的节点；利用多模态大语言模型生成候选类别；仅当候选类别得到多模态证据一致支持、且不会引入冗余类别时，才选择性地扩展类别空间。

Result: 实验表明，MOVE 在未知识别、开放域标注和下游图学习任务上平均提升 11.87%。

Conclusion: MOVE 通过多模态联合识别未知节点、生成并验证候选类别、选择性扩展类别空间，有效解决了开放世界多模态图学习中新类别涌现与冗余类别的问题，显著提升多项任务性能。

Abstract: Multimodal graph learning faces a fundamental challenge: new classes may emerge after deployment, while models are trained with a fixed label space. Existing approaches typically detect unknown nodes and use LLMs to generate candidate class descriptions, but they do not determine whether existing classes are insufficient to cover these nodes or whether a generated class is reliable enough to expand the class space. Our empirical study reveals three challenges: multimodal information beyond individual modalities is required for unknown-node identification, LLM-generated class descriptions may not fully capture multimodal class characteristics, and directly adding candidate classes can introduce redundant categories. Based on these observations, we propose MOVE, a multimodal open-world class verification and expansion framework. MOVE identifies nodes that cannot be assigned to existing classes by jointly considering visual tokens, textual attributes, and graph context, leverages a multimodal LLM to generate candidate classes, and selectively expands the class space only when candidates are consistently supported by multimodal evidence without introducing unnecessary categories. Experiments demonstrate that MOVE achieves an average improvement of 11.87\% across unknown recognition, open-domain annotation, and downstream graph learning tasks.

</details>


### [368] [IrekoGPT: Turning Structured Pruning into Post-Hoc Slimmable LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00426)
*Pietro Moriello,Pietro Buzzega,Angelo Porrello,Simone Calderara*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 IrekoGPT，一种将预训练大语言模型（LLM）转化为宽度可在推理时动态调整的「可瘦身（slimmable）」模型的后处理方法。它在 SliceGPT 基础上保留投影矩阵而不做剪枝，使单个模型能暴露不同宽度的嵌套子网络，并通过跨压缩比的逐层校准和梯度自由的岭回归校正下游线性层来提升鲁棒性。在 Llama 和 Qwen 系列上的初步结果显示其优于朴素 PCA 瘦身方法，尤其在高压缩率下收益最大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 剪枝/压缩方法（如 SliceGPT）通常产生固定宽度的单一模型，无法在推理时灵活调节计算量；且朴素 PCA 类瘦身方法在高压缩比下性能退化明显。作者希望在不重新训练的前提下，构建一个可动态切换宽度的模型，并提升高压缩率下的鲁棒性与精度。

Method: IrekoGPT 为后处理方法：1）在 SliceGPT 框架下保留各层的投影矩阵、不做剪枝，使单一模型暴露不同宽度的嵌套子网络；2）对每一层在多个压缩比下进行联合校准以增强鲁棒性；3）采用梯度自由的岭回归（ridge regression）来校正剪枝后的下游线性层，以补偿近似误差。

Result: 在 Llama 和 Qwen 系列模型上的初步实验表明，IrekoGPT 相比朴素的 PCA 瘦身方法整体更优，且在高压缩率（即宽度大幅缩减）时提升尤为显著。

Conclusion: IrekoGPT 提供了一种无需训练的、可动态调整宽度的 LLM 瘦身方案，通过保留投影矩阵、跨压缩比校准和岭回归校正，有效缓解了高压缩率下的性能损失。代码已开源。

Abstract: We introduce IrekoGPT, a post-hoc method for converting pretrained LLMs into slimmable models whose width can be adjusted at inference time. Building on SliceGPT, we retain its projection matrices without pruning them, allowing a single model to expose nested subnetworks at different widths. We improve robustness by calibrating each layer across multiple compression ratios, and correct downstream linear layers through gradient-free ridge regression. Across Llama and Qwen models, preliminary results show improvements over naive PCA-based slimming, with the largest gains at high compression. Code is available at https://github.com/aimagelab/IrekoGPT

</details>


### [369] [Coupling Perception and Reasoning in Federated Multimodal Graph Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00277)
*Zekai Chen,Xun Wu,Hailin Zhang,Xunkai Li,Yu Liu,Kairui Yang,Muyan Huang,Xuaner Chen,Rong-Hua Li,Guoren Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 FedCORE，一种联邦多模态图基础模型（GFM）适配框架，通过共享低维隐状态同时表示 Encoder 与 GNN 的更新，以解决两者独立适配导致的配对敏感性（pairing sensitivity）问题，从而在保护隐私的分散图数据上实现兼容的感知与推理协同适应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有联邦 GFM 适配方法主要只更新图侧模块（GNN）而冻结多模态 Encoder，即只调整"信息如何传播"却固定"提取什么信息"。作者通过经验研究发现 Encoder 与 GNN 的适配并不独立：Encoder 适配受图关系影响，且跨客户端的模块互换揭示出分别参数化的 Encoder 与 GNN 更新之间存在显著配对敏感性（pairing gap 高达 30.6）。

Method: 提出 FedCORE 框架：将 Encoder 与 GNN 的更新通过一个共享的低维隐状态（core）来表示；从多模态信号与结构信号联合优化该核心，并直接在共享状态空间中进行联邦演化（federated evolution），从而保证感知（Encoder）与推理（GNN）适配之间的兼容性。

Result: 大量实验表明，FedCORE 将 Encoder–GNN 配对差距（pairing gap）从 30.6 降至 5.9，相比独立联合适配实现了 80.7% 的降低。

Conclusion: 通过在共享低维隐状态空间中统一表示并联合优化 Encoder 与 GNN 的更新，FedCORE 有效缓解了联邦 GFM 适配中感知与推理模块的配对敏感性问题，显著缩小配对差距，验证了协同适配相比独立更新的优越性。

Abstract: Federated multimodal graph foundation models (GFMs) aim to adapt pretrained multimodal models to decentralized graph data, where each client owns a private multimodal graph and cannot share raw information. These models typically combine a multimodal Encoder that extracts semantic evidence from heterogeneous modalities and a graph neural network (GNN) that performs relational reasoning over graph structures. However, existing federated GFM adaptation methods mainly update graph-side modules while keeping the multimodal Encoder frozen, limiting adaptation to \emph{how information is propagated} while fixing \emph{what information is extracted}. Through empirical studies, we reveal that Encoder and GNN adaptations are not independent: Encoder adaptation is affected by graph relations, while cross-client module swapping reveals substantial pairing sensitivity between separately parameterized Encoder and GNN updates. Motivated by this observation, we propose \textbf{FedCORE}, a federated adaptation framework that represents Encoder and GNN updates through a shared low-dimensional latent state. FedCORE jointly optimizes this core from multimodal and structural signals and performs federated evolution directly in the shared state space, preserving compatibility between perception and reasoning adaptations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FedCORE reduces the Encoder--GNN pairing gap from $30.6$ to $5.9$, corresponding to an $80.7\%$ reduction over independent joint adaptation.

</details>


### [370] [Exact information accounting for SGD methods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00446)
*Akshay Balsubramani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对随机梯度下降（SGD）及其变体给出了一种精确的信息论分析，将预条件 SGD 步解释为高斯贝叶斯模型的后验均值更新，并将其单步遗憾分解为内在时间代价与比较器信息变化量之和。该拆分可推广为目标函数本身的恒等式，统一解释了凸收敛、鞍点逃逸、平坦度与泛化、学习率调度、自适应优化器以及噪声/动量/重尾/无梯度等变体的行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准几何分析难以统一刻画 SGD 及其众多变体的动力学与泛化行为，作者希望用一种精确而非近似的信息论框架，为 SGD 的收敛、逃逸、泛化与各种优化技巧提供统一解释。

Method: 将预条件 SGD 步骤建模为高斯贝叶斯模型的后验均值更新，推导单步遗憾的精确恒等式：遗憾 = 内在时间代价 + 比较器信息变化量；并将该拆分推广至目标函数本身。通过在合成与真实训练集上测量各项，验证恒等式并解释经典收敛界的松弛来源。

Result: 恒等式把凸收敛、严格鞍点逃逸、平坦度-泛化联系、标准学习率调度、自适应优化器及噪声/动量/重尾/无梯度变体分别对应为某一项或特例。在真实网络上，该恒等式将经典收敛界的松弛归因于其推导中被丢弃的项，并能根据步数及步的一致性区分达到相同训练损失的优化器；其与泛化优劣的关系因网络而异。对无梯度 SGD，恒等式决定了曲率预处理器应如何进入更新。由此得到的基于锐度的泛化证书，在数据无关的各向同性先验下，除非曲率谱在所有参数上近乎平坦，否则在网络规模上是空洞的。

Conclusion: 信息论恒等式为 SGD 及其变体提供了一个统一的精确分析框架，能揭示经典界松弛的成因并区分不同优化器；但其泛化证书的有效性受限于曲率谱结构，在真实网络尺度下通常不成立。

Abstract: As an alternative to the standard geometric analyses, we give an exact, information-theoretic analysis of stochastic gradient descent (SGD) and its variants. We show that a preconditioned SGD step is the posterior-mean update of a Gaussian Bayes model, and that its one-step regret splits into an intrinsic-time cost and a change in comparator information. The split extends to an identity for the objective itself. Convex convergence, strict-saddle-point escape, the link between flatness and generalization, the standard learning-rate schedules, adaptive optimizers, and the noisy, momentum, heavy-tailed, and gradient-free variants of SGD each correspond to a term or a special case of this identity. We measure its terms on synthetic and real training runs. On real networks it attributes the slack of classical convergence bounds to the terms their derivations drop and separates optimizers that reach the same training loss. That separation follows the number and consistency of their steps. Its relation to which of them generalizes better differs between networks. For gradient-free SGD the identity determines how a curvature preconditioner should enter the update. The sharpness-based generalization certificate it yields, with a data-independent isotropic prior, is vacuous at network scale unless the curvature spectrum is nearly flat across all parameters.

</details>


### [371] [Stable and Counterfactually Robust Physical World Models from Imposed Structure and Learned Physics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00280)
*Yufeng Wang,Parivesh Priye,Lu Wei,Haibin Ling*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究如何将最少的通用物理结构硬编码进世界模型，使模型能同时满足热力学第二定律相容的耗散、对物理参数干预的正确响应、百倍训练时长的长期稳定性，以及对扰动的鲁棒性，同时将系统特定的物理从数据中学习得到。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型通过模仿记录轨迹来预测物理系统演化，但由于物理定律未被完整提供也未被可靠遵守，模型可能出现能量凭空产生、长时间外推漂移或发散，并在回答改变后的物理定律查询时仍沿用训练时观察到的旧规律。作者旨在探究：需要向世界模型中硬编码多少通用物理结构，才能让模型在满足上述四个性质的同时，通过数据学习系统特定的物理知识。

Method: 所施加的物理结构是通用的：动力学由学习到的能量的梯度经一个固定的可逆算子生成；能量被限制在约束（confining）函数类中；一个单向端口只能移除能量而不能注入；驱动通道已知；被干预的参数通过可分离映射进入模型。模型需学习能量泛函、本构关系、耗散率和耦合。通过在电磁腔、粒子网格（PIC）和浅水流体三个物理系统上进行实验验证。

Result: 约九千参数的模型能够以单位斜率恢复本构函数；用同一组权重以四个数量级区分守恒世界和耗散世界；能够将符号、幅值、速率和重力等参数的改变迁移到未见过的数值，而同容量但缺乏该结构的模型表现仅为随机水平或更差。非线性本构关系被恢复时保留了其曲率特征，对留出干预的预测比收敛的线性模型好2–17倍。

Conclusion: 通过在结构中硬编码少量通用物理先验（梯度流生成、能量约束、单向耗散端口、已知驱动通道、可分离参数映射），并结合数据学习系统特定物理，可使世界模型同时满足耗散相容性、干预响应、长期稳定性和扰动鲁棒性四项性质，并展现出远超同容量无结构模型的泛化与迁移能力。

Abstract: A world model learns to forecast how a physical system evolves from recorded trajectories, yet the systems it imitates obey physical laws that are neither fully supplied nor reliably respected. The model may create energy, drift or diverge over long rollouts, and answer a changed law query using the law observed during training. We ask how much general physical structure must be hard coded into a world model, and how much system-specific physics can then be learned from data, for four properties to hold simultaneously: second law compatible dissipation, correct responses to interventions on physical parameters, stability out to one hundred times the training horizon, and robustness to disturbances. The imposed structure is general: dynamics are generated from the gradient of a learned energy through a fixed reversible operator, the energy is restricted to a confining class, a one way port can remove energy but never inject it, the drive channel is known, and the intervened parameter enters through a separable map. The model learns the energy functional, constitutive relations, dissipation rate, and couplings. Across an electromagnetic cavity, a particle in cell grid, and a shallow-water fluid, models with roughly nine thousand parameters recover constitutive functions with unit slope, separate conserving from dissipating worlds by four orders of magnitude using a single set of weights, and transfer changes in sign, magnitude, rate, and gravity to unseen values, where equal-capacity models without the same structure perform at chance or worse. A nonlinear constitutive law is recovered with its curvature preserved and predicts a held-out intervention $2$-$17\times$ better than a converged linear model.

</details>


### [372] [Grand Canonical Generators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00683)
*Andreas Burger,Malte Franke,Luka Mucko,Kjell Jorner,Alan Aspuru-Guzik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"巨正则生成器"(Grand Canonical Generators, GCG)，将玻尔兹曼生成器扩展到巨正则系综，实现可变粒子数体系的高效生成与采样。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有玻尔兹曼生成器(Boltzmann generators)主要局限于固定粒子数的正则系综，无法直接处理粒子数可变的体系（如吸附、相变、开放系统）。巨正则系综下的采样面临粒子数离散跳跃和高维配置空间耦合的挑战，因此需要一种能够同时生成粒子数和构型、且具备可处理似然的生成框架。

Method: 提出两种设计：其一，将可变尺寸的生成模型以化学势为条件，联合采样粒子数和构型；其二，将巨正则分布分解为"粒子数分布×对应正则玻尔兹曼密度"的因子化形式，其中正则部分可复用任意现有玻尔兹曼生成器，并把已知的化学势线性依赖解析地编码进去，从而得到可处理的似然，支持自归一化重要性采样(SNIS)。

Result: 在Lennard-Jones流体和沸石中甲烷吸附两个体系上，GCG能准确复现巨正则可观测量，展现出跨化学势的泛化能力，并可通过SNIS和巨正则蒙特卡洛(GCMC)进行校正。

Conclusion: GCG成功将玻尔兹曼生成器推广至巨正则系综，因子化设计兼具灵活性与解析可处理性，并通过实验验证了其准确性、泛化性及与重要性采样/GCMC结合的校正能力。

Abstract: We introduce Grand Canonical Generators (GCG), a generative framework that extends Boltzmann generators to the grand canonical ensemble. We present two designs. The first conditions a variable-size generative model on the chemical potential, sampling particle number and configuration jointly. The second factorizes the grand canonical distribution into a particle-number distribution and the corresponding canonical Boltzmann density. This factorized formulation can use any existing Boltzmann generator for the canonical component, encodes the known linear chemical-potential dependence analytically, and yields a tractable likelihood that supports self-normalized importance sampling (SNIS). Empirically, GCG accurately reproduces grand canonical observables on a Lennard--Jones fluid and methane adsorption in a zeolite, demonstrating generalization across chemical potentials and correction via SNIS and grand canonical Monte Carlo.

</details>


### [373] [Bellman-Certified Rounding for Sparse Policy Deployment in MDPs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00325)
*Zhaojun Peng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究在有限 MDP 中，将连续策略的行混合向量舍入为稀疏二元策略时，如何保证折扣回报的保留程度。通过 2d+2 次 Bellman 求解构造可复用包络，结合秩二有理表示与加权曲率积分，实现候选级与局部轨迹级紧致下界，显著提升舍入认证覆盖率并大幅降低界限与损失之比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续策略优化会把更新扩散到许多状态，但实际部署往往只允许少数完整的状态级改动。策略相关的访问分布使各行编辑相互耦合，而长时域又令全局曲率界过于保守，因而需要在不牺牲理论保证的前提下，为连续策略到稀疏二元策略的舍入提供紧致且有认证能力的折扣回报下界。

Method: 作者利用 2d+2 次 Bellman 求解构造可在舍入前支持统一界与候选特定界的可复用包络（envelopes）；对每次交换采用秩二有理表示，允许沿实际实现轨迹进行加权曲率积分，从而得到更紧的局部下界。文中还证明了在预算伸缩时线性维度依赖不可避免，且精确的全局曲率阈值判定是困难的。

Result: 在结构化测试集上，候选特定界将舍入前认证覆盖率从 48.2% 提升到 74.1%；在 γ=0.95 的耦合实例上，局部积分将界限与损失之比的中位数从 402.3 降至 2.08，显著逼近真实损失。

Conclusion: 通过可复用包络、秩二有理表示与加权曲率积分相结合，能够为连续策略到稀疏二元策略的舍入提供统计上紧致且可伸缩的保证；线性维度依赖与全局曲率阈值判定的困难性揭示了问题固有的计算极限，而候选特定与局部积分策略有效缓解了全局界的保守性。

Abstract: Continuous policy optimization may spread an update across many states, even when deployment permits only a few complete state-level changes. We study how much discounted return can be retained when continuous row mixtures are rounded to sparse binary policies in finite MDPs. Policy-dependent visitation couples the row edits, while long horizons make global curvature bounds conservative. From $2d+2$ Bellman solves, we derive reusable envelopes that support uniform and candidate-specific guarantees before rounding. A rank-two rational representation of each exchange further permits weighted curvature integration along the realized trajectory. We prove that linear dimension dependence is unavoidable when the budget scales, and that exact global curvature thresholding is hard. Candidate-specific bounds raise pre-rounding certification coverage from $48.2\%$ to $74.1\%$ on the structured suite. At $γ=0.95$, local integration lowers the median bound-to-loss ratio from $402.3$ to $2.08$ on coupled instances.

</details>


### [374] [Beyond Diagonal State Space Models: Exact Non-Abelian Group Tracking, Solvability Barriers, and Geometric Physical Manifolds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00329)
*Zeyu Jia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出非交换状态空间模型（NC-SSM）及其变体 SO(3)-SSM 与 Cayley-SSM，将状态转移提升到紧李群 SU(2)、SO(3)、SO(N)，克服传统对角 SSM 因转移矩阵可交换性导致的优化退化问题，在群跟踪、黎曼流形保持、文法/句法任务上取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有选择性状态空间模型（Mamba、S4D、LRU）受限于转移矩阵可交换性（A_t A_t' = A_t' A_t）以及可解仿射变换群（Aff_D 的导出长度 ≤ 2），在非可解单群（如 A_5）上因模拟非阿贝尔交换子所需的指数级电路仿真深度而遭遇严重优化退化，故需设计可表达非交换转移的 SSM。

Method: 提出 Non-Commutative State Space Models（NC-SSM），将状态转移提升到紧李群 SU(2)、SO(3) 及任意维 Cayley-SSM（SO(N)）。借助闭式 Euler-Rodrigues 映射与有理 Cayley 变换实现精确保范等距（||U_t|| = 1）。关键技术包括：纯 Hopf 纤维化 Bloch 投影读出（S^3/{±1} ≅ S^2 ≅ SO(3)）消除符号歧义；真四元数并行前缀扫描（T=2048 时 9.06x 加速）；Identity-Gated Lie SSM 消除稀疏句法相位漂移。

Result: 在 14 个实验基准上：(1) NC-SSM 在 S_3、D_4、Q_8 及单群 A_5 上实现 100% 跟踪，3 层深度对角基线仅 6.60%（p=8.81e-4）；(2) Cayley-SO(5)-SSM 突破 Klein 1884 年关于对称群 S_5 的上限（50.92% vs 对角线 5.25%，p=0.0015，方差比 SO(3) 降低 7.8 倍）；(3) SO(3)-SSM 在 300 步内保持黎曼流形（漂移 < 3.12e-6，优势 > 580,000 倍），达到 0.04 度航位推算误差及主动切空间去噪；(4) NC-SSM 在 Dyck-2 上达 74.36%，深层 AST 作用域跟踪达 30.26%（p=0.0081）；(5) 消融实验证实严格等距在无损长程联想记忆中是数学上必要的。

Conclusion: 通过将状态空间提升到非交换紧李群并保证严格等距，NC-SSM 有效突破了对角 SSM 的可交换性限制，显著改善了对非交换群结构与长程记忆的表达能力，证明了严格等距性对无损长程联想记忆的数学必要性。

Abstract: Selective state space models (SSMs), such as Mamba, S4D, and LRU, are bounded by transition matrix commutativity (A_t A_t' = A_t' A_t) and solvable affine transformation groups (Aff_D of derived length <= 2). Consequently, stacked multi-layer diagonal networks face severe optimization degradation on non-solvable simple groups such as A_5 due to the exponential circuit emulation depth required to simulate non-abelian commutators. We propose Non-Commutative State Space Models (NC-SSM), their real-orthogonal counterpart SO(3)-SSM, and arbitrary-dimension Cayley-SSM, lifting state transitions to compact Lie groups SU(2), SO(3), and SO(N). Via closed-form Euler-Rodrigues maps and rational Cayley transforms, NC-SSM achieves exact norm-preserving isometry (||U_t|| = 1). We introduce pure Hopf-fibration Bloch projective readouts (S^3/{+-1} =~ S^2 =~ SO(3)) to eliminate sign ambiguity, true quaternion parallel prefix scans (9.06x speedup at T=2048), and Identity-Gated Lie SSMs to eliminate sparse syntax phase drift. Extensive benchmarks across 14 experimental regimes show: (1) NC-SSM achieves 100% tracking on S_3, D_4, Q_8 and simple group A_5, where a 3-layer deep diagonal baseline collapses to 6.60% (p = 8.81e-4); (2) Cayley-SO(5)-SSM breaks Klein's 1884 ceiling on symmetric group S_5 (50.92% vs diagonal 5.25%, p = 0.0015, delivering 7.8x variance reduction over SO(3)); (3) SO(3)-SSM preserves Riemannian manifolds across 300 steps (< 3.12e-6 drift, > 580,000x advantage), achieving 0.04 deg dead-reckoning error and active tangent denoising; (4) NC-SSM achieves 74.36% on Dyck-2 and 30.26% on deep AST scope tracking (p = 0.0081); and (5) ablation confirms strict isometry is mathematically necessary for lossless long-range associative memory.

</details>


### [375] [The Weakest Link: Distilling LLM Reasoning with Worst-Case Constrained Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00332)
*Matthieu Zimmer,Xiaotong Ji,Tu Nguyen,Haitham Bou-Ammar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将推理蒸馏建模为受约束的强化学习问题：在最大化任务奖励的同时，对轨迹每个前缀上的教师对数似然施加最坏情况（worst-case）约束，从而避免学生模型通过"奖励黑客"或"步骤间补偿"来掩盖中间逻辑错误。作者通过构造无增广的约束MDP和低方差策略梯度分解，在数学推理与代码生成任务上扩充了准确率-忠实度的帕累托前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推理蒸馏方法面临两难：纯奖励优化（如GRPO）会导致奖励黑客——学生用错误中间逻辑得到正确答案；而用对教师的软散度正则（如KL蒸馏）会稀释任务性能，并且由于对步骤求平均，允许学生在某一步严重违反逻辑却用其他步的高教师一致性来补偿。作者认为这违背推理本质：思维链的有效性取决于其最薄弱的环节，因此需要逐前缀的最坏情况约束。

Method: 将推理蒸馏形式化为受约束强化学习：最大化任务奖励，同时约束轨迹每个前缀上的教师对数似然满足最坏情况下界。为避免对偶拉格朗日求解器的高成本以及状态增广方法（如Saute）在测试时依赖教师的问题，作者推导了一个无增广的约束MDP，其奖励变换保留硬约束语义，并给出低方差策略梯度分解（单步项与长期项），且在惩罚极限下几乎必然满足最坏情况约束。

Result: 在数学推理与代码生成任务上的大量实验表明，该方法显著扩展了准确率-忠实度的帕累托前沿：达到与纯RL相当的最终答案正确率，同时大幅降低对教师约束的违反，从而在所有评测设置中取得最高的严格推理成功率（Reasoning Success Rate）。

Conclusion: 作者论证了对教师一致性的平均化度量与推理本质不匹配，提出以逐前缀的最坏情况约束取代软散度正则，通过无增广约束MDP实现高效求解。实验证明该方法在保持高任务准确率的同时显著提升推理链的忠实度与正确性，实现了准确率-忠实度权衡的帕累托改进。

Abstract: Distilling the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) into smaller students is a central challenge for efficient deployment. Current approaches face a fundamental tension: optimizing purely for verifiable task rewards (e.g., via GRPO) leads to reward hacking, where students arrive at correct final answers through flawed intermediate logic, while regularizing with soft divergence penalties against a teacher (e.g., KL-based distillation) dilutes task performance and, critically, allows the student to compensate for severe logical violations at one step with high teacher agreement at others. We argue that this averaging is fundamentally misaligned with the nature of reasoning: a chain-of-thought is only as valid as its weakest link. Motivated by this observation, we formulate reasoning distillation as a constrained reinforcement learning problem in which the task reward is maximized subject to a worst-case constraint on the teacher log-likelihood along every prefix of the trajectory. To avoid the prohibitive cost of dual Lagrangian solvers and the test-time teacher dependence of state-augmented methods such as Saute, we derive an unaugmented constrained MDP whose reward transformation preserves the hard-constraint semantics, admits a low-variance policy gradient decomposition into single-step and long-term terms, and provably satisfies the worst-case constraint almost surely in the penalty limit. Through extensive experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation tasks, we demonstrate that our method significantly expands the accuracy-fidelity Pareto front. By matching the high Final Answer Correctness of pure RL and drastically reducing teacher constraint violations, we ultimately achieve the highest rigorous Reasoning Success Rate across all evaluated settings.

</details>


### [376] [Signal-Noise Factorization Isolates Nuisance Variation into Removable Subspaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00751)
*Sakin Kirti,Joel Zylberberg*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文构建了强化表示几何性质的两种正则化器（信号-噪声因式分解 SNF 与信号-信号因式分解 SSF），在 CIFAR-100 与 MedMNIST-C 腐蚀数据的 BloodMNIST 上测试。结果表明，增强 SNF 能显著提升模型性能（尤其在分布外腐蚀数据上），而增强 SSF 无效；机制在于 SNF 使噪声表征进入与类别信号分离的子空间，可被估计并投影移除，从而大幅提升准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期理论工作指出，深度网络的表示几何存在两个影响推理能力的基本性质：信号-噪声因式分解（SNF，即区分信号与噪声的能力）和信号-信号因式分解（SSF，即区分任务相关与任务无关信号的能力）。作者旨在探究能否通过显式正则化强化这两项性质，并理解其对表示几何及模型性能（尤其在存在分布外图像失真的计算机视觉与生物医学任务中）的影响。

Method: 作者设计了分别强化 SNF 和 SSF 两种性质的正则化器，并在 CIFAR-100 分类任务上与 L2 正则化的基线网络进行对比，考察正则化器如何塑造表示几何并影响基准性能。针对生物医学应用，进一步在经 MedMNIST-C 五种严重程度腐蚀处理的 BloodMNIST 数据集上评估性能。为揭示机制，作者在不同正则化条件下分析干扰（nuisance）子空间，并在留出数据上估计腐蚀主导方向并将其从表征中投影移除。

Result: 增强 SNF 能提升模型性能，而增强 SSF 未带来提升。在 MedMNIST-C 腐蚀的 BloodMNIST 上，SNF 正则化带来更大的性能增益。机制分析显示，SNF 正则化的模型将噪声表征在与类别相关信号相分离的独立子空间中；由于该几何结构是显式的，可在留出数据上估计主导腐蚀方向并将其投影移除，这一操作带来了显著的准确率提升。

Conclusion: 强制信号-噪声因式分解的正则化器能在推理时含有分布外图像失真的计算机视觉任务中带来实质性改进。研究还表明，塑造表征方式对性能的影响上，将干扰变量与类别变量隔离（SNF）比维持类别变量的因式分解表征（SSF）更为重要。

Abstract: Recent theoretical work identified fundamental properties of representation geometry that shape inference ability of deep neural networks. These include signal-noise factorization (SNF), the ability to segregate signal from noise, and signal-signal factorization (SSF), the ability to segregate task-specific and task-irrelevant signals. Here, we built regularizers that reinforce these two properties during training. We compared networks trained with these regularizers to $L_2$-regularized baseline networks on the CIFAR-100 classification task to understand how our regularizers shape representation geometry and impact performance on a well-known computer vision baseline. Enhancing SNF via regularization improved model performance but enhancing SSF did not. Motivated by biomedical applications, we investigated how our regularizers affected performance on the BloodMNIST dataset treated with MedMNIST-C corruptions at five severity levels, and found even larger performance gains using the SNF regularizer. To understand the mechanism by which SNF-regularization produces improved performance, we analyzed the nuisance subspaces across regularization regimes, finding that the SNF-regularized models represent noise in distinct subspaces, separate from class-relevant signal. Because this geometry is explicit, the dominant corruption-induced directions can be estimated on held-out data and projected out of the representations. This manipulation led to a substantial gain in accuracy. These results show that regularizers that enforce signal-noise factorization can produce substantial improvements on computer vision tasks that contain out-of-distribution image distortions at inference time. They also highlight how shaping representations affects model performance: isolating nuisance variables from categorical ones is more important than maintaining factorized representations of categorical variables.

</details>


### [377] [Benchmarking System One decision models against trained classifiers and language models for automated decision gates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00346)
*Amir Rafe,Subasish Das*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统评测了打字决策模型（System One 模型）与监督分类器、生成式语言模型在自动化决策门控任务上的表现，并给出随条件变化的模型选型设计规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化决策系统中需要模型直接给出可设阈值的选项概率，而无需生成文本；打字决策模型正是为此设计，但其与监督分类器、生成式模型的相对优劣在不同条件下尚缺乏系统性比较。

Method: 在受控匹配条件下，对一个统一评测框架中的八个决策模型检查点（来自六个模型家族，含托管模型 Jev）与两个生成式对照模型发送相同语义请求，并在相同的工作流、意图和社会科学数据集上评测监督分类器与零样本分类器。

Result: 不同模型类别的排序取决于条件：有任务标签时，小规模训练分类器在意图任务上最准确，在工作流上与最佳决策模型无显著差异；无标签时，除编码器类检查点外，所有决策模型在工作流和意图上均超过零样本蕴含分类器。通过选项键似然读取时，更大的生成模型在工作流和意图上与 Jev 持平，并在 5% 风险下接受更多工作流决策；微调后的决策检查点相比未调优主干获得意图准确率提升。在少量选项上拟合的存储温度在选项多时增大校准误差；以 5% 域内风险设定的保留阈值下，Jev 仍接受 0.310 的域外请求。交换 yes/no 时 Jev 每百项翻转 50.5 个答案，而微调检查点降低了主干模型的社会科学翻转。意图训练的第一阶段升级到 Jev 的级联方案，在满 GPU 利用率下以 0.43 的成本达到同等准确率。

Conclusion: 实验结果形成了随条件变化的自动化决策门控设计规则：有标签时优先使用小规模训练分类器，无标签时优先使用决策模型（编码器类除外），并可用级联架构在保持精度的同时显著降低推理成本。

Abstract: Software that hands branching decisions to a model needs a declared option and a probability it can threshold. Typed decision models, also called System One models, return such probabilities without generating text, while supervised classifiers and generative language models are the established alternatives. Under matched conditions, one harness sends eight decision-model checkpoints from six families, including the hosted model Jev, and two generative comparators the same semantic requests, and scores supervised and zero-shot classifiers on the same workflow, intent and social-science items. The ranking of the model classes depends on the conditions. With the task's own labels, small trained classifiers are the most accurate on intents and not significantly different from the best decision models on workflows. Without labels, every decision model except the encoder-based checkpoints exceeds a zero-shot entailment classifier on workflows and intents. Read through option-key likelihoods, a larger generative model is level with Jev on workflows and intents and accepts more workflow decisions at five percent risk, and fine-tuned decision checkpoints gain intent accuracy over their untuned backbones. Stored temperatures fitted on few options raise calibration error with many options, and a held-out threshold for five percent in-scope risk still lets Jev accept 0.310 of out-of-scope requests. Swapping yes and no flips 50.5 answers per hundred for Jev, while fine-tuned checkpoints cut their backbones' social-science flips. An intent-trained first stage escalating to Jev matches its accuracy at 0.43 of its cost at full graphics-processor utilization. The results yield condition-dependent design rules for automated decision gates.

</details>


### [378] [Scalable Multi-Task Inverse Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00758)
*Allen Tran,Jia Wan,Nathan Kallus,Aurélien Bibaut*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种多任务逆强化学习方法，在同一环境、不同奖励的多智能体数据上利用低秩假设进行池化学习，从而缓解覆盖要求、实现对新环境下多任务的可扩展评估，并给出有限样本保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 逆强化学习通过迁移奖励实现修改环境下智能体的反事实评估，但目标环境改变智能体的状态占用，对数据覆盖提出严格要求。为缓解覆盖不足问题，并实现对多任务在新环境下可扩展、低计算成本的评估，需要利用多任务之间的结构化信息。

Method: 提出一种多任务逆强化学习方法：在同一环境中收集具有不同奖励的多个智能体的数据，并在低秩假设下对这些数据进行联合（池化）学习。低秩结构使得奖励恢复与策略规划的计算复杂度随秩而非任务数量增长。

Result: 提供了奖励恢复与在新环境中策略学习的有限样本保证；实验表明该方法对有限覆盖具有鲁棒性，能在各任务支持集内外恢复奖励，迁移到目标环境的后悔值低于基线方法，且随任务数增加，相对逐任务方法的计算优势更加明显。

Conclusion: 通过低秩假设下的多任务数据池化，该方法有效缓解了逆强化学习的覆盖限制，并以与秩成正比的低计算成本实现了新环境下多任务的可扩展评估，具备理论与实验双重支持。

Abstract: By learning transferable rewards, inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) enables counterfactual evaluation of agents under modified environments. Such transfer places strict requirements on coverage since target environments affect agents' state occupancy. We propose a multi-task IRL method that pools data across multiple agents with different rewards in the same environment under a low-rank assumption. In addition to alleviating coverage requirements, so each task need not visit every state as long as others do, the method offers scalable evaluation of multiple tasks under new environments as computationally intensive planning scales with rank rather than the number of tasks. We provide finite sample guarantees on reward recovery and on policy learning in new environments. Experiments show our method is robust to limited coverage, recovers rewards on and off of each task's support, transfers to target environments at lower regret than baselines, with its computational advantage over per-task methods widening as tasks grow.

</details>


### [379] [Deep Learning for Anomaly Detection in Railway Systems: A Structured Survey](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00363)
*Ammar Bouketta,Smail Niar,Hamza Ouarnoughi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统综述了基于深度学习的铁路异常检测方法，提出了统一分类体系，梳理了各类网络架构与学习范式，并讨论了数据挑战、评估实践与部署问题，最终给出面向决策的选型框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代铁路系统安全可靠运行日益依赖数据驱动的监测与智能故障检测。随着车辆与基础设施多源异构传感器数据快速增长，深度学习成为铁路异常检测的有效范式，但现有研究缺乏系统的组织与统一视角，需要结构化的综述来梳理方法、明确挑战并指导选择与部署。

Method: 本文采用结构化综述方法，提出一个统一分类体系（taxonomy），从异常位置、数据表示与表现形式、传感模态、时间特性四个维度组织已有方法；将卷积、循环、注意力架构、自编码器、生成对抗网络及Transformer等方法归入基于分类、预测、重构及混合式四类学习范式；并系统考察数据层面挑战、评估实践、性能指标与工程化部署（边缘-云架构、计算约束、硬件感知优化）。

Result: 综述构建了覆盖异常特性、数据属性与运行约束的决策导向框架，将各类深度学习检测范式与具体部署配置相匹配，形成从方法选型到落地部署的结构化参考，并指出了向可靠、可扩展智能监测系统演进中的开放挑战。

Conclusion: 论文为铁路异常检测的深度学习方案选择与部署提供了结构化参考，强调需结合异常特征、数据特点和运行约束来匹配检测范式与部署架构，并指出了实现可靠、可扩展智能监测系统仍需解决的开放问题。

Abstract: Ensuring safe and reliable operation of modern railway systems increasingly relies on data-driven monitoring and intelligent fault detection. Deep learning has emerged as an effective paradigm for railway anomaly detection, driven by the growing availability of heterogeneous sensor data from rolling stock and infrastructure. This paper presents a structured survey of deep learning-based anomaly detection approaches for railway systems. The surveyed methods are organized using a unified taxonomy covering anomaly location, data representation and manifestation, sensing modality, and temporal characteristics. Existing approaches, including convolutional, recurrent and attention-based architectures, autoencoders, generative adversarial networks, and transformers, are structured into classification-based, prediction-based, reconstruction-based, and hybrid learning paradigms. The survey also examines data-centric challenges, evaluation practices, performance metrics, and practical deployment aspects, including edge-cloud architectures, computational constraints, and hardware-aware optimization. Finally, a decision-oriented framework links anomaly characteristics, data properties, and operational constraints to suitable detection paradigms and deployment configurations. This work provides a structured reference for selecting and deploying deep learning solutions for railway anomaly detection and highlights open challenges toward reliable and scalable intelligent monitoring systems.

</details>


### [380] [Manifold-Constrained Initial Noise Optimization for Efficient Generative Model Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00365)
*Jinho Chang,Jong Chul Ye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ZeNOVA 是一种稳定且高效的零阶（无梯度）初始噪声对齐方法，通过退火软值引导、流形约束的超球面 Langevin 动力学和 Metropolis-Hastings 跳跃，在图像与视频生成模型上显著优于所有对比的零阶基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蒸馏与 flow-map 模型已能实现一步或几步的高质量确定性生成，催生出直接优化高斯初始噪声的奖励对齐分支。但现有初始噪声优化方法大多依赖一阶梯度信息，在奖励函数为黑盒（无法求梯度）的场景下不可用、不稳定或低效，因此需要一种无梯度的稳定高效方法。

Method: 提出 ZeNOVA，在梯度无关（零阶）框架下解决黑盒奖励下的初始噪声对齐问题，核心包括三个组件：1）退火软值引导（annealed soft-value guidance），缓解黑盒场景中算法的核心困难；2）流形约束的超球面 Langevin 动力学，利用高斯先验的几何结构优化噪声；3）Metropolis-Hastings 跳跃，保证采样的正确性与稳定性。

Result: 在图像和视频生成模型上的大量实验表明，ZeNOVA 在将初始噪声优化到更高奖励方面显著优于所有评估的零阶基线方法，且更为稳定，同时充分挖掘了高斯先验的几何特性。

Conclusion: ZeNOVA 证明了其作为一种梯度无关的初始噪声对齐方法，在各种黑盒奖励对齐任务中具有实用适用性，为黑盒场景下的奖励对齐提供了稳定、高效的解决方案。

Abstract: Recent advances in distillation and flow-map models have enabled deterministic one- or few-step generation for high-quality data, facilitating a new branch of reward alignment approaches that directly optimize the initial noise from a Gaussian distribution. However, most existing initial-noise optimization methods rely on first-order gradient information, which is either inapplicable or suffers from instability and inefficiency in black-box reward scenarios. Here, we introduce ZeNOVA, a stable and efficient initial noise alignment method in a gradient-free manner. Specifically, we address existing algorithms' major challenge in black-box scenarios through annealed soft-value guidance, manifold-constrained hyperspherical Langevin dynamics, and Metropolis-Hastings jumping. Extensive experiments on image and video generative models show that ZeNOVA outperforms all evaluated zeroth-order baselines by optimizing the initial noise toward higher rewards substantially more stably while exploiting the geometry of the Gaussian prior, demonstrating its practical applicability to various black-box reward alignment.

</details>


### [381] [Platonic Task Arithmetic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00929)
*Junghwan Park,Woojin Cho*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对跨架构模型间无法进行权重空间任务算术的问题，基于柏拉图的洞穴寓言提出"柏拉图式任务向量"假说，并引入"通用任务描述符"（Universal Task Descriptors）这一与架构和嵌入维度无关的矩阵对象，通过线性算子与低秩适配两种方式实现跨异构模型的任务知识迁移与组合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 专精于同一任务的模型会收敛到相似行为，但其参数更新缺乏统一的坐标系，导致权重空间的任务算术只能局限于单一模型内部，无法在没有结构对应关系的跨架构模型间通用。作者希望找出模型特定更新背后共享的、与模型无关的底层对象，并使之可操作。

Method: 作者借鉴柏拉图洞穴寓言，假设模型特定更新是某个共享的、模型无关对象（柏拉图式任务向量）的"影子"。针对图像/音频编码器与文本编码器配对的模型，提出通用任务描述符：形状与架构和嵌入维度无关的矩阵，通过任务的未标注探针图像和类名提示记录任务的功能效应，并支持以矩阵运算实现加法与取反。将描述符迁移到目标模型即通过编辑目标模型使其在探针数据上重现该描述符。具体实现两种方式：（1）描述符分解为图像嵌入上的位移场，通过单次最小二乘求解得到线性算子，折叠进目标模型最后一层作为权重编辑，借助线性性，算子库可通过带符号求和实现任意组合与强度；（2）在相同目标上训练低秩适配器，可达各层并联合拟合组合，代价是每次编辑需一次优化。

Result: 异构模型仅部分共享该对象，模型特定残差的范数与共享分量相当，但跨模型迁移仍保留了目标模型自身描述符增益的74-80%。在六个模型家族、八个分类任务及一个音频-文本设置上的实验表明，两种实现方式下任务知识都能跨异构模型迁移与组合。

Conclusion: 通用任务描述符作为模型无关的任务功能表示，通过线性权重编辑和低秩适配两种方式，成功实现了任务知识在异构模型间的迁移与组合，验证了"柏拉图式任务向量"假说的可行性。

Abstract: Models specialized for the same task converge to similar behavior, yet the parameter updates that produce it share no common coordinate system, so weight-space task arithmetic stays confined to a single model and cannot cross architectures without a structural correspondence. Drawing on Plato's allegory of the cave, we hypothesize that these model-specific updates are shadows of one shared, model-agnostic object, which we call the platonic task vector. To make it operational for models that pair an image or audio encoder with a text encoder, we introduce Universal Task Descriptors: matrices whose shape is independent of architecture and embedding dimension, which record a task's functional effect and support addition and negation as matrix operations. Transferring a descriptor into a target means editing the target until it reproduces the descriptor on the task's unlabeled probe images and class-name prompts, requiring no per-image labels. We realize this edit in two ways.
